bibl.title: ﻿Śrīmad Vṛddhavāgbhaṭaviracitaḥ Aṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahaḥ Induvyākhyāsahitaḥ
bibl.publisher: Śa. He. Gurjara at the Āyurvidyā Mudraṇālaya
bibl.note: This machine-readable file omits the commentary of Indu that is printed in this edition.

lg.l: rāgādirogāḥ sahajāḥ samūlā yenā 'śu sarve jagato 'py apāstāḥ |
tam ekavaidyaṃ śirasā namāmi vaidyāgamajñāṃś ca pitāmahādīn ||

div2.p: athāta āyuṣkāmīyaṃ nāmādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha smā+āhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ ||

lg.l: dadau dakṣāya so 'śvibhyāṃ tau śatakratave tataḥ ||
gatam aṣṭāṅgatāṃ puṇyaṃ bubudhe yaṃ pitāmahaḥ |
gṛhītvā te tam āmrāyaṃ prakāśya ca parasparam ||
svaṃ svaṃ tantraṃ tatas te 'pi cakrus tāni kṛtāni ca |
taiḥ praśastāni tāny eṣāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ bhuvi lebhire |
bhavaty adhyayanenaiva yasmāt proktaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
tantrakāraiḥ sa eva 'rthaḥ kvacit kścid viśeṣataḥ |
na mātrāmātram apy atra kiccid āgamavarjitam |
te 'rthāḥ sa granthabandhaś ca saṅkṣepāya kramo 'nyathā ||
vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaś ceti trayo doṣāḥ samāsataḥ |
vikṛtā 'vikṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te varttayanti ca ||
tair bhaved viṣamas tīkṣṇo mandaś cāgniḥ samaiḥ samaḥ |
koṣṭhaḥ krūro mṛdur madhyo madhyaḥ syāt taiḥ samair api ||
taiś ca tisraḥ prakṛtayo hīnamadhyottamāḥ pṛthak ||
tatra rūkṣo laghu śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaś calo 'nilaḥ ||
pittaṃ sasnehatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ laghu visraṃ saraṃ dravam |
snigdhaḥ śīto gurur mandaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛtsnaḥ sthiraḥ ||
tajjān ity upacāreṇa tān āhur ghṛtadāhavat ||
garbhotpādaś ca karmāṇi dhātūnāṃ kramaśo viduḥ ||
śarīraṃ dhārayanty ete dhātvāhāraś ca sarvadā |
ṣaḍ dravyam āśritās te ca yathāpūrvaṃ balāvahāḥ ||
śamanaṃ kopanaṃ svasthahitaṃ dravyam iti tridhā |
indriyārthā vyavāyī ca vikāṣī cāpare guṇāḥ ||
vyavāyī deham akhilaṃ vyāpya pākāya kalpate |
sattvaṃ rajas tamaś ceti trayaḥ proktā mahāguṇāḥ ||
rajas tamaś ca manaso dvau ca doṣav udāhṛtau ||
śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ ceti samāsād auṣadhaṃ dvidhā |
vastir vireko vamanaṃ tathā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu |
vamau madātyaye 'rśassu viśi dvau dvau ca mūtrite ||
snāne pṛthag grahe bhūte dvāv unmāde smṛtikṣaye ||
mūrdhni vraṇe tathā dvau dvau sadyobhaṅge bhagandare |
viṣe dvau bhujage kīṭe dvau ca lūtāsu mūṣike |
pañcadaśyām acandrāyāṃ parokṣe vā guroḥ paṭhet |
na brūyāt kevalaṃ nāma nā 'sādhv api vināṭayet |
anāthān rogiṇo yaś ca putravat samupācaret ||
sa muhyaty āturaṃ prāpya prāpya bhīrur ivāhavam |
yaḥ punaḥ kurute karma dhārṣṭyāc chāstravivarjjitaḥ ||
sa satsu garhām āpneti vadhaṃ carcchati rājataḥ |
jñānaṃ caturvidhaṃ yasya sa rājārho bhiṣaktamaḥ |
pradīpabhūtaṃ śāstraṃ hi darśanaṃ vipulā matiḥ ||
āhūta eva yo yāti suveṣaḥ sunimittataḥ ||
gatvā 'turārthād anyatra na nidhatte manaḥ kvacit |
hrepaṇīyāṃ ca tadvāarttāṃ na prakāśayate bahiḥ |
sahasā na ca tasyāpi kriyākālam ahāpayan ||
jānāti copacarituṃ sa vaidyaḥ siddhim aśnute |
tābhiś ca rahasi sthānaṃ parihāsaṃ ca varjayet |
ārttaṃ ca nṛpasadvaidyair dviṣṭaṃ tadveṣiṇaṃ dviṣam ||
kriyāvikrayiṇo vaidyān mṛtyor agresarā hi te ||
āḍhyo rogī bhiṣagvaśyo jñāpakaḥ satvavān api ||
yad vaidye viguṇe pādā guṇavanto 'py anarthakāḥ |
sa pādahīnān apy ārtān guṇavān yac ca yāpayet ||
cikitsāyās tam evātaḥ pradhānaṃ kāraṇaṃ viduḥ |
sādhyo 'sādhya iti vyādhir dvidhā tau tu punar dvidhā ||
susādhyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaś ca yāpyo yaś cānupakramaḥ |
kṛcchrair upāyaiḥ kṛcchras tu mahadbhiś ca cireṇa ca |
śeṣatvād āyuṣaḥ pathyair yāpyaḥ prāyo viparyaye |
datvā 'lpaṃ sukham alpena hetunā sa pratanyate ||
vyādhīn purā parīkṣyaivam ārabheta tataḥ kriyām ||
sādhyayor api saṃyogo balinor yāty asādhyatām ||
nāsādhyaḥ sādhyatāṃ yāti sādhyo yāti tv asādhyatām ||
pādāpacārād daivāc ca yānty avasthāntaraṃ gadāḥ |
varam āśīviṣaviṣaṃ dīptam agnim ayo 'pi vā ||
upayuñjīta na tv ārttād āmiṣaṃ kṛpaṇāj janāt |
varo bhūtadayā dharma ity ārtteṣu bhiṣagvaraḥ ||
varttate yas tu siddhārthaḥ sa sarvam ativarttate ||
pravarttayet pracalitaṃ na tu yatnād udīrayet |
na cātiraskṛtya mahīṃ bhayāśaktyos tu kāmataḥ |
abhyuddhṛtābhiḥ śucibhir adbhir mṛdbhiś ca yojayet ||
snātvā bhoktumanā bhuktvā suptvā kṣutvā surārccane |
prāṅmukho vā viviktastho na bahirjānu nānyadṛk |
noddhṛtair nānato nordhvaṃ nāgnipakvair nna pūtibhiḥ |
prātar bhuktvā ca yatavāg bhakṣayed dantadhāvanam |
śanais tena tato dantān dantamāṃsāny abādhayan |
dantān pūrvam adho gharṣet prātaḥ siñcec ca locanaṃ |
praṇamya devān vṛddhāṃś ca maṅgalāṣṭaśataṃ śubham |
sauvīram añjanaṃ nityaṃ hitam akṣṇos tato bhajet |
vāso na dhārayej jīrṇaṃ malinaṃ raktam ulbaṇam ||
mālyaṃ na lambaṃ na bahir na raktaṃ jalajāddate |
naiva cānyena vidhṛtaṃ vastraṃ puṣpam upānahau ||
pathyaṃ suptotthite bhukte snāte vānte ca mānave ||
dvipatraṃ ekaṃ pūgaṃ ca sacūrṇakhadiraṃ ca tat |
kṛṣiṃ vāṇijyāṃ gorakṣām upāyair guṇinaṃ nṛpam ||
niśi cātyayike kārye daṇḍī maulī sahāyavān |
prāvṛtya paryaṭed rātrau na prāvṛtya śiro 'hani ||
na seveta na śarvaryāṃ vṛkṣacaityaṃ na catvaram ||
na huṃkuryāc chavaṃ pūjyaṃ praśastān maṅgalāni ca ||
na cchinnapucchair naikākṣaigāpṛṣṭhena ca na vrajet ||
na śatruṇā nāviditair naiko nādhārmikaiḥ saha |
nadīṃ taren na bāhubhyāṃ nāgniskandham abhivrajet ||
nā 'rohod viṣamaṃ śailaṃ nāvaṃ saṃśayitāṃ tarum |
nipātayen na loṣṭena na phalena phalaṃ drumāt ||
na vāryamāṇaḥ praviśen nādvāreṇa nā ca+āsane |
svayaṃ tiṣṭhet paragṛhe yuktaniṃdraṃ na bodhayet ||
na svahastena dantair vā snānaṃ cānu samācaret |
tvacyaś ca param abhyaṅgo yasmāt taṃ śīlayed ataḥ ||
vātapittāmayī bālo vṛddho 'jīrṇī ca taṃ tyajet ||
śītakāle vasante ca mandam eva tato 'nyadā ||
taṃ kṛtvā 'nusukhaṃ dehaṃ marddayec ca samantataḥ |
tṛṣṇā kṣayaḥ pratamako raktapittaṃ śramaḥ klamaḥ ||
ativyāyāmataḥ kāso jvaraś cchardiś ca jāyate |
gajaṃ siṃha iva+ākarṣan bhajann ati vinaśyati |
nā 'nāplutya śiraḥ snāyān na jale 'lpe na śītale ||
nātmānam īkṣeta jale na taṭastho jalāśayam |
na pratisphālayed ambu pāṇinā caraṇena vā ||
snātvā na mṛjyāt gātrāṇi dhunuyān na śiroruhān |
na tv ambaraṃ pūrvadhṛtaṃ na ca tailavase spṛśet |
abhinandya prasannātmā hutvā datvā ca śaktitaḥ ||
prayacchet sarvam uddiśya pācayen nā 'nnam ātmane ||
notsaṅge bhakṣayet bhakṣyān jalaṃ nāñjalinā pibet ||
sarvañ ca tilasambaddhaṃ nā 'dyād astamite ravau |
na bhuktamātra āsyen na niṣiddhaṃ bhajet sukhaṃ ||
śrutād anyatra santuṣṭas tatraiva ca kutūhalī |
dātā pitṛbhyaḥ piṇḍasya yaṣṭā hotā kṛpātmakaḥ |
dharmyam arthyaṃ priyaṃ tathyaṃ mitaṃ pathyaṃ vaded vacaḥ ||
nā+ātmānam avajānīyān na stūyān na ca pīḍayet |
nā 'runtudaḥ syān na krūro na tīkṣṇo no 'patāpavān |
hetāv īrṣyen na tu phale pāpaṃ pāpe 'pi nācaret ||
parasya daṇḍaṃ nodyacchet kruddho nainaṃ nipātayet |
na kuryān mithunībhūya śaucaṃ prati vilambanam ||
vahen na bhāraṃ śirasā yugapac cāgnivāhiṇī |
nāsikāṃ na vikuṣṇīyād daśanān na vighaṭṭayet ||
pādaṃ pādena nā 'krāmen na kaṇḍūyen na śaucayet ||
na kāṃsyabhājane tau ca nopaviṣṭaḥ prasādhayet |
nā 'nuvātaṃ na vivṛto na klānto nā 'nyamānasaḥ ||
dhamen nā 'syena na skanden nā 'dhaḥ kuryān na pādataḥ |
nāpraśastaṃ na viṇmūtraṃ na darpaṇam amārjitam |
uparaktaṃ ca bhāsvantaṃ vāsasā vā tirohitam |
nā 'nyad apy atitejasvi na kruddhabhya guror mukham ||
striyaṃ stravantīṃ nodakyāṃ na nagnāṃ nā 'nyasaṅgatām |
śayīta naikaśayane na cāśnīyās tayā saha |
tām anīrṣyaṃś ca gopāyet svairiṇīṃ nādhivāsayet ||
paśyen na yāyān na paṭhen na svapyān na spṛśechiraḥ ||
pāyayantīṃ carantīṃ vā nānyasmai gāṃ nivedayet |
nānyad devārcane karma kuryād dhāven na varṣati |
tithiṃ pakṣasya na brūyāt nakṣatrāṇi na nirdiśet ||
prakāśayen nāvamānaṃ na ca niḥsneatāṃ prabhoḥ ||
na deśaṃ vyādhibahulaṃ nāvaidyaṃ nāpy anāyakam |
daśa karmapatān rakṣan jayann abhyantarān arīn |
sāyaṃ bhuktvā laghu hitaṃ samāhitamanāḥ śuciḥ ||
ādadīta sadā dehād itthaṃ sāram asārataḥ |
sukham āyur hitaṃ coktaṃ viparītaṃ viparyaye ||
sarvatejonidhānaṃ hi nṛpa ity ucyate bhuvi |
adūṣayan manas tasmāt bhaktimāṃs tam upācaret ||
sarvāḥ prakṛtyabhyadhikāś ca ceṣṭās tatsannidhāne parivarjayet tu ||
satvādyavasthā vividhāś ca tās tāḥ samyak samīkṣyā+ātmahitaṃ vidadhyāt |
anyo 'pi yaḥ kaścid ihā 'sti mārgo hitopadeśeṣu bhajeta taṃ ca ||
iti caritam upetaḥ sarvajīvopajīvyaṃ prathitapṛthuguṇaudho rakṣito devatābhiḥ |
samadhikaśatajīvī nirvṛtaḥ puṇyakarmā vrajati sugatinimno dehabhede 'pi tuṣṭim ||

div2.p: kālo hi nāma bhagavān anādinidhano yathopacitakarmānusārī |
yadanurodhād ādityādayaḥ khādayaś ca mahābhūtaviśeṣās tathā tathā vipariṇamanto janmavatāṃ janmamaraṇasyarturasavīryadopadehabalavyāpatsaṃ padāṃ ca kāraṇatvaṃ patyayatāṃ pratipadyante ||

tatrākṣinimeṣo māntrā tāḥ pañcadaśa kāṣṭhā tās triṃśat kalā tāḥ sadaśabhāgā viṃśatir nāḍikā nāḍikādvayaṃ muhūrtaś ca te tulyarātrindive rāśibhāge catvāraḥ pādonā yāmaḥ taiś caturbhir aho rātriś ca pañcadaśāhorātrāḥ pakṣaḥ pakṣadvayaṃ māsaḥ sa śuklāntaḥ tair mārgaśīrṣādibhir dvisaṃkhyaiḥ kramād dhemantaśiśiravasantagrīṣmavarṣaśaradākhyāḥ ṣaḍṛtavo bhavanti teṣu śiśirādayas trayo raver udagayanam ādānañ ca śeṣā dakṣiṇāyanaṃ visargaś ca tāv ādānavisargau varṣam ||

tayor ādānam āgneyam tasmin khalu kālasvabhāvamārgaparigṛhīto 'tyarthopṇagabhastijālamaṇḍalo 'rkas tatsaṃparkād vāyavaś ca tīvrarūkṣāḥ somajaṃ guṇam upaśoṣayanto jagataḥ sneham ādadānā ṛtukrameṇo pajanitaraukṣyā rūkṣān rasāṃs tiktakaṣāyakaṭukān abhiprabalayanto nṛṇāṃ daurbalyam āvahanti ||

vasargas tu saumyaḥ tasminn api kālamārgameghavātavarṣābhihataprabhāve dakṣiṇāyanage 'rke śaśini cāvyāhatabale śiśirābhir bhābhiḥ śaśvad āpyāyamāne māhendrasalila praśānta santāpe jagaty arūkṣā rasāḥ pravardhante 'mlalavaṇamadhurā yathākramaṃ balaṃ copacīyate nṛṇām iti ||
hemante śiśire cāgryaṃ visargādānayor balam śaradvasantayor madhyaṃ hīnaṃ varṣānidāghayoḥ ||

lg.l: nadyaḥ sabāṣpāḥ soṣmāṇaḥ kūpāpaś ca himāgame ||
dhātūn api paced asya tatas teṣāṃ kṣayān marut ||
tejaḥ sahacaraḥ kupyec chītaḥ śīte viśeṣataḥ |
ato hime bhajet snigdhān svādvamlalavaṇān rasān ||
raukṣyaṃ ca+ādānajaṃ tasmāt kāryaḥ pūrvo 'dhikaṃ vidhiḥ |
diśo jvalanti bhūmiś ca māruto naiṛtaḥ sukhaḥ |
ādatte jagatas tejas tada+ādityo bhṛśaṃ yataḥ |
madyaṃ na sevyaṃ svalpaṃ vā sevyaṃ subahuvāri vā |
svādu śītaṃ dravaṃ cānnaṃ jāṅgalān mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ |
sarāṃsi vāpiḥ saritaḥ kānanāni himāni ca |
nigadaṃ madirāriṣṭam ārdvīkaṃ svalpam ambu vā ||
divyaṃ kvathitakūpotthaṃ cauṇḍaṃ sārasam eva vā |
śaradi vyoma śubhrābhraṃ kiñcit paṅkāṅkitā mahī |
taptānāṃ sañcitaṃ pūrvaṃ tadā pittaṃ prakupyati ||
tatra pūrvo vidhis tyājyaḥ sevanīyo 'paraḥ kramāt ||
asātmyajā hi rogāḥ syuḥ sahasā tyāgaśīlanāt |
rtuṣv evaṃvidheṣv eṣa vidhiḥ svāsthye ca dehināṃ ||
yathottaraṃ bhajec caryāṃ tatra tasya balād iti ||
mukhena viṭpravṛttiś ca pūrvoktāś cāmayāḥ smṛtāḥ |
mūtrasya rodhāt pūrve ca prāyo rogāḥ tadauṣadham |
mūtrajeṣu tu pāne ca prāgbhaktaṃ śasyeta ghṛtam ||
avapīḍakam etac ca saṃjñitaṃ dhāraṇāt punaḥ ||
pravartayet kṣutiṃ saktāṃ svedābhyaṅgau ca śīlayet |
yojyaṃ vātaghnam annaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ cauttarabhaktikam ||
tṛpṇāyā nigrahāt tatra śītaḥ sarvo vidhir hitaḥ ||
tatra yojyaṃ laghu snigdham uṣṇam alpaṃ ca bhojanam ||
aṅgamardaś ca tatreṣṭaḥ svapnaḥ saṃvāhanāni ca ||
śoṣo hidhmā ca kāryo 'tra kāsahā sutarāṃ vidhiḥ ||
hitaṃ viśramaṇaṃ tatra vātaghnaś ca kriyākramaḥ ||
jṛmbhāyāḥ kṣavavad rogāḥ sarvaś cānilajid vidhiḥ |
sagulmā bāṣpatas tatra svapno madyaṃ priyāḥ kathāḥ |
vyāyāmaḥ srutir asrasya śastaṃ cātra virecanam |
bastiśuddhikaraiḥ siddhaṃ bhajet kṣīraṃ priyāḥ striyaḥ ||
tatra seveta sarvaṃ ca varjayed vegadhāriṇam |
nirdiṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ tatra bhūyiṣṭhaṃ ye tu tān prati ||
tataś cānekadhā prāyaḥ pavano yat prakupyati |
kramād apām api maṇau paṅko 'vaśyaṃ bhavaty ataḥ |
cayakāṣṭhām upāruhya kurvate te hy upekṣitāḥ |
ucitair api cāhārair yasmād asya vahanti na |
ye tu saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhā na teṣāṃ punar udbhavaḥ |
kāmakrodhabhayādyāś ca te syur āgantavo gadāḥ |
śītodbhavaṃ doṣacayaṃ vasante viśodhayan grīṣmajam abhrakāle |
ghanātyaye vārṣikam āśu samyak prāpnoti rogān ṛtujān na jātu ||
dātā samaḥ satyaparaḥ kṣamāvān āptopasevī ca bhavaty arogaḥ ||
artheṣv alabhyeṣv akṛtaprayatnaṃ kṛtādaraṃ nityam apāyavatsu |
jitendriyaṃ nānupatānti rogās tatkālayuktaṃ yadi nāsti daivam ||
kāle 'nukūlo viṣayā manojñā dharmyāḥ kriyāḥ karma sukhānubandhi |
sattvaṃ vidheyaṃ viśadā ca buddhir bhavanti dhīrasya sadā sukhāya ||
tanv avyaktarasaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ śītaṃ śucy amṛtopamam ||
aklinnam avivarṇaṃ vā tat peyaṃ gāṅgam anyathā ||
sāmudraṃ tan na pātavyaṃ māsād āśvayujād vinā |
śvete kaṣāyaṃ tat svādu kṛṣṇe tiktaṃ ca pāṇḍure |
vāpīnadītoyam iti tat punaḥ smṛtam aṣṭadhā |
sārasaṃ svādu laghu ca tāṭākaṃ guru vātalam |
audbhidaṃ svādu pittaghnaṃ svādu vāpījalaṃ gaghu |
nādeyaṃ vātalaṃ rūkṣaṃ kaṭukaṃ ca tad ādiśet ||
pathyāḥ samāsāt tā nadyo viparītās tato 'nyathā |
himavanmalayodbhūtāḥ pathyās tā eva ca sthitāḥ |
anārtavaṃ ca yad divyam ārtavaṃ prathamaṃ ca yat ||
tad varjayed abhave vā toyasyānyasya śasyate ||
ajīrṇe kvathitaṃ cā++āme pakve jīrṇe 'pi netarat |
śīte vidhir ayaṃ tapte tv ajīrṇe śiśiraṃ tyajet ||
pānīyaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇā viśvam eva ca tanmayam |
na hi toyād vinā vṛttiḥ svasthasya vyādhitasya vā ||
kevalaṃ sauṣadhaṃ pakvam āmam uṣṇaṃ hitaṃ ca tat |
samīkṣya mātrayā yuktam amṛtaṃ viṣam anyayā ||
pāke svādu himaṃ vīrye tad uṣṇam api yojitam |
nālpam apy āmam udakaṃ hitaṃ tad dhi tridoṣakṛt ||
kāmam alpam aśaktau tu peyam auṣadhasaṃskṛtam ||
ante karoti sthūlatvam ūrdhvaṃ cāmāśayāt kapham |
madhye madhyāṅgatāṃ sāmyaṃ dhātūnāṃ jaraṇaṃ sukham ||
pānīyam uṣṇaṃ śītaṃ vā tridoṣaghnaṃ tṛḍaritijit |
laghv arūkṣaṃ klamaghnañ ca toyaṃ kvathitaśītalam ||
bhavet paryuṣitaṃ tac ca toyaṃ himakarodbhavam |
nālikerodakaṃ snigdhaṃ svādu vṛṣyaṃ himaṃ laghu |
divyaṃ vāri varaṃ varṣe nādeyam avaraṃ ||
prāyaḥ payaḥ atra gavyaṃ tu jīvanīyaṃ rasāyanam |
hastinyāḥ sthairyakṛt bāḍhaṃ uṣṇaṃ tv aikaśaphaṃ laghu |
payo 'bhiṣyandi gurv āmaṃ yuktyā śṛtam ato 'nyathā |
piṇyākāmlāśinīnāṃ tu gurv abhiṣyandi tat bhṛśam |
aceṣṭayā ca prādoṣāt garīyaḥ smṛtam auṣasam ||
hrasveṣu cātidehebhyo māṃseṣv apy evam ādiśet ||
pīnase mūtrakuchre ca rūkṣaṃ tu grahaṇīgade ||
na cānāmalakaṃ nāpi nityaṃ no mandam anyathā |
tadvan mastu saraṃ srotaśśodhi viṣṭambhajil laghu ||
snehānām uttamaṃ śītaṃ vayasaḥ sthāpanaṃ ghṛtam ||
pūrvoktāṃś cādhikān kuryāt guṇāṃs tad amṛtopamam ||
tadvac ca ghṛtamaṇḍo 'pi rukṣas tīkṣṇas tanuś ca saḥ |
ikṣoḥ saro guruḥ snigdho vṛṃhaṇaḥ kaphamūtrakṛt ||
kiñcit kālavidhṛtyā ca vikṛtiṃ yāti yāntrikaḥ |
vidāhī guru viṣṭambhī tenāsau tatra pauṇḍrakaḥ |
sakṣārāḥ sakaṣāyāś ca soṣṇāḥ kiñcid vidāhinaḥ ||
hṛdyaḥ purāṇaḥ pathyaś ca navaḥ śleṣmāgnisādakṛt ||
uṣṇam uṣṇārtam uṣṇe ca yuktaṃ coṣṇair nihanti tat |
kurvate te svayaṃ yac ca saviṣā bhramarādayaḥ |
pracchardane nirūhe ca madhūṣṇaṃ na nivāryate ||
alabdhapākam āśv eva tayor yasmān nivartate |
na hi kaṣṭatamaṃ kiñcit tad ajīrṇād yato naram |
bhrāmaraṃ pauṣpikaṃ kṣaudraṃ mākṣikaṃ ca yathottaram |
varaṃ jīrṇaṃ ca teṣv antye dve eva hy upayojayet ||
tailaṃ svayonivat tatra mukhyaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vyavāyi ca |
tvagdoṣakṛd acakṣuṣyaṃ sūkṣmoṣṇaṃ kaphakṛn na ca ||
satiktoṣaṇam airaṇḍaṃ tailaṃ svādu saraṃ guru |
tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ picchilaṃ visraṃ raktairaṇḍodbhavaṃ tv ati ||
tilatailaṃ varaṃ teṣu kausumbham avaraṃ param |
māṃsānugasvarūpau ca vidyān medopi tāv iva |
kākamadgu vasā tadvat kāraṇḍotthā ca ninditā ||
tadguṇā vāruṇī hṛdyā laghus tīkṣṇā nihanti ca ||
jagalaḥ pācano grāhī rūkṣas tadvac ca medakaḥ |
vraṇe pāṇḍvāmaye kuṣṭhe na cātyarthaṃ virudhyate ||
kauhalī bṛṃhaṇī gurvī śleṣmalas tu madhūlakaḥ ||
mārdvikaṃ lekhanaṃ hṛdyaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ saram ||
śārkaraḥ surabhiḥ tvādur hṛdyo nātimado maghuḥ |
maireyo madhuro hṛṣyaḥ saraḥ santarpaṇo guruḥ |
drākṣāsavo madhusamaḥ paramaṃ sa tu dīpanaḥ |
śāṇḍākī cā 'sutaṃ cānyat kālāmlaṃ rocanaṃ laghu ||
te kramād vituṣair vidyāt satuṣaiś ca yavaiḥ kṛte ||
dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ bhedi teṣu gomūtram uttamam ||
hanty unmādam apasmāraṃ krimīn mehañ ca rāsabham |
tiktā pāpmāharā mūtraṃ mānuṣaṃ tu viṣāpaham ||
pataṅgās tapanīyāś ca ye cānye śālayaḥ śubhāḥ ||
mahāṃs taṃ cānu kalamas taṃ cāpy anu tataḥ pare ||
sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣāś ca pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ ca ninditāḥ |
snigdho grāhī laghuḥ svādus tridoṣaghnaḥ sthiro himaḥ ||
gandhanāḥ kuruvindāś ca guṇair alpāntarāḥ smṛtāḥ |
koradūṣaḥ paraṃ grāī sparśe śīto viṣāpahaḥ ||
rūkṣaḥ śīto guruḥ svāduḥ saro viḍvātakṛd yavaḥ |
vṛṣyaḥ śīto guruḥ snigdho jīvano vātapittahā ||
pathyā nandīmukhī śītā kaṣāyā madhurā laghuḥ ||
rūkṣā baddhamalāḥ śītā vipāke kaṭukā hitāḥ ||
haritās teṣv api varā makuṣṭhāḥ krimikāriṇaḥ |
varṇyāḥ paraṃ pralepādyair masūrā grāhiṇo bhṛśam ||
ghnanti śukrāśmarīṃ śukraṃ dṛṣṭiṃ śophaṃ tathodaram ||
niṣpāvas tu saro rūkṣaḥ kaṣāyamadhuro guruḥ ||
kṛṣṇaḥ praśastas tam anu śuklas tam anu cāruṇa ||
dṛkcchukrahṛt kaṭuḥ pāke tadvat bījaṃ kusumbhajam ||
māṣo 'tra sarveṣv avaro yavakaḥ śūkajeṣu ca |
navaṃ dhānyam abhiṣyandi sekyaṃ kedārajaṃ ca yat ||
vilepī grāhiṇī hṛdyā tṛṣṇāghnī dīpanī hitā |
sudhautaḥ prasrutaḥ svinnas tyaktoṣmā caudano laghuḥ |
viparīto guruḥ kṣīramāṃsādyair yaś ca sādhitaḥ |
hṛdyaḥ pathyaḥ paraṃ vṛṣyo bṛṃhaṇaḥ prīṇano rasaḥ |
piśitena rasas tatra yūṣo dhānyaiḥ khalaḥ phalaiḥ ||
vidyād yūṣe rase sūpe śāke caivottarottaram ||
rasālā bṛṃhaṇī vṛṣyā snigdhā balaya rucipradā |
viṣṭambhi mūtralaṃ hṛdyaṃ yathādravyaguṇaṃ ca tat |
dhāna viṣṭambhinī rūkṣā tarpaṇī lekhanī guruḥ |
saktavo laghavaḥ pānāt sadya eva balapradāḥ |
nicayāt kaṭhinā gurvī proktā piṇḍī mṛdur laghuḥ ||
nodakāntaritān na dvir na niśāyāṃ na kevalān |
na bhuktvā na dvijaiś chitvā saktūn adyān na vā bahūn ||
karālakṛtamālau ca pṛṣataś ca mṛgāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
vartako vartikā ceti tittiriḥ krakaraḥ śikhī |
pārāvataḥ pāṇavika ity uktāḥ pratudā dvijāḥ |
śvetaḥ śyāmaś citrapṛṣṭhaḥ kālakaḥ kākulī mṛgaḥ ||
sṛmaraś camaraḥ khaḍgo gavayaś ca mahāmṛgāḥ |
rājī cilicimādyaś ca māṃsam ity āhur aṣṭadhā ||
tatra baddhamalā rucyā māṃsānām uttamāḥ himāḥ ||
tāmro 'tra hariṇaḥ kṛṣṇas tv eṇo hṛdyas tridoṣajit |
laghīyān ṣaḍrasaś cāsau grāhī rūkṣo himaḥ śaśaḥ ||
tadval lāvo 'py arūkṣas tuṃ kiñcid rūkṣaḥ kapiñjalaḥ ||
pārāvatāḥ kapotāś cṛa tadvad vanyāḥ supūjitāḥ |
tadvac ca kukkuṭo vṛṣyo grāmyas tu śleṣmalo guruḥ |
caṭakāḥ śleṣmalāḥ snigdhā vātaghnāḥ śukralāḥ param ||
kulīraḥ paramaṃ vṛṣyo bṛṃhaṇaḥ prīṇano guruḥ ||
viparītam ato jñeyam āvikaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ tu tat |
sadyohataṃ vayasthaṃ ca śuddhaṃ surabhi śasyate ||
eṇaḥ kuraṅgo hariṇaḥ śaśo lāvaḥ kapiñjalaḥ |
ṛśyaḥ kāṇakapotaś ca śeṣam uktaṃ yathāyatham ||
laghur yoṣic catuṣpātsu vihaṅgeṣu punaḥ pumān ||
hanti doṣatrayaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vṛṣyā soṣṇā rasāyanī |
tiktaṃ pāke kaṭu grāhi vātalaṃ kaphapittajit ||
baddhamūtrā sarā bhañjī karīraṃ syād abhīrujam ||
snigdhaṃ śītaṃ guru svādu bṛṃhaṇaṃ śukrakṛt param ||
pālakyā pichilā gurvvī śleṣmalā bhedinī himā |
madaghny upodakā cuñcur grāhī tau pūrvavat tathā ||
jīvanī bṛṃhaṇī kaṇṭhyā gurvī vṛṣyā rasāyanī ||
śākānāṃ pravarā nyūnā dvitīyā kiñcid eva tu ||
satarūḍhaṃ kadambaṃ ca rūkṣaṃ grāhi himaṃ guru |
ālūpāni ca sarvāṇi tathā sūpyāni lakṣmaṇā |
laghupatrā tu yā cillī sā vāstukasamā matā ||
laghur uṣṇā sarā tiktā sorupūkā ca lāṅgalī |
rūkṣoṣṇam amlaṃ kausumbhaṃ guru pittakaraṃ saram |
sakṣāraṃ madhuraṃ snigdham uṣṇaṃ guru ca sārṣapam ||
yad bālam avyaktarasaṃ kiṃcit kṣāraṃ satiktakam ||
tan mūlakaṃ doṣaharaṃ laghu soṣṇaṃ niyacchati |
gurv abhiṣyandi ca snigdhasiddhaṃ tad api vātajit |
vātaśleṣmaharaṃ śuṣkaṃ sarvam āmaṃ tu doṣalam ||
rase pāke ca kaṭukaṃ doṣotkleśakaraṃ laghu |
hṛdyaḥ keśyo gurur vṛṣyaḥ snigdho rocanadīpanaḥ |
palāṇḍus tadguṇair nyūno vipāke madhuras tu saḥ |
dīpanaḥ sūraṇo rucyaḥ kaphaghno viśado laghuḥ |
viśeṣād arśasāṃ pathyo bhūkandas tv atidoṣalaḥ ||
patre puṣpe phale kande ca gurutā kramāt |
varā śākeṣu jīvantī sārṣapas tv avarāḥ param ||
sarvaṃ hṛdyaṃ laghu snigdhaṃ grāhi rocanadīpanam |
ūrumāṇaṃ priyālaṃ ca bṛṃhaṇaṃ guru śītalam ||
nālikeraṃ guru snigdhaṃ pittaghnaṃ svādu śītalam |
snigdhaṃ svādu kaṣāyaṃ ca rājādanaphalaṃ guru |
phalaṃ tu pittalaṃ tālaṃ saraṃ kāśmaryajaṃ himam ||
paraṃ vātaharaṃ snigdham anuṣṇaṃ tu priyālajam ||
kolamajjā guṇais tadvat tṛṭchardiḥkāsajic ca saḥ ||
viṣaghnam ubhayaṃ grāhi kapitthāny evam ādiśet ||
bhavyaṃ viśadam amlaṃ ca jāmbavaṃ tv ativātalam ||
viṣṭambhakṛd akaṇṭhyaṃ ca sāmlaṃ tu kṣīrivṛkṣajam |
svādu sāmlaṃ guru snigdhaṃ mārutaghnam apittalam |
pakvaṃ bālaṃ punas tīkṣṇaṃ pittalaṃ laghu dīpanam |
vātaśleṣmaghnam uṣṇaṃ ca snigdhaṃ grāhy ubhayaṃ param ||
satiktaṃ svādu yat pīlu nātyuṣṇaṃ tat tridoṣajit |
tad asthy agnisamaṃ medhyaṃ kaphavātaharaṃ param ||
svādvamlaṃ śītam uṣṇaṃ ca dvidhā pārāvataṃ guru |
pakvam āśu jarāṃ yāti nātyuṣṇaṃ guru doṣalam |
dhānyaṃ tyajet tathā śākaṃ rūkṣasiddham akomalam |
prāyeṇa phalam apy evaṃ tathāmaṃ bilvavarjitam |
na śakyaṃ vistareṇāpi vaktuṃ sarvaṃ tu sarvathā |
tatas tato yato dṛṣṭās te te bhāvāstathā tathā ||
mātrayā sevitaṃ madyaṃ hanti rogās tadudbhavān |
kodravo hanty asṛkpittaṃ karoty eva vidāhibhiḥ |
kuṣṭhaṃ tatkāry api tilo hanti bhallātakaiḥ saha ||
tṛṣyaty agneḥ samadanaṃ sarpir apy upadiśyate ||
saktavo vātalā rūkṣāḥ pītās te tarpayanti tu |
bhṛṣṭaḥ kṣuṇṇo 'pi pṛthuko raktaśāler laghor guruḥ |
saṅgrāhiṇo laghor mudgāt kulmāṣo bhedano guruḥ ||
guḍāt toyāc ca sutarāṃ mūtralaṃ guru pānakam ||
cakṣuṣyo 'pi hi godhūmas tailapakvas tu dṛṣṭihā |
mūlakaṃ doṣajananaṃ siddhaṃ tu tad adoṣalam ||
uṣṇaṃ viṣībhavaty eva viṣaghnam api mākṣikam |
medhyastilaḥ sparśaśīto medhyaṃ tailaṃ khalo himaḥ |
tasyaiva śleṣmakāritvaṃ na tailasya khalasya vā ||
kṣāraḥ prācyeṣu matsyās tu saindhaveṣv aśmakeṣu tu |
bālhīkā bālhavāś cīnāḥ śūlikā yavanāḥ śakāḥ ||
dehasātmyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ madyaṃ māsaṃ ca kasyacit ||
ahitair api teṣāṃ ca tair evopahitaṃ hitam ||
sātmyaṃ hy āśu balaṃ dhatte nātidoṣaṃ ca bahv api ||
sraṃsanaṃ sat payo gavyaṃ bhavati grāhi kasyacit |
takram āmaṃ kaphaṃ koṣṭhe hanti kaṇṭhe karoti tu |
dṛṣṭe sparśahimaṃ dravyaṃ śrotrasyoṣṇaṃ tu pūjitam ||
payaḥ svādu saraṃ śītaṃ viparītaṃ tato dadhi |
kālena jāyate tasmāt kṣīravac ca punar ghṛtam ||
payo dadhi ca vātaghnam ajātaṃ vātalaṃ tu tat |
takraṃ grāhi kaṣāyāmlam amlam eva tu bhedanam ||
śīte na tu tadādyante snigdhāmlalavaṇā hitāḥ ||
ṛtuṣv anyo raseṣv anyo raukṣye snehe bale kramaḥ |
mūlakaṃ dosajid bālaṃ viparītaṃ tu kandavat |
jvare peyā kaṣāyāś ca sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ virecanam ||
apathyaṃ pathyam apy annaṃ niśāyāṃ netrarogiṇām ||
ahitāḥ saktavaḥ śuṣkā hitās te tu pramehiṇaḥ |
tad eva madyaṃ madyasya viṣasya tu viṣāntaram ||
svedair yāti śamaṃ dāhaḥ prāyo laśunapānajaḥ |
divāsvapnāj jarāṃ yāti bhuktam anyedyur adya na ||
duṣpānaṃ durjaraṃ sarpir dīpanaṃ ca payo 'nyathā ||
te tair eva punar daṣṭāḥ sadyo jahati jīvitam ||
svayam eva viṣaṃ tīvraṃ tān punar nātibādhate |
sarvāṅgavyāpi teṣāṃ ca śukravat saṃsṛtaṃ viṣam ||
tan māṃsam upayogāya māṃsavarge ca paṭhyate |
chardighnī makṣikāviṭ ca makṣikaiva tu vāmayet ||
tulye 'pi deśakālādau laṅghanaṃ na samaṃ matam ||
sarvathā doṣajit takraṃ grahaṇyāṃ doṣakṛd vraṇe |
ity ete 'nye ca bahavaḥ sūksmā durlabhahetukāḥ |
dharmā vicitrā bhāveṣu kiñcit teṣāṃ nidarśitam ||

div2.p: athāto 'nnarakṣāvidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ ||
īśvarāṇāṃ vasumatāṃ viśeṣeṇa tu bhūbhujāṃ prāyeṇa mitrebhyo 'py amitrā bhūyāṃso bhavanti |

tasmād rājā kulīnaṃ snigdham āptam āstikarmāyarmāyaparigrahaṃ dakṣaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ nibhṛtaṃ śucim anuddhatam analasam avyasaninam anahaṅkṛtam akopanam asāhasikaṃ vākyārthāvabodhakuśalaṃ niṣṇātam aṣṭāṅge yathāmrāyam āryuvede suvihitayogakṣemaṃ sannihitāgadādiyogaṃ sātmyajñaṃ ca prāṇācāryaṃ parigṛhṇīyāt |
tam arthamānābhyāṃ yathākālaṃ gurum iva śiṣayaḥ pitaram iva putraḥ pūjayet |
pratikūlam api tadvacaḥ sāmprataṃ matam iti pratimanyeta |
na hi bhadro 'pi gajapatir niraṅkuśaḥ ślāghanīyo janasya |
tasmāt tadāyattam āhāravihāraṃ prati cātmānaṃ kuryāt |
upāttam api khalu jīvitam upāyabalena svayam adhitiṣṭhati ||
pratikṣaṇaṃ pratyavekṣaṇīyāvasthāś ca rogiṇo viśeṣeṇa rājānaḥ |
te hi pramādaparigatā duḥkhāsahiṣṇavaś ca svayam apy apathyarucayaḥ sannihitāhitapriyavacanaprāyaparicārakāś ca tasmād bhiṣajo rājā rājagṛhāsanne niveśanaṃ kārayet |
tathā hi sarvopakaraṇeṣu nṛpatiśarīropayogiṣv aparokṣavṛttir bhavati ||
sa samyak sampannam annaṃ suparīkṣitaṃ viśuddham agnyādiṣu prāg upanītaṃ śikhinā dṛṣṭam abhiprokṣitaṃ prokṣāṇaiḥ puraḥsthito rājānaṃ hastabaddhauṣadhiratnaṃ bhojayet ||
tatra saviṣam annaṃ srāvyamāṇam avisrāvyaṃ bhavati
pakvaṃ ca sadyaḥ paryuṣitam iva nirūṣma stabdhaṃ ca jāyate
kvāthaḥ dhyāmatā śyāmatā hīnātiriktavikṛtānāṃ cātra cchāyānāṃ darśanam adarśanam eva vā
viśeṣeṇa lavaṇolbaṇeṣu phenamālā rasasya madhye nīlā rājiḥ
yatra cānena viṣaṃ prayuktaṃ tad viśeṣeṇa |
skhalitagatir dīno lajjāvān asthānahāsī pṛṣṭo 'py asambandham uttaraṃ dadāti |
nṛpājñātvarayāpi kecid aparādhāntarād vā 'navasthitasattvāḥ samācaranty evam |
vahnis tu saviṣam annaṃ prāpyaikāvarto rūkṣamandārcir indrāyudhavad anekavarṇajvālo bhṛśaṃ caṭacaṭāyate |
tatra naladakuṣṭhalāmajjakaiḥ kṣaudradrutair nasyam añjanaṃ ca kuryāt |
dṛṣṭa eva cāsmiṃs tu cakorasyākṣiṇī virajyete |
darśanād eva cāsya viṣaṃ mandatām upaiti ||
hastena spṛṣṭam annaṃ viṣavad dāhaśophasvāpanakhaśātān karoti |
tatra madamaphalālabubimbīkośātakīphalair dādhimadhuyuktam āśu vamanaṃ dadyāt

triphalātrikaṭunāgapuṣpamadhukabarhiṇaparṇībṛhatīdvayacūrṇaṃ siṃhavyāghravṛkatarakṣudvīpimārjārasṛgālamṛgagodhānāmanyatamapittarasasaṃyuktaṃ sakṣaudraṃ pānam eṣa jīvano nāmāgadaḥ paraṃ sarvaviṣauṣadham |
tasmin jīrṇe śyāmāvyoṣātiviṣāsiddhena payasā ghṛtena vopastambhitāṃ mudgayūṣeṇa kiṃcil lavaṇena sasarpiṣkeṇa mṛdvodanaṃ bhojayet |
tatra nīlinīphalayuktena sarpiṣā virecanaṃ samākṣikaṃ ca dūṣīviṣāriṃ dadhnā pāyayet |

dantakāṣṭhaprayukte tu viṣe kūrcakaviśaraṇam auṣadhagandho rūkṣatā tāludantajihvoṣṭhamāṃsaśophaś ca tatra pracchāya dhātakīpuṣpajāmbavāsthiharītakīcūrṇaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ saptacchadakalkena vā pratisāraṇaṃ kuryāt |
kapitthameṣaśṛṅgībhallātakānāṃ puṣpair varaṇaniryāsena vāñjanaṃ bṛhatīśirīṣabījaprapauṇḍarīkanāgabalācūrṇaṃ saptakṛtvo madhunā bhāvayet |
nasyadhūmaprayukte śirorukkāphāsrāvaḥ khebhyo rudhirāgamanam indriyavaikṛtaṃ ca |
tatrātiviṣāśvetākākamācīmadayantikākalke kṣīrasiddhaṃ sarpir nnasye pāne ca vidadhyāt ||
viśeṣatas tv ābharaṇakṛte vikāre 'śvagandhāpāmārgakiṇihīkhadiraśirīṣakalkair gopittayuktaiḥ pradehaḥ |
tatra śyāmāpālindītaṇḍulīyakacūrṇa ghṛtarkṣapittaiḥ subhāvitayā kṛṣṇamṛdā pralepaḥ |
tatra bahupatrāsvaraso ghṛtakṣaudrasaṃyuktaḥ pratipūraṇaṃ somavalkaraso vā suśītaḥ |
mukhālepaprayukte mukhaśyāvatā padmakaṇṭakā bhavanty abhyaṅgajāś ca vikārāḥ |

lg.l: ghreyāṇi ghrāpayitvā tu spṛśyān saṃspṛśya tān api |
tato vijñāya śuddhiṃ ca bhājanasyodakasya ca |
tasmāt tīkṣṇaviṣaṃ haste badhnīyāt kuśalo bhiṣak ||
saṃvibhaktaś ca bhaktaś ca śucir vaidyavaśūnugaḥ |
tān vaidyo guṇavān eko manasā pratijāgṛyāt ||
panthānam udakaṃ chāyāṃ bhaktaṃ yavasam indhanam |
dūṣayanty arayo yasmāt tān vidyāc chodhayeta ca ||
prasthānaṃ vā niveśaṃ vā nāvijñāya prayojayet |
chardir mūrchā jvaro mohaḥ śiroduḥkhaṃ ca jāyate ||
sarvagandhaiḥ samaṃ yojya pacet pakve ca nikṣipet ||
cāraṭīṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca prokṣayet tena tāṃ bhuvam ||
saviṣaṃ virasaṃ toyaṃ kavoṣṇaṃ rājibhiś citam |
phaṇijjakaṃ prativiṣāṃ dagdhvā tad bhasma gālayet |
bahuśo gālitaṃ tac ca pācayet tatra ca kṣipet ||
pātyante bindavas tasmād yatra tan nirviṣībhavet |
śīte gharmo himaś coṣṇe māruto viṣasaṃyutaḥ ||
nirgandham atigandhaṃ vā tat puṣpaṃ hṛcchirorujam |
bhūmim uddiśya yat proktaṃ tat sarvaṃ tatra ceṣyate |
na ca kanyām aviditāṃ saṃspṛśed aparīkṣitām ||
vividhān kurvate yogān kuśalāḥ khalu mānavāḥ |
sparśocchvāsādibhir hanti tasyās tv etat parīkṣaṇam |
jantubhir mriyate jñātvā tām evaṃ dūratas tyajet ||
nāprāśitaṃ ca sūdādyaiḥ kiñcid apy āharen nṛpaḥ ||

div2.p: atha śuklapakṣe puṇye 'hani puṣyapunarvasuhastacitrāmṛgaśiraḥśravaṇarevatīśatabhiṣakprājāpatyottarāṇām anyatamena nakṣatreṇa yogam upagate bhagavaty auṣadhipatau praśaste muhūrte sindhusrotaḥsamutthaṃ snigdhaṃ saprabhaṃ gandhavarṇacchadair nīlotpalābham añjanam āharet |
tat sarvaṃ mūṣāyāṃ prakṣipya balimaṅgalapūrvakam agnim upasāmādhāya khadirakadaradhavasyandanānām anyatamadārubhi gomayair vā prajvālayet |

tataś cāryāvalokiteśvaram āryatārāṃ brahmadakṣāśvirudrendradityasomavaruṇavaiśvānaravāyuviṣṇujanakabharadvājadhanvantarisuśrutabhavyasukanyāskandaścyavanavainateyān anyāṃś ca yathāvidhyuktadevatāḥ sumano 'kṣatalājasvastikasaṃyāvanistuṣayavasaṃskṛtaguḍaghṛtamiśrapāyasair arcayitvā vṛddhavaidyabrahmaṇāṃś ca śuklavāsaso mahatībhir dakṣiṇābhiḥ pūjayitvā tasminn agnau tad añjanaṃ dhmātaṃ dhmātam āvṛtya pṛthak pṛthaṅ niṣecayet |
tataḥ śukle vāsasi badhvā dvādaśarātra māntarikṣe 'mbhāsi vāsayet |

tataś chāyāyāṃ viśoṣya sphaṭikamuktāpravālakālanusāryāpratīvāpaṃ punar api balimaṅgalapūrvakam ahatavāsasā kanyayā dṛṣadi peṣayitvā suvarṇarajatatāmraśaṅkhaśailadviradaradanagavayaśṛṅgavaiḍūryasphaṭikameṣaśṛṅgyasanasārānyatamaghaṭṭitāyām añjanikāyāṃ nidhāpayet |
atha pūrvavat punar api kṛtasvastyayanaṃ sāvitreṇa karmaṇā sarvavit dvijanmā vidhivat tad abhisaṃskuryāt |

tato gajaskandham āropya pāṇḍuracchatracāmarabālavyajanair anugataṃ tathā śaṅkhadundubhisvanair dvijātivaraprayuktaiś ca vedavādamiśraiḥ puṇyāhaghoṣaiḥ kṛtapuṣpopahāraṃ vaidyagṛhān nāyakagṛham anupraveśayet |

anantaraṃ ca tena videhādhipopadiṣṭena sarvārtheṣu siddhenāñjanena yathoktānām evāñjanabhājanadravyāṇām anyatamayā śalākayā gobrāhmaṇapūjāpūrvakaṃ śuciḥ saniyamo bhūtvā dhāraṇīm imāṃ vidyām adhīyānaḥ pūtaḥ pūrvam akṣi dakṣiṇam añjayet ||
atha mantraḥ namaś cakṣuḥpariśodhanarājāya tathāgatāyarhate samyaksambuddhāya tad yathā auṃ cakṣuḥ prajñācakṣur jñānacakṣur vijñānacakṣur viśodhaya svāhā ||
tataḥ paraṃ ca tām eva dhāriṇīm anusmaran sāyamprātaḥ patyaham etat paramaṃ pavitram ārogyakaram ūrjaskaraṃ sarvaviṣaghnam añjanam aśvibhyām indrasya vṛtravadhābhyudyatasya prāk prakalpitam |
tasmodatad rājñāṃ rājamahāmātrāṇāṃ ca mahīṃ vijagīṣamāṇānāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vedādhyayanam anyad vā mahacchāstram avagāhamānānāṃ prasannamanā bhiṣak prakalpayed iti |

lg.l: yān sevamāno nṛpatiḥ śatrubhyo naiti pajcatām ||
saviṣaṃ prokṣitaṃ tena sadyo bhavati nirvisam |
tataḥ kṛtvā maṇiṃ hemnā baddhaṃ hastena dhārayet ||
saṃspṛṣṭaṃ saviṣaṃ tena sadyo bhavati nirviṣam |
viṣajit paramaṃ kāryo maṇiratnaṃ ca pūrvavat |
vāditrāṇi patākāś ca piṣṭair obhiś ca lekhitāḥ |
śrutvā dṛṣṭvā samāghrāya sadyo bhavati nirviṣam ||
viṣaṃ bhuktaṃ jarāṃ yāti nirviṣe 'pi na doṣakṛt |
na tatra kīṭāḥ saviṣā nondurā na sarīsṛpāḥ |
na kṛtyā karṣaṇā(kārmaṇā)dyāś ca dhūpo 'yaṃ yatra dahyate ||
viṣair na bādhyate syāc ca nārīnaranṛpapriyaḥ |
digdhaṃ nirviṣatām eti gātram ity āha gautamaḥ |
pibed ghṛtam ajeyākhyam amṛtaṃ vāpy abhuktavān ||
sarpiḥ kṣaudraṃ dadhi kṣīram antataḥ śītalaṃ jalam |
suśītāḥ saghṛtāś caiṣāṃ yathāsvaṃ kalpitā rasāḥ |
viṣapītāya dadyāc ca śuddhāyordhvam adhas tathā ||
śuddhe hṛdi tataḥ śāṇaṃ hemacūrṇasya dāpayet ||
jāyate vipulaṃ cāyur gare 'py eṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
yad rājñaḥ karmabhis tasmād ārādhyo 'sāv atīndriyaiḥ ||
yatra sākṣan nṛpas tatra vijñātaḥ praviśod bhiṣak |
ucite purato rājñas tiṣṭhed vākyaṃ ca nākṣipet |
deśe kāle parārthaṃ ca vaded dharmārthasaṃhitam |
nānuśiṣyād apṛcchantaṃ mahad etad dhi sāhasam ||
anukūlaṃ hitaṃ vācyam ahitād vārayen mithaḥ ||
udāraiḥ sāntvayan vākyair doṣaś cet tadupekṣayā |
tūṣṇīṃ vā prativākye syād varjayed veṣyasaṅkathām ||
vipaścid apy acittajño bāliśo 'pi tu bhāvavit |
nivedya rājñe kurvīta kāryāṇi sulaghūny api |
na yāyān na ciraṃ tiṣṭhet kośasthānāvarodhayoḥ ||
vastrādi rājñā sadṛśaṃ rājalīlāṃ ca varjayet |
dattaṃ yat tu nṛpeṇava tad dhāryaṃ tuṣṭivṛddhaye ||
pāto yathā hi duḥkhāya nocchrāyaḥ sukhakṛt tathā |
prāpya duṣpnāpam aiśvaryaṃ bahumānaṃ ca bhūpateḥ ||
rātrau siddhārthakān bhūtim akṣatair anvitāṃ śucim |
upahāraṃ ca sandhyāyāṃ bhuktvā cānte niśāsu ca ||
etat svastyayanaṃ karma kartavyaṃ śucinā śuceḥ |
saṅkṣepa eṣa viṣapālanasādhanāya proktas tu vistaravidhiḥ punar uttare tu |
ālocya samyag akhilaṃ matipūrvakārī yuñjīta taṃ parivikalpya vikāracihnam ||
iti viṣagararakṣorakṣaṇāyopadeśaṃ bhajati narapatir yo nityam evāpramattaḥ |
nijapararipuvṛndair apradhṛṣyo mahātmā janayati janatāyāḥ kṣemayogau cirāya ||

div2.p: grāmyānūpaudakapiśitāni madhuguḍatilapayomāṣamūlakabisair virūḍhadhānyaiś ca naikadhyam adyāt |
ubhayaṃ hy etan madhurarasavipākitvād abhiṣyandi śītoṣṇavīryatvāt parasparaṃ viruddham |
sa punaḥ śakalī lohitanayanaḥ sarvato lohitarājir lohitaprabhākaraḥ prāyo bhūmau carati so 'tyābhiṣyanditamatvāt sutarāṃ vyādhīn upajanayaty āmaviṣaṃ ca ||
tata uttaraṃ vā viruddhaṃ phalañ ca kaṅguvarakamakuṣṭhavellakulatthamāṣaniṣpāvāś ca |
na mūlakadiharitaṃ bhakṣayitvā payaḥ sevyaṃ kuṣṭhābādhabhayāt |
pauṣkaraṃ rauhiṇīkaṃ jātukaṃ vā śākaṃ saha madhupyobhyāṃ nābhyavaharet |
tathā sarṣapatailabhṛṣṭānāṃ matsyabadarāṇāṃ badarāṇi śvāvidvarāhamāṃsaṃ caikadhyaṃ pittenāmamāṃsāni
dadhnā kukkuṭaṃ pṛṣataṃ ca kusumbhaśākenairaurabhraṃ sauvīrakeṇa tilaśaṣkulīḥ
dadhnā māṣasūpena guḍena madhunā ghṛtena vā lakucaphalaṃ
tām eva matsyapacane śṛṅgiverapacane vā bhājane siddhām anyatra vā siddhāṃ rātrim uṣitāṃ
madhusarpirvasātailodakāni samadhṛtāni dviśas triśaḥ samastāni vā |
madhupuṣkarabījaṃ padmottarikāśākaṃ śārkaro mairayo madhu ca sahopayuktaṃ viruddham |
śītoṣṇaṃ navapurāṇam āmapakvaṃ ca naikam aikadhyam adyāt |
bheṣajadravyāṇāṃ tu yathopadeśam eva prayogo nyāyyataraḥ |

lg.l: utkleśya doṣān na haret dravyaṃ yat tat samāsataḥ |
viruddhaṃ tad dhi dhātūnāṃ pratyanīkatayā sthitam ||
saṃskārādivaśena ca bhavati nisargād api virodhaḥ ||
kṣīraṃ kulatthaiḥ panasena matsyais taptaṃ dadhi kṣaudraghṛte samāṃśe |
vāry ūṣare rātriṣu saktavaś ca toyāntarās te yavakās tathā ca ||
upanītam alaṃ viddhān sarvatra kramate yataḥ ||
kuryād viruddham aśanaṃ jvaram astrapittam aṣṭau gadāṃś ca mahato viṣavac ca mṛtyum ||
teṣv āśu kuryāt saṃśuddhiṃ śamaṃ vā tadvirodhibhiḥ |
dravyais tair eva vā pūrvaṃ śarīrasyābhisaṃskṛtim ||
virodhy api na pīḍāyai sātmyam alpaṃ ca bhojanam ||
yogādibhedād yad yad vā pathyānām apy apathyatā |
pādāṃśena tyajet sātmyam ahitaṃ hitam ācaret |
ekāntaraṃ tataś cordhvaṃ dvyantaraṃ tryantaraṃ tathā ||

div2.p: tritayaṃ ca tadupastambhanam āhāraḥ svapno 'brahmacaryaṃ ca |
ebhir yuktiyuktair upastabdham upastambhaiḥ śarīraṃ balavarṇopacayocitam anuvarttate yāvadāyuḥsaṃskāraḥ |

lg.l: bāhulyāt tamaso rātrau nidrā prāyeṇa jāyate ||
nidrāyattaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ puṣṭiḥ kārśyaṃ balābalam |
vṛṣatā klībatā jñānam ajñānaṃ jīvitaṃ na ca ||
akāle 'tiprasaṅgāc ca na ca nidrā niṣevitā |
saiva yuktā punar yuṅkte nidrā dehaṃ sukhāyuṣā |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ snigdhaṃ prasvapanaṃ divā |
dhātusāmyaṃ tathā hy eṣāṃ śleṣmā cāṅgāni puṣyati ||
viṣārttaḥ kaṇṭharogī ca naiva jātu niśāsv api ||
eta eva ca vijñeyā nidrānāśasya hetavaḥ |
arddhatrirātrāt sā sādhyā na sā sādhyā tataḥ param |
yathākālam ato nidrāṃ rātrau seveta sātmyataḥ ||
asātmyāj jāgarād ardhaṃ prātaḥ svapyād abhuktavān |
śīlayen mandanidras tu kṣīram ikṣurasaṃ rasān ||
śālīn madyāni māṣāṃś ca kīlāṭān māhiṣaṃ dadhi ||
cakṣuṣas tarpaṇaṃ lepaḥ śiraso vadanasya ca ||
pravāte surabhau deśe sukhāṃ śayyāṃ yathocite |
sarpiḥ kṣīrānupānaṃ ca jīvanīyaiḥ śṛtaṃ pibet |
etāny eva ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ nidrāluḥ parivarjayet ||
nidrā bibhartti prathamā śarīraṃ pāpmāntagā vyādhinimittam anyāḥ ||

div2.p: grāmyadharmapravṛttau tu rajasvalām aniṣṭām aniṣṭācārām aśastām atisthūlām atikṛśāṃ garbhiṇīṃ sūtikām anuttānāṃ vikṛtāṅgāṃ gaṇikām aprajasaṃ duṣṭayonim anyayonim anyastriyaṃ viśeṣāc ca vayovarṇavṛddhāṃ sagotrāṃ gurumitrabandhubhṛtyapatnīṃ varṇinīṃ tathā caityacatvaracatuṣpathopavanaśmaśānāghātasalilauṣadhadvijagurusuranṛpālayeṣv ahani gosarge madhyandine 'rddharātrau parveṣv anaṅge pipāsur apraṇītasaṅkalpo vā na gacchet |
viśeṣeṇa cātivyāyatāṃ garbhiṇīṃ navaprasūtām ṛtumatīṃ saṃvṛtayoniṃ ca |
na ca niṣekābhimukhaṃ śukraṃ dhārayed iti |

lg.l: nārīṃ nārīr guṇair yuktāṃ sahapūrvaguṇāṃ vrajet ||
dvyahād vasante tasyānte pakṣāt tadvat ghanodaye seveta kāmataḥ kāmaṃ hemante śiśire balī |
strīsaṃsargad dhi sadyaḥ syāt klībatā balinām api |
evaṃ cāpyāyate śīghraṃ teṣāṃ śukraṃ ca dhāma ca ||
vāyoḥ kopam adharmaṃ ca mūḍhaḥ prāpnoty ato 'nyathā ||
na conaḥ ṣoḍaśād varṣāt saptateḥ parato na ac |
āyuṣkāmo naraḥ strībhiḥ saṃyogaṃ gantum arhati ||
śuṣkaṃ rūkṣaṃ yathā kāṣṭhaṃ jantujagdhaṃ vijarjaram |
spṛṣṭam āśu viśīryeta tathā vṛddhaḥ striyaṃ vrajan ||
kāyasya tejaḥ paramaṃ hi śukram āhārasārad api sārabhūtam |
jitātmanā tat parirakṣaṇīyaṃ tato vapuḥ santatir apy udārā ||
hite 'pi ratam āhāre yojayanty āmayair naram ||
na hi sarvāṇy apathyāni tulyadoṣāṇi naiva ca ||
sarve tulyabalā doṣā na sarvāṇi vapūṃṣi ca |
vyādhikṣamatve śaktāni yato 'pathyaṃ tad eva tu ||
ta eva ca punar ddoṣā hetubhir bahubhiś citāḥ ||
dehe 'hitocite te syuś cirād apy āśukāriṇaḥ ||
yeṣām aniyataṃ karma tasmin kāle sudāruṇe ||
karma pañcavidhaṃ teṣāṃ yojyaṃ tadvad rasāyanam |
śasyate dehavṛddhiś ca bheṣajaiḥ pūrvam uddhṛtaiḥ ||
hemantādiṣu kurvīta svaṃ svaṃ cākālikeṣv api |
ata eva ca caryāyāṃ hemantaśiśire same ||
daive puruṣakāre ca sthitaṃ tasya balābalam ||
tayor udārayor yuktir dīrghasya susukhasya ca |
madhyā madhyasya miśrasya saṅkīrṇā śruṇu cāparam |
tathā daivena balinā pauruṣaṃ karma durbalam |
dṛṣṭvā yad eke manyante niyataṃ mānam āyuṣaḥ ||
karma kiñcit kvacit kāle vipākaniyataṃ mahat |
tatraikaḥ kālasaṃyuktaḥ śeṣās tv āgantavaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
śyenādinā ca yāgena bhrātṛvyasya tathā ca taiḥ |
sarvasmād eva cātmānaṃ gopayed īdṛśī smṛtiḥ ||
dhruvaṃ rogitvam anyeṣāṃ mṛtyur eva tv aparvaṇi |
varjayed iti na brūyur munayo divyacakṣuṣaḥ |
na vā te 'pi yathākāmam āyuṣaḥ sthitim āpnuyuḥ |
upekṣayā na maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ vā cikitsayā ||
nāyudhair dviṣam indrādyā nauṣadhair ārtam aśvinau |
mṛtyuṃ taṃ kālajaṃ prāhur itaraṃ tadviparyaye ||
yathā ratho vāhyamāno nyāyena kramaśaḥ kṣayam |
sa evāto yathā ca syād viparīto viparyaye |
sarvam anyat parityajya śarīraṃ pālayed ataḥ |
samīkṣya hitam aśnīyād deho hy āhārasambhavaḥ ||
na jātu dhārayed vegāṃs tad dhi sarvāpadāspadam ||
ahitāny api santyajya doṣam āpy āpnuyād yadi |
tathāpy ānṛṇyam āyāti sādhūnām ātmavān iti ||
yac ca rogasamutthānaṃ na śakyam iha kenacit |
parivartuṃ na tat prāpya śocitavyaṃ manīṣiṇā ||
jitvā varjyāni varjyāni ciraṃ jīvitum icchatā ||
smarann ātreyavacaso na dhīmān kartum arhati ||

div2.p: vidhivihitam annapānam iṣṭendriyārtham āyatanam āyuṣo bruvate |
athātmavān svabhāvasaṃyogasaṃskāramātrādeśakālopayogavyavasthāḥ saptāhārakalpanāviśeṣāṇāṃ svāsthyāsvāsthyaphalānāṃ hetubhūtāḥ samīkṣya hitam eva anurudhyeta |
te khalv api saṃyogādiviśeṣair anyathātvaṃ pratipadyante ||
tatra saṃyogo nāma dvayor bahūnāṃ vā dravyāṇāṃ saṃhatībhāvaḥ |
sa viśeṣam ārabhate yan naikaikaśo dravyāṇi |
mātrā punaḥ piṇḍaparimāṇataḥ samudāyena pratidravyāpekṣayā cāhārarāśiḥ |
tatra punar upayoktā svasthāturatvataḥ prakṛtibhedataś ca parīkṣyaḥ ||
ajīrṇe 'pi pūrvasyāhārasyāpariṇato rasa uttareṇopasaṃsṛjyamānaḥ sarvān doṣān prakopayaty āśu |

jīrṇe tu svasthānastheṣu doṣeṣu vātānulomyād utsṛṣṭeṣu mūtrapurīṣavegeṣu viśuddheṣūdgārahṛdayasrotomukheṣu viśadakaraṇe laghuni śarīre 'gnāv udīrṇe jātāyā bubhukṣāyām abhyavahṛtam annam apradūṣayad doṣān āyurbalavarṇān abhivarddhayati |
atītakālaṃ punas tad vātaviṣṭabdhaṃ kṛcchrād vipacyate karśayaty annaruciṃ ca punar upahanti |

upayogavyavasthā tu nāsnāto na digvāsā naikavastradhṛk na malinavasano nāhutvā na japitvā nānirūpya devatābhyo na pitṛbhyo na datvāgram annam agnaye na gurubhyo nātithaye nābhyāgatebhyo na śvavayaḥśvapacebhyaḥ pratyavekṣya cāśritopāśitān api tiraśco 'pi svaparigṛhītān praśastadeśakālopakaraṇayuktaḥ sragvī vibhūṣitaḥ surandhir ārdrapāṇipādaḥ suviśuddhavadano 'bhimatasahāyaḥ keśamakṣikādyanupajuṣṭam anindyam anindann aninditam apunaruṣṇīkṛtaṃ nātyuṣṇam anupadagdhaṃ susiddham alolo nāsātmyaṃ nāviditaṃ nāviditāgamaṃ nātisāyaṃ nātiprage nākāśe nātape nāndhakāre nādho vṛkṣasya na śyyāstho nonnamya pradeśinīṃ na pātre bhinne nāsaṃvṛte na maline bhāvadūṣite vā na cāsanasthite na hastasthe na haste prāṅmukhaḥ sumanāḥ śucibhaktākṣudhitānukūlajanopahitaṃ hitam annam aśrīyāt |
snigdhaṃ laghūṣṇam avilambita manatidrutam ajalpann ahasaṃs tanmanāḥ samīkṣya samyag ātmānam ||
snigdhalaghūṣṇāni hi vahnim audaryam udīrayanti koṣṭhaṃ pariśodhayānti dhātūn na vikurvate kṣipraṃ jarayanti anilam anulomayanti |
tathā snigdhaṃ dṛḍhīkarotīndriyāṇy upacinoti śarīram apacinoti jarasaṃ balam abhivarddhayati varṇaprasādam abhinirvarttayati |
laghu ca punaḥ svabhāvādibhir annam apratipīḍayad doṣān avyathamānaṃ pariṇāmam eti |
uṣṇaṃ ca punar janayati rucim upaśoṣayati śleṣmāṇam |
vilambitaṃ tu bhuñjāno na tṛptim adhigacchati bahu ca bhuṅkte śītībhavati cānnajātaṃ viṣamapākaṃ ca bhavati |
atidrutaṃ tu bhuñjānasya jalpato hasto 'nyamanaso vā bhaved utsnehanam avasādanaṃ bhojanasyāpratiṣṭhānaṃ guṇadoṣāvibhāvanaṃ ca ||
samīkṣya samyag ātmānam iti mamedaṃ sātmyam idam asātmyam iti nityam apramattaḥ pratyavekṣeta |
tatra sātmyaṃ nāma sahātmanā bhavaty abhyastaṃ tadaucityād upaśeta ity eke |
anye punaḥ prakṛtivayodeśartudoṣavyādhivaśena sātmyaṃ bahuvidham icchanti |
te hy upaśayamātram aṅgīkṛtya viparītaguṇam apy upacāreṇa sātmyam ācakṣate |
tatra sarvarasaṃ pravaram ekarasam avaraṃ madhyaṃ tu madhyamam eva |
itareṣām api krameṇa sātmyam api cāhitaṃ pādena vā vivarjayed ity uktaṃ prāk |
tatra yad āhārajātaṃ samadhātūn anuvarttayati viṣamāṃś ca samīkaroti tat samāsato hitam |
tat punar mātrāyogādivaicitryād aniyatam api yathopadeśaṃ yathābhūyiṣṭhaṃ ca śīlayet pariharec ca ||
tathā viśeṣataḥ samaśanam adhyaśanam amātraśanaṃ viṣamāśanaṃ ca varjayet |
bhuñjānas tu peyāyūṣarasān vyañjanāni rājateṣu pātreṣu nidadhyāt |
ghṛtam āyase payaḥ suśītaṃ tāmramaye pānīya pānakāni ca mṛddhemasphaṭikakācamayeṣu audanaṃ ca vistīrṇe manorame sthāne |
savye peyaṃ lehyaṃ mukhodgharṣaṇapiṇḍīṃ ca madhye bhojyam iti |
yathāgnisātmyaṃ tu prāk dravam upaśuṣkaṃ vāśnīyāt |
tatra mandāgrer dravoṣṇena samuttejitoṣmaṇo 'nyad upayuktaṃ samyak pākameti ||
anupāne tu salilam eva śreṣṭhaṃ sarvarasayonitvāt sarvabhūtasātmyatvāj jīvanādiguṇayogāc ca |
tac chītaṃ dadhimadhuyavagodhūmamadyaviśeṣeṣu sarveṣu ca vidāhiṣu śarad grīṣmayoś ca |
uṣṇaṃ piṣṭamayeṣv anyeṣu ca durjareṣu hemante ca |
triphalodakaṃ tu sakṣaudraṃ śleṣmaṇi prāthaś cākṣigalarogeṣu |
mastv eva vā dadhni kūcikākīlāṭayoś ca |
madyaṃ māṃseṣu phalāmlam ambu vāsavāṃś ca vividhān vibhajya prayojayet |
viśeṣatas tu madhvāsavān grāmyeṣu tīkṣṇān triphalāsavān vanyeṣu |
nyagrodhādiphalāsavān viṣkireṣu arkaśeluśirīṣakapitthāsavān bileśayeṣu digdhahateṣu ca |
amlaphalāsavān prasaheṣu kāśekṣupadmabījaśṛṅgāṭakakaśerukamṛdvīkākhadirāsavān kṣaudrayuktaṃ vā śītam udakam udaścid vā mahāmṛgeṣv audakeṣu ca |
surāṃ pratudeṣu tathā śramārtteṣu kṛśeṣu ca |

anupānaṃ khalu tarpayati prīṇayaty ūrjayati bṛṃhayati dehasya paryāptim abhinirvartayati bhuktam avasādayaty annasaṅghātaṃ bhinatti mārdavam āpādayati kledayati sukhapariṇāmitām āśuvyavāyitāṃ cāhārasyopajanayati |
teṣāṃ hi pradūṣyāmāśayam uraḥkaṇṭhasthitam āhārajaṃ sneham āsādya tadabhiṣyandāgnisādacchardyādīn āmayān vidadhyāt |

tataḥ pāṇigatam annam anyenāpanīya dantāntarasthaṃ ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ śodhanena viśodhya lepagandhasnehāpanodam ācānto 'ṅgulyagragalitāmbupariṣiktanetras tāmbūlādikṛta vadanavaiśadyo dhūmapānādihṛtordhvakaphavegaḥ padaśatamātraṃ gatvā vāmapārśvena saṃviśet |
tad yathā ūṣmā vāyuḥ snehaḥ kledaḥ kālaḥ samayogaś ca |
tatroṣmā pacati vāyur apakarṣati sneho mārdavaṃ janayati klaidaḥ śaithilyam āpādayati kālaḥ sarvavapurvyāptim abhinirvarttayati |
samayogasya tu punaḥ kāraṇāny ucito hitaś ca dehasaṃskāro 'bhyavahāraś ceṣṭā śayanaṃ saumanasyaṃ ca |
pariṇamatas tv āhārasya guṇāḥ śarīraguṇabhāvam āpadyante yathāsvam aviruddhāḥ |
viruddhās tu vihatāś ca virodhibhir vihanyuḥ śarīram iti |

lg.l: na jātu bhuktavān adyān mātrayādyāt sukāṅkṣitaḥ ||
tyajed eharasāsātmyaṃ guru śuṣkaṃ ca bhojanam ||
svāsthyānuvṛttikṛd yac ca rogocchedakaraṃ ca yat ||
annena kukṣer dvāv aṃśau pānenaikaṃ prapūrayet |
yojyaḥ kramo 'yaṃ satataṃ nāvaśyam itareṣu ca ||
atidravaṃ pīnasamehakāsasyandān karoty agnibalaṃ ca hanti ||
atimadhuram analaśamanaṃ bhuktam asātmyaṃ na puṣṭaye vapuṣaḥ |

div2.p: tanum api tanujāṃ rujāṃ tv anāpya vrajati naraḥ sa samāśatasya pāram ||

kukṣer apratipīḍanam āhāreṇa hṛdayasyāsaṃrodhaḥ pārśvayor avipāṭanam anatigauravam udarasya prīṇanam indriyāṇāṃ kṣutpipāsoparatiḥ sthānāsanaśayanagamanocchvāsapraśvāsabhāṣyasaṅkathāsu sukhānuvṛttiḥ sāyaṃ prātaś ca sukhena pariṇamanaṃ balavarṇopacayakaratvaṃ ceti mātrāyā lakṣaṇam ||
anilānalaguṇabahulāni hi laghūni tulyaguṇatvād agnisandhukṣaṇāny avidhinā cālpadoṣāṇi |
itarāṇi tu pṛthivīsalilaguṇabahulāny asāmānyād viparītāny anyatra vyāyāmāgnibalāt |
tatra hīnamātram aśanaṃ balavarṇopacayamanobuddhīndriyopaghātakaraṃ vibandhakṛd avṛṣyam anaujasyaṃ sāravidhmāpanam alakṣmījananam aśīteś ca vātavikārāṇām āyatanam |
tena hi prapīḍyamānā vātādayo yugapat prakupitāḥ kukṣyaikadeśasthās tad evāparipakvam āviśya viṣṭambhayanto 'lasakam abhinirvartayanti |

lg.l: prayāti nordhvaṃ nādhastād āhāro na ca pacyate |

div2.p: śleṣmā tu chardyarocakaprasekāṅgasādāvipākaśītajvaragātragauravāṇi viśeṣatas tu durbalasyālpavahner bahuśleṣmaṇo vātamūtrapurīṣavegavidhāriṇo 'nnapānam anilaprapīḍitaṃ śleṣmaṇā vibaddhamārgam alasatvād abahirmukhībhavat chardyatīsāravarjyāni yathoktāni śūlādīny upajanayaty atimātrāṇi |
atimātraduṣṭās tu doṣāḥ śarīraṃ daṇḍavat stambhayanti tatas tam alasakam asādhyaṃ bruvate ||
na ca kevalaṃ mātrayaiva kṛtsnam āhāraphalam avāptuṃ śakyaṃ svabhāvādīnāṃ bhinnaphalatvāt ||
gururūkṣaśuṣkaśītadviṣṭaviṣṭambhividāahyaśuciviruddhātyambupānadravam akāle kāle vā kāmakrodhalobherṣyādvrīśokodvegabhayakṣudupataptena vā yad annapānam upayujyate tad apy āmam eva pradūṣayati ||
tatra sādhyamānaṃ duṣṭam alasībhūtam ullikhet pāyayitvā salavaṇam uṣṇaṃ vāri |
tathā tv acchardayantam atilīnadoṣaṃ kṛṣṇānāgadantīkalkayuktaṃ pāyayet |

lg.l: ghṛtatailaṃ pacet sāmlais tac ca khallīghnam uttamam ||
udvarttanaṃ khalliviṣūcikāghnaṃ tailaṃ vipakvaṃ ca tadarthakāri ||

div2.p: āmadoṣeṣu tv annakāle jīrṇāhāraṃ doṣopaliptāmāśayaṃ stimitagurukoṣṭham anannābhilāṣiṇam abhisamīkṣya pāyayed doṣaśeṣapācanārtham auṣadhaṃ vahnisandhukṣaṇārthaṃ ca |
yata āmadoṣadurbalo hy agnir yugapad āmadoṣam auṣadham āhārajātaṃ cāśaktaḥ paktum ||
api caiṣā vibhramo 'tibalatvād uparatānalabalam āturaṃ sahasaivātipātatyet |
tena hy anilānalavṛdhyā vātātapaparīta ivālpaḥ salilāśayo 'lpadoṣaḥ praśoṣam āpadyate |
laṅghanapācanābhyāṃ madhyadoṣe vātātapābhyāṃ pāṃsubhasmāvakiraṇairiva cānatimahān salilāśayaḥ |
na hy asrāvite palvalodakaughe śālyādipuṣṭir bhavati ||
evam anyeṣām api vyādhīnāṃ yathāsvaṃ nidānaviparītam auṣadham evāvacārayet |
sati tv anubandhe nidānaviparītam apāsya vyādhiviparītam eva tadarthakāri vā |
vimuktāmadoṣasya punaḥ paripakvāmadoṣaśeṣasya dīpte cāgnāv abhyaṅgāsthāpanānuvāsanaṃ vividhasnehapānaṃ ca yuktyā prayojyam |

lg.l: vyoṣaṃ karañjasya phalaṃ haridre mūlaṃ samāvāpya ca mātuluṅgyāḥ |
chayāviśuṣkā gulikāḥ kṛtāstā hanyur viṣūcīṃ nayanāñjanena ||
ajīrṇaṃ ca kaphād āmaṃ viṣṭabdham anilād bhavet |
vidagdhe bhramatṛṇmūrchāḥ pittac ca vividhā rujāḥ |
udgāraś ca sādhūmāmlaḥ svedo dāhaś ca jāyate ||
laṅghanaṃ kāryam āme tu viṣṭabdhe svedanaṃ bhṛśam |
vidagdhe vamanaṃ yad vā yathāvasthaṃ hitaṃ bhavet ||
ragīyaso bhavel līnād āmād eva vilambikā |
yāmaiś caturbhir dvābhyāṃ ca bhojyabhaiṣajyayoḥ same |
pāko 'gnau yuktayor drāk ca tīkṣṇe mande punaś cirāt ||
prātarāśe tv ajīrṇe 'pi sāyamāśo na duṣyati |
ajīrṇe sāyamāśe tu prātarāśo hi duṣyati ||
tasmin vibuddhe srotāṃsi sphuṭatvaṃ yānti sarvaśaḥ ||
vyāyāmāc ca vicārāc ca vikṣiptatvāc ca cetasaḥ |
na kledam upagacchanti divā tenāsya dhātavaḥ ||
aklinneṣv annam āsiktam atyantena na duṣyati |
avidagdheṣv iva payassv anyat saṃmiśritaṃ payaḥ ||
rātrau tu hṛdaye mlāne saṃvṛteṣv ayaneṣu ca |
klinneṣv anyad apakveṣu teṣv āsiktaṃ praduṣyati |
vidagdheṣu payassv anyāt payas tapteṣv ivāpitam |
naiśe tasmād ajīrṇe 'nne nānyad bhuñjīta bhojanam ||
doṣopanaddhaṃ yadi līnamannaṃ pittolbaṇarayāvṛṇuyān na vahnim |
jāyeta duṣṭā tu tato budhukṣā yā mandabuddhīn viṣavan nihanti ||

div2.p: teṣu vakṣyamāṇaṃ hemādi lavaṇāntaṃ prāyeṇa bhaumam |
punar api ca trividhaṃ daivavyapāśrayaṃ yuktivyapāśrayaṃ satvāvajayaś ceti |
ābhyantaraṃ yad antaram anupraviśyāvikṣobhayad doṣān śamayati |
nidānatyāgo yathādoṣaṃ śītoṣṇaśanavyāyāmādīnāṃ varjanaṃ snigdharukṣādyanabhyavahāraś ca |
tatra śastrādisādhye bheṣajam anukramate na tu bheṣajasādhye śastrādi ||
punar api trividhaṃ hetuviparītaṃ vyādhiviparītam ubhayārthakāri ca |
yac ca doṣaśamanatve saty api jvare viśeṣato hitaṃ mustā parpaṭakaṃ yavāgvaśca pramehe rajanī yavānnaṃ cetyādi |

tathā chardyāṃ chardanam atisāre virecanaṃ madātyaye madyapānaṃ tutthadagdhe 'gnipratapanaṃ pitte 'ntarnnigūḍhe vimārgage vā svedaḥ kaṭvamlalavaṇatīkṣṇoṣṇābhyavahāraś ca bahiḥ pravarttanāya svamārgāpādanāya ca |
śleṣmaṇi cāntarnigūḍhe stabdhe bahiḥ śītopacāras tatpīḍitasyoṣmaṇo 'ntaḥpraveśena kapho vilayatām upayāti |
evaṃvidhaṃ hy aviparītam eva sat bheṣajaṃ hetuvyādhiviparītam arthaṃ karoti ||
anauṣadhaṃ punar dvividhaṃ bādhanam anubādhanaṃ ca |
paraṃ cāto rasavīryādibhedena yathāsthūlam auṣadhaikadeśa upadiśyate ||

lg.l: rūpyaṃ snigdhaṃ kaṣāyāmla vipāke madhuraṃ rasam |
lekhanaṃ pittalaṃ kiñcit trapu sīsaṃ ca tadguṇam ||
sakṣāra uṣṇavīryaś ca kāco dṛṣṭikṛd añjanāt ||
tutthakaṃ kaṭu sakṣāraṃ kaṣāyaṃ viṣadaṃ laghu ||
kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ śītaṃ lekhanaṃ snigdham añjanam |
viṣyandi lavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sṛṣṭamalaṃ viduḥ |
saidhanvaṃ tatra sasvādu vṛṣyaṃ hṛdyaṃ tridoṣanut |
laghv anuṣṇaṃ dṛśaḥ pathyam avidāhy agnidīpanam ||
romakaṃ laghu pāṃsūtthaṃ sakṣāraṃ śleṣmalaṃ guru ||
svarjikā tadguṇān nyūnā kṣāreṇa tu tato 'dhikā ||
kṣāraḥ sarvaś ca paramaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇaḥ kṛmijil laghuḥ |
kaṣāyā madhurā pāke rūkṣā vilavaṇā laghuḥ |
dīpanī pācanī medhyā vayasaḥ sthāpanī param ||
harītakī jayed vyādhīṃs tāaṃs tāṃś ca kaphavātajān |
tadvad āmalakaṃ śītaṃ mādhuryāt pittajit param ||
paraṃ ca kaṇṭhyaṃ cakṣuṣyaṃ hṛdyaṃ dāhajvarāpaham ||
akṣaṃ tu tadguṇān nyūnaṃ kaṣāyamadhuraṃ himam |
paraṃ keśyas tu tanmajjā śukraghnaṃ ca tato 'ñjanam |
rase pāke ca kaṭukaṃ kaphaghnaṃ maricaṃ laghu |
śleṣmalā svādu śītārdrā gurvīṃ snigdhā ca pippalī ||
sā śuṣkā viparītātaḥ snigdhā vṛṣyā rase kaṭuḥ |
nāgaraṃ dīpanaṃ vṛṣyaṃ grāhi hṛdyaṃ vibandhanut ||
tadvad ārdrakam etac ca trayaṃ trikaṭukaṃ jayet ||
pañcakolakam etac ca maricena vinā smṛtam |
ahṛdyāḥ sarṣapāḥ snigdhā bāṣpikāvac ca kīrttitāḥ |
vraṇyaḥ svaryaḥ kaṭuḥ pāke rukṣaḥ sūkṣmo 'gnidīpanaḥ ||
piṭakāgranthiśophāṃś ca hanty uṣṇaḥ sraṃsano laghuḥ ||
laghu raktaṃ tathośīraṃ vālakaṃ pācanaṃ ca tat |
guru svādu himaṃ vṛṣyaṃ cakṣuṣyṃ svaravarṇakṛt ||
pralepāj jayataḥ kaṇḍūṃ śophaṃ duṣṭavraṇaṃ viṣam ||
balātrayaṃ svādu vṛṣyaṃ snigdhaṃ śītaṃ balapradam |
tāmbulaṃ kaṭu sakṣāraṃ rucyam uṣṇaṃ kaphapraṇut |
bhedi sammohakṛt pūgaṃ kaṣāyaṃ svādu rocanam ||
kaphaghnaṃ kaitakaṃ tiktaṃ śairīṣaṃ viṣahāri ca ||
bandhūkaṃ śleṣmalaṃ grāhi tadvad eva ca yūthikā |
śramāgnimūrcchāś ca jayed apravātas tv ato 'nyathā |
sannipātajvaraṃ śvāsam āmaṃ vāyuṃ ca kopayet |
paścimaḥ śiśiro hanti mūrcchāṃ dāhaṃ tṛṣaṃ viṣam ||
uttaro mārutaḥ snigdho mṛdur madhura eva ca |
kuryāt pittāsravahnīṃś ca chāyā caitān apohati |
rasādibhedair iti bheṣajānā diṅmātram uktaṃ na yato 'sti kiñcit |
anauṣadhaṃ dravyam ihāvabodho rūpasya teṣāṃ vanagocarebhyaḥ ||
agryāṇāṃ śatam uddiṣṭaṃ pañca pañcāśad uttaram |

div2.p: bastiṣu tu teṣu teṣv avasthāntareṣu yāny upayujyante dravyāṇi tāny asaṅkhyeyatvān nopadiśyante |
rasaskandhebhya eva yathādoṣaṃ yathāvasthaṃ ca vibhajet |
rājādanamajjakṣaudralavaṇāni madyāni gavādiśakṛdrasamūtrapittāny evaṃvidhāni cendriyopaśayāny anyāny api tathā snehāḥ kṣīraṃ raktaṃ māṃsaraso dhānyarasas toyam iti śirovirecanopayogīni ||

madhukapadmakamañjiṣṭhāśārivāmustāpunnāganāgakesarailavālukasuvarṇatvaktamālapṛthvīkāhareṇulākṣāśatapuṣpāsallakīśarkarāmadanakamarubakanyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣalodhratvak padmotpalāni sarvagandhadravyāṇi ca kuṣṭhatagaravarjyāni prāyogikadhūmopayogīni agaruguggulusallakīśaileyakanaladahrīberahareṇūśīramustādhyāmakavarāṅgaśrīveṣṭakasthauṇeyakaparipelavailavālukakundurukasarjarasayaṣṭyāhvaphalasārasnehamadhūcchiṣṭabilvaphalamajjayavatilamāṣakuṅkumāni medomajjavasāsarpīṣi ca snaihikadhūmopayogīni |
śirovirecanadravyāṇi gandhadravyāṇi ca tīkṣṇāni manohvā haritālaṃ ceti tīkṣṇadhūmopayogīni ||

bhadradārukuṣṭhatagaravaruṇabalātibalārtagalakacchurāhlādinīkuberākṣīvatsādinyarkālarkakatakabhārṅgīkārpāsīvṛścikālīpattūraprabhṛtīni vidāryādigaṇo vīratarādi stṛṇākhyavarjyāni ṣaṭ pañcamūlāni ceti vātaśamanāni |

dūrvānantāmocarasamañjiṣṭhāparipelavakālākālīyakakadalīkandalīpayasyātmaguptānālikerakharjjūradrākṣāvidārībadarībalānāgabalānāgapuṣpaśatāvarīśīta pākyodanapākītṛṇaśūlyāṃśumatīdvayāriṣṭakāriṣṭāṭarūṣaketkaṭarpriyaṅgudhātakīdhavadhavadhanvanasyandanakhadirakadarapriyālatālasālasarjatiniśāśvakarṇagundrāvānīrapadmāpadmakapadmabījamṛṇālakumudanalinasaugandhikapuṇḍarīkaśatapatraśaivālakalhārotpalakākolyutpalikāśalūkaśṛṅgāṭakakaśerukakrauñcādanaprabhṛtīni anyāni ca śītavīryāṇi sārivādiḥ padmakādiḥ paṭolāadir nyagrodhādir dāhaharo mahākaṣāyas tṛṇapañcamūlaṃ ceti pittaśamanāni |

śītaśivaśatapuṣpāsaralasuradārurāsneṅgu dīsātalāsumanaḥkākādanīlāṅgalikāhastikarṇamuñjātalāmajjakaprabhṛtīny anyāni ca rūkṣoṣṇavīryāṇy āragvadhādir asanādir arkādiḥ surasādir muṣkakādir vatsakādir mustādiḥ śītaghnaś ca mahākaṣāyo vallīkaṇṭakapañcamūle ca śleṣmaśamanānīti ||
athāto mahākaṣāyasaṅgraham adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ ||
ānantyād auṣadhānām āmayānāṃ cānantā eva kaṣāyāḥ |
ye tu sutarām upayogavantaḥ prakarṣavartino vā te jīvanīyādisaṃjñāḥ |
śakyaṃ hi buddhimadbhiḥ svāduśītasnigdhādīn jīvantyādiṣu sādhāraṇān guṇān ālocya kṣīrekṣudrākṣākṣoḍavidārīkandādiṣv api tadguṇeṣu jīvanīyāditvam avadhārayitum |
yathoktānusaraṇam eva tu śreyo mandabuddher iti |
vyastāś ca te catvāri pañcāśadadhikāni tadabhidhānāny eva |
yady api tāni tāny eva dravyāṇīti dravyasaṅkaraḥ kaṣāyeṣu tathāpi na saṃjñāvirodhaḥ |
tatra lavaṇavarjyā rasāḥ kalpanāyāṃ kaṣāyā ity ucayante |

lg.l: haimavatī ciribilvaṃ mustā kuṣṭhaṃ vacā haridre ca |
aindry atirasā payasyā ṛṣyaproktā sthirā balātibalā |
iti balyo daśako 'yaṃ hayagandhā rohiṇī ṛṣabhaḥ ||
ghnanti krimīn śvadaṃṣṭrāviṣākhuparṇyas tathā na cirāt ||
hidhmāṃ nighnanti śaṭī durālabhā badarabījaṃ ca ||
bhṛṣṭā ca mṛt payasyā saśālmalī viḍvirajanāni ||

div2.p: kamalanalinakumuda madhukasaugandhikadhātakīlatākusumam mūtraṃ nayati virāgaṃ sotpalaśatapatrapuṇḍarīkaṃ ca ||

lg.l: kāsaṃ ghnanti saśṛṅgī tāmalakī kaṇṭakārī ca ||
triphalā ceti gaṇo 'yaṃ jvarasya śamanāy nirdiṣṭaḥ ||
kāśmaryaphalaṃ candanam eṣa gaṇo dāhahā proktaḥ ||
śītaṃ śamayanty acirāt syonākaḥ sāgnimanthaś ca ||
kākoly elā sevyaṃ nidigdhike śālipṛśniparṇyau ca |
śamayati sapañcakolaṃ śophaṃ daśamūlam ādyaṃ ca ||
saṃsthāpayanti rudhiraṃ rudhiraṃ ca saśarkaraṃ lodhram ||
amṛtā pathyā dhātrī jīvantī śreyasī sthirāyuktā |
maṇḍūkaparṇy atirasā sthāpayati punarnavā ca vayaḥ ||
kaṇḍūkarī jīvanahrasvasaṃjñe dve pañcake gopasutā tripādī ||
padmakapuṇḍrau vṛddhitugardhyaḥ śṛṅgy amṛtā daśa jīvanasaṃjñāḥ |
parūṣakaṃ varā drākṣā kaṭphalaṃ katakāt phalam |
nihanti kaphapittakuṣṭhajvarān viṣaṃ vamim arocakaṃ kāmalām ||
arkālarkau nāgadantī viśalyā bhārṅgī rāsnā vṛścikālī prakīryā |
pratyakpuṣpī pītatailodakīryāḥ śvetāyugmaṃ tāpasānāṃ ca vṛkṣaḥ ||
sandhānīyau hitau pitte vraṇānām api ropaṇau ||
kuṣṭhaṃ truṭī haimavatī ca yonistanyāmayaghnā malapācanāś ca ||

div2.p: nyagrodhādir gaṇo vraṇyaḥ saṅgrāhī bhagnasādhanaḥ medaḥpittāsratṛḍdāhayoniroganibarhaṇaḥ ||

lg.l: śuktivyāghranakhau surāhvam agaruḥ śrīvāsakaḥ kuṅkumaṃ caṇḍāgugguludevadhūpakhapurāḥ punnāganāgāhvayam ||
bastāntrī vyādhighāto bahalabahurasas tīkṣṇavṛkṣāt phalāni śyāmādyo hanti gulmaṃ viṣam arucikaphau hṛdrujaṃ mūtrakṛchram ||
pañcaviṃśītar ity uktā vargās teṣu tv alābhataḥ |
yuñjyāt tadvidham anyac ca dravyaṃ jahyād ayaugikam ||
pāne nasye 'nvāsane 'ntar bahir vā lepābhyaṅgair ghnanti rogān sukṛchrān ||

div2.p: tasyādhiṣṭhānaṃ pṛthivī yonir udakaṃ khānilānalasamavāyān nirvṛttiviśeṣau |
anurasas tu rasenābhibhūtatvād avyakto vyakto vā kiñcid ante |
tadāśrayeṣu ca dravyasaṃjñakeṣu pṛthivyādiṣu guṇāḥ prakṛtivikṛtivicāradeśakālavaśād gurvādayo raseṣu sāhacaryād upacaryante ||
itthaṃ ca nānauṣadhabhūtaṃ jagati kiñcid dravyam asti vividhārthaprayogavaśāt ||
tayor hi lāghavād ūrdhvagatitvāc cāgneḥ plavanatvāc ca mārutasya ||
tayor hi gauravā nimnagatvāc ca toyasya ||
tatsaṅkare ca yato bāhulyena kāryakartṛtvaṃ bhavati yad evādhikaṃ tad eva tatkāryakaram iti vyapadeśaḥ |

lg.l: vīryaṃ dravyasya tad jñeyaṃ yadyogāt kriyate kriyā |
nāvīryaṃ kurute kiñcit sarvā vīryakṛtā hi sā ||

div2.p: tair api caivam atiprakṛṣṭaśaktiyuktānām aśeṣaudhaguṇasārabhūtānām aṣṭānām eva gurvādīnāṃ vīryasaṃjñā viśiṣṭāmnāyavihitāpi laukikīti samudbhāvyate |
tathā hi tayā rasavipākaguṇāntaravijayino bhūyāṃsaś ca variṣṭhāś ca guṇāḥ saṅgṛhītāḥ |
viśeṣavṛtyā ca tatra tatra dravyasvarūpakathane vyavahāraḥ pravṛttito bhavati |
ata eva sarvātiśāyī dravyasvabhāvaḥ prabhāva ity āmnātaḥ |
saty api ca kriyānirvarttanasāmānye tadviparītā rasādayo vīryākhyayā prabhāvasaṃjñayā vā na parāmṛśyante ||
anye tu gurvādīnām agnīṣomātmakatvād ādānavisargavibhāagena kālasya coṣṇaśītātmakatvād dvividham evāmananti |
vipākas tu prāyaḥ svāduḥ svādulavaṇayor amlo 'mlasya kaṭur itareṣām |

lg.l: pākās trayo rasānām amlo 'mlaṃ pacyate kaṭuḥ kaṭukam |
kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ kaṭuko yeṣāṃ vipāka iti pakṣaḥ |

div2.p: tatra yan madhuraṃ rasavipākayoḥ śītavīryaṃ ca dravyaṃ yac cāmlaṃ tayor uṣṇavīryaṃ ca yad vā kaṭukaṃ teṣāṃ yathāsvaṃ rasebhyaḥ prāyo guṇān doṣakopaśamanatvaṃ ca vidyāt |
yathā madhu madhuraṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ śamayati kaṭuvipākatayā |
sakaṣāyatvād raukṣyāc ca vātaṃ janayati śītavīryatvāc ca |
ānūpaudakapiśitaṃ śītam api pittaṃ karoty uṣṇavīryatvāt |
tathā tailaṃ kaṭuvipākatayā ca vipākata eva baddhaviṇmūtram |
amlaṃ kāñjikaṃ kaphaṃ jayati rūkṣoṣṇatvāt kapitthaṃ tu raukṣyāt pittaṃ tu śītavīryatvāt |
āmalakaṃ pittaṃ śītavīryatvāt svādupākatayā ca kaphaṃ raukṣyāl lāghavāc ca śaityaraukṣyalāghavais tu na vātam |
lavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ svādupākatayā pittaṃ jayati lāghavāt kaphaṃ jayati |
kaṭukāpi śuṇṭhī snehauṣṇyasvādupākair vātaṃ kṣapayati pippalī ca |
snigdhāni tiktāni vyāghrīviśalyārkāgarūṇy uṣṇavīryatvāt pittaṃ janayanti |
kaṣāyatiktaṃ mahat pañcamūlaṃ vātaṃ jayati na tu pittaṃ uṣṇavīryatvāt |
kaṣāyaś ca kulattho 'mlapākatayā cety etan nidarśanamātram uktam ||

lg.l: kiñcid rasena kurute karma pākena cāparam |
rasaṃ vipākas tau vīryaṃ prabhāvas tāny apohati |
nāvaśyaṃ syur vighātāya guṇadoṣā mitho yathā ||
saha vṛttyā sthitāḥ kṣīre na tv ānūpaudakāmiṣe ||
guṇā dravyeṣu ye coktās ta eva tanudoṣayoḥ |
saṅkīrṇatvāt phale cāsau tulyatvān na vivakṣyate |
saṅkhyābhedo yathā nāsti rasānām api sa kramaḥ |
na ca tad dāḍimādyeṣu ṣaḍ evāto rasāḥ smṛtāḥ |
yathārasaṃ jaguḥ pākān ṣaṭ kecit tad asāmpratam |
yat svādur vrīhir amlatvaṃ na cāmlam api dāḍimam ||
yāti tailaṃ ca kaṭutāṃ kaṭukāpi na pippalī |
yathārasatve pākānāṃ na syād evaṃ viparyayaḥ ||
yasmād ṛdṣṭo yavaḥ syādur gurur apy anilapradaḥ |
dīpanaṃ śītam apy ājyaṃ vasoṣṇāpy agnisādinī ||
kaṭupāko 'pi pittaghno mudgo māṣas tu pittalaḥ |
rasaḥ svādur yathā caitat tathānyeṣv api dṛśyate |
kurute dadhi gurv eva vahniṃ pārāvataṃ na tu |
kaṣāyā grāhiṇī śītā dhātakī na harītakī |
apradhānāḥ pṛthak tasmād rasādyāḥ saṃśritās tu te ||
prabhāvaś ca yato dravye dravyaṃ śreṣṭham ato matam |
rasādisāmye yat karma viśiṣṭaṃ tat prabhāvajam ||
madhukasya ca mṛdvīkā ghṛtaṃ kṣīrasya dīpanam ||
laśuno vātakaphakṛn na tu tair eva yadguṇaiḥ ||
mitho viruddhān vātādīn lohitādyā jayanti yat |
darśanādyair api viṣaṃ yan niyacchati cāgadaḥ ||
virecayati yad vṛṣyam āśu śukraṃ karoti vā |
ūrdhvādhobhāgikaṃ yac ca dravyaṃ yac chamanādi ca ||
mātrādi prāpya tattac ca yat prapañcena varṇitam |
tac ca prabhāvajaṃ sarvam ato 'cintyaḥ sa ucyate ||
rasena vīryeṇa guṇaiś ca karma dravyaṃ vipākena ca yad vidadhyāt |
sadyo 'nyathā tat kurute prabhāvād dhetor atas tatra na gocaro 'sti ||

div2.p: rasaḥ khalv āpyaḥ prāg avyaktaś ca |
sa ṣaḍṛtukatvāt kālasya mahābhūtaguṇair ūnātiriktaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭo viṣamaṃ vidagdhaḥ ṣoḍhā pṛthag vipariṇamate madhurādibhedena ||
teṣāṃ svādur āsvādyamāno mukham upalimpatīndriyāṇi prasādayati |
amlas tu jihvām udvejayaty uraḥkaṇṭhaṃ vidahati |
mukhaṃ srāvayaty akṣibhruvaṃ saṅkocayati daśanān harṣayati romāṇi ca |
lavaṇo mukhaṃ viṣyandayati kaṇṭhakapolaṃ vidahati annaṃ prarocayati |
tikto viśadayati vadanaṃ viśodhayati kaṇṭhaṃ pratihanti rasanām |
kaṭuko bhṛśam udvejayati jihvāgraṃ cimicimāyati kaṇṭhakapolaṃ srāvayati mukhākṣināsikaṃ vidahati deham |
kaṣāyas tu jaḍayati jihvāṃ badhnāti kaṇṭhaṃ pīḍayati hṛdayam ||

tatra madhuro raso janmaprabhṛtisātmyāt sarvadhātuvivardhanaḥ āyuṣyo bālavṛddhakṣatakṣīṇabalavarṇendriyatvakkeśakaṇṭhahitaḥ prīṇano bṛṃhaṇo jīvanas tarpaṇaḥ sthairyasandhānaḥ stanyakaro vātapittaviṣadāhamūrchātṛṣṇāpraśamanaḥ snigdhaḥ śīto mṛdur guruś ca ||
amlo 'nilanibarhaṇo 'nulomanaḥ koṣṭhavidāhī raktapittakṛd uṣṇavīryaḥ śītasparśo bodhayatīndriyāṇi |
rocanaḥ pācano dīpano bṛṃhaṇas tarpaṇaḥ prīṇanaḥ kledano vyavāyī laghuḥ snigdho hṛdyaś ca ||

lg.l: kṣatavihitavisarpaṃ raktapittaṃ pipāsāṃ śvayathum api kṛśānāṃ taijasatvāt bhramaṃ ca ||

div2.p: lavaṇaḥ stambhabandhasaṅghātavidhmāpanaḥ sarvarasapratyanīko dīpano rocanaḥ pācanaḥ kledanaḥ śoṣaṇaḥ snehanaḥ svedano bhedanaḥ chedanaḥ saro vyavāyī vikāṣī harati pavanaṃ viṣyandayati kaphaṃ viśodhayati srotāṃsi nātiguruḥ snigdhatīkṣṇoṣṇaś ca ||

lg.l: kṣataviṣamadavṛddhiṃ vātaraktaṃ karoti kṣapayati balabhojaḥ soti vā sevanena ||

div2.p: tiktaḥ svayam arociṣṇur aruciviṣakṛmimūrcchotkledajvaradāhatṛṭakuṣṭhakaṇḍūharaḥ kledamedovasāmajjaviṇmūtrapittaśleṣmopaśoṣaṇo dīpanaḥ pācano lekhanaḥ stanyakaṇṭhaviśodhano medhyo nātirūkṣaḥ śīto laghuś ca ||

kaṭuko 'lasakaśvayathūdardasthaulyābhiṣyandakṛmivaktrarogaviṣakuṣṭhakaṇḍūprasādhano vraṇāvasādanaḥ sneha kledaśoṣaṇo rocanaḥ pācano dīpano lekhanaḥ śodhanaḥ śoṣayaty annaṃ sphuṭayatīndriyāṇi bhinatti śoṇitasaṃghātaṃ chinnatti bandhān vivṛṇoti srotāṃsi kṣapayati śleṣmāṇaṃ laghurūkṣatīkṣṇoṣṇaś ca ||

lg.l: kaṣāyo balāsaṃ sapittaṃ saraktaṃ nihanty āśu badhnāti varcotirūkṣaḥ |
gurus tvaksavarṇatvakṛt kledaśoṣī himaḥ prīṇano ropaṇo lekhanaś ca ||

div2.p: kaṭukadravyaskandho maricahiṅgutejovatīhastipippalīviḍaṅgabhallātakāsthimūlakasarṣapalaśunapalāṇḍukarañjamanaśśilāladevadārukuṣṭhailāsurasacorakahareṇukāmūtrapittaprabhṛtīni kuṭherādiś ca haritavargaḥ pañcakolaṃ ca ||
prāyaḥ kaṣāyaṃ śītaṃ stambhanaṃ cānyatra harītakyāḥ ||

lg.l: śreṣṭhā yathāsvaṃ skandheṣu rasadeśas tu vakṣyate ||

div2.p: atha yaḥ śiśirapavanadharaṇīdharavividhavanagahananadītaṭākapalvalodapānakamalakumudakuvalayāvakīrṇo ramyaḥ sthirasnigdhabhūmir bhūriharitatṛṇo 'tidūravistṛtapratānapravālopasaṃcchannapādapaḥ sasyasarīsṛpakhagabahulaḥ śleṣmapittaprāyo gurvauṣadhisalilaḥ ślīpadagalarogāpācīṃjvarādyāmayopadrutajanapadaḥ so 'nūpo madhurarasayoniḥ ||
yas tu viṣamavipulasikatāsthalabahulo 'tidūrāvagāḍhavirasasalilaḥ kleśasahārogaśarīradīrghāyuḥprāyo janapado 'nūparītaś ca sa jāṅgalaḥ kaṭukarasayoniḥ |
tayor ādyo lavaṇāmlayor yonir itaraś cetarayoḥ |

lg.l: svādur dvikeṣu pañcāmlaś caturo lavaṇas trayam |
dvau tiktaḥ kaṭukaś caikaṃ yāti pañcadaśaiva te ||
trīn yuktas tiktakena dvau kaṭunaikaṃ niṣevate ||
svādur daśaivam amlaḥ ṣaṭ saṃyogān pūrvavat kriyā |
lavaṇas trīn bhajaty ekaṃ tikta evaṃ tu viṃśatiḥ ||
svāduś cāmlaś catuṣkeṣu ṣaṭ trayaṃ lavaṇānugaḥ |
ekaṃ tiktayuto yāti daśaiva madhuro rasaḥ ||
catvāro 'mlaḥ paṭuś caikaṃ bhedāḥ pañcadaśeti ca |
ekaikasya parityāgāt saṃyogāḥ pañcake ca ṣaṭ ||
ekaś ca ṣaḍrasaḥ ṣaṭ ca pṛthag evaṃ triṣaṣṭidhā |

div2.p: pramehapūrvarūpaiḥ sthaulyopadravaiś cānyair api śleṣmaraktamāṃsavikāraprāyair medaḥ |
śramadaurbalyāsyaśoṣatimiradarśanāṅgamardapāṇḍutāsadanaklaibyamuṣkatodameḍhradhūmāyanaiś cirāc ca niṣekeṇa saraktaniṣekeṇa vā śukram |
saśabdasya vāyoḥ kukṣau tiryag ūrdhvaṃ ca bhramaṇenāntraveṣṭanena pārśvahṛdayapīḍanenālpatayā ca śakṛt |
anye 'pi ca malā yathāyathaṃ malāyanaṃ śoṣaśūnyatvalāghavaiḥ |
vṛddhes tu malānāṃ kṣayaḥ pīḍayati sutarām anaucityāt ||
dhātavaḥ khalu śārīrāḥ samānaiḥ samānaguṇabhūyiṣṭhair vāhāravihārair abhyasyamānair vṛddhim āpnuvanti |
tathā hi dehadhātavo ye guravas te gurubhir aikyakāritayopacīyante |
laghavas tu laghubhis tadviparītais tu pṛthaktvakāribhir apacīyante |
tasmād anyebhyo dravyebhyo 'pi sutarāṃ raktam āpyāyyate raktena māṃsaṃ māṃsena medo medasāsthi taruṇāsthnā majjā majñā śukraṃ śukreṇāmagarmeṇa garbhaḥ |
yatra tv evaṃ lakṣaṇena sāmānyena sāmānyavatām āhāravihārāṇām asānnidhyaṃ syāt sannihitānāṃ cābhyavaharaṇam aśakyaṃ viruddhatvād ghṛṇitvād arucer anyasmād vā kāraṇāntarāt |
tatra samānaguṇabhūyiṣṭhānām anyaprakṛtīnām āhāravihārāṇām abhyavahāraḥ śreyān ||
tad yathā śukrakṣaye kṣīrasarpiṣor upayogo madhurasnigdhaśītānām apareṣāṃ ca dravyāṇām |
karmāpi yad yasya dhātoḥ samānakriyatayā vṛddhikaraṃ tasya tasya vṛddhim abhilaṣatā tat tad āsevyam |

lg.l: vṛddhiḥ kṣayaś ca dhātūnāṃ jāyate śṛṇu cāparam ||
pāramparye 'pi dāvāgnes tat tat prāpyendhanaṃ śikhā |
dravyaṃ tulyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ hi svaṃ svaṃ vṛdhdyai kṣayāya ca |
pūrvo dhātuḥ paraṃ kuryāt vṛddhaḥ kṣīṇaś ca tadvidham |
doṣā duṣṭā rasair dhātūn dūṣayanty ubhaye malān ||
adho dve sapta śirasi khāni svedavahāni ca |
malā malāyanāni syur yathāsvaṃ teṣv ato gadāḥ ||
rakte visarpaṃ dāhaṃ ca māṃse māṃspākakothanam |
śleṣmā tvaci sthitaḥ kuryāt stambhaṃ śvetāvabhāsatām |
medogaḥ sthūlatāṃ meham asthnāṃ stabdhatvam asthigaḥ ||
arocakāvipākau ca tāṃs tāṃś ca kaphasambhavān ||
vṛdhyābhiṣyandanāt pākāt koṣṭhaṃ vāyoś ca nigrahāt ||
te kālādibalaṃ labdhvā kupyanty anyāśrayeṣv api ||
āgantuṃ śamayed doṣaṃ sthāninaṃ pratikṛtya vā |
tejo yat sarvadhātūnām ojas tat param ucyate |
yat sāram ādau garbhasya yac ca garbharasād rasaḥ |
yac charīrarasaḥ snehaḥ prāṇo yatra pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
yasyānāśān na nāśo 'sti prīṇitā yena dehinaḥ ||
hṛdayastham api vyāpi tat paraṃ jīvitāspadam |
duścchāyo durmanā rūkṣo bhavet kṣāmaś ca tatkṣaye ||
yad annaṃ dveṣṭi yad api prārthayetāvirodhi tu |
tat tatyajan samaśnaṃś ca tau tau vṛddhikṣayau jayet ||
vṛddhāḥ kṣīṇāś ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ lakṣayanty abudhā na tat ||
yathābalaṃ yathāsvaṃ ca doṣā vṛddhā vitanvate |
rūpāṇi jahati kṣīṇāḥ samāḥ svaṃ karma kurvate ||
ya eva dehasya samā vivṛdhyai ta eva doṣā viṣamā vadhāya |
yasmād atas te hitacaryayaiva kṣayād vivṛddher iva rakṣaṇīyāḥ ||

div2.p: tatra pakvāśayaḥ kaṭiḥ sakthinī pādāv asthi śrotraṃ sparśanaṃ ca vātasthānāni |
nābhir āmāśayaḥ svedo lasīkā rudhiraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca pittasthānāni |
uraḥ kaṇṭhaḥ śiraḥ kloma parvāṇy āmāśayo raso medo ghrāṇaṃ rasanaṃ ca śleṣmasthānāni |
ittham adhomadhyordhvasanniveśinā doṣatrayeṇa śarīram agāram iva sthūṇātritayena sthirīkṛtam |
ataś ca doṣā dehasya sthirīkaraṇāt sthūṇā ity ucyante |

vyāno hṛdy avasthitaḥ kṛtsnadehacaraḥ śīghrataragatiḥ gatiprasāraṇākuñcanotkṣepāvakṣepanibheṣonmeṣajṛmbhaṇānnāsvādanasrotoviśodhanasvedāsṛksrāvaṇādikriyo yonau ca śukrapratipādano vibhajya cānnasya kiṭṭāt sāraṃ tena kramaśo dhātūṃs tarpayati |
apānas tv apānasthito bastiśroṇimeḍhravṛṣaṇavaṅkṣaṇorucaro viṇmūtraśukrārtavagarbhaniṣkramaṇādikriya iti ||

tatra yad āmāśayapakvāśayamadhyasthaṃ pañcamahābhūtātmakatve 'pi tejoguṇotkarṣāt kṣapitasomaguṇaṃ tataś ca tyaktadravasvabhāvaṃ sahakārikāraṇair vāyukledādibhir anugrahād dahanapacanādikriyayā labdhāgniśabdaṃ pittam annaṃ pacati sārakiṭṭau vibhajati śeṣāṇi ca pittasthānāni tatrastham evānugṛhṇāti tat pācakam ity ucyate |
tad abhyaṅgapariṣekālepādīn pācayati chāyāś ca prakāśayati ||
sa tūrasthaḥ svavīryeṇa trikasyānnavīryeṇa ca saha hṛdayasya ca śeṣāṇāṃ ca śleṣmasthānānāṃ tatrastha evodakakarmaṇāvalambanād avalambaka ity ucyate |
evam amīṣu sthāneṣu bhūyiṣṭham avikṛtāḥ sakalaśarīravyāpino 'pi vātapittaśleṣmāṇo vartante |
śītaguṇopahitās tīkṣṇādayaḥ pittasya cayam uṣṇaguṇopahitāḥ kopaṃ śītaguṇopahitā mandādayaḥ praśamam |
śītaguṇopahitāḥ snigdhādayaḥ kaphasya cayam uṣṇaguṇopahitāḥ kopaṃ tathā tu rūkṣādayaḥ praśamam ||

lg.l: cayo vṛddhiḥ svadhāmny eva pradveṣo vṛddhihetuṣu |
doṣo vikāraṃ kurute khe varṣam iva toyadaḥ ||

div2.p: atha prakupitā vātādayo nānāvidhair vikāraiḥ śarīram upatapanti |
āviṣkṛtatamās tu vāyor aśītir vikārāḥ tad yathā |

nakhabhedo vipādikā pādaśūlaṃ pādabhraṃśaḥ suptapādatā vātakhuḍatā gulphagrahaḥ piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ gṛddhrasī jānubhedo jānuviśleṣaḥ ūrusāda ūrustambhaḥ paṅgutvaṃ gudabhraṃśo gudārtir vṛṣaṇākṣepo meḍhrastambho vaṅkṣaṇānāhaḥ śreṇibhedo viṅbheda udāvartaḥ khañjatvaṃ kubjatvaṃ vāmanatvaṃ trikagrahaḥ pṛṣṭhagrahaḥ pārśvāvamarda udarāveṣṭo hṛnmoho hṛddravo vakṣodgharṣas tathā vakṣoparodho vakṣastodo bāhuśoṣas tathā grīvāstambho manyāstambhaḥ kaṇṭhoddhvaṃso hanustambhas tālvoṣṭhabhedo dantabhedo dantaśaithilyaṃ mūkatvaṃ vāksaṅgaḥ pralāpaḥ kaṣāyāmyatā mukhaśoṣo rasājñatvaṃ ghrāṇanāśaḥ karṇaśūlam aśabdaśrutir uccaiḥśrutir bādhiryaṃ vartmastambho vartmasaṅkocas timiram akṣiśūlam akṣivyudāso bhrūvyudāsaḥ śaṅkhabhedo lalāṭabhedaḥ śiroruk keśabhūmisphuṭanam arditam ekāṅgarogaḥ sarvāṅgaroga ākṣepako daṇḍakaḥ śramo bhramo vepathur jṛmbhā glānir viṣādo raukṣyaṃ pāruṣyaṃ śyāvāruṇābhāsatvam asvapno 'navasthitacittatā ca ||

pittavikārāḥ punar oṣaḥ ploṣo davo davathur vidāho 'ntardāhas tvagdāho 'ṃsadāho dhūmako 'mlaka ūṣmādhikyam atisvedo 'ṅgagandho 'vayavasadanaṃ śoṇitakledo māṃsakledas tvaṅmāṃsāvadaraṇaṃ carmadaraṇaṃ raktakoṭho raktavisphoṭo raktamaṇḍalāni raktapittaṃ haritatvaṃ hāridratvaṃ nīlikā kakṣyā kāmalā tiktāsyatā lohitagandhāsyatā pūtimukhatvaṃ tṛṣṇādhikyam atṛptir āsyapāko galapāko 'kṣipākaḥ pāyupāko meḍhrapāko jīvādānaṃ tamaḥpraveśo haritahāridranetramūtraśakṛttvaṃ ca ||

śleṣmavikārās tu tṛptis tandrā nidrādhikyaṃ staimityaṃ gurugātratālasyaṃ mukhamādhuryaṃ prasekaḥ śleṣmodgiraṇaṃ malādhikyaṃ balāso hṛdayopalepaḥ kaṇṭhopalepo dhamanīpraticayo galagaṇḍo 'tisthaulyaṃ śītāgnitvam udardaḥ śvetāvabhāsatā śvetanetramūtraśakṛttvaṃ ca ||
anye punar āhur annānabhinandatā tṛptir iva tṛptir arocakaḥ |
staimityaṃ tu pramīlaka ity anyaiḥ paṭhitam |

lg.l: sarāgakaṇḍūḥ śophaḥ syād udardaḥ sa kaphodbhava iti ||

div2.p: kṣudravikārāḥ punar yad evāṅgam āviśanti tadupapadam eva nāma labhante |
teṣāṃ hi tathaiva svarūpam upadiṣṭaṃ bhavati ||
sarveṣu teṣu teṣv anukteṣu cānyeṣv asaṅkhyeyatvād vikāreṣv imāny eva doṣāṇām ātmaliṅgāni sakalaśarīravyāpīny avyabhivārīṇi ca |
karmāṇi tu vāyoḥ sraṃsavyāsasaṅgasādhedatodaharṣatarṣavarttāṅgamardakampavyathaveṣṭabhaṅgaśūlaśoṣasvāpapāruṣyasauṣiryasaṅkocaspandanāni kaṣāyarasatvaṃ śyāvāruṇavarṇatā ca |
kapilabalas tv eṣāṃ svalakṣaṇāni rasato nirdideśa |
pittaṃ vidgdham amlatām upaiti śleṣmā lavaṇatām |
tad evam etāni vāyvādirūpakarmāṇy avahitaḥ samyag upalakṣayed āgamapratyakṣānumānaiḥ |

lg.l: pṛthak trīn viddhi saṃsargas tridhā tatra tu tān nava ||
trīn eva samayā vṛddhyā ṣaḍ ekasyātiśāyane |
pañcaviṃśatir ity evaṃ vṛddhaiḥ kṣīṇaiś ca tāvataḥ ||
ekaikavṛddhisamatākṣayaiḥ ṣaṭ te punaś ca ṣaṭ |
prakṛtisthaṃ yadā pittaṃ vṛddho vāyuḥ kaphakṣaye |
sthānād ādāya gātreṣu yatra yatra visarpati ||
tadā bhedaś ca dāhaś ca tatra tatrānavasthitau |
prakutisthaṃ kaphaṃ kṣīṇe pitte vāyur yadā balī |
prakṛtisthaṃ yadā vātaṃ pittaṃ vṛddhaṃ kaphakṣaye |
prakṛtisthaṃ kaphaṃ vṛddhaṃ pittaṃ vāyukṣaye yadā |
prakṛtisthaṃ yadā vāyuṃ vṛddhaḥ pittakṣaye kaphaḥ |
sannirundhyāt tadā kuryāc chītakaṃ gauravaṃ jvaram ||
śeṣeṣv api tu tān eva kalpayet tad yathāyatham ||
ānantyaṃ taratamayogataś ca yātān jānīyād avahitamānaso yathāsvam ||

div2.p: athāto doṣopakramaṇīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāhur ātreyo maharṣayaḥ |

vātasyopakramaḥ snehaḥ svedo mṛdūni snigdhoṣṇamadhurāmlalavaṇāni saṃśodhanāny abhyavahāryāṇi cābhyaṅgapūrvam upanāhanopaveṣṭanonmardanapariṣekāvagāhasaṃvāhana pīḍanāni vitrāsanavidhmāpanavismaraṇāni surāsavavidhānaṃ snehāś cānekayonayo dīpanīyapācanīyavātaharavirecanīyadravyopahitās tathā śatapākasahasrapākāḥ sarvaśaḥ prayogārthā bastayo bastiniyamo viśeṣatas tailaṃ māṃsaraso 'nuvāsanāni sukhaśīlatā strīsamparkavarjyaś ca haimanto vidhiḥ ||
pittasya sarpiṣpānaṃ sarpiṣā snehanam adhodoṣaharaṇaṃ madhuratiktakaṣāyāṇām auṣadhābhyavahāryāṇām upayogo mṛdusurabhiśītahṛdyānāṃ gandhānām upasevā paramaśiśirasurabhisalilamajjanam |

mano 'nukūlasaṃsparśasukhānāṃ muktāmaṇivaiḍūryāśmagarbhaśaṅkhaśilāpadmarāgacandrakāntakāntatarataralāvalīnāṃ bhramaratrāsitasahasrapatrāsitotpala kadalīdalanavamālikākundamallikādivividhavarṇaprasūnaviracitānāṃ srajāṃ ca dhāraṇam urasā |
anṛtavacanavirahasvabhāvasurabhitaravadanakuḍmalānāṃ nātispaṣṭābhidhāyinām anupacāramadhurakomalollāpānāṃ priyāṇām apatyakānāṃ sadayam āśleṣaḥ |

nirdayaṃ ca tanutaramṛdusurabhinivasanābhir mallikāmukulānukārimuktāphalaprāyālaṅkārābhiḥ sahacarīninādasañjalpopajanitautsukyakalahaṃsānunāditanūpuraraśanākalāpaśiñjitānugamanasammugdhamugdhasnigdhamṛduvacanābhir nijajaghananibiḍakucayugalālaṅkārabhārodvahanaśramaśvasanakampitamadhyamukulitalocanotpalābhiḥ kiñcidvigalitanavayauvanābhiḥ priyaṅgasaṅgamātrātimātrasukhāsvādavisraṃsyamānāṃśukaikakālopajātavrīḍāvailakṣyapragalbhatāvaiklavyaharṣaviṣādavismayasmitakopaprasādasādhvasasrastasvinnasarvāṅgadravīkṛtahimāṅgarāgābhiḥ samastadehahṛdayaprahlādakāriṇībhir vilāsavatībhiś caturaṅgam ivānaṅgabalam aṅgais tanubhir api samudvahantībhir aṅganābhir āśleṣaḥ |

sāgarānukāritoyāśayopatīrasuniviṣṭakusumitabahuviṭapapṛthutuṅgavividhatarataṭaruhatarunivahabahalacchāyopasañchannaṃ ghavalaraktanīlanīrajarajovyāptasamastajalavipulasikatilatalopakalpitaṃ dolāyamānagaṇatithapṛthudṛtikalaśasaraṇakarakasravadudakapravāhāhitamṛtsaurabhabhūtalaikadeśaṃ pralambamānāmrajambūkadambavidulaniculādikisalayamañjarīstabakapratyuptapaṭālikaṃ muhur muhuḥ puruṣaprayatnapreritaghaṭamukhodgīrṇośīracandanānuviddhāvalagnapatitaśeṣa muktāphalāyamānajalalavam uchrāyavistāravad aniṣiddhadūravistṛtaśītavātapraveśam atyarthasantatāmbuśītaśīkarābhiṣekapratihatasantāpadāhamohaśramaklamapipāsam atiśayaprāptarāmaṇīyakaṃ himācalasparddhiśaityam ambudharakālalīlāviḍambi kāyamānam |
viśeṣatas tu ghṛtaṃ payo virecanāni saumyāḥ sarve bhāvāḥ divāsvapnavarjyaś ca graiṣmo vidhiḥ ||

śleṣmaṇaḥ punar vidhivihitāni tīkṣṇāni saṃśodhanāni rūkṣaprāyāṇy abhyavahāryāṇi kaṭutiktakaṣāyopahitāni tīkṣṇāni dīrghakālasthitāni hṛdyāni madyāni dhāvanalaṅghanaplavanajāgaraṇāniyuddhayuddhavyavāyavyāyāmarūkṣonmardanasnānocchādanāni |
viśeṣataḥ kṣaudraṃ yūṣo vamanāni sarvaśaś copavāsaḥ sadhūmagaṇḍūṣaḥ sukhapratiṣedhaḥ sukhārtham eva vāsantiko vidhir iti |

lg.l: upakramaḥ pṛthag doṣān yo 'yam uddiśya kīrtitaḥ |
yojyāḥ paṭvamlamadhurā vāyau kruddhe rasāḥ kramāt |
pitte pittas tataḥ svāduḥ kaṣāyaś ca raso hitaḥ ||
kaṭukaḥ prāk tatas tiktaḥ kaṣāyo 'nte kaphāmaye ||
tadvidhas tadvidhe dehe kālasyauṣṇyān na kupyati ||
pittaṃ yāti cayaṃ kopaṃ na tu kālasya śaityataḥ ||
tulye 'pi kāle dehe ca skannatvān na prakupyati ||
cayādīn yānti sadyo 'pi doṣāḥ kāle 'pi vā na tu ||
caya eva jayed doṣaṃ kupitaṃ tv avirodhayan |
ūce parāśaro 'py artham amum eva pramāṇayan |
sthānataḥ kecid icchanti prāk tāvac chleṣmaṇo vadham |
śirasy urasi kaṇṭhe ca pralipte 'nnaruciḥ kutaḥ ||
tasmād ādau kapho ghātyaḥ kāyadvārārgalo hi saḥ |
madhyasthāyi yataḥ pittam āśukāri ca cintyate ||
ata eva ca pittādiḥ kaphānto 'nyaiḥ kramaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
suśrutaś ca na sarvatra matam etat bravīti tu |
viśaś ca saraṇaṃ pittāt tathā ca mṛdukoṣṭhatā ||
vāyuś ca varddhate 'vaśyaṃ yātsvahassu tayoḥ kṣaye ||
kaphapittānilān anye kramād āhus tayor api |
vijñāya karmabhiḥ svaiḥ svair doṣodrekaṃ yathābalam |
bheṣajaṃ yojayet tat tat tantrīkuryān na tu kramam ||
prayogaḥ śamayed vyādhiṃ yonyam anyam udīrayet |
nāsau viśuddhaḥ śuddhas tu śamayed yo na kopayet ||
kruddhaṃ malam alaṃ jetuṃ nālpabhāvād ubhāv api |
doṣā doṣātmakatvāc ca na same 'pi parasparam ||
dṛṣṭā mithaś ca doṣeṣu nātonyonyaṃ jayanti te ||
ārambhakaṃ virodhe 'pi mitho yad yat guṇatrayam |
viśvasya dṛṣṭaṃ yugapad vyādher doṣatrayaṃ tathā ||
durgandham asitaṃ pittaṃ kaṭukaṃ bahalaṃ guru ||
āvilas tantumāṃs tyānaḥ pralepī picchilaḥ kaphaḥ |
viparyaye tu pakvatvaṃ tathā tāmraṃ samecakam ||
pītañ ca pittam acchañ ca śleṣmācchaḥ piṇḍito 'thavā |
viśadaś ca saphenaś ca dhavalo madhuro rase ||
āmena tena sampṛktā doṣā dūṣyāś ca dūṣitāḥ |
samā ity upadiśyante ye ca rogās tadudbhavāḥ ||
līnān dhātuṣv anutkliṣṭān phalād āmād rasān iva ||
āśnayasya hi nāśāya te syur durnirharatvataḥ |
pācanair dīpanaiḥ srehais tān svedaiś ca pariṣkṛtān ||
hanty āśu yuktaṃ vaktreṇa dravyam āmāśayān malān ||
utkliṣṭān adha ūrdhvaṃ vā na cāmān vahataḥ svayam ||
dhārayed auṣadhair doṣān vidhṛtās te hi kurvate |
pravṛttān prāg ato doṣān upekṣeta hitāśinaḥ |
vibaddhān pācanais tais taiḥ pācayan nirhareta vā ||

div2.p: athāto rogabhedīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ |
kālajāḥ śītādikṛtā jvarādayo vyāpannajā asaṃrakṣaṇajāś ca |
ta ete samāsataḥ punar dvividhā bhavanti |
tatra rogotpattiṃ prati pratyutpannaṃ karma yad anenaiva śarīreṇa dṛṣṭam adṛṣṭañ coddiśyāptopadiṣṭānāṃ vihitānāṃ pratiṣiddhānām ananuṣṭhānam anuṣṭhānaṃ vā |
tat tu punar daivākhyam uktañ ca niyatāniyatabhedena prāk |
tatra yathāsvaṃ pratipakṣaśīlanāt pūrveṣāṃ rogāṇām upaśamaḥ |
anye punaḥ pratyutpannaṃ karma parakṛtam api varṇayanti |
evañ cāhuḥ yadi svayaṃ kṛtād eva karmaṇaḥ kāryānirvṛttiḥ syāt |
kim iti vidvān api parācaritayor upakārāpakārayoḥ sukhaduḥkhānurodhāt toṣaroṣau pratikartavyacittaṃ vā pratipadyate |
evam ete vyādhayo dvividhāḥ santaḥ trividhā jāyante |
sakalo 'pi cāyaṃ rogasamūhaḥ pratikāravān āyurvedavihitam upadeśam apekṣate |
yasmān niyatahetuko 'py āmayaḥ samyak bhiṣagādeśānuṣṭhānād upāttāyussaṃskārāparikṣaye jātopi vā sahyavedanatāṃ pratipadyate |
anupakramyamāṇas tu sarva eva prāyaśo bhinaty akaṇḍe |
svayam api ca daivān nidānālpatayā vā nivartamānaṣ ṣoḍaśaguṇasamudita kriyopalambhād āśutaram aparikliṣṭasya cāpagacchati |
aniyataphaladāyini tu daive hitābhyāsaratasyā 'vakāśam eva na labhate vyādhiḥ |
tasmān na kasyāñcid avasthāyām ātmavān hitāhitayoḥ tulyadarśī syāt |
tatrālpalakṣaṇā mṛdavo madhyalakṣaṇā madhyāḥ sampūrṇalakṣaṇās tv adhimātrāḥ |
te punaḥ sukhasādhyādiviśeṣeṇa caturvidhāḥ prāg upadiṣṭāḥ |
subahuśo 'pi ca bhidyamānā vyādhayo nijāgantutāṃ na vyabhicaranti ||
teṣu pūrvaṃ vātādayo vaiṣamyam āpadyante tato vyathābhinirvartate |
bāhyahetujās tv āgantavaḥ teṣu prāhareṇa vyathā pūrvam upajāyate tato doṣavaiṣamyam |
doṣavaiṣamyeṇaiva ca bahurūpā rug anubadhyate pravarddhate ca |
evañca kṛtvā na doṣavyatirekeṇa rogānubandhaḥ kevalaṃ paurvāparye viśeṣaḥ |
asaṅkhyeyatvāc ca doṣaliṅgair eva rogān upakramaṃ ca vibhajet ||
yathaiva śakuniḥ sarvataḥ paripatan divasaṃ svāṃ cchāyāṃ nātivartate |
yathā vā kṛtsnaṃ vikārajātaṃ vaiśvarūpyeṇa vyavashtitaṃ guṇatrayam apy atiricya na vartate |
tathaivedam api kṛtsnaṃ vikārajātaṃ doṣatrayam iti |
yathā ca vidyudvarṣādayo nabhasi bhavanti na tv avaśyaṃ nimittatas tv avaśyam api |
trividhan tu nimittam eṣām asātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaḥ pajñāparādhāḥ pariṇāmaśca te punaḥ pratyekam atiyogāyogamithyāyogabhedāt tridhā bhidyante |
tatra yathāsvaṃ cakṣurādīndriyāṇāṃ rūpādibhir arthair atisaṃsargo 'tiyogaḥ |
alpaśo naiva vā saṃsargas tv ayogaḥ |
svabhāvādibhir āhārakalpanāviśeṣāyatanair apathyānāṃ rasānām abhyavahāraḥ tathā snānādīnāṃ śītoṣṇādīnāñ ca spṛśyānām ayathāvad upasevanam aśucibhūtābhighātaviṣavātādisaṃsparśaś ca bhithyāyogaḥ ||
kāyavāṅmanobhedena tu trividham apy ahitaṃ karma prajñāparādhaḥ |
sarvo vā prajñāparādha evāyaṃ yad eṣām avivarjanam |
tatrāpi rasavarjyā viṣayā yathāyatham indriyaṃ bādhante 'nugṛhṇanti ca |
sarveṣāṃ punar vikārāṇāṃ nidānadoṣadūṣyāviśeṣebhyo bhāvābhāvaviśeṣā bhavanti |
yadā hy ete trayo nidānādiviśeṣāt nānyonyam anubadhnantīṣad vānubadhnanty abalā vā na tadāminirvarttante vyādharyāścarā dvābhinirvarttante tanavo vā bhavanty asampūrṇaliṅgā vā |
trayaś ca rogāṇāṃ mārgā bāhyamadhyābhyantarāḥ tatra bāhyo raktādidhātavas tvak ca |

ābhyantaro mahāsrotaḥ śarīramadhyaṃ mahānimnam āmapakvāśayāśrayaḥ koṣṭho 'ntar iti paryāyāḥ tadāśrayā jvarātīsārachardyalasakaviṣūcikāśvāsakāsahidhmānāhodaraplīhādayo 'ntarbhāgāś ca visarpaśophārśovidradhigulmādayaḥ ||
te ca rogāḥ svapradhānā bhavanty anyaparivārā vā kramād anubandhyanubandhākhyāḥ |
itare tu tadviparītāḥ tadvac ca doṣā api |
pradhānapraśame ca praśamo bhavati teṣām anupaśāmyato vā paścāt tān upakramet |
sa hi pīḍākarataro bhavati vyādhiparikliṣṭadehatvāt pramehapiṭakādivat |
tathānyaḥ pradhāna eva rogo 'nyasya pradhānasya hetuḥ bhavati |
yathā jvaro raktapittasya raktapittaṃ vā jvarasya |
ekaś cāpacāro nimittam ekasya vyādheḥ bahūnāṃ ca tathā bahavaḥ tadvadekaṃ liṅgam |
evam eva praśame 'bhyupāyaḥ tathā sa evānyasya prakope |
tasmāt tān avahitaḥ samyag āgamādibhiḥ parīkṣeta ||

tatrāgamato rogam evam evaṃ prakopaṇam evaṃ yonim evam adhiṣṭhānam evam ātmānam evaṃ devanam evaṃ rūpaśabdagandharasasparśam evaṃ pūrvarūpam evam upadravam evaṃ vṛddhisthānakṣayānvitam evam udarkam evaṃ nāmānam |
tasminn iyaṃ pratīkārasya pravṛttiḥ anyathā nivṛttiḥ |

pratyakṣatas tv āturasya yathāsvam indriyair varṇasaṃsthānapramāṇopacayachāyāviṇmūtra charditādhikyam āntrakūjanam aṅgulyādiṣu sandhiṣu sphuṭanaṃ dehaśakṛdvarṇādigandhaṃ suptaśītoṣṇastambhanasaṃspandaślakṣṇakharasparśañ ca |
prakṛtivikṛtiyuktam āsyarasan tu praśnena tathā succhardanaducchardanatvaṃ mṛdukrūrakoṣṭhatāṃ svapnadarśanamabhiprāyaṃ janmāmayapravṛttinakṣatradviṣṭeṣṭasukhaduḥkhāni ca |
