tatkṛteṣu ca śūlānāhavibandheṣv anantaroktānāṃ ghṛtānām auṣadhaiś cūrṇaguṭikākvāthān koladāḍimamātuluṅgasurāmaṇḍatakramastudhānyāmloṣṇodakānām anyatamena prakalpayet |

lg.l: trilavaṇahapuṣājamodājagandhāvacāhiṅgupāṭhopakuñcīśaṭhījīrakājājikustumbarībāṣpikākāravītumburusvarjikā yāvaśūko jaṭāpauṣkarī dāḍimaṃ tintiṇīkaṃ viḍaṅgāni bhārṅgī varo vetasāmlo miśir maricagajakaṇābhayāpañcakolāni kumbho nikumbho viśālā yavānī surāhvaṃ ca tat sarvam ekatra cūrṇīkṛtaṃ bījapūrād rasenāsakṛt bhāvitaṃ yaḥ pibet prātarāhārakāle 'thavā māsamātraṃ hitāśī naraḥ sādaram |

plutam aśiśiravāriṇā jīrṇamadyena mūtreṇa takreṇa kolāmbhasā mastunā peyayā sarpiṣauṣṭreṇa dugdhena kaulatthayūṣeṇa vā kṣāraniścyotatoyena vā dāḍimād vā rasenātmavān ebhir evauṣadhaiḥ sādhitaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ hṛdayagudakaṭīyakṛtplīhaguhyāśritaṃ tasya śūlaṃ praṇaśyet tathā gulmaviṣṭambhadurnāmakṛcchrodarādhmānahidhmāvibandhāḥ savardhmāruciśvāsakāsāḥ prapaktuṃ ca śakto bhavet pāvakaḥ prāśyamānāni pāṣāṇacūrṇāny api ||

div2.p: abhayāpaladvayam amlavetasapaladvayaṃ pālikān vacāviśvabheṣajatrivṛddantīcitrakaśaṭhīpuṣkarajaṭāyāvaśūkān kārṣikān maricājājīsaindhavopakuñcikāśitivārakayavānīdhātakīpuṣpaviḍaṅgān hiṅgutrikarṣaṃ ca cūrṇitaṃ pūrvavad bhāvitaṃ pītaṃ ca samānaṃ tena ||

yavānīśatapuṣpānāgakesaravacāmustavyoṣapāṭhāguggulutrivṛtāgajapippalītālīsailāpāmārgadravantīnidigdhikāmūlānāṃ bhāgo bhāgaś cāmlavetasasya tat sūkṣmarajīkṛtaṃ mātuluṅgadāḍimabadararasaśīdhusuroṣṇasalilānyatamena pītaṃ śūlagulmavardhmānāhodarakoṣṭhastaimityārśośmarīmūtragrahakaṭīpṛṣṭhagrahonmādāpasmāraskannaśukratāgnisādān apanayati ||
tatas tad acchaṃ śuṇṭhīsaindhavakuṣṭhakṛmighnacūrṇapratīvāpam adhiśṛtya lehībhūtam ādadīta |

mahauṣadhadevadārudantītrivṛtpāṭhākṣāradvayatriphalopakuñcikācavikādvīpippalīdvayapippalīmūlasarpasugandhā kuṣṭakaṭurohiṇīnām ardhapalikān bhāgān palaṃ palaṃ ca pañcānāṃ lavaṇānām ekatra cūrṇayitvā dadhnā trivṛtena cāplāvya kalaśodare 'ntardhūmaṃ pācayet |
agnivarṇaṃ ca kalaśam apanīya kṣāram ādadīta |
eṣa kṣārāgado bhelavihitaḥ samānaḥ pūrveṇa sarpamūṣikadaṣṭAgarāpasmāronmādāśmarīyoniśukradoṣāṃś ca sādhayati ||
pittaṃ ca vivṛddham antaḥ santāpaṃ janayet |
atyudriktapittas triphalāṃ trāyamāṇāṃ vā kṣīreṇa pibet |
luñcitatilapaladvayaṃ śuṇṭhyardhapalaṃ ca piṣṭaṃ guḍapalopetam uṣṇena payasā pibet |
tad vātagulmodāvartayoniśūlān apohati tathā kṣīraśṛtena mahāpañcamūlena śilāhvayam |
svedāṃś ca vividhān punaḥ punar yojayet ||
athavā rāmaṭhasyaiko bhāgaḥ saindhavasya trayo navairaṇḍatailasya saptaviṃśatir laśunasvarasasya tad aikadhyaṃ kṛtvā pītam udaragaragulmavardhmaplīhaśūlaharam |
tat peyāmaṇḍena saha rasāśinā nīlinīghṛtaṃ palamātrayā pītaṃ gulmaplīhakuṣṭhaśvitrajaṭharavyaṅgaśophajvarapāṇḍurogonmādāpasmārān apakarṣati |
durvirecyo hi sarva eva gulmī mārutābhibhūtakoṣṭhatvāt |
tasmāt susnigdham enaṃ snehavirekair vā śodhayet ||
pittagulme tu snigdhoṣṇena jāte sraṃsanārthaṃ madhunā kampillakam avalihyāt |
rūkṣoṣṇasamudbhūte punaḥ saṃśamanārthaṃ tiktakaṃ vāsāghṛtaṃ vā pibet |
athavā tṛṇapañcamūlakvāthena jīvanīyakalkena ca siddhaṃ sarpiḥ |
tathā nyagrodhādigaṇena tṛṇapañcamūlādibhir vā pṛthak sādhitaṃ kṣīram ||
rūkṣoṣṇaje 'pi cātyayike sāmānyato vā samutpanne vidradhivihitānāṃ triphalādikvāthatrāyamāṇāghṛtadrākṣāghṛtānām anyatamaṃ pibet |
kṣīraṃ vā trāyamāṇāśṛtaṃ koṣṇaṃ pītvā kṣīram eva sukhoṣṇam anupibet ||
pakvāśayasthe vā gulme kṣīrabastibhiḥ satiktaiḥ saṃśodhayet |
maṇikanakarajatatāmrabhājanāni ca śiśiravāripūrṇāni gulmadeśasyopari dhārayen muktāvalīś ca suśītāḥ |
srutaraktaṃ ca jāṅgalarasair labdhabalam artiśeṣanāśāya punaḥ sarpir abhyāsayet ||
paryāgatam āpa tadvad upalakṣya tathaiva sarvathopacaret ||
śleṣmagulminaṃ prāg eva vidhivad vāmayed avāmyam upavāsayet |
tathā svedān vātagulmoktāni ca ghṛtādīni dviguṇahiṅgukṣārāmlavetasāni ||
bhallātakapaladvayaṃ laghupañcamūlaṃ ca pālikam udakāḍhake prasthāvaśeṣaṃ pācayet |
tasmin kṣīraprasthe ca sarpiḥprasthaṃ hiṅguviḍaṅgaśaṭhībiḍasaindhavakṣārarāsnānāgarapippalīṣaḍgranthāmadhukacitrakaiḥ kāṣikair vipacet |
ṣaṭpalaṃ vā dviguṇakṣāraṃ kṣīrarahitaṃ mastudadhikāñjikārdrakarasāḍhakadvayopetaṃ sādhayitvā prayuñjīta |
tato 'sya sarvam aṅgaṃ gulmaṃ ca sādhmānaṃ savibandhaṃ kaṭhinam unnataṃ gūḍhamāṃsaṃ sthiraṃ mahāvastuṃ ca bahudhā bahuśaś ca svedayet |
snigdhasvinnaśarīrasya śithilatāṃ gate gulme yathoktāṃ ghaṭikāṃ lāgayet |
tayā saṅgṛhīte ca gulme ghaṭīm apanayet bhindyād vā ||
tato hṛdayam āntraṃ ca varjayan gulmaṃ vimārgājapadādarśānyatamena vastrāntaritaṃ prapīḍayet pramṛjyāt |
tataḥ sālvalādibhiḥ sukhoṣṇair lepayitvā lohapātraiḥ svedayet |
evam amunā krameṇa sthānād apasṛte śithilībhūte ca gulme virekān snehavato dāśamūlikāṃś ca bstīn vidadhyāt |
triphalākumbhanikumbhadaśamūlānāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśāvaśiṣṭaṃ kvāthaṃ ghṛtam eraṇḍatailaṃ kṣīraṃ caikataḥ sādhayet |
pippalyāmalakadrākṣāśyāmādyaiḥ pālikair eraṇḍatailahaviṣoḥ prasthau ṣaḍguṇe payasi paced ayaṃ miśrakasneho gulmināṃ sraṃsano vṛddhividradhigulmavātavyādhiṣu ca paramamṛtam ||

dantyāḥ palāni pañcaviṃśatis tāvanty eva citrakasya tāvatya eva harītakyaḥ sarvam ekatra salilakalaśe 'ṣṭāṃśāvaśiṣṭaṃ sādhayitvā pūte ca tasmin rase tāś ca harītakīḥ pañcaviṃśatiṃ guḍapalāni tailārdhakuḍavaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ trivṛtākuḍavam ardhapalonmitāṃ māgādhikāṃ mahauṣadhaṃ ca prakṣipet |
tato mṛdvagninā lehībhūte 'vatārite śīte ca tailasamaṃ madhu karṣāṃśaṃ ca caturjātakacūrṇaṃ miśrayet |
mūtrabastikṣārāṃś ca tāṃs tāṃs tatra tatroktān kṣīrarasasnigdhāhāro dvyaham ekāhaṃ vā viśrāmya prayuñjīta |
kṣāro hi śleṣmāṇaṃ snigdhasthiraṃ madhuram āśayāt chindan kṣarayati ||

lg.l: ślaiṣmikaḥ kṛtamūlatvād yadi gulmo na śāmyati |
tasya dāhaṃ hṛte rakte kuryād ante śarādibhiḥ ||

div2.p: atha vastrāntaritaṃ saparyantaṃ gulmanicayaṃ pradīptena śaralohāgnimanthatindukakāṣṭhānām anyatamena nābhibastihṛdayāntraromarājīḥ pariharan nātigāḍhaṃ parāmṛśet |
tataḥ kaṣāyasvāduśītair agnivegam upaśamayya varṇopakramaṃ kurvīta ||
vyāmiśradoṣe tu vyāmiśram idam eva yathoktaṃ vidadhyāt ||
raktagulme punar atītaprasavakālāyā yoṣitaḥ snehasvedapūrvakaṃ snehavirecanaṃ vitaret |
evam abhidyamāne yonau yonivirecanārthaṃ kṣāreṇa mahāvṛkṣakṣīreṇa vā yuktaṃ palalam |
tābhyāṃ vā bhāvitān kaṭukamatsyāṃs tatpittabhāvitān vā varāhapittabhāvitān vā naktakān ūrdhvādhobhāgikadravyabhāvitān vā |
bastiṃ ca sakṣārakṣīramūtraṃ dāśamūlikam uttarabastiṃ ca yojayet ||
sarveṣu cānnapānasvarūpajño gulmeṣv āhāram agnibalāpekṣī prayuñjīta ||
ānāhādiṣv apy āmaśuddhavātodāvartānurodhena gulmavat pratikuryād iti |

lg.l: mande 'gnau vardhate gulmaḥ pradīpte tu praśāmyati |

div2.p: sarvam evodaram atimātradoṣasañcayānubandhena srotomukhanirodhād vyākulānilatayā yat prajāyate tasmād abhīkṣṇam udarī virecanānyupayuñjīta |
mūtrakṣīrānyatarayuktam eraṇḍatailam ahar ahar māsam ekaṃ dvau vā kṣīrāhāro vā gavyaṃ vā māhiṣaṃ vā mūtram |
śophaśūlānāhatṛṇmūrcchāparīto viśeṣeṇa payo 'nupānaṃ gomūtreṇa prāṇadāṃ pibet |
harītakīcūrṇaprasthayuktam āḍhakaṃ ghṛtasyāṅgāreṣv abhivilāpya khajenābhimathya suguptaṃ yavapalle māsaṃ sthāpayet |
tataś cod vṛtya parisrāvya harītakīkvāthāmladadhipratīvāpaṃ vipācayet ||
athavā gavye payasi mahāvṛkṣakṣīram āvāpya vipācya śītībhūtam abhimathya taṃ navanītaṃ mahāvṛkṣakṣīreṇaiva saha sādhayet ||

athavā cavikācitrakadantyativiṣākuṣṭhasārivāviḍaṅgatriphalākaṭurohiṇīdviharidrāśāṅkhinītrivṛddīpyakān ardhakārṣikān rājavṛkṣaphalamajjādvipalaṃ mahāvṛkṣakṣīradvipalaṃ gomūtrakṣīraghṛtatrikuḍavaṃ caikadhyaṃ pācayet |
yāvaśūkapañcakolakaṣaṭpalena vā mastudaśamūlakvāthāḍhakadvayena ca siddhaṃ sarpiḥprasthaṃ prayojayet ||
sarpiṣpānasraste ca doṣe balavān virecanārthaṃ mūtrāsavāriṣṭasurāḥ snuhīkṣīrayuktāḥ śīlayet |
kampillakanīlinīphalatrivṛtānāṃ kramād dvitricaturbhiḥ karṣair yuktāś cūrṇayitvā mūtreṇa pibet |
jīrṇe ca peyāmaṇḍapo rasāśī vā syāt |
anena vidhinā cūrṇam idam udarāṇi jātodakāny api nibarhayati |
vamanavirecanaśirovirecanavatsakādivacāharidrādivargadravyāṇi pṛthakpālikāni sūkṣmakalkīkṛtāni lavaṇāni ca vajravṛkṣakṣīraprasthaṃ ca prakṣipya mūtragaṇe mṛdvagninā ghaṭṭayan pācayet |
avidagdhakalkaṃ ca tat siddham avatārya śītībhūtam aṅguṣṭhamātrāṃ guṭikāṃ vartayitvā yathābalaṃ tricaturo māsān upayojayet |
kṛtavirecanaś ca kṣāmadeho 'ntarāntarā kṣīram auṣṭrakaṃ gavyam ājaṃ vā vyoṣayuktaṃ śīlayet |
doṣaśeṣavijayāya ca śīlayec cavikānāgaraṃ kṣīreṇa piṣṭam |
suradārucitrakaṃ vā suraṅgāṃ vā punarnavaṃ vā triphalādantīrauhītakaniryūhaṃ vā vyoṣakṣāropetaṃ tat snuhīkṣīraghṛtayuktam ||
purāṇam annaṃ takram ariṣṭāṃś ca tāṃs tān kṣīraṃ ca dantīcitrakaviḍaṅgacavikātrikaṭukopetam |
punaḥ punaś ca snehayed virecayec ca |
kaphe pitte vā vātenāvṛte tābhyāṃ vā vāte balavān vātagulmoktakrameṇairaṇḍatailaṃ pibet ||
limpec ca jaṭharam udariṇāṃ śigrupalāśārkāśvakarṇagajapippalīdevadārubhir mūtrapiṣṭaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ |
viriktasya cāsya sadā mlānam udaraṃ sālvalādibhir upanaddhaṃ ghanena vāsasā veṣṭayet |
evam enam anavakāśo vāyur na punar ādhmāpayati |
tathāpi punaḥ suviriktasyādhmāne 'mlalavaṇān susnigdhān nirūhān dadyāt |
atha vātodariṇaṃ vidāryādisiddhena sarpiṣopasnehya sveditāṅgaṃ tilvakaghṛtena bahuśo 'nulomayet |
kṛtāyāṃ ca saṃsargyāṃ balārthaṃ kṣīram avacārayet |
tato yūṣarasādibhir mandāmlalavaṇaiḥ samiddhānalam udāvartinaṃ punaḥ snigdhasvinnam āsthāpayed vidāryādikvāthena citrāphalatailapragāḍhena tīkṣṇoṣṇādhobhāgikadravyayuktena vā dāśamūlikena ||
dīptāgniṃ ca baddhamalam asthisandhitrikapārśvādiśūlasphuraṇākṣepayuktaṃ rūkṣam anuvāsayed vātaharāmlasiddhābhyāṃ tilorubūkatailābhyām |
bhojayec cainaṃ jāṅgalarasena vidāryādiśṛtena vā payasā ||
pittodariṇaṃ madhuravipakvena sarpiṣopasnehya śyāmātrivṛttriphalāvipakvenānulomyainaṃ madhughṛtasitāḍhyena nyagrodhādiniryūheṇāsthāpayed anuvāsayec ca ||
durbalaṃ tu prāg evānuvāsya kṣīrabastibhiḥ śodhayet ||
sañjātabalāgniṃ ca snigdhaṃ punaḥ kṣīreṇa satrivṛtkakenorubūkaśṛtena vā |
sātalātrāyamāṇābhyāṃ vāragvandhena vā saśleṣmaṇi pitte samūtreṇa savāte tiktaghṛtānvitena payasā punaḥ punar virecayet bastikarma cācaret ||
ebhir eva kṣīrair vidāryādiśṛtena vā bhojayet |
śleṣmodariṇaṃ vatsakādisiddhena sarpiṣopasnehya snuhīkṣīravipakvenānulomya kaṭukṣārayuktaiḥ kaphaharairāhāraiḥ saṃsarjya trikaṭumūtratailapragāḍhena muṣkakādikvāthenāsthāpayed anuvāsayec ca |
styānakaphodaraṃ kṣāram ariṣṭāṃś ca tīkṣṇān pāyayet |
sarvam evety eke sarvasya sarvātmakatvāt kṛcchratamatvāc ca |
saptalāśaṅkhinīniryāsasiddhena ca sarpiṣā virecayen māsam ardhamāsaṃ vā |
tathā cānupaśāmyati nicayātmake sarvatra ca jaṭhare jñātīn āśrāvya madyenāśvamārakaguñjākākādanīmūlakalkaṃ pāyayet |
ikṣugaṇḍikāṃ vā bhakṣayet kṛṣṇasarpeṇa daṃśayitvā vallīphalāni vā mūlakaṃ vā ||
evaṃ hy asya doṣasaṅghātaḥ sthiro līna unmārgago viṣeṇāśu pramāthinā vibhinno bahiḥ pravartate |
tatas trivṛdvāstukamaṇḍūkaparṇīkālaśākayavaśākānām anya tamaṃ svarasasādhitam anamlalavaṇasnehaṃ svinnāssvinnam anannabhuṅ māsam ekam aśnīyāt |
tataḥ śākair nirhṛte doṣe parato durbalāya kārabhaṃ kṣīraṃ prayuñjīta ||
plīhodare yathādoṣam upasnigdhasvinnasya dadhnā bhuktavato vāmabāhau sirāṃ vidhyet |
punaś ca snehapītaṃ viśuddhadehaṃ samudraśuktikṣāraṃ payasā pāyayet hiṅgu suvarcikāṃ vā |
agnisāde tu trilavaṇādiṃ kṣārān ariṣṭāṃś ca pibet |
rohītakatvakpalāni pañcaviṃśatiṃ kolaprasthadvayaṃ ca toye kvāthayet tena kvāthena tathā pālikaiḥ pañcakolakais taiḥ sarvaiś ca tulyayā rohītakatvacā kalkīkṛtair ghṛtaprasthaṃ sādhayet |
rohītakalatāḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ kalpitāḥ harītakīś ca toye gomūtre vā saptarātram āsunuyāt |
evam anupaśāmyaty aprāptapicchodake vātakapholbaṇe gulmavidhināgnikarma kuryāt ||
baddhodare svinnāya satailalavaṇamūtraṃ tīkṣṇaṃ nirūham anuvāsanaṃ ca dadyāt |
sraṃsanāni cānnāny udāvartaharāṇi ca tīkṣṇaṃ ca virecanaṃ yac ca kiñcid vātaghnam ||
dakodare tu pūrvam udakadoṣaharaṇārthaṃ rūkṣatīkṣṇauṣadhān samūtrān niryūhacūrṇakṣārān kaphaghnāni dīpanīyāni cānnapānāni yojayet ||
evam asiddhau baddhacchidradakodareṣv aśmaryām iva suhṛdāṃ prakāśya śastram avacārayet |

tatra baddhacchidrodarayoḥ snigdhasvinnasyādho nābheś caturaṅgulāni vāmato 'pahāyodaraṃ pāṭayitvā caturaṅgulapramāṇam āntrāṇi niṣkāsya nirīkṣya baddhagudodarasyāntrapratirodhakaraṃ bālaṃ malopalepam aśmānaṃ cāpaharet |
parisrāviṇi śalyam uddhṛtyāntraparisrāvaṃ viśodhya tac chidraṃ markoṭakair daṃśayet |
tato madhughṛtābhyām abhyajyāntrāṇi yathāsthānaṃ sthāpayitvā bāhyaṃ vraṇam udarasya sīvyet |
yaṣṭīmadhukamiśrayā ca kṛṣṇamṛdā vraṇam abhilipya badhnīyāt |
atha nivātam āgāraṃ praveśya kṣīravṛttiṃ snehadroṇyāṃ vāsayet ||

dakodare savaṣu ca jātodakeṣu jaṭhareṣu vātaharatailābhyaktasyoṣṇodakasvinnasyāptaiḥ parigṛhītasyākakṣyātaḥ paṭaveṣṭitodarasyādho nābher vāmataś caturaṅgulam apahāya vrīhimukhenāṅguṣṭhodaramātram avagāḍhaṃ vidhvā nāḍīṃ nidhāya doṣodakam ardhamātram avasiñcet |
tato nāḍīm uddhṛtya tailalavaṇenābhyajya vraṇaṃ bandhanenopacaret ||
sahasā sarvasnim visrāvite tṛṣṇā jvaro 'ṅgamardo 'tīsāraḥ śvāsaḥ kāsaḥ pādadāho vā jāyate |
atas tṛtīyacaturthapañcamaṣaṣṭhāṣṭamadvādaśaṣoḍaśarātrāṇām anyatamam antaraṃ kṛtvā doṣodakam alpaśo visrāvayet |
nisrute ca doṣodake vimṛdyodaram āvikakauśeyacarmaṇām anyatareṇa gāḍhataraṃ veṣṭayet |
laṅghayitvā ca yavāgūm alpasnehalavaṇāṃ mātrayā pāyayet |
anyac ca māsatrayam alpalavaṇam alpakṣīraṃ śyāmākaṃ koradūṣaṃ vā bhuñjīteti |

lg.l: vahnir mandatvam āyāti doṣaiḥ kukṣau prapūrite |
tasmāt bhojyāni yojyāni dīpanāni laghūni ca ||
bhāvitānāṃ gavāṃ mūtre ṣaṣṭikānāṃ ca taṇḍulaiḥ ||
yavāgūṃ payasā siddhāṃ prakāmaṃ bhojayen naram |
svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ vrajanty eṣāṃ vātapittakaphās tathā |
prayogāṇāṃ ca sarveṣām anu kṣīraṃ prayojayet |

div2.p: pāṇḍvāmayinam ādau kalyāṇakapañcagavyatiktakānām anyatamaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayet |

dāḍimasārataḥ kuḍavaṃ dhānyakārdhakuḍavaṃ pippalyaṣṭamikāṃ śuṇṭhīcitrakayoś ca palaṃ palam ekataḥ kalkīkṛtya toyāḍhake viṃśatipalaṃ ghṛtasya siddhaṃ hṛtpāṇḍurogagulmaplīhārśaḥśvāsakāsamūḍhavātavātakaphārtiharam agnidīpanaṃ vandhyānāṃ sammataṃ duḥkhaprasavinīnāṃ ca ||
punaś ca snigdhaṃ mūtrayuktaṃ gavyaṃ māhiṣaṃ vārdhamāsaṃ payaḥ pāyayet |
vatsakabījaviśālākuṣṭhakaṭukādārumustānāṃ samā bhāgāḥ mūrvābhāgadvayam ativiṣābhāgārdhaṃ ca cūrṇitaṃ sukhāmbunā pītvā kṣaudram anulihyāt |

trikaṭukakālatilalohair vā mākṣikadhātutulyair mākṣikeṇa vaṭakā vyoṣakāgniviḍaṅgabhāgā nava nava cāyasacūrṇabhāgā madhughṛtābhyāṃ takreṇoṣṇodakena vopayuktā hṛtpāṇḍurogakāmalākuṣṭhārśaḥśophodaraplīhamehaharāḥ ||
mākṣikadhātucavikādārudārvītvaggranthikān triphalādīni ca nava vicūrṇya cūrṇād dviguṇaṃ ca suślakṣṇaṃ pṛthaṅ maṇḍūraṃ tato gomūtraṃ sarvato 'ṣṭaguṇaṃ paktvā tasmiṃs tat kṣipet |
te takrānupānam abhyastāḥ paramauṣadhaṃ pāṇḍvāmayināṃ śophārśaḥkuṣṭhakāmalāmehaplīhāḍhyavātakaphārtānāṃ ca ||
śilājatutāpyarūpyāyomalāḥ pṛthak pañcapalikās triphalādayaś ca vigataghanāḥ palāṃśāḥ ślakṣṇarajasaḥ sitopalāpalāṣṭakayuktāḥ kṣaudradrutā yogarājaḥ |

triphalākuṭajaphalaghanapaṭolapicumandamahauṣadhakaṣāyair māsam ardhamāsaṃ vā bhāvitāny aṣṭau śilāhvayapalāni samasitāny upakulyātugākṣīrīdhātrīphalakarkaṭakaśṛṅgyaḥ pṛthak palāṃśāḥ nidigdhikāphalamūlayoḥ palaṃ trijātakatrikarṣaṃ ca kṣaudratripalayuktān vaṭakān vartayet |
te dāḍimāmbukṣīrarasasalilasurāsavānyatamānupānā vajrābhidhānā vajram ivānantaroktān rogān dārayanti |
drākṣāpippalīprasthadvayaṃ śarkarārdhatulāṃ tavakṣīrīnāgaramadhukāni ca dvipalikāni cūrṇayitvāmalakarasadroṇe prakṣipya mṛdvagninā pacet |
lehībhūte śīte ca tasmin madhuprastham āvapet |
trisugandhikasya karṣatrayaṃ ca cūrṇīkṛtya darvyā parighaṭya jātīpuṣpādivāsite mṛdbhāṇḍe nidadhyāt |
ayaṃ drākṣāleha upayujyamānaḥ pāṇḍvāmayahṛdrogakāmalāhalīmakajvaragulmodaraśophodāvartādīn aparān api virekasādhyān vyādhīn prasahya vāyur ivābhrāṇy apaharati ||
bhojanaṃ tu sātmyataḥ śāliyavagodhūmamudgajāṅgalamāṃsāni payo ghṛtaṃ vṛṣapaṭolavetaparpaṭaśākaṃ drākṣādāḍimakharjūrāmalakarasāni |

pañca drākṣāyā balāyāḥ sapta jaladroṇe paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ tebhyo rasam ādāya pūtaśīte 'smin śarkarātulāṃ madhuprasthaṃ karṣāṃśāni ca cūrṇitāni vyoṣavyāghranakhośīrakramukailāvālukakuṣṭhamadhukāni nikṣipya ghṛtabhājane sarvam aikadhyaṃ yavapalle grīṣme daśarātraṃ viṃśatirātraṃ śīte sthāpayet |
ardhatulāṃ daśamūlasya triphalāyāḥ pṛthag ardhaprastha kuṭajatvacaś ca |
mṛdvīkārdhaprasthaṃ ca ṣoḍaśaguṇe pādaśeṣam ambhasi vipācya rasam ādadīta |
taṃ pūtaśītaṃ sitopalātulādvayena lohacūrṇaprasthena ca yuktaṃ māgadhikārdhaprasthena ślakṣṇapiṣṭena granthikapalenārdhapalikaiś ca maricaviḍaṅgailavālukaiḥ pralipte ghṛtakumbhe nidhāpayet |

athavā cavyakuṣṭhacitrakapralipte bhājane mastudroṇaṃ guḍatulāṃ pippalīprasthatrayaṃ triphalāprasthatrayaṃ viḍaṅgaprasthatrayaṃ kuḍavāṃśāṃś ca maricaparūṣakadrākṣākāśmaryaphalendrayavān dvipalikāni ca dantīcitrakabhallātakāni cūrṇitāni prakṣipet |
tato yavapallasthaṃ pakṣam upekṣya yathābalaṃ pibet |

lg.l: mṛdaṃ nirghātayet kāyāt tīkṣṇaiḥ saṃśodhanaiḥ puraḥ |
balādhānāni sarpīṃṣi śuddhe koṣṭhe tu yojayet ||
mustāny ayorajaḥ pāṭhā viḍaṅgaṃ devadāru ca ||
vṛścikālī ca bhārṅgī ca sakṣīrais taiḥ śṛtaṃ ghṛtam |
ghṛtaprasthaḥ śṛtas tadvat plīhāśvayathujic ca saḥ ||
māhiṣāt sarpiṣaḥ prasthaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrve paraḥ pare |
kumbhasya cūrṇaṃ sakṣaudraṃ traiphalena rasena vā |
saśarkarāṃ tribhāṇḍīṃ vā gavākṣīṃ vā prayojayet ||
triphalāyā guḍūcyā vā dārvyā nimbasya vā rasam |
tilapiṣṭanibhaṃ yas tu kāmalāvān sṛjen malam |
kaphasammūrchito vāyur yadā pittaṃ bahiḥ kṣipet ||
svaṃ pittam eti tenāsya śakṛd apy anurajyate |
māsaṃ mākṣikadhātuṃ vā kiṭṭaṃ vātha hiraṇyajam ||
drākṣālehaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ sarpīṃṣi madhurāṇi ca ||

div2.p: śvayathuṣu doṣajeṣu sarveṣu sarvasareṣv āmānubaddheṣu laṅghana pācanaśodhanāny ādau yojayet |
ārdrakaṃ vā tulyaguḍam ardhapalābhivṛddhaṃ pañcapalaprakarṣaṃ prayuñjīta |
kumbhanikumbhavyoṣāgnikair vā karabhīkṣīravṛttir vā syāt gomūtraṃ mahaṣīmūtraṃ vā sakṣīraṃ kṣīrāśanaḥ pibet ||
dāḍimayavānīyavānakadhanikāpāṭhāmlavetasamaricapañcakolabilvaphalayāvaśūkānakṣamātrān salilāḍhake vipācya tatkaṣāyeṇa ghṛtaprasthaṃ sādhayec chophārśogulmamehāgnisādaharam |
yathādoṣocchrayaṃ ca dhānvantaraṃ kalyāṇakaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tiktaṃ mahātiktam udaroktāni vā tilvakacaturthāni ghṛtāni pāyayet ||
lehībhūte tatra trikaṭukatrijātakayavakṣāracūrṇaṃ prakṣipet kṣaudrārdhaprasthaṃ ca |
etā daśamūlaharītakyo 'tipravṛddham api śvayathum udarārocakāvipākapāṇḍurogagulmamehaśvāsakāsakārśyāmavātāmlapittamūtraśukradoṣāṃś ca nighnanti ||
śaṭhīpuṣkaramūlakāravīcitrakājājījīvantībilvamadhyayavakṣāravṛkṣāmlair daśamūlena ca parigṛhītāni ghṛtatailabhṛṣṭāni peyādīny annāny alpasnehalavaṇāny upakalpayet |
athānilaje śvayathau trivṛtam eraṇḍatailaṃ vārdhamāsaṃ māsaṃ vā pibet |
eraṇḍatailam eva ca viḍvātasaṅge prāgbhaktaṃ payasā rasair vā |
bhallātakacitrakavyoṣaviḍaṅgabṛhatīphalāni pṛthak prasthāṃśāny acchadhānyāmladroṇe gomayāgninā tribhāgaśeṣam avatārayet |
tat pūtaśītaṃ mastukalaśena sitopalātulayā ca yuktam agnikamāgadhikākalkalipte dṛḍhe bhāṇḍe samāvāpya vaihāyase suguptaṃ sthāpayet |
tato daśāhasthito 'yam upayukto bhallātakāriṣṭaḥ śophodarārśobhagandaragrahaṇīkṛmikuṣṭhamehakārśyakikkasān satvaram apanayati ||
triphalāmaricadrākṣāpippalīkāśmaryaphalānāṃ pratyekaṃ śataṃ guḍatulām udakadroṇaṃ ca madhuliptabhājanasthaṃ saptāham uṣṇe kāle dvisaptāhaṃ śīte dhārayet |
ekadeśāśraye ca śvayathau yathāsannaṃ vamanādīni raktāvasecanaṃ ca kurvīteti |

lg.l: prāyo 'bhighātād anilaḥ saraktaḥ śophaṃ sarāgaṃ prakaroti tatra |
visarpanun mārutaraktanuc ca kāryaṃ viṣaghnaṃ viṣaje ca karma ||
gauḍaṃ piṣṭānnaṃ dadhisalavaṇaṃ picchilaṃ madyam amlam |
dhānā vallūraṃ samaśanam atho gurv asātmyaṃ vidāhi |
svapnaṃ cārātrau śvayathugadavān varjayen maithunaṃ ca ||

div2.p: pūrvarūpeṣv eva sarvavisarpāṇāṃ laṅghanaṃ rūkṣaṇaṃ sirāmokṣaṇam ullekhanaṃ virecanaṃ ca kuryāt |
nirāmeṣu kṣīṇakapheṣu ca śītavīryāṇi sarpīṃṣi tiktakatrāyamāṇāghṛtādīni pāne dadyāt |
śleṣmaṇy ajagandhāśvagandhāsaralakālakaiṣikāgaruvocarāsnāvacāśītaśivendravallīgomūtrāṇi varaṇādiṃ ca saṃsarge yathādoṣabalaṃ vikalpayet ||
tatra kaphasthānāśrite sāme pittasthānagate ca rūkṣā viśītāḥ pralepapariṣekāḥ ||
pitte tanavaḥ suśītāḥ saghṛtā vastrāntaritāḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe cāpanīyānye prayojyāḥ ||
granthivisarpe raktapittasaṃsargam avekṣya prāg laṅghanādīni virecanāntāni śamanāni ca yojayet |
śūle ca tadā snigdhāmloṣṇābhir utkārikābhir granthīnām upanāhanam |
vātakaphavisarpoktaiś ca lepas tair eva vā siddhena tailena toyena vā pariṣekaḥ |
limped vā śuṣkamūlakasya kalkena naktamālatvaco vā |
vidagdhaṃ vā raktam apanīyāpanīya punaḥ punaḥ svedayet |
sarvasmin visarpe paryāgate vidārite ca vraṇavat |
kardamake śīghrataraṃ sutarāṃ ca vamanādīni kṛtvā punar jalaukobhir asṛg avasecayet |
virekārthaṃ ca trivṛccūrṇaṃ sarpiṣā payasā drākṣārasena gharmāmbhasā vā pāyayet |

lg.l: yac ca nāsāv asaṃsṛṣṭo raktapittena jāyate ||
na ghṛtaṃ bahudoṣāya deyaṃ yan na virecanam |
tena doṣo hy upastabdhas tvagraktapiśitaṃ pacet ||

div2.p: tatra vātottare meṣaśṛṅgīśārṅgeṣṭairaṇḍaguḍūcīdvipañcamūlasiddhaṃ tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā pānābhyaṅgayor vidadhyāt ||
tena kārṣikaiś candanopakulyāmustātrāyantīndrayavabhūnimbaiḥ kalkitaiḥ sapiṣo dvādaśapalaṃ sādhayet |

saptacchadakaṭukātiviṣāśamyākapāṭhāmustatriphalośīrapaṭolaparpaṭakapippalīdvayadvirajanīdvisārivā candanadurālabhāpadmakavacāśatāvarīviśālākuṭajabījavṛṣamūrvāguḍūcībhūnimbatrāyamāṇāmadhukagarbhaṃ dviguṇāmalakarasam aṣṭaguṇāmbu sarpir vipakvaṃ mahātiktakākhyaṃ ghṛtam adhikaguṇaṃ pūrvasmāt |
athavā bṛhatīdvayakākamācīśukanāsākvāthe maricaviḍaṅgaśigrujātīdevadārukṣavakaharidrābhayākalkena vājimūtreṇa ca siddhaṃ sarpiḥ ||
tataḥ snigdhasya yathādoṣaṃ yathāsannaṃ ca saṃśodhanāni prayuñjīta |
sirāṃ ca balāpekṣī vidhyed ekāṃ dve tisraś catasraḥ pañca vā |
antarāntarā ca punaḥ punaḥ snehaṃ pibet |
durbalaṃ hi śūnyakoṣṭhaṃ kuṣṭhinaṃ vāyur abhibhavati |
paṭolaviśālayor mūlaṃ triphalā ca pṛthak tribhāgonatriśāṇāḥ kaṭukātrāyamāṇe śāṇāṃśe śuṇṭhyās tribhāgonaḥ śāṇaḥ tad etat palam aikadhyaṃ salile vipācya pāyayet |
āvartakītulāṃ salilārmaṇe 'ṣṭāṃśaśiṣṭāṃ vipācya tena niryūheṇa tanmūlaiś ca ghṛtaprasthaṃ sādhayet |
śītalavaṇamāranālaṃ jīrṇasnehaś ca tenaiva kodravaudanam aśnīyāt |

khadirakadaratiniśāsanaśirīṣaśiṃśapāśākasarjārjunajambūkaravīradhavāmalakīmuṣkakākṣikabadarīvañjulanimbakarañjakadambamadhūkasārān sārdrān kṛtamālaniculapaṭolāṅkolabalābilvakuṭajakaṭabhīpāribhadrasahacaragṛdhranakhīvaraṇavardhamānārkasaubhañjanāṭarūṣakaśatāvarīśvadaṃṣṭrāhimārāśvakarṇaśrīparṇīsvayaṃguptāgnimanthendravāruṇīkākodumbarikāmeṣaśṛṅgīṭuṇṭukaguḍūcīvarṣābhūvāyasībṛhatīdvayarohiṇīmūrvāśārṅgaṣṭāmūlāni ca śakalayitvā pṛthak triṃśatpalikāni saṅkṣudya mahati kaṭāhe 'ṣṭaguṇenāmbhasā kvāthayet |

aṣṭabhāgaśeṣaṃ niryūham avatārya parisrāvya ca tasmin sarpiṣaḥ palaśatatrayaṃ vipaced īṣadavaśeṣakaṣāye ca vidalīkṛtāruṣkarasahasratrayam atrāvāpya punaḥ pācayed vigatasvarasāny aruṣkarāṇy apāsya tasmin snehe sucūrṇitāni prakṣipet |

vyādhighātavyoṣanākulīmārkavārkakākādanītagarakaṭukākuṣṭhabilvahiṅguviḍaṅgacitrakātiviṣāmustendrayavendravāruṇīrūpya malaloharajolohakāntarasāñjanābhraśukanāsādevadālītriphalālāṅgalikīviśālākumbhanikumbhavacāvārāhīmahādrumakośātakīprapunnāṭasomaparṇīnalikādvayapaṭolījātīpallavatāpyakāravellīkūlikākandakasaptacchadaśārṅgeṣṭotpalasārivāgugguluśilājatumūrvākustumbarījīvakadvayapāṭhendrurekhāvajrakandaharidrādvayalavaṇapañcakāni pratyekaṃ tripalikāni śṛṅgīviṣapalaṃ caikaṃ tato darvyā samantād āghaṭya suguptaṃ bhūmau dhānye vā māsaṃ nikhanet ||
atha kṛtasaṃśuddhisvastyayanaḥ kuṣṭhī prātas tato mātrām upayuñjīta |
jīrṇe ca yatheṣṭam āhāraṃ tenāsya pūrvam aṅgāni tudyante bhidyante śūyante sphuranti sphuṭanti ca |

lg.l: śophaṃ kṛmīn pāṇḍugadaṃ jvarāṃś ca nivartayaty eṣa rasāyanāgryaḥ ||

div2.p: athavā kṣuṇṇān yavān nistuṣān rātrau gomūtraparyuṣitān ahani kiliñje śoṣayed evaṃ saptāhaṃ bhāvayec choṣayec ca |

evam asanādikvāthapītānām āragvadhādikaṣāyapītāna vā gojīrṇakānāṃ vā yavānāṃ saktūn aruṣkarāgnimanthacūrṇamiśrān khadirāsanasārarohitakaguḍūcīnām anyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa dāḍimāmlavetasāmlena saindhavalavaṇena sitāmadhumadhureṇāloḍya pāyayet |
yāvakāṃś ca bhakṣyān apūpapūrṇakośaśaṣkulī prabhṛtīn kuryāt |

surāṃ kalpayet palāśakṣārabhāvitaśālitaṇḍulapiṣṭena kṣārodakenaiva sveditena priyaṅgugajapippalīcitrakakebukailāvālukaparipelavalodhramaricaviḍaṅgacūrṇamiśreṇa nave caināṃ bhājane jatusṛte kṣaudrapippalīlipte sthāpayet |
khadiraśiṃśapāsāram uttamakāraṇīṃ brahmīṃ kośavatīṃ ca kaṣāyakalpena vipacet |

trivṛcchyāmāgnimanthasaptalākebukaśaṅkhinītilvakatriphalāpalāśaśiṃśapānāṃ rasam ādāya palāśadroṇyām abhyāsicaya khadirāṅgārataptamayaḥpiṇḍam ekaviṃśativārān nirvāpya tatas taṃ rasam āsicya sthālyāṃ gomayāgninā sādhayet |
pippalīcūrṇasya bhāgaṃ dvau madhunas tāvad ghṛtasya tataś caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭe 'vatīrṇe bhūyo 'gnitaptamayaḥpiṇḍaṃ tasmin prakṣipet praśāntaṃ ca lohapātre suguptaṃ nidadhyāt |
iyam ayaskṛtiḥ dussādham api kuṣṭhaṃ mehaṃ vā sādhayati |
sthūlaṃ karśayati śopham upahanti sannam agnim uddharati |
asanādikvātham āsicya palāśadroṇyam ayoghanais taptaiḥ saṃyojya nirvāpya ca kṛtasaṃskāre kalaśe prakṣipya vatsakādiṃ prativāpya kṣaudraṃ ca suguptaṃ māsaṃ nidhāyopayuñjīta ||
khadirasuradārukvāthaprasthaṃ kṣaudraprasthaṃ matsyaṇḍikāpprasthaṃ lohacūrṇārdhaprasthaṃ triphalācaturjātakamaricāni ca kārṣikāṇi prakṣipyāyase bhāṇḍe māsasthitaṃ tad upayojayet ||
rasāyanaprayogeṇa ca lohatulāṃ tuvarakāsthīni bhallātakāny alambuṣām avalgujaṃ guggulum arśovihitavidhānena vā citrakam iti ||

lg.l: annapānaṃ hitaṃ kuṣṭhe na tv amlalavaṇoṣaṇam |
viḍaṅgasārāmalakābhayānāṃ palaṃ palaṃ trīṇi palāni kumbhāt |
guḍasya ca dvādaśa māsam eṣa jitātmanā hanty upayujyamānaḥ ||
siddhaṃ yogaṃ prāha yakṣo mumuhṣor bhikṣoḥ prāṇān māṇibhadraḥ kilemam ||

div2.p: vātottarāṃs tu sarpir vipācitaṃ kvathitakalkitaiś ca kaṭukādyaiḥ |

lg.l: śītaḥ kaṣāyaḥ khadirasya pītaḥ sakṣaudratārkṣyo harati prasahya |
sarpir madhubhyāṃ triphalārasena viḍaṅgakalkena ca samprayuktaḥ |
kuṣṭhaṃ kaṣāyaḥ khadirasya hanti tiṣṭhan kaṣāyaṃ manasīva dharmaḥ ||
khadirasya lūnaśiraso mūle khātasya madhyamaṃ mūlam |
tasmād yaś cyavate rasaḥ sa sahitaḥ kṣaudrājyadhātrīrasaiḥ |
prasthas tasya jarāṃ ca bhojyam iha tu tyājyaṃ ca bhallātavat ||
dārvī rasāñjanaṃ vā gomūtreṇa prabādhate kuṣṭham |
raktā nimbaṃ suratarukṛtaṃ pañcamūlyau ca cūrṇaṃ pītvā māsaṃ jayati hitabhug gavyamūtreṇa kuṣṭham ||
prayāharet samastaṃ kṛtamālataroś ca tat tadvat ||
saptāham ekatas tad rasena bhṛṅgyās tato bhāvyam ||
atha pītam akṣamātraṃ ghṛtena dugdhena koṣṇasalilair vā |
acirāt karoti vahniṃ matiṃ smṛtiṃ pāṭavaṃ medhām ||
guṭikā rasāyanaṃ syāt kuṣṭhajic ca viṣyā ca saptasamā ||
sāvartakīkṛmiharaiḥ kramavardhitāṃśaiḥ mūtreṇa tulyatuvarair vaṭakā gadaghnāḥ ||
sāyomalā sāmalakā satailā kuṣṭhāni kṛcchrāṇi nihanti līḍhā ||
tadardhaṃ dvīpino mūlaṃ tadvad brāhmīṃ samārkavām ||
jīrṇe rasena rūkṣeṇa peyāpūrvaṃ ca bhojayet ||
khādet parastān māsasya bhavet kāmacaraḥ kramāt ||
evaṃ sarvāṇi kuṣṭhāni jayaty atibalāny api |
piṣṭaiḥ siddhaṃ sarpiṣaḥ prastham ebhiḥ krūre koṣṭhe snehanaṃ recanaṃ ca |
mūtre vinītā triphalārase vā siddhā ghṛte vāmbhasi kevale vā |
pracched alpaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ nirecayed vā jalaukobhiḥ ||
yeṣu na śastraṃ kramate sparśendriyanāśaneṣu kuṣṭheṣu |
teṣu nipātyaḥ kṣāro raktaṃ doṣaṃ ca visrāvya ||
lepo 'tikaṭhinaparuṣe supte kuṣṭhe sthire purāṇe ca |
ghṛṣṭāni gomayair vā tataḥ pradehaiḥ pradehyāni ||
āragvadhaḥ saiḍagajaḥ karañjo vāsā guḍūcī madanaṃ haridre |
śryāhvaḥ surāhvaḥ khadiro dhavaś ca nimbo viḍaṅgaḥ karavīrakaś ca ||
granthiś ca bhūrjo laśunaḥ śirīṣaḥ salomaśo guggulukṛṣṇagandhe |
vacāhareṇustrivṛtā nikumbho bhallātakaṃ gairikam añjanaṃ ca |
ity ardharūpair vihitāḥ ṣaḍ ete gopittapītāḥ punar eva piṣṭāḥ |
siddhāḥ paraṃ sarṣapatailayuktāś cūrṇāḥ pradehā bahuśāḥ prayojyāḥ ||
kuṣṭhāni kṛcchrāṇi navaṃ kilāsaṃ surendraluptaṃ kiṭibhaṃ sadadrum |
bhagandarārśāṃsy apacīṃ sapāmāṃ hanyuḥ prayuktān acirān narāṇām ||
nimbaṃ haridre surasaṃ paṭolaṃ kuṣṭhāśvagandhe suradāruśigru |
sasarṣapaṃ tumburudhānyavanyaṃ caṇḍāṃ ca cūrṇāni samāni kuryāt ||
tais takrapiṣṭaiḥ prathamaṃ śarīraṃ tailāktam udvartayituṃ yateta |
tathāsya kaṇḍūḥ piṭakāḥ sakoṭhāḥ kuṣṭhāni śophāś ca śamaṃ vrajanti ||
tailaktagātrasya kṛtāni cūrṇāny etāni dadyād avacūrṇanārtham |
dadruḥ sakaṇḍūḥ kiṭibhāni pāmā vicarcikā ceti tathā na santi ||
kāṇḍe mahāvṛkṣabhave nilīnaḥ svinnaḥ kukūle puṭapākayuktyā |
vicarcikāṃ sarṣapakalkapiṇḍo nihanti lajjām iva rāgavegaḥ ||
manaḥśilāle maricāni tailam ārkaṃ payaḥ kuṣṭhaharaḥ pradehaḥ |
dinakarakarābhitaptaiḥ kuṣṭhaṃ ghṛṣṭaṃ ca naṣṭaṃ ca ||
tailena yuktam uṣitaṃ saptāhaṃ bhājane tāmre ||
māsān navaṃ kilāsaṃ snānena vinā viśuddhasya ||
mayūrakaṃ jarjaritaṃ samūlaṃ dagdhvā parisrāvya ca saptakṛtvaḥ |
jīvantī mañjiṣṭhā dārvī kāmpillakaṃ payas tuttham |
eṣa ghṛtatailapākaḥ siddhaḥ siddhe ca sarjarasaḥ ||
deyaḥ samadhūcchiṣṭo vipādikā tena naśyati hy aktā |
varā vellaṃ ca tais tailaṃ sagomūtrair vipācitam ||
kanakakṣīrī śailā bhārṅgī dantyāḥ phalāni mūlaṃ ca |
etais tailaṃ tailaṃ kaṭutailaṃ vā caturguṇe mūtre |
śilā ca cūrṇo navanītayuktaṃ kuṣṭhe sravaty abhyadhikaṃ praśastaḥ ||
lākṣāvyoṣaṃ prāpunāṭaṃ ca bījaṃ saśrīveṣṭāḥ kuṣṭhasiddhārthakāś ca |
takronmiśraḥ syād dharidrā ca lepo dadrūṣūkto mūlakotthaṃ ca bījam ||
tribhiḥ pralepair api baddhamūlāṃ dadrūṃ ca kaṇḍūṃ ca vināśayanti ||
granthiś ca bhaurjaḥ karavīramūlaṃ cūrṇāni sādhyāni tuṣodakena ||
darvīpralepaṃ pravadanti lepam etat paraṃ kuṣṭhaniṣūdanāya ||
kṣāreṇa gavāṃ mūtrasrutena tenāsya maṇḍalāny āśu |
māṃsī maricaṃ lavaṇaṃ rajanī tagaraṃ sudhā gṛhād dhūmaḥ |
mūtraṃ pittaṃ kṣāraḥ pālāśaḥ kuṣṭhanul lepaḥ ||
mustaṃ triphalā madanaṃ karañja āragvadhaḥ kaliṅgayavāḥ |
eṣa kaṣāyo vamanaṃ virecanaṃ varṇadas tathodgharṣaḥ |
piṣṭā ca kākamācī caturvidhaḥ kuṣṭhahā lepaḥ ||
iti ṣaṭ kaṣāyayogāḥ kuṣṭhaghnāḥ saptamaś ca tiniśasya |
snāne pāne ca hitās tathāṣṭamaś cāśvamārasya ||
ālepanaṃ pragharṣaṇam avacūrṇanam eta eva ca kaṣāyāḥ |
kuṣṭheṣu hitāny āhus tailaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca khadirasārasya ||
śītāḥ pradehasekās tiktaṃ sarpiḥ sirāvirekaś ca |
sadhyodugdhaṃ dugdhaṃ ṣaṇmāsān kārabhaṃ bhajet samadhu ||
pakṣāt pakṣāt chardanāny abhyupeyān māsān māsāc chodhanaṃ cāpy adhastāt |
śuddhir mūrdhnaḥ syāt trirātrāt trirātrāt ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe māsy asṛṅmokṣaṇaṃ ca ||
yo durvānto durvirikto 'thavā syāt kuṣṭhī doṣair uddhatair vyāpyate 'sau |
nissandehaṃ yāty asādhyatvam evaṃ tasmāt kṛtsnān nirhared asya doṣān ||
kuṣṭhād api bībhatsaṃ yac chīghrataraṃ ca yāty asādhyatvam |
śvitram atas taś chāntyai yateta dīpte yathā bhavane ||
śataṃ palānāṃ pratyekaṃ varāyās tv āḍhakatrayam ||
śyāmāṃ kirātaṃ kaṭukatrayaṃ ca pañcāḍhakaṃ tatra ca pañcagavyāt ||
na kilāsam eva kevalam apacīkṛmikāsakuṣṭham abhyastam ||
saṃśodhanaṃ viśeṣāt pītasnehasya yojayed anu ca |
śvitre sraṃsanam agryaṃ malayūrasa iṣyate saguḍaḥ ||
seveta viriktaś ca tryahaṃ pipāsuḥ pibet peyām ||
śvitre 'ṅge ye sphoṭā jāyante kaṇṭakena tān bhindyāt |
sphoṭeṣu nissṛteṣu prātaḥ prātaḥ pibet pakṣam ||
pīte kilāsī tilatailadigdho dine dine syād ravipādasevī |
jīrṇe ca takrāplutakodravāśī sphoṭodbhavāyaiṣa vidhis trirātram ||
vidhvānyedyuḥ sphoṭakān kaṇṭakais tān bastāmbhobhir ghṛṣṭayā śuktavartyā |
limpet kāmaṃ lepanād vedanāyāṃ lepo yojyaḥ śaṅkhanābhir jalena ||
gavyaṃ mūtraṃ citrakavyoṣayuktaṃ sarpiḥkumbhe saṃsthitaṃ kṣaudramiśram |
pakṣād ūrdhvaṃ śvitraṇā peyam etat kāryaṃ cāsmai kuṣṭhadṛṣṭaṃ vidhānam ||
mārkavam athavā khāded bhṛṣṭaṃ tailena lohapātrastham |
bījakaśṛtaṃ ca dugdhaṃ tad anupibec śvitranāśāya ||
pūtīkārkavyādhighātasnuhīnā mūtraiḥ piṣṭāḥ pallavā jātijāś ca |
ghnanty ālepāc śvitradurnāmadadrūn pāmākoṭhān duṣṭanāḍīvraṇāṃś ca ||
dvaipyaṃ dagdhaṃ carma mātaṅgajaṃ vā śvitre lepastailayukto variṣṭhaḥ |
pūtīkīṭo rājavṛkṣodbhavena kṣāreṇāktaḥ śvitram eko 'pi hanti ||
rātrau gomūtre vāsitān jarjarāṅgān ahni cchāyāyāṃ śoṣayet sphoṭahetūn |
evaṃ vārāṃs trīn bhāvayec ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ snuhyāḥ kṣīreṇa śvitranāśāya lepaḥ ||
śikhipittaṃ tathā dagdhaṃ drīberaṃ vā tad āplutam ||
dadyāt tasya purīṣeṇa śvitram uddālya lepayet |
māsaṃ hanty āśu tac śvitraṃ viśeṣād guhyasaṃśrayam ||
dvau kuḍavāv iha dadyāt sarṣapatailāc ca cāturthīm |
śvitraṃ ghṛṣṭaṃ liptaṃ trīn ālepāṃs tayā na laṅghayati |
mūtreṇa gavāṃ piṣṭaḥ savarṇakaraṇaḥ paraṃ śvitre ||
kṣāre sudagdhe gajaliṇḍaje vā gajasya mūtreṇa parisrute ca |
droṇapramāṇe daśabhāgayuktaṃ datvā paced bījam avalgujānām ||
śvitraṃ jayec cikkaṇatāṃ gatena tena praliptaṃ bahuśaḥ praghṛṣṭam |
kuṣṭhaṃ maśaṃ vā tilakālakaṃ vā yad vā vraṇe syād adhimāṃsajātam ||
tutthaṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ lavaṇāni pañca kṣāradvayaṃ lāṅgalikāṃ ca paktvā ||
kuṣṭhe kilāse tilakālakeṣu maśeṣu durnāmasu carmakīle ||
śudhyā śoṇitamokṣair virūkṣaṇair bhakṣaṇaiś ca saktūnām |
tasminn eva nirūḍhaṃ taṃ pāyayeta virecanam |
sakṣaudraṃ surasādīn vā lihyāt kṣaudrayutān pṛthak ||
kṛmimān madhunā lihyāt bhāvitaṃ vā varārasaiḥ |
śirogateṣu krimiṣu cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ ca tat ||
paktvā pūpalikāṃ khādet dhānyāmlaṃ ca pibed anu ||
dinam āruṣkaraṃ tailaṃ pāne bastau ca yojayet |
tac chodhanaṃ pibet kāle vidadhyāc cānuvāsanam ||
kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtaṃ guḍaṃ ca dadhīni śākāni ca parṇavanti |
samāsato 'mlān madhurān rasāṃś ca krimīn jighāṃsuḥ parivarjayec ca ||

div2.p: sarveṣu kevalānilavikāreṣv antarbahiḥ snehasvedau sālvalenopanāho nivātaṃ sthānaṃ prāvaraṇāni daśamūlakvāthasiddhā mahāsnehapragāḍhāḥ snigdhā dadhyamlā nāgarapippalītīkṣṇā grāmyānūpaudakaśiraḥpiśitarasāḥ payāṃsi yūṣāḥ prīṇanāni cānnāni |
tair eva ca māṃsair mahāsnehasaṃsṛṣṭais tadaktānām abhīkṣṇaṃ piṇḍādisvedāḥ ||
snigdhasvinnasya hi todabhedāyāmaśūlādayo vātavikārāḥ śīghram upaśāmyanti |
snehaś ca dhātūn puṣṇāti balaṃ ca dehe janayati |
tan mṛdūkṛte ca koṣṭhe nāvatiṣṭhanty anilāmayāḥ ||
yadi tu sadoṣatvān na nivartante tataḥ sarvaśarīrage 'pi vāyau viśeṣataḥ pakvāśayāśrite mṛdusnehavirecanaṃ tilvakasarpiḥ sātalāghṛtam airaṇḍatailaṃ vā kṣīreṇa dadyāt |
evaṃ hi viśuddhasrotaso 'nāvṛtaḥ pavano vicarann āśu śāntim eti ||

lg.l: sroto badhvānilaṃ rundhyāt tasmāt tam anulomayet ||

div2.p: atha durbale virecye nirūhaṃ pācanīyadīpanīyadravyayuktam evaṃvidhaṃ ca bhojyam |
viśuddhasya ca samiddhe 'grāv asakṛt snehasvedau svādvamlalavaṇaṃ cānnapānam |
evam apy anivṛttāv avapīḍakasnehān bastikarma ca prayojayet ||
āmāśayagate kṛtavamanasya ṣaḍḍharaṇaṃ cūrṇaṃ parataś ca yathārhaṃ snehādīn |
aśeṣakoṣṭhāśrite punar arśograhaṇīvihitam āmamalapācanaṃ kṣāropayogān antargulmopakramaṃ ca prayuñjīta |
śrotrādigate śirogate ca viśeṣeṇa snaihikaṃ nasyaṃ dhūmaṃ śirobastimardanālepanān yathāsvaṃ ca srotasāṃ prīṇanam ||
śuṣyati tu garbhe bāleṣu ca yaṣṭīmadhukakāśmaryaphalasārivāśarkarāśṛtaṃ payo dadyāt |
athāpatānakinam asrastākṣam astabdhalāṅgulam avedanam asvedanam apralāpinam akhaṭvāghātinam abahirāyāminaṃ copakrameta ||

tatra prāg eva snigdhasvinnāṅgaṃ vyoṣaviḍaṅgaśvetamaricair anyaiś ca tīkṣṇaiḥ śirovirecanaiḥ srotoviśuddhaye kṛtanasyam anantaraṃ cainaṃ vidāryādikvāthamāṃsarasakṣīradadhivipakvaṃ sarpir acchaṃ pāyayet |
tato bhadradārvādivargaṃ vātaghnam āhṛtya sayavakolakulatthaṃ sānūpamāṃsaṃ ca niṣkvāthya tatkaṣāyeṇāmlakṣīravatā madhuravargapratīvāpaṃ mahāsnehaṃ vipacet |
balīyasi ca vāte sukhoṣṇakarīṣapūrṇe kūpe nikhanyād āmukham |
taptāyāṃ vā rathakāraculyāṃ śilāyāṃ vā surāpariṣiktāyāṃ śāyayet palālāvacchannam |
mūlakorubūkasphūrjātakārkasaptalāśaṅkhinīsvarasasiddhaṃ vā talam abhyaṅgādiṣu yojyam abhuktavatā caitat pītam amladadhimaricavacāyuktam ākṣepakam apahanti ||
tilapīḍanopakaraṇadravyāṇy alpakālatailaparipītāny avakṣudya mahati kaṭāhe pānīyenāplāvya kvāthayed āsnehopagamāt |
tatas tat sneham ambhasa upariṣṭāt pāṇiśarāvayor anyatareṇādāya vātaghnauṣadhadattapratīvāpaṃ snehapākakalpena pacet |
vegāntareṣu ca tīkṣṇāny avapīḍāni pradhamanāni vāsakṛd dadyāt |
tathāsya śleṣmāpagamanena śvasanavimokṣāt saṃjñā punaḥ punar noparudhyate |

trivṛdṛntīsuvarṇakṣīrīśaṅkhinīviḍaṅgatriphalānām akṣasamāḥ kalkāḥ bilvamātrakaṃ tilvakamūlānāṃ triphalārasadadhipātre dve ghṛtapātram akaṃ sarvam aikadhyaṃ pratisaṃsṛjya vipaced etat tilvakasarpiḥ snehavirecanam anilarogeṣu |
sakaphe tu vāte tulburuphalābhayāhiṅgupuṣkaramūlalavaṇatrayacūrṇaṃ yavakvāthena kṛtpārśvārtiharaṃ pibet |
pathyāśatārdhakalkena vā sauvarcalapaladvayayuktaṃ caturguṇakṣīraṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet tad apatantrakaghnam |
na cāsya śodhanārthaṃ bastayas tīkṣṇāḥ prayoktavyāḥ |

lg.l: prasvidyaṃś ca dhanuṣkampī daśarātraṃ na jīvati ||
vegeṣv ato 'nyathā jīven mandeṣu vinato jaḍaḥ |

div2.p: svedayitvā ca hanū stabdhau srastau svasthānam ānīya pāṇibhyāṃ pīḍayet |
tathā mahātṛṇapañcamūlavidāryādijīvanīyāni medyamāṃsāny audakakandāṃś ca dviguṇodake kṣīraśeṣaṃ niṣkvāthya parisrāvya tailaprasthenonmiśraṃ punar adhiśrayet |
yathoktāś ca yavāgūḥ snigdhāś ca nasyadhūmakavalagrahāḥ prayojyāḥ |
upalipya ca gomayena punaḥ khadirakāṣṭhair dagdhvā tad bhasmāpanīya tatra śītībhūte tailaṃ niṣecayet |
tām anugatatailāṃ mṛttikām ādāya pañcamūlena saha kvāthayet |
tam api kvāthaṃ parisrutam aṣṭaguṇena payasā tailāvaśeṣaṃ pācayet |

tadvac ca pañcamūlakāṣṭhair dagdhvā bhasmāpanīya vidāryādisiddhena tailena śataśo niṣicya pūrvavan mṛdam ādāyoṣṇodakavati kaṭāhe 'bhyāsicya tailaṃ pāṇinā picunā vā gṛhītvā vātaharauṣadhakvāthamāṃsarasakṣīrāmlabhāgasahasreṇa sahasrapākaṃ sādhayed yāvatā kālena śaknuyāt paktuṃ prativāpaś cātra haimavatā dakṣiṇāpathagā cāśvagandhā vātaghnāni ca dravyāṇi |
etat sahasrapākam anivāryavīryaṃ tailam evaṃ bhāgaśatapakvaṃ śatapākam |
tataḥ snigdhasvinnasya ślakṣṇasya mṛdunaś carmaṇo vāsaso vā caturaṅgulavistṛtābhiḥ paṭṭikābhir vakrībhūtapradeśān avagṛhṇan sarvato veṣṭayet badhnīyāt |
niśi badhvā divā muñced divā vā jiśi |
avyathaṃ ca pratilomaṃ pramārjayann ṛju kurvaṃś ca punar badhnīyāt |
ekāṅgarogiṇam amlānagātraṃ snehasvedopapannaṃ mṛdunā saṃśodhanena saṃśodhyānuvāsyāsthāpya cākṣepakavidhānenopacaret |
apabāhuke nācanam ūrdhvabhaktaṃ ca nirāme snehapānam |
viśvabhīprabhṛtiṣu pādadāhānteṣu yathoktāṃ sirāṃ vidhvā vātavyādhivad upācaret ||
ūrulīnānāṃ vāyunā stabdhānāṃ ca vamanādibhir ūrdhvaṃ netum ambhasām iva nimnāt sthalam aśakyatvāt |
tatas tatra tu bahuśaḥ śamanaśoṣaṇāni yuktyāvekṣya yuñjīta |
rūkṣopacārān yavaśyāmākakodravoddālakam alavaṇam alpatailasiddhaṃ śākaṃ kṣārāriṣṭamadhūdakāni ca śīlayet ||
sa saindhavaṃ vacādiṃ haridrādiṃ vatsakādiṃ vā |
atyapatṛptaṃ tu rūkṣaṃ kṣāmam anidraṃ jāṅgalarasaiḥ śālibhiś ca tarpayet |
sasaindhavapalaṃ śuṇṭhīcitrakapippalīmūlānāṃ pṛthak dvipalaṃ daśa bhallātakāsthīni kalkīkṛtyaikadhyam āranālāḍhakena saha tailaprasthaṃ pacet |
tat sarvavātavikāreṣu pathyaṃ viśeṣād ūrustambhārśogṛdhrasīghnam apatyadaṃ ca |
evam ūrustambho hi śuṣke śleṣmaṇi praśāmyatīti ||

lg.l: sahacaraṃ suradāru sanāgaraṃ kvathitam ambhasi tailavimiśritam |
nimbāmṛtāvṛṣapaṭolanidigdhikānāṃ bhāgān pṛthag daśapalān vipaced ghaṭe 'pām |
aṣṭāṃśaśeṣitarasena punaś ca tena prasthaṃ ghṛtasya vipacet picubhāgakalkaiḥ ||
mañjiṣṭhayātiviṣayā viṣayā yavānyā saṃśuddhaguggulupalair api pañcasaṅkhyaiḥ |
tat sevitaṃ vidhamati prabalaṃ samīraṃ sandhyasthimajjagatam apy atha kuṣṭham īdṛk ||
tasya śuktiḥ prakuñco vā nasyaṃ vāte śirogate ||
jīrṇaṃ piṇyākaṃ pañcamūlaṃ pṛthak ca kvāthaṃ kvāthābhyām ekatas tailam ābhyām kṣīrād aṣṭāṃśaṃ pācayet tena pānād vātā naśyeyuḥ śleṣmayuktā viśeṣāt ||
samūlaśākhasya sahācarasya tulāṃ sametāṃ daśamūlataś ca |
abhīrumūlāc ca tulārdham etad aṣṭāṃśaśeṣaṃ vipaced vahe 'pām ||
tulyakṣīraṃ pālikais tailapātraṃ siddhaṃ kṛcchrān śīlitaṃ hanti vātān |
tailam analpatuṣodakayuktaṃ mārutam asthigataṃ tad apohet ||
daśamūlāc ca vipaced bhāgān pañcapalān pṛthak ||
toyārmaṇeṇa pādasthe samaṃ tailaṃ payo dadhi |
kākolī pauṣkaraṃ mūlam aśvagandhāṃ ca sādhitam ||
samūlajālāṃ vipacet prasāriṇīṃ tulonmitāṃ pādadhṛte ghaṭe 'mbhasaḥ |
pṛthak satailaṃ dadhi tatsamaṃ kṣipet samaṃ ca tābhyāṃ vijayāṃ tataḥ pacet ||
sagranthikākhyair dvipalaiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ bhallātakānāṃ daśakais tribhīś ca ||

div2.p: śuṇṭhīpalatrayayutair vinihanti pānanasyādibhis tad akhilān maruto vikārān kuṣṭhapramehahatanāmamanovikāraśvāsāsthibhaṅgajaṭharakrimibījadoṣān ||

lg.l: bheḍasya saṃmataṃ tailaṃ tat kṛcchrān anilāmayān |
patrakalkaṃ tataḥ pūtaṃ vidhinā tat prayojitam ||
śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ jvaraṃ mūrchāṃ chardiṃ tṛṣṇāṃ kṣataṃ kṣayam |
yac ca śītajvare tailam agarvādyam udāhṛtam |
rāsnācitrakayor dve dve daśamūlāt palaṃ palam |
majjānaṃ tailam ājyaṃ ca jīvanīyapalāni ṣaṭ |
kalkam ekatra tat siddhaṃ siddhaṃ śuddhānilāmaye ||
tat snehaṃ daśamūlasya kaṣāyeṇa punaḥ pacet ||
pāne nasye 'nvāsane 'bhyañjane ca snehāḥ kāle samyag ete prayuktāḥ |
duṣṭān vātān āśu śāntiṃ nayeyur vandhyā narīḥ putrabhājaś ca kuryuḥ ||
snehasvedair drutaḥ śleṣmā yadā pakvāśaye sthitaḥ |
pittaṃ vā darśayed rūpaṃ bastibhis taṃ vinirjayet ||

div2.p: vātaśoṇitinaḥ snigdhasya dāharāgaruktodeṣu jalaukobhiḥ kaṇḍūpatāpasvāpacimicimāyaneṣu śṛṅgatumbair daśād deśāntaraṃ sañcarat sirayā pracchānena vā duṣṭam asṛg asakṛd alpam avasecayet ||
naiva ca srāvayed aṅgaglānau rūkṣe vātottaraṃ ca raktam |
tataś ca punaḥ snehayuktāni rūkṣāṇi vā virecanāni bastikarma cāsakṛt prayojayet ||
atha vātaprabale purāṇaghṛtaṃ pibec chatāvarīghṛtaṃ vā ||

pādaśeṣe ca tattulyāni pṛthak chāgamāṃsāmalakekṣurasaghṛtakṣīrāṇi saṃyojya kalkaṃ ca pippalīmaricakāśmaryaphalotpaladvimedādviśrāvaṇīvīrāpunarnavanāgarasamaṅgātugākṣīrīkṣīrakākolīdrākṣākṣoḍapadmabījaśṛṅgāṭakanikocakabhavyorumāṇakharjūravātāmamuñjātābhiṣukāṇāṃ punaḥ pacet |
etaj jīvanīyākhyaṃ sarpir vātavikārān viśeṣataś ca pāṇḍurogajvarāpasmārabhagandaraśvāsakāsahidhmāsvarabhedapārśvaśūlayakṛtplīhamūtrasaṅgāśmarīvāttaśoṇitasarvāṅgaikāṅgarogān apaharati |
balyaṃ varṇyaṃ vṛṣyaṃ cakṣuṣyaṃ putradaṃ ca |
vātaharasiddhena payasāmlair vā sparśasukhaṃ pariṣekaṃ kurvīta ||

pratyekaśo yavagodhūmatilamudgamāṣeṣu kākolījīvakarṣabhakabalātibalātibalāśṛgālavinnāmeṣaśṛṅgīpriyālasitopalāsurabhivacākaśerukalkamiśreṣūpanāhārthaṃ sarpistailavasāmajjadugdhasiddhān pañca pāyasān upakalpayet |
śītaiś ca candanapadmakabisamṛṇālādibhiḥ śṛtena kṣīreṇa pariṣekaḥ |
dhānyāmlena vā jīvanīyasiddhena vā sarpiṣā śatadhautena vā ||
tilāś ca payasā piṣṭāḥ bhṛṣṭāḥ kapāle punaḥ payasi prakṣipya nirvāpitāḥ ||
raktaprabale 'py evaṃ bahuśaś ca śoṇitam avasecayet ||
yathārhasnehapītaṃ ca mṛdu vāmayed virūkṣayec ca |
sarveṣu ca yathāyathaṃ guḍūcīṃ guḍaharītakīṃ pippalīvardhamānaṃ vā śīlayed bastikarma cābhīkṣṇam iti |

lg.l: koṣṇā lepāś ca śasyante vātarakte kaphottare ||
kṣīre pacec chataṃ vārāṃs tad evaṃ madhukāc chate ||
kupite mārgasaṃrodhān medaso vā kaphasya vā |
bheṣajaṃ snehanaṃ kuryād yac ca raktaprasādanam ||
gambhīre raktam ākrāntaṃ syāc ced vātena varjayet |
bhinnaṃ sravati tad raktaṃ vidagdhaṃ pūyam eva vā |
kuryād upadravāṇāṃ ca tasmāt tasmāc cikitsitāt |
yathāsannaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ vikalpyaṃ syād yathābalam ||
vāyau pittāvṛte śītām uṣṇāṃ ca bahuśaḥ kriyām |
vyatyāsād yojayet sarpir jīvanīyaṃ ca pāyayet ||
dhanvamāṃsaṃ yavaḥ śālir virekaḥ kṣīravān mṛduḥ |
svedās tīkṣṇā nirūhāś ca vamanaṃ savirecanam ||
apāne tvāvṛte sarvaṃ dīpanaṃ grāhi bheṣajam |
prāṇādyānāṃ bhiṣak kuryād vitarkya svayam eva tat ||
samānaṃ śamayod vidvāṃs tridhā vyānaṃ ca yojayet ||
svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ nayed evaṃ vṛtān vātān vimārgagān ||
raktāvṛte 'pi tadvac ca khuḍoktaṃ yac ca bheṣajam |
bheṣajaṃ śamanaṃ śastaṃ paryāyaiḥ smṛtam auṣadham ||

div2.p: doṣādīnām eva cātibahvavasthābhedād vamanādiṣu kalpanānāṃ vyāpadāṃ sādhanānāṃ ca yad asaṅkhyeyatvam ato buddhimatāṃ vikalpamārgapradarśanārtham udāharaṇamātraṃ kalpasiddhisthānam upadekṣyate ||

atha vasantagrīṣmayor antare praśaste 'hani muhūrte ca nātiharitapāṇḍūni madanaphalāny ādāya tāni pramṛjya kuśamūṭake badhvā gomayenālipya yavabusamāṣaśālivrīhikulatthamudgānyatamarāśāv aṣṭarātram uṣitāny uddhṛtyātape śoṣayet |
suśuṣkāṇāṃ pippalīr ud vṛtya dadhighṛtamadhupalalamṛditāḥ punaḥ śoṣayitvā navaṃ kalaśam arajaskam ākaṇṭhaṃ pūrayitvā suguptaṃ nidhāpayet ||

tataḥ prayogakāle tāsāṃ phalapippalīnām antarnakhamuṣṭiṃ yāvad vā sādhu manyeta tāvaj jarjarīkṛtya yaṣṭīmadhukakaṣāye kovidārakacchudāranīpavidulabimbīśaṇapuṣpīsadāpuṣpīpratyakpuṣpyanyatamakaṣāye vā rātrim uṣitaṃ vimṛditaṃ pūtaṃ sūtroktavidhinā pāyayet |
phalapippalīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ vā svakvāthabhāvitaṃ tribhāgatriphalācūrṇaṃ kovidārādiniryūheṇa balavatkaphaprasekāpacyarbudagranthijvarodarārocakeṣu pibet ||
phalamajjasiddhaṃ vā payas tasminn eva vā yavāgūm adhobhāge raktapitte hṛddāhe ca ||
tasya vā payasaḥ śītasya santānikāñjaliṃ pitte prakupite urasi kaṇṭhe hṛdaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe ||
tajjaṃ vā dadhi dadhyuttaraṃ vā kaphacchardiprasekatamakeṣu |
tasmād vā payaso navanītam utpannaṃ phalādiṣaṭkakvāthasiddhaṃ kaphābhibhūte 'gnau śuṣyaccharīre ca ||
phalamajjacūrṇamiśreṇa vāragvadhādi dravyāṇāṃ ghoṇṭanimbabāṇavarjānāṃ sasomavalkapañcakolakānām anyatamasya niryūheṇa sādhitaṃ leham upayuñjīta ||

phalamajjacūrṇamiśreṇa vā reṇukailāśatāhvākustumburutagarakṛṣṭhatvakcorakamarubakāgarugugguluvālakaśrīveṣṭakaparipelavamāṃsīśaileyasthauṇeyakasurasārevatapūtyaśokarohiṇīnāṃ dvāviṃśater anyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa sādhitām utkārikāṃ modakaṃ vā bhakṣayet ||
phalapippalīsvarasakaṣāyaparipītair vā tilaśālitaṇḍulapiṣṭais tatkaṣāyopasṛṣṭaiḥ surasādidravyānyatamaniryūhopasṛṣṭair vā śaṣkulīr apūpān anyān vā bhakṣyān sādhayitvā bhakṣayet ||
phalapippalīnāṃ vā bhallātakavidhisrutaṃ svarasam ādarvīpralepāt paktvā lehayet |

phalapippalīnāṃ vā phalādiniryūheṇaikaviṃśatikṛtvaḥ subhāvitānāṃ kusumarajaḥsadṛśena cūrṇenāvacūrṇayet sarasi saroruhaṃ bṛhatsāyāhne tad rātrim uṣitaṃ prabhāte punar avacūrṇitam ud vṛtya haridrākṛsarākṣariyavāgūnām anya tamaṃ saindhavaguḍaphāṇitopetam ākaṇṭhaṃ pītavān upajighret |
sukumāraḥ samucitasurabhir gandhasampadutkliṣṭakaphapitto bheṣajadveṣī ca tathā hi sukhena chardayati ||
evam eva ca phalābhāve madanapuṣpāṇi śalaṭūni ca kalpayet |
tatkaṣāyasaṃsṛṣṭāṃ paryāgatānāṃ jīrṇānāṃ jīmūtakaphalānāṃ śuṣkāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ payasā vātapitte pibet ||
dvitrāṇi vāpothyāragvadhādīnāṃ navānām anyatamasya paṭolyā vā niryūheṇāsutāni mathitvā pittaśleṣmaje jvare |
tasyāpuṣpaphalasya pravālaiḥ śṛtaṃ kṣīram udriktapitte kaphajvare ||
ikṣvākuphalasvarasaṃ vā triguṇakṣīrasādhitam urasthite kaphe pīnase svarasāde vā vamanārthī pibet |
ikṣvākubījāni vā chāgakṣīrabhāvitāni viṣagulmodaragaragaṇḍagranthyarbudaślīpadeṣu ikṣvākuphalamadhyaṃ vā mastunā kuṣṭhaviṣapāṇḍvāmayeṣu |
tad eva vā madhyaṃ saguḍapalalaṃ bhakṣayet ||
bilvamūladviprasthakvāthena vā tumbībījāni kvāthayet tatas tasmin tribhāgena ghṛtam |
punar adhiśritya lehaṃ sādhayet tam avalihya pramathyām anupibet ||
ayam eva ca kalpaḥ kāśmaryādiṣu caturṣu mahāpañcamūlāṅgeṣu pṛthak pṛthag ukto veditavyaḥ ||
dhāmārgavo viśeṣeṇa garagulmodarakāsakaphasañcayottharogeṣu sthireṣu guruṣu ca śleṣmāśayasthe vātaśleṣmaṇi ca kaṇṭhāśraye prakalpyaḥ |
jīvanīyānyatamacūrṇasaṃyuktān samadhuśarkarāṃs tatkaṣāyair lehān pittopasarjane śleṣmaṇi vidadhyāt ||
sumanaḥsaumanasyāyanīharidrācorakahaimavatīmahāsahākṣudrasahāvṛścīvabimbīpunarnavakāsamardānyatamakaṣāyeṇa vā dhāmārgavaphalam ekaṃ dve vā manovikāreṣu ||
kuṭajaphalaṃ punaḥ sukumāreṣūlbaṇāsrapittakapheṣu vātaśoṇitavisarpajvarakuṣṭhādiṣu ca yojayet |
kuṭajaphalacūrṇāny arkakṣīreṇa saptāhaṃ bhāvayitvā jīvakakaṣāyeṇa pibet |
phalajīmūtakekṣvākujīvantīmūlānyatamakaṣāyeṇa vā sarṣapamadhūkalavaṇānyatamāmbhasā vā kuṭajaphalacūrṇaṃ kṛsarayā vā vamanāya kalpayed iti |

lg.l: vamanānāṃ dig ity eṣā sutarām upayoginām |
bījenānena matimān anyān api ca kalpayed iti ||

div2.p: trivṛtāyāḥ khalu dvividhaṃ mūlam aruṇaṃ śyāvaṃ ca |
tatrāruṇaṃ kaṣāyamadhuraṃ vipāke kaṭukaṃ rūkṣaṃ śleṣmapittaharaṃ kalpanāṃviśeṣāt punaḥ sarvavyādhipraśamanam |
itarad api tasmāt guṇaiḥ kiñcid ūnaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kaṇṭhahṛdayakarṣaṇaṃ mūrchāsammohakṛd āśu doṣaharatvāt bahudoṣakleśakṣamakrūrakoṣṭheṣu praśastaṃ śyāmāśabdavācyaṃ ca ||
atha tayor mūlam atiryagvisṛtaṃ gambhīrānugataṃ ślakṣṇam āharet |
tatas tvacaṃ śoṣayitvā samyak suguptaṃ sthāpayet ||
tac cūrṇaṃ śuṇṭhīsaindhavayuktam amlair māṃsarasena vā pibed vātāmayeṣu |

ebhir eva ca dravyair yathāsvaṃ ghṛtaśarkarādrākṣekṣurasatugākṣīrīmadhurāṇi mātuluṅgadāḍimāmalakakolakaramardakapittharasatakrāmlāni saindhavalavaṇāni vyoṣatīkṣṇāni vividhaveśavāraparipūritāni sahakārarasatrijātanāgakesarakarpūrasurabhīṇi lehaguṭikāmodakabhakṣyabhojyāny upakalpayed iti |

lg.l: ekīkṛtya ca tat svinnaṃ puṭapākena bhakṣayet ||
tvagelābhyāṃ samā nīlī tais trivṛttaś ca śarkarā |
sarvato 'rdhena tal līḍhaṃ madhvājyena guḍena vā ||
paktvā mṛdvagninā khādet tato mātrām ayantraṇaḥ ||
grahaṇīpāṇḍurogāṃś ca hanti puṃsavanaś ca saḥ ||
guḍaḥ kalyāṇako nāma sarvartuṣu ca yaugikaḥ |
sarvaiḥ samā samasitā kṣaudreṇa guṭikāḥ kṛtāḥ |
trivṛtāṃ citrakaṃ pāṭhām ajājīṃ saralaṃ vacām |
svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca hemante cūrṇam uṣṇāmbunā pibet ||
svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca saṃcūrṇya gomūtre bhāvayet tryaham |
tac cūrṇaṃ śarkarātulyaṃ maṇḍenāmlena vā pibet |
tad yojyaṃ tarpaṇe yūṣe piśite rāgayuktiṣu ||
trivṛnmuṣṭīṃs tu sanakhān aṣṭau droṇe 'mbhasaḥ pacet |
āsutaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ palle jātaṃ sauvīrakaṃ pibet ||
bhṛṣṭān vā satuṣān śuṣkān yavāṃs taccūrṇasaṃyutān |
āsutān ambhasā tadvat pibej jātaṃ tuṣodakam ||
bāle vṛddhe kṣate kṣīṇe sukumāre ca mānave |
tato majjānam uddhṛtya śucau pātre nidhāpayet ||
sauvīrakeṇa vā yuktaṃ kalkena traivṛtena vā ||
caturaṅgulasiddhād vā kṣīrād yad udiyāt ghṛtam |
majjakalkena dhātrīṇāṃ rase tat sādhitaṃ pibet ||
tad eva daśamūlasya kulatthānāṃ yavasya ca |
kaṣāye sādhitaṃ sāpaḥ kalkaiḥ śyāmādibhiḥ pibet ||
dantīkaṣāye tanmajjño guḍaṃ jīrṇaṃ ca nikṣipet |
tam ariṣṭaṃ sthitaṃ māsaṃ pāyayet pakṣam eva vā ||
viśoṣya cūrṇayitvā ca dvau bhāgau gālayet tataḥ ||
kaṣāye daśamūlasya taṃ bhāgaṃ bhāvitaṃ punaḥ ||
śuṣkacūrṇaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet |
marujāḥ sunuyāt tac ca jātaṃ sauvīrakaṃ yadā |
bhaved añjalinā tasya lodhrakalkaṃ pibet tadā ||
saghṛtaḥ sādhito lehaḥ sa ca śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam ||
sudhā bhinatti doṣāṇāṃ mahāntam api sañcayam |
āśv eva kaṣṭavibhraṃśā naiva tāṃ kalpayed ataḥ ||
sā śreṣṭhā kaṇṭakais tīkṣṇair bahubhiś ca samācitā |
dvivarṣāṃ vā trivarṣāṃ vā śiśirānte viśeṣataḥ ||
tāṃ pāṭayitvā śastreṇa kṣīram uddhārayet tataḥ |
bilvādīnāṃ bṛhatyor vā kvāthena samam ekaśaḥ ||
rātrau mūtre divā gharme saptāhaṃ sthāpayed iti ||
saptalāyās tathā mūlaṃ te tu tīkṣṇavikāṣiṇī |
śoṣayec cātape 'gnyarkau hato hy asya vikāṣitām ||
vātatarṣe jvare paitte syāt sa evājagandhayā ||
trīn aṃśān phāṇitāt dvau ca bhṛṣṭas taile ghṛte 'thavā ||
mūtrabhāvitam ājyena vibej jīrṇe ca tarpaṇam |
sarvadā sarvarogeṣu bāle vṛddhe ca tad dhitam ||
gaṇḍamālāsu vāte ca pāṇḍuroge ca śasyate ||
guḍasyāṣṭapale pathyā viṃśatiḥ syāt palṃ palam |
guḍena bhakṣayet toyaṃ kavoṣṇaṃ ca pibed anu ||
māṣapramāṇās tāḥ śuṣkā lihyād yakṣmī ghṛtadrutāḥ |
madyena tas taiś ca mano 'nukūlair yuktāni deyāni virecanāni ||

div2.p: atikṣudhitenātimṛdukoṣṭhenālpaśleṣmaṇā durvamena hīnamātram atimātraṃ tīkṣṇam atiśītam ajīrṇe vā pītaṃ vamanam adho gacchati |
taṃ punar āśu snehayitvā yaugikair mātrākālādyapekṣaṃ vāmayet |
vyāpatkarāṇi ca pūrvoktam atikramaṃ smaran pariharet ||
ajīrṇinaḥ śleṣmavato 'tyuṣṇatīkṣṇalavaṇam atimātram ahṛdyaṃ vā virecanam anyad vā bheṣajam ūrdhvaṃ pravartate |
tata ūrdhvam apy uttiṣṭhati hṛdyalehavaṭakavarjyam auṣadhaṃ na tṛtīyam avacārayet ||
krūrakoṣṭhasyātitīkṣṇāgrer alpam alpavīryaṃ vā bheṣajam ūrdhvabhāgikam adhobhāgikaṃ vā bhaktavad upaiti pākam |
tatra samudīrṇā doṣā yathākālam anirhriyamāṇā vibhramaṃ kurvanti |
taṃ snigdhakoṣṭham analpam amandaṃ cauṣadhaṃ pāyayet ||
kaṣāyam alpam apratyagraṃ rūkṣaṃ vā bheṣajam asnigdhasvinnena vā pītaṃ śītopacāreṇa vā stabdhaṃ doṣavigrathitam ayogī bhavati |
ubhayoś ca saṃśodhanayor lavaṇatailābhyaktaṃ piṇḍaprastarābhyāṃ svedayet ||
snigdhasvinnasya ca vamanam akṛtvā virecanaṃ pītavataḥ sāmasya vā mṛdu vā viriktasyādhobhāgetyarthagurustabdhodaratā śūlo vātamūtrapurīṣasaṅgaś ca bhavati |
tam apy ayoginaṃ samūtrais tīkṣṇair āsthāpya jāṅgalarasaiś ca bhojayitvā phaladārupippalīsiddhena tailenānuvāsya vātaharaiś ca snehair upasnehya punas tīkṣṇair virecayet ||
kapholbaṇasyātisnigdhasya gurukoṣṭhasya mandāgner vā mṛdupraṇītam auṣadhaṃ bhṛśam utkleśya doṣān jāḍyatandrādaurbalyāṅgasādān janayati |
laṅghanena ca sandhukṣitāgniṃ punaḥ snigdhaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇair viśodhayet ||
saśeṣānnāya vātaśleṣmavate rūkṣāya sodāvartāya mandāgnaye vā śītaṃ rūkṣaṃ vā dattam auṣadhaṃ bhṛśam ādhmānaṃ karoti |
tatra malasaṅgāt samunnahyaty udaram antaḥśūlaṃ dṛtivat pārśvayor āpūrṇatā śiraḥpṛṣṭharujā śvāsakāsau pāyubastinistodaś ca bhavati |
kṣāmeṇālpabalena mṛdukoṣṭhāgninā rūkṣeṇāsnigdhena vā svinnena sāmena vā balavad auṣadham upayuktaṃ sapittam anilaṃ pradūṣya parikartikām āpādayati |
tatra nābhibastigudameḍhre sadāhaparikartanam anilasaṅgo viṣṭambhaś ca ||
śītāmbupariṣiktaṃ cainaṃ payasā bhuktavantaṃ ghṛtamaṇḍena yaṣṭīmadhukatailena vānuvāsayet |
kṣāmasya ca madhuro bṛṃhaṇaś ca sarvo vidhir iṣṭaḥ ||
savāte dadhisārāmlaṃ dāḍimatvacā yuktaṃ bhojane pāne ca prayuñjīta sadāḍimarasaṃ ca sarpiḥ pibed uṣṇāmbunā vā tiladevadārukalkam ||
krūrakoṣṭhasya bahudoṣasyālpam alpaguṇaṃ mṛdusnigdhaṃ vā śodhanam avacāritam utkleśya doṣān na nirharati |
upaśāntaparisravaṃ ca punar upasnigdhaṃ tīkṣṇaiḥ śodhayet |
pītauṣadho yadā vegam udīrayati nigṛhṇāti vā |
tasyāṃ sadāhaśūlaṃ sapicchaṃ śvetaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ vā bhṛśaṃ pravāhamāṇaḥ kapham upaviśati |
pītauṣadhasya bheṣajodgāracchardyādīnāṃ nigrahād vātādayaḥ kupitā hṛdayam upasṛtya hṛdgrahaṃ ghoram āvahanti |
tataḥ pradhānamarmopatāpād vedanābhir atyartham āturaḥ pīḍyate |
mohahidhmākāsalālāpārśvaśūlayuto vepathumān naṣṭasaṃjño dantān kaṭakaṭāpayaty udvṛttākṣo jihvāṃ khādati |
tasmai bhiṣak śīghram amuhyann abhyaṅgapūrvaṃ dhānyasvedena parisvedya tīkṣṇam avapīḍaṃ dadyāt |
tato doṣaśeṣaṃ pācanīyaiḥ pācayed yathādoṣocchrayaṃ ca bastīn vitaret ||
asnigdhasvinnenābrahmacariṇā vegadhāriṇā mṛdukoṣṭhena sukumāreṇa vā rūkṣam auṣadham atimātraṃ prayuktam ativirekād vāyuṃ kopayati |
tasya viśeṣāt pārśvapṛṣṭhaśroṇimanyāmamasu śūlamūrcchābhramakalpastambho nistodo bheda udveṣṭanaṃ saṃjñānāśaś ca syāt |
tam abhyajya dhānyaiḥ svedayitvā yaṣṭīmadhukavipakvena tailenānuvāsayet |
snigdhasvinnasyātimṛdukoṣṭhasya kṣudhitasya vā tīkṣṇam atibhūri vā prayuktam auṣadhaṃ sarvaśo nirhṛtya malān dhātūn api dravīkṛtya visrāvayed atiyogena |
taṃ śatadhautaghṛtenābhyajya kaṣāyasvāduśītaiḥ pradehapariṣekāvagāhānnapānaiḥ śarkarāmadhumadbhiś ca lahaḥ stambhayet ||
picchābastīṃś casmai dadyān madhuravargasiddhaṃ ca kṣīrasarpiḥ sarpirmaṇḍo 'nuvāsanam |
viśeṣeṇa vamanātiyoge saghṛtatasitākṣaudraṃ phalarasair manthaṃ pibet |
kṣīrivṛkṣaśuṅgasiddhāṃ vā samākṣikāṃ peyāṃ kṣīraṃ vā saṃgrāhidravyasiddhaṃ ca kṣīraṃ bhojane 'vacārayet ||
sodgārāyāṃ ca chardyāṃ dhanikāmadhūkamadhurasāmustāñjanāni madhunā lihyāt |
vāksaṅge hanusaṅge 'nilārtau ca ghṛtamāṃsarasasiddhām alpataṇḍulāṃ peyāṃ pibet |
nirgatāṃ tu jihvāṃ tiladrākṣākalkaliptāṃ vyoṣalavaṇacūrṇapraghṛṣṭāṃ vā praveśayet |
akṣiṇī vyāvṛtte ghṛtābhyakte pīḍayed visaṃjñaṃ sāmaveṇugītaśabdān śrāvayet ||
virecanātiyoge taṇḍulāmbhasā madhumiśreṇa vamet priyaṅvādiṃ ca taṇḍulodakena pibed rodhrarasāñjanadāḍimatvaco vā |
gudaṃ niḥsṛtam abhyajya svedayitvā kaṣāyaiś ca stambhayitvā praveśayet |
ubhayatra ca jīvaraktapittayor jñānārthaṃ rakte śuklaṃ picu plotaṃ vā kṣipet |
annaṃ vā tadvimiśraṃ śune kākāya vā dadyāt |
tasmin bhukte jīvaṃ vaded abhukte pittam ||
āmaraṇāc ca tasya tṛṇmūrchāmadārtasya kriyāṃ pittaghnīm atiyogoktāṃ ca kuryāt |
śyāmākāśmaryamadhukadūrvośīrairvā śṛtaṃ payo ghṛtamaṇḍāñjanayuktaṃ śītaṃ bastau niṣecayet ||
śeṣeṣv api cāsamyakprayuktavamanavirecanopadraveṣu yathāmayaṃ doṣādīn apekṣya pratikuryād bastivyāpatsiddhiṃ cekṣeta ||
yā tu virecane parikartikā tad vamane kaṇṭhakṣaṇanam |
yad adhaḥparisravaḥ sa kaphapraseko yad adhaḥpravāhaṇaṃ sa śuṣkodgāra iti |

lg.l: chardanaṃ na tu duśchada durvirecyaṃ na recanam |
pāyayed auṣadhaṃ bhūyas tan nihanti tathā hi tau ||
vamitaṃ kavalaiḥ śuddhaṃ laṅghitaṃ pāyayet tu tam ||
vibaddhe 'lpe cirād doṣe sravaty uṣṇaṃ pibej jalam |
tenādhmānaṃ vamis tṛṣṇā vibandhaś cāśu śāmyati ||
bheṣajaṃ doṣaruddhaṃ cen nodhva nādhaḥ pravartate |
ajīrṇam apravṛttau tu suśītaiḥ stambhayed bhiṣak ||
kadācic chleṣmaṇā ruddhaṃ tiṣṭhaty urasi bheṣajam |
kṣīṇe śleṣmaṇi sāyāhne rātrau vā tat pravartate ||
rukṣānāhārayor jīrṇe tiṣṭhaty ūrdhvaṃ gate 'pi vā |
vāyunā bheṣaje tv anyat sasnehalavaṇaṃ pibet ||
pittaghnaṃ svādu śītaṃ ca bheṣajaṃ tatra śasyate ||
bheṣajaṃ tatra tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ kaṭvādi kaphanud dhitam ||
utpadyamānāsu ca tāsu tāsu vyāpatsu saṃśodhanavibhrameṇa |
diśānayaivāśu yateta siddhyai jyotir hi śāstraṃ nayadurnayānām ||
balāṃ guḍūcīṃ triphalāṃ sarāsnāṃ dvipañcamūlaṃ ca palonmitāni |
aṣṭau phalāny ardhatulāṃ ca māṃsāt chāgāt paced apsu caturthaśeṣam ||
kalkair guḍakṣaudraghṛtaḥ satailair yuktaḥ sukhoṣṇo lavaṇānvitaś ca ||
bastiḥ paraṃ sarvagadapramāthī svasthe hito jīvanabṛṃhaṇaś ca |
bastau ca yasmin paṭhito na kalkaḥ sarvatra dadyād amum eva tatra ||
prastho rasāc chāgarasārdhayuktaḥ sādhyaḥ punaḥ prasthasamaḥ sa yāvat ||
syād dīpano māṃsabalapradaś ca cakṣurbalaṃ copadadhāti sadyaḥ ||
eraṇḍamūlāt tripalaṃ palāśat tathā palāṃśaṃ laghupañcamūlam |
gulmāśmavardhmagrahaṇīgudotthāṃs tāṃs tāṃś ca rogān kaphavātajātān ||
catuṣpale tailaghṛtasya bhṛṣṭaḥ chāgāc chatārdho dadhidāḍimāmlaḥ |
yaṣṭhyāhvalodhrābhayacandanaiś ca śṛtaṃ payo 'gryaṃ kamalotpalaiś ca |
godhūmacūrṇaiś ca picupramāṇair ikṣovidāryāś ca rasena yuktam |
paktvā kulatthān bṛhatīṃ ca toye rasasya tasya prasṛtā daśa syuḥ ||
tān sarṣapailāmadanaiḥ sakuṣṭhair akṣapramāṇaiḥ prasṛtaiś ca yuktān |
kṣaudrasya tailasya phalāhvayasya kṣārasya tailasya ca sārṣapasya ||
dadyān nirūhaṃ kapharogitāya mandāgnaye cāśanavidviṣe ca ||
dvipañcamūlaṃ ca palāṃśakāni kṣuṇṇāni dhautāni phalāni cāṣṭau ||
kalkair yavānyā madanaiś ca yuktaṃ nātyuṣṇaśītaṃ guḍasaindhavāktam ||
kṣaudrasya tailasya ca sarpiṣaś ca navasya yuktaṃ prasṛtitrayeṇa |
pragrahaḥ khadiraḥ kuṣṭhaṃ śamī piṇḍītako yavāḥ ||
vaṭādyāḥ kiṃśukaṃ lodhram iti saṅgrāhikā matāḥ ||
hitaḥ pravāhaṇe tadvad vṛntaiḥ śālmalakasya ca ||
karmaṇā viplutānāṃ ca vakṣyāmi prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak ||
kṣīrāt dvau prasṛtau kāryai madhutailaghṛtāt trayaḥ |
bilvādimūlakvāthāt dvau kaulatthād dvau sa vātajit ||
prasṛtaḥ pṛthag ājyāc ca bastiḥ sarṣapakalkavān |
kaṣāyāt prasṛtāḥ pañca tailādeko vimathya tān |
bastiḥ kavoṣṇaḥ sāhāne mūtrakṛcchre varo mataḥ ||
tīkṣṇair vikarṣite snigdho madhuraḥ śiśiro mṛduḥ ||
svaḥ svair auṣadhavargaiḥ svān svān rogān nivatayati ||
uṣṇārtānāṃ śītān śītārtānā tathā sukhoṣṇāṃś ca |
bastīn na bṛṃhaṇīyān dadyād vyādhiṣu viśodhanīyeṣu |
medasvino viśodhyā ye ca narāḥ kuṣṭhamehārtāḥ ||
suradāru ca rāsnā ca bastir doṣaharaḥ śivaḥ ||
jalāḍhake pacet tac ca pādaśeṣaṃ parisrutam ||
taiḥ siddhaṃ chāgalaṃ kṣīraṃ kukkuṭāṇḍarasaḥ sitā |
ato daśadaśāhena yas tu bastīn niṣevate |
nātiyogaṃ na cāyogaṃ stāmbhinas te ca kurvate ||
mṛdutvān na nivartante yasya tv ete prayojitāḥ |
samūtrair bastibhis tīkṣṇair āsthāpyaḥ kṣipram eva saḥ ||
yuktyā tasmān niṣeveta yāpanān na prasaṅgataḥ ||
dravyeṣu yāpanīyeṣu siddhān snehān pṛthak pṛthak |
kalkīkṛtya kṣipet tasmin pṛthak ca prasthasammitam ||
nirvalīpalitaḥ kāntaś cirajīvī bhavet sa ca |
evaṃ ca bastayo 'nye 'pi kalpyāḥ pākyāś ca naikaśaḥ |
śataṃ vārān sahasraṃ vā pācayet sambhave sati ||
vahe vipācya toyasya droṇaśeṣeṇa tena ca |
jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ madhukaṃ balām |
piṣṭvā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīre sādhayeta caturguṇe ||
saindhavaṃ madanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvā niculo vacā |
nāgaraṃ puṣkaraṃ medā cavikā citrakaḥ śaṭhī |
bilvājamodacapalā dantī rāsnā ca taiḥ smaiḥ |
sādhyam eraṇḍatailaṃ vā tailaṃ vā kapharoganut ||
ānāham aśmarīṃ cāśu hanyāt tad anuvāsanam ||
phalair aṣṭaguṇe cāmle siddham anvāsanaṃ kaphe ||
pṛcchati sma munim ity atha dhīmān agniveśa iha kintu phalānām |
bastikarmaṇi hitaṃ satataṃ syāt taṃ punarvasur iti praśaśāsa ||
iha kuṣṭhahitā garāgarī hitam ikṣvākuphalaṃ pramehiṇām |
kuṭajasya phalaṃ hṛdāmaye pravaraṃ kośaphalaṃ tu pāṇḍuṣu ||
udare kṛtavedhanaṃ hitaṃ madanaṃ sarvagadāvirodhi ca |
pravaraṃ tad ataḥ phalādiṣu smṛtam āsthāpanayojanāsv iti ||
atha munivṛṣabhe nigadya vākyaṃ sthitavati vijñapayāmbabhūva bhūyaḥ |
idam atigahanaṃ sahānyaśiṣyair avanigato 'ñjalim agrato nidhāya ||
citrakarmaguṇakṛd guruṇokto bastir ūrdhvam atha caiti na nābheḥ |
śīghnam āpatati cānu sa dehāt sarvataḥ katham apohati doṣān ||
ūce gurus timitamārutavaśyam etat dehasya yad bahir upāśritam antare vā |
duṣṭasya tasya janayann anulomatāṃ tu bastir hinasti viṣamān api rogapūgān ||
śākhāgatāḥ koṣṭhagatāś ca rogā marmordhvasarvāvayavāṅgajāś ca |
ye santi teṣāṃ na tu kaścid anyo vāyoḥ paraṃ janmani hetur asti ||
tasyātivṛddhasya śamāya nānyad basteḥ samaṃ bheṣajam asti yasmāt ||
śāmyanti yatnena jite 'nile ca tadīritāḥ pittakaphādayo 'pi |
tasmāc cikitsārdham iti bruvanti sarvāṃ cikitsām api bastim eke ||
vīryeṇa bastir ādatte khastho 'rko bhūrasān iva ||
yat tatrauṣadhavīryaṃ hi tad apānena vāyunā |
samānād duttaraṃ caivaṃ vyānādyāḥ pavanāḥ kramāt |
te tṛptāḥ prakṛtiṃ yātāḥ śarīrānugrahe sthitāḥ ||
santarpayanti paritaḥ svān svān bhūtaguṇāṃs tanau ||
vyānas tiryag apāno 'dhaḥ prāṇaś cordhvaṃ prakarṣati |
evaṃ vātaiḥ sirābhiś ca vapur bastiḥ suyojitaḥ |
bastis tasmāt sarvakarmapradhānaṃ sarvātaṅkān hanti niḥśeṣataś ca |
srotāṃsy antaḥ śodhayitvā ca kuryād ojas tejaḥ śukramedhāgnikīptim ||
ayogād atiyogāc ca basteḥ syuḥ ṣaṭ ṣaḍ āpadaḥ ||
bastiḥ saṅkṣobhya taṃ doṣaṃ durbalatvād anirharan |
uṣṇasya tasmād ekasya tatra pānaṃ praśasyate |
phalavartyas tathā svedāḥ kālaṃ jñātvā virecanam ||
mūrchayaty anilaṃ mārgaṃ ruṇaddhy agniṃ hinasti ca ||
peyāḥ prasannayā vā syur ariṣṭenāsavena vā ||
piṣṭvā kuṣṭhaṃ ca mūtreṇa pibet kṣārāṃś ca dīpanān |
bastim asya vidaddhyāc ca samūtraṃ dāśamūlikam ||
rūṇaddhi hṛdayaṃ śūlair itaś cetaś ca dhāvati ||
ūrdhvaṃ so 'nusaran dehaṃ kuryād vāyuḥ śirorujam |
utkleśyālpaṃ hared doṣaṃ janayec ca pravāhikām ||
śophaṃ bastāv apāne ca sadanaṃ corujaṅkṣayoḥ |
vidadhyāl laṅkṣayitvā ca vṛttiṃ tasya viriktavat ||
vījed āklamanāśāc ca prāṇāyāmaṃ ca kārayet ||
śastrolkārajapuruṣair bastir eti tathā hy adhaḥ ||
pāṇivastrair galāpīḍaṃ kuryān na mriyate yathā |
apānaḥ pavano bastiṃ tam āśv evāpakarṣati ||
śirasthe nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ pracchādyaṃ sarṣapaiḥ śiraḥ ||
alpadoṣe mṛdau koṣṭhe prayukto vā punaḥ punaḥ ||
piṣṭvā drākṣāṃ madhūkaṃ ca kṣīre taṇḍuladhāvane ||
karoty aṅgarujāṃ jṛmbhāṃ stambhaṃ bhedaṃ ca parvaṇām ||
kuryād dhidhmāṃ hitaṃ tatra hidhmāghnaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca yat ||
atitīkṣṇaḥ savāto vā na vā samyak prapīḍitaḥ |
śṛtair bastir hitaḥ siddho vātaghnaiś cānuvāsanam ||
hṛtvā bastir malāñ chīghraṃ vātapitte prakopayet ||
nābhibastigudāṃs te hi kṛntato 'sya muhur muhuḥ |
picchilaś ca hito bastiḥ snehaś ca madhuraiḥ śṛtaḥ ||
gudaṃ likhan dahan kṣiṇvan karoty asraparisravam ||
sa vidagdhaṃ sravaty asraṃ varṇaiḥ pittaṃ ca bhūribhiḥ |
tatrārdraiḥ śālmalīpatraiḥ kṣuṇair ājaṃ payaḥ śṛtam |
pūtaṃ ghṛtānvitaṃ bastiṃ dadyād anyāṃś ca picchilān ||
tad dhi pittaśakṛdvātān hatvā dāhādikān jayet ||
viśuddhaś ca pibec chītāṃ yavāgūṃ śarkarāyutām |
māṣayūṣeṇa kulmāṣān pānaṃ dadhy athavā surām ||
āmaṃ yaḥ kuṇapaṃ rugvān upaveśyeta sāruciḥ |
śakṛd vātam asṛk pittaṃ kaphaṃ vā yo 'tisāryate |
pakvaṃ tatra svavargīyo bastiḥ śeṣṭhaṃ bhiṣagjitam ||
ṣaṇṇām eṣāṃ dvisaṃsargāt triṃśad bhedā bhavanti tu |
kevalaiḥ saha ṣaṭtriṃśad vidyāt sopadravāṃś ca tān ||
pācanaṃ śasyate bastir āme hi pratiṣidhyate ||
śakṛtā vāyunā vāme tena varcasi vānile |
pittenāme 'sṛjā tadvat tayor āmena vā punaḥ |
vātena viśi pitte vā viṭpittāsrais tathānile |
bastir vātena rakte tu kāryaḥ svādvamlatiktakaḥ ||
kaphena viśi pitte vā kaphe viṭpittayoḥ |
syād bastiḥ kaṭutiktāmlaḥ saṃsṛṣṭe vāyunā kaphe ||
yugapat ṣaḍrasaṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ saṃsarge pācanaṃ bhavet |
nirāmāṇāṃ tu pañcānāṃ bastiḥ ṣaḍsiko hitaḥ ||
śaṅkhaṃ sarjarasaṃ lākṣāṃ kattṛṇaṃ ca palāṃśikam ||
piṣṭvā taiḥ sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ kṣīradviguṇitaṃ pacet |
masūrāśvatthaśuṅgaiś ca yavāgūḥ syāj jale śṛtaiḥ ||
śīto 'lpo vādhike vāte pittetyuṣṇaḥ kaphe mṛduḥ |
dattas tair āvṛtaḥ sneho nāyāty abhibhavād api ||
tābhyām eva ca tailābhyāṃ sāyaṃ bhukte 'nuvāsayet ||
vidyāt pittāvṛtaṃ svādutiktais taṃ bastibhir haret ||
kaṭūnāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca kvāthaiś cūrṇaiś ca pācanam |
mṛdur virekaḥ sarvaṃ ca tatrāmavihitaṃ hitam ||
gude praṇihitaḥ sneho vegād dhāvaty anāvṛtaḥ |
ūrdhvakāyaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhād ūrdhvebhyaḥ khebhya ety api ||
chardighnībhiḥ kriyābhiś ca tasya kuryān nivartanam ||
nāpakvaṃ praṇayet snehaṃ gudaṃ sa hy upalimpati |
tīkṣṇo bastis tathā tailam arkapatrarase śṛtam ||
hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ tanu sthūlaṃ jīrṇaṃ śithilabandhanam |
pārśvacchidraṃ tathā vakram aṣṭau netrāṇi varjayet ||
guḍapīḍā gatir jihmā teṣāṃ doṣā yathākramam ||
chinnaḥ klinnaś ca tān aṣṭau bastīn karmasu varjayet ||
uttānaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvaṃ sapta śayyāḥ parityajet ||
taddoṣāḥ syur vidhātavyaṃ yathaupayikam atra ca ||
anucchravāsya tu baddhe vā datte niḥśeṣa eva vā |
tatrābhyaṅgo gude svedo vātaghnāny aśanāni ca ||
drutaṃ praṇīte niṣkṛṣṭe sahasotkṣipta eva vā |
tiryagvalyāvṛte dvāre baddhe vāpi na gacchati |
netre tad ṛju niṣkṛṣya saṃśodhya ca punar nayet ||
uraḥ śirorujaṃ sādam ūrvoś ca janayed balī |
syād dāho davathuḥ śophaḥ kampenābhihate gude |
tatra sarpiḥ picuḥ kṣīraṃ picchābastiś ca śasyate ||
na bhāvayati mandas tu bāhyaś cāśu nivartate |
snehas tatra punaḥ samyak praṇeyaḥ siddhim icchatā ||
atiprapīḍitaḥ koṣṭhe tiṣṭhaty āyāti vā galam |
tatra bastir virekaś ca galapīḍādi karma ca ||
yathāṇḍaṃ taruṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ tailapātraṃ yathā tathā |
vyatyāsād upayogena kramāt taṃ prakṛtiṃ nayet |
maunaṃ vidhir vātaharo yathāsvaṃ ca vikārajit ||
ahitānnād yathādoṣaṃ rogāḥ syur bheṣajāni ca ||
āhāro bṛṃhaṇas tatra vṛṣyās te te ca bastayaḥ ||
phalavartiṃ purā dadyād atha bastiṃ calāpaham ||
phalaṃ ca mūtre kvathitaṃ samastu tat ghṛtaṃ satailaṃ lavaṇāni pañca ca ||
balāṃ sarāsnāṃ phalabilvacitrakān dvipañcamūlaṃ kṛtamālakāt phalam ||
yavān kulatthāṃś ca pacej jale rasaḥ samustapāṭhendrayavaiś ca kalkavān |
tathānuvāsyaṃ madhukena sādhitaṃ phalena bilvena śatāhvayāthavā |
sajīvanīyas tu raso 'nuvāsane nirūhaṇe cālavaṇaḥ śiśor hitaḥ ||

div2.p: jāṅgale sādhāraṇe vā deśe yathākālaṃ śiśirātapapavanasalilasevite same śucau pradakṣiṇodake śmaśānacaityadevayajanāgārasabhāśvabhrārāmavalmīkoṣaravirahite kuśarohiṣāstīrṇe snigdhakṛṣṇasuvarṇamadhurasurabhimṛttike mṛdāv aphālakṛṣṭenupahatenyair balvattarair drumair bheṣajāni praśasyanta iti sāmānyato bhūmiparīkṣā ||
viśeṣatas tv aśmavatī sthirā gurvī śyāmā kṛṣṇā sthūlatṛṇavṛkṣasasyaprāyā svaguṇabhūyiṣṭhā |
mṛdvī samā śvabhravaty avyaktarasajalā mahāparvatavṛkṣā śyāmā cākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhā |
tatrāmbupṛthivīguṇabhūyiṣṭhāsu bhūmiṣu jātāni virecanāni bṛṃhaṇāni ca śasyante |
tatra yāni kālajāny upagatasampūrṇapramāṇarasavīryagandhāni kālātapāgnisalilapavanaśastrajantubhir anupahatagandhavarṇarasasparśaprabhāvāny avagāḍhamūlāny udīcyāṃ diśi sthitāni |
anye punar āhuḥ saumyāny auṣadhāni saumyeṣv ṛtuṣv āgneyāny āgneyeṣu |
atha maṅgalācāraḥ kalyāṇavṛttaḥ śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ sampūjya ca devatām aśvinau gobrāhmaṇāṃś ca kṛtopavāsaḥ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā gṛhṇīyāt |

gṛhītvā cānurūpaguṇavadbhājanasaṃsthāny agāreṣu pūrvottaradvāreṣu nivātapravātaikadeśeṣu nityapuṣpopahārabalikarmavatsv agnisalilopasvedadhūmarajomūṣikacatuṣpadām anabhigamanīyāni svavacchannāni śikyeṣv āsajya sthāpayet ||

lg.l: kṣīraṃ bāṣkayaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ viṇmūtraṃ tac ca nīrujām |

div2.p: niryāsaḥ kalko niryūhaḥ śītaḥ phāṇṭaś ca |
tasya samastadravyāparityāgād āplutopayogāc ca kalkād abhedaḥ |

tatra bhedyāny auṣadhāny aṇuśo bhedayitvā chedayitvā chedayāni prakṣālyodakena śucau rūkṣāyām adhaḥpraliptāyāṃ tāmrāyomṛnmayānyatamāyāṃ sthālyāṃ samāvāpya bahvalpapānīyagrāhitām auṣadhānām ākalayya yāvatā muktarasatā syāt tāvad udakam āsecayec choṣayec ca |
athāgnāv adhiśritya mahaty āsane sukhopaviṣṭaḥ sarvataḥ satatam avalokayan darvyāvaghaṭṭayan mṛdunā paritaḥ samupagacchatānalena sādhayet |
kṣīrādisahitaṃ ca dravyaṃ na samyaṅmuktarasaṃ bhavatīti vārikvāthapūrvakaṃ kṣīrādyais tadupadeśe anupadagdhaṃ kvāthayet ||
tatra samyag rasavīryādīny auṣadhasya samīkṣya vyādhyāturādibalataś ca niryāsādīnāṃ kalpanāṃ mātrāṃ ca saṃśrayet ||

lg.l: mātrāyā na vyavasthāsti vyādhiṃ koṣṭhaṃ balaṃ vayaḥ |
ālocya deśakālau ca yojyā tadvac ca kalpanā ||

div2.p: ity alam etad upadiṣṭaṃ buddhimatāṃ jñānaprabodhāya |
śītaphāṇṭayor auṣadhapalaṃ ṣaṭcaturbhir ambupalair āsutam iti ||
snehapāke tv anirdiṣṭapramāṇe samuditasya dravasya pādena sneho yojyas tatpādena kalkaḥ ||

lg.l: kalkasya yojayed aṃśaṃ caturthaṃ ṣaṣṭham aṣṭamam ||

div2.p: pañcaprabhṛti tu dravaṃ pṛthak snehasamam evāvapet |
tatra yadā viramati śabdaḥ prasādam āpadyate sneho yathāsvaṃ varṇagandharasotpattir bhaiṣajyam aṅgulībhyāṃ mṛdyamānam anatimṛdv anatidāruṇam anaṅguligrāhi ca syāt |

lg.l: lehasya tantumattāpsu majjanaṃ saraṇaṃ na ca ||

div2.p: athāvatārya śītībhūtam ahatena vāsasā paripūya śucau dṛḍhe kalaśe samāsicyāpidhānena pidhāya śuklena vastrapaṭṭenāvacchādya sūtreṇa subaddhaṃ svanuguptaṃ śucau deśe susthitaṃ sthāpayet ||
karṣasya suvarṇam akṣaṃ picur biḍālapadakaṃ pāṇitalaṃ tindukaṃ kavalagrahaḥ ṣoḍaśikā ca |
palasya muṣṭiḥ prakuñcaś caturthikā bilvam āmraṃ ca |
tulā punaḥ palaśataṃ tāni viṃśatir bhāra iti |

lg.l: śuṣkameyeṣv idaṃ mānaṃ dviguṇaṃ tu dravārdrayoḥ ||
kalpayet sadṛśān bhāgān pramāṇaṃ yatra noditam ||
kiñcit sīdati kṛṣṇe ca vartyamāne tu paścimaḥ |
dagdho 'taurdhvaṃ niṣkāryaḥ syād āmas tv agnisādakṛt |
mṛdur nasye kharo 'bhyaṅge pāne bastau ca cikkaṇaḥ ||
saumyaṃ pathyaṃ ca tatrādyam āgneyaṃ vaindhyam auṣadham ||
caturthaśeṣaḥ pūtas tu kaṣāyo grāhya iṣyate |
atha kvāthyeṣu teṣūktaṃ toyād anyat drava bhavet ||
tac cāmbuvat prayoktavyaṃ tat ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ tataḥ |
dravaṃ yat tatra paṭhitaṃ kṣīraṃ vā dadhimastu vā ||
mūtraṃ takraṃ surāmaṇḍaṃ yadi vāpy amlakāñjikam |
anirdiṣṭe pramāṇe tu kvāthyānāṃ ca dravasya ca |
kartavyaṃ sati nirdeśe yathānirdiṣṭam eva hi |
tatra prasiddhim āśritya bheṣajeṣu jaleṣu ca |
tathā vidheyā bhāgāḥ syur vyādhyādisadṛśā yathā ||
tasmād ardhapalaṃ vāpi karṣann ayam athāpi vā |
dravyāṇāṃ syāt palaṃ vāpi dviprastham udakasya tu ||
hīnaṃ vāpi tataḥ kāryam evaṃ yūṣe ca pānake ||
dravyaṃ snehasamaṃ kvāthyam atra pakṣe prayujyate ||
kaṣāya eva cet tatra dravārthaṃ kevalo bhavet |
tathānyad api tatroktaṃ dravaṃ kṣīrādikaṃ bhavet ||
dravyaṃ snehasamaṃ kvāthyam anyatrāpi drave sati ||
na tatra yujyate tasmād anurūpeṇa kalpayet |
anye tu bhiṣajaḥ prāhuḥ kvāthyāny aṣṭaguṇe 'mbhasi ||
kvāthyaṃ tu bhavati snehād atra dviguṇam auṣadham |
kaṣāyeṇaiva cet sādhyaḥ saty anyasmin drave tathā ||
etāvāṃs tu viśeṣo 'tra śeṣam ātrāpi pūrvavat ||
kvāthyaṃ tu bheṣajaṃ snehād atra pakṣe caturguṇam |
kriyate dviguṇaṃ kvāthyaṃ tataḥ snehāt prayujyate ||
dravāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ prasthaṃ śuṣkāt prasthād yato mataḥ |
prasiddhis tu cikitsāyāṃ dvidhā hi bhiṣajām iha ||
suśrutasya tu yaḥ pūrvam upanyastaś cirantanaḥ |
ity evaṃ trividhaḥ proktaḥ kaṣāyagrahaṇaṃ prati |
evam anyatra sarveṣāṃ kalkāt snehaś caturguṇaḥ ||
caturguṇaṃ dravaṃ snehād yatra yat paṭhyate dravam |
anukte tu drave deyaṃ jalam eva caturguṇam ||
kalkakalpas tu carake kaṣāyāṇāṃ na kīrtitaḥ ||
kaṣāyasya tu peyasya yadi vā kalkacūrṇayoḥ |
anuktāpi yathā mātrā pañcād vakṣyāmy ahaṃ tathā ||
vaidyaiḥ prāyeṇa na tathā yaḥ ṣoḍaśaguṇodakaḥ ||
snehaprasthe vipaktavye śuṣkaṃ tac ca bhaved yadi |
ārdraṃ ced uddhṛtaṃ sadyas tataḥ palaśatadvayam ||
sahasrapākāḥ snehās tu śatapākāś ca kīrtitāḥ ||
subhāvitaṃ svalpam api dravyaṃ tad bahukarmakṛt |
tasmād bahutaraṃ dravyaṃ yatra pakṣe prayujyate ||
snehapākeṣu saḥ śreyān ity eṣa tu mayāśritaḥ |
pācanāḥ śamanīyāś ca ye kaṣāyā jvarādiṣu |
mātrāṃ tu vaidyāḥ kvāthasya pāyayanti catuṣpalām |
vādhituṃ śakyate naiva jñāpakaṃ cātra vidyate |
śāstre kuṣṭhe ca mātrā sā mahatī samprakāśitā |
catuṣpalā kaṣāyasya mātrā yā bhiṣajāṃ matā ||
pale caturguṇajale sā mātrā na prasidhyati |
evaṃ sati ca sādhyaṃ syād bheṣajānāṃ catuṣpalam ||
pātavyā ṣaṭpalā mātrā tasya dravyapalāni ṣaṭ ||
na ṣaṭpalāni kvāthyante na ca toyaṃ caturguṇam ||
jvarādīnāṃ kaṣāyeṣu sneheṣv eva hi sā matā ||
tatrāpi hi viśeṣo 'yam anyaḥ kaiścid upāśritaḥ ||
pūrvaṃ prasthavyapekṣā yā proktā vijñāpake sati ||
ghṛtaṃ muktvā kaṣāyasya proktā mātrā catuṣpalā ||
dravyāṇāṃ ca palaṃ kvāthyaṃ paṭolādye prakīrtitam ||
tat ṣoḍaśaguṇe toye yadi na kvāthyate tataḥ ||
ity etat ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ toyaṃ yatra prayujyate ||
draveṣu dviguṇaṃ mānaṃ sadyaś caivoddhṛteṣu ca |
dviguṇaṃ mānam ity etad ārabhya kuḍavād iti ||
śuṣkāṇāṃ ca dravāṇāṃ ca samaṃ tu kuḍavād adhaḥ |
yad uktaṃ śatam evātra palānāṃ parigṛhyate ||
naivāñjalau na prasṛte na pale na palād adhaḥ |
dravāṇām auṣadhānāṃ hi dviguṇaṃ mānam iṣyate ||
te ca kaṣāyāṣṭapale catuṣpalaṃ sarpiṣaś ca paktavyam |
yāvat syād aṣṭapalaṃ śeṣaṃ peyaṃ tataḥ koṣṇam iti ||
palasya dviguṇe māne kriyamāṇe na yujyate ||
dviguṇe hi pale tat syād ekam eva palāṣṭakam |
catuṣpalaṃ ca dātavyaṃ yat proktaṃ saha sarpisā ||
palasya dviguṇe māne tad apy aṣṭapalaṃ bhavet |
catuḥsuvarṇaṃ hi palaṃ śuṣkāṇām iṣyate yataḥ ||
dviguṇatvāt dravāṇāṃ hi tat syād aṣṭasuvarṇakam |
eṣā mātrā dviguṇitā dviguṇe prasṛte bhavet ||
catvāriṃśat palāni syur aṣṭābhir adhikāni ca ||
svarasāt kvathitāc chītāt kaṣāyāt ṣaṭpalaṃ pibet |
yad uktaṃ kharaṇādena tad dvādaśapalaṃ bhavet ||
paittike paṭhyate gulme sarpiṣaś ca catuṣpalam |
pibet saṃmūrchitaṃ tena gulmaḥ śāmyati paittikaḥ ||
añjaler dviguṇatvād dhi mātrā sāṣṭapalā bhavet |
palāni pṛthag aṣṭāṣṭau kṛtvā samyag vipācayet ||
aṣṭau pratyekam etāni syuḥ ṣoḍaśa palāni tu |
dravāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ mānaṃ tat kāryaṃ kuḍavādiṣu |
ārdreṣv api na sarveṣu sadyas teṣūdghṛteṣu ca ||
dviguṇaṃ mānam icchanti viśeṣo 'tra ca kalpyate |
teṣv eva dviguṇaṃ mānaṃ na sarveṣūdghṛteṣu hi |
ārdrāṇām eva yeṣāṃ tu prasiddhim upakalpayet ||
ārdrāṇām eva teṣāṃ hi prayogaḥ śasyate yataḥ |
nai tatra dviguṇaṃ mānaṃ bhiṣagbhiḥ kaiścid āśritam |
kvāthyānām auṣadhānāṃ hi pramāṇaṃ yatra noditam |
caturguṇaṃ ca nirdiṣṭam anyat kṣīrādikaṃ dravam ||
kaṣāyo 'py auṣadhānāṃ hi tatra kāryaś caturguṇaḥ |
evam evauṣadhānāṃ hi pramāṇaṃ yatra noditam |
dviguṇaṃ cāpi nirdiṣṭam anyat kṣīrādikaṃ dravam ||
kaṣāyo 'py auṣadhānāṃ hi dviguṇas tatra yujyate |
nirdiṣṭaṃ kṣīram anyad vā dravaṃ yatra caturguṇam |
kvāthauṣadhānāṃ mānaṃ ca proktaṃ noktaṃ jalasya tu ||
caturthaśeṣaḥ kvāthaḥ syāt tato dravyāc caturguṇaḥ |
pramāṇaṃ tu tathā noktaṃ snehasyoktaṃ na vā bhavet ||
tulyaṃ kvāthena dātavyaṃ tatra kṣīrādikaṃ dravam |
kartavyaṃ ca tathā tat syād yathā snehāc caturguṇam ||
evaṃ vai dviguṇe snehāt triguṇe ca prakīrtite ||
yathā kaṣāyasahitaṃ dravaṃ syāt tac caturguṇam ||
atrodāharaṇaṃ tat syād yathā snehāc caturguṇaḥ |
kaṣāyaḥ paṭhyate yatra pramāṇaṃ cāsya noditam ||
caturguṇaṃ vāpy adhikaṃ proktaṃ kṣīrādikaṃ dravam |
tatrāpi ca prayoktavyaṃ snehāt kvāthaṃ caturguṇam ||
paṭhyate vātaroge tad udāharaṇam atra hi ||
bahūni yatra paṭhyante kvacit snehe dravāṇi hi |
bahūnām api teṣāṃ ca parimāṇaṃ na paṭhyate ||
sarveṣāṃ samudāyaḥ syāt tatra snehāc caturguṇaḥ |
bahuṣv ekaikam icchanti kecit tatra samaṃ dravam |
ity evaṃ matabhedāt tu yathā kvāthavidhau tathā ||
necchanti kecit pratyekam āhuḥ snehasamaṃ dravam ||
udāharaṇam atrāsti yo vāpy anyo bahudravaḥ |
caturguṇo 'tra kiṃ tarhi pākyād daśaguṇaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
kvāthyāni yāni tānyatra pākyāḥ śataguṇe jale ||
prāgukto 'pi mayārtho yaḥ ślokais tasmāt prakāśitaḥ ||

div2.p: atha khalu jātamātram eva bālam ulbāt saindhavasarpiṣā mārjayet ||

tato 'syātiprabalamohajvaraparītasarvagātrasya krośitum api rujānurūpam asamarthasyānavasthitāśeṣadehadhātor asambhāvyayauvanādyavasthasya krakacasparśam iva karavasanaśayanasaṃsargaṃ manyamānasyāvikalpitam aṅgāni vikṣipataḥ punar iva maraṇam anubhavato līyamānasaṃjñasyātisambādhayonipuṭāvapīḍitaprāṇapratyānayanāya balātailena pariṣekaṃ kuryāt |
yadi vāceṣṭa eva syāt tataḥ kṛṣṇakapālikayā śūrpeṇa cainam abhiniṣpunīyāt |

lg.l: ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradāṃ śatam ||
nakṣatrāṇi diśo rātrir ahaś ca tvābhirakṣatu ||

div2.p: pratyāgataprāṇasya ca prakṛtibhūtasya nābhinālaṃ nālābhibandhanāc caturaṅgulasyordhvaṃ kṣaumasūtreṇa badhvā tīkṣṇena śastreṇa vardhayet |
tataḥ kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa sarvagandhodakena vā taptatapanīyarajatanirvāpaṇakavoṣṇena kapitthapatrakaṣāyeṇa vā tadvidhena snāpayet ||
tato 'sya suparilikhitanakhayā suprakṣālitopavānayā kārpāsapicvavaguṇṭhitayā dakṣiṇapradeśinyā jihvauṣṭhakaṇṭham anusukhaṃ pramṛjyāt |
tataś caindrībrāhmīśaṅkhapuṣpīvacākalkaṃ madhughṛtopetaṃ hareṇumātraṃ kuśāgrābhimantritaṃ sauvarṇenāśvatthapatreṇa medhāyurbalajananaṃ prāśayet |

lg.l: tṛtīye 'hni caturthe vā strīṇāṃ stanyaṃ pravartate ||

div2.p: tasmāt prathame 'hany anantāmiśrite madhusarpiṣī mantrapūte trikālaṃ prāśayet |
tataḥ prāṅnivāritastanyasya svapāṇitalasammitaṃ sarpir dvikālaṃ dāpayed anantaraṃ ca stanyam iṣṭataḥ ||
ahar ahaś cāsya śrotraśṛṅgāṭakaṃ snehāplutena plotena pracchādayet ||
prākśirasaṃ cainaṃ kṣaumanicaye saṃveśayed ucchīrṣake cāsyābhimantritam udakumbhaṃ sthāpayet dvārapakṣayoś ca ||
kumārasya ca saha mātrā kaṇṭhe ucchīrṣake ca |
dvāre ca dehalīm anu tiryaṅ musalaṃ nidhāpayet |

athāsya samānavarṇā madhyamavayāḥ śucir alolupā nibhṛtānāturā jīvadvatsā vatsalā dakṣiṇā brahmacāriṇy avyaṅgā bahukṣīrā śuklāmbarācarā dīrghadrasvādidehadoṣāṣṭakarahitā alambordhvacucūkātipīnahanistanadoṣamuktā yuktacūcukā dhātrī syāt tasyā eva stanyaṃ pibet ||
tac codakapātre duhyamānam ekatāṃ yad udakena saha gacchati vakṣyamāṇadoṣarahitaṃ ca tac chuddham ārogyabalajananam ||
atha dhātrī snātānuliptā nityam ahatavāsāḥ sumanāḥ prajāsthāpanauṣadhīḥ śirasā bibhrāṇā prāṅmukhī stanaṃ prāgdakṣiṇaṃ dhautam īṣatparisrutaṃ pāyayet ||
nānāstanyasya hy asātmyatvān nānāvidhā vyāpado bhavanti |
stanyajananāni tu madyāni śīdhuvarjyāny ānūpamāṃsāni dravāḥ svādvamlalavaṇaprāyāś cāhārāḥ kṣīriṇyaś cauṣadhayaḥ kṣīrapānam anāyāsaḥ saumanasyaṃ ca ||
na tu kṣudhitaśokārtaśrāntakruddhapraduṣṭadhātuṃgarbhiṇīviruddhāhārabhuktānāṃ stanyaṃ pāyayen nājīrṇauṣadhaṃ ca bālam iti |

lg.l: jāgṛyur bāndhavās tasya dadhataḥ paramāṃ mudam ||
daśame dvādaśe vāhni gotrācāraiḥ śubhaiḥ śubhe |
sūtā snānotsavaṃ kuryāt pitāpatyasya nāma ca ||
nakṣatradevatāyuktaṃ tad eva tu na kevalam |
maṅgalyam antarantasthaṃ na duṣṭaṃ na ca taddhitam ||
bodhayet sahasā suptaṃ no na cainaṃ samutkṣipet |
tathā hy asya samutrāso vegarodhaś ca jāyate ||
hastābhyāṃ grīvayā mūrdhnā viśeṣāt satataṃ vacām |
stanyadoṣāt gadās tasya yathoktaṃ tat pibed yataḥ |
na garbhiṇyāḥ pibet stanyaṃ pārigarbhikakṛd dhi tat ||
stanyābhāve payaś chāgaṃ gavyaṃ vā tadguṇaṃ pibet |
mūlaiḥ siddhaṃ bṛhatyādyaiḥ sthirābhyāṃ vā sitāyutam ||
dharaṇy aśeṣabhūtānāṃ mātā tvam asi kāmadhuk |
kumāraṃ pāhi māteva brahmā tad anumanyatām ||
svāheti mantreṇānena pratyahaṃ ca tataḥ param |
sāśrayaṃ sāvalambaṃ ca kaṭyādīn mardayed anu ||
ṣaṣṭhe 'nnaprāśanaṃ māsi kramāt tac ca prayojayet |
bhajed yathā yathā cānnaṃ stanyaṃ tyājyaṃ tathā tathā |
prāgdakṣiṇaṃ kumārasya bhiṣag vāmaṃ tu yoṣitaḥ |
dakṣiṇena dadhat sūcīṃ pālīm anyena pāṇinā ||
vidhyed daivakṛte chidre sakṛd evarju lāghavāt ||
nordhvaṃ na pārśvato nādhaḥ sirās tatra hi saṃśritāḥ ||
āmatailena siñcec ca bahalāṃ tadvad ārayā ||
varti stryahāt tato rūḍhaṃ vardhayeta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
nājīṇa na malodreke na cātyuṣṇe 'pi vardhayet |
bhindyād avṛddhau strīṇān tu pālīm antarapāṅgataḥ |
naiva cāpāṅgayor bāhyāṃ vyāpadaḥ syus tato dhruvāḥ ||
jāte mahati saṃrambhe vartim āśv apanīya tat ||
surūḍhaṃ ca punar vidhyat tvarayā tu vivardhanāt ||
chidyeta pālī śuddhasya śuddhāsrāṃ sandadhīta tām |
varṣaṃ svavasater bāhyaṃ kumārasya na darśayet |
dīpam ātapam agniṃ ca rūpam anyac ca bhāsuram ||
pūrvoktaṃ yojayet kṣīram annaṃ ca laghu bṛṃhaṇam ||
rogāṃś cāsya jayet saumyair bheṣajair aviṣādakaiḥ |
trāsayen nāvidheyaṃ ca trastaṃ gṛhvanti hi grahāḥ |
vastrapātāt parasparśāt pālayel laṅghanāc ca tam ||
jātuṣaṃ ghoṣavac citram atrāsaṃ ramaṇaṃ bṛhat |
anuśiṣyāt sadā cainaṃ dharmāya vinayāya ca ||
rakṣoghnaḥ puṣṭido 'bhyaṅgas tadvad udvartanaṃ ca taiḥ ||
grīṣme vātātapasvedair bālaḥ klāmyaty ato himam |
prātar eva pibed dugdhaṃ jīvanīyagaṇaiḥ śṛtam ||
sitāghṛtāḍhyān saktūṃś ca lihyān na tv eva pītakam |
nātyambupāyī lihyād vā ghṛtasātmyo ghṛtaṃ śṛtam ||
kaṭunnaṭena mūrdhānaṃ limped anyaiś ca śītalaiḥ ||
ebhiḥ kṣīraghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ lihyāt bālo ghanātyaye |
rakṣoghnaṃ ca viṣaghnaṃ ca sārasvatam idaṃ ghṛtam |
vayasthā pippalī kuṣṭhaṃ haridrā sārivā vacā |
māṃsī kaiḍaryam ity etac cūrṇaṃ brāhmīrajaḥsamam ||
prātaḥ prātar imaṃ lehaṃ dhātrīṃ cāsyāvalehayet ||
rohiṣaṃ cety amī prāśāḥ pṛthag dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ ||
nityaṃ mṛdbhakṣaṇād rakṣet tayā syur niyataṃ gadāḥ ||
tasya tatghaṭṭanāt kruddhaḥ kuryād dantāmayān marut ||
śūrair āyudhibhir guptam adhṛṣyaṃ nagaraṃ paraiḥ |
yathā śiśor vapus tadvad yathoktair vidhibhir grahaiḥ ||

div2.p: trividho hi bālaḥ prāguktas tatra kṣīrapasya kṣīram aduṣṭaṃ prayuñjīta |
kṣīraṃ hi yathoktair doṣakopanair āhāravihārair dhātryā vyāpannaṃ vividhāmayodayāya bālasya prakalpate ||
tatra śyāvāruṇavarṇaṃ tiktakaṣāyānurasaṃ viśadaṃ rūkṣam alakṣyagandhaṃ phenilam atṛptikaram ādhmānamūtravarcovibandhakṛt karśanam apsu visarpati vicchinnaṃ ca plavate vātaduṣṭam ||
kṛṣṇanīlatāmrāvabhāsaṃ tiktāmlakaṭukānurasaṃ kuṇaparudhiragandhi bhṛśoṣṇam apsu pītarājimad vidāhakaraṃ ca pittaduṣṭam ||
atyarthaśuklamadhuraṃ lavaṇānurasaṃ ghṛtatailavasāmajjagandhi picchilaṃ bahalaṃ tantumat guru salile 'vasīdati nidrābahulaṃ ca śleṣmaduṣṭam ||
sa yaṃ pradeśam abhīkṣṇaṃ spṛśati sparśaṃ ca na kṣamate tatra rujam upalakṣayet ||
mūtrasaṅgatṛṇmūrcchotrāsadigvīkṣaṇakhallīhastapādastambhakubjībhavanakeśaluñcanair bastau guhye ca sarvatra ca svabhā vātiriktarodanena mukhavikūṇanena ca ||
atha yathāmayaṃ yathādoṣaṃ ca dhātryāḥ śamanaśodhanāni prayuñjīta ||
