tatra vātadūṣite stanye devadārusaralakaṭurohiṇīvacākuṣṭhapāṭhābhārṅgīmāgadhikāvṛścikālīcitrakājamodaśuṇṭhīmarīcānāṃ kvāthaṃ daśamūlakvāthaṃ vā trirātraṃ pāyayitvā vātavyādhivihitānāṃ sarpiṣām anyatamaṃ nigadamadirānupānaṃ dadyād vātaharadravyasiddhaṃ vā |
evaṃvidhair eva ca vipakvaṃ saśarkaraṃ sarpiḥ ||
tiktānurasaṃ stanyaṃ mudgamāṣapalāśābhyāṃ kākolīyugalena ca śodhayet |
phenilaṃ vicchinnaṃ plavamānaṃ ca bilvāgnimanthaśṛtena payasā haviṣā ca |
ebhir eva ca dravyaiḥ sarpīṣi pittaghnāni ca virecanāni śītāṃś cābhyaṅgapradehasekān kuryāt ||
bhṛśoṣṇam anāmadāhajvarakaraṃ virecanaṃ ca tac candanotpalakamalaiḥ ||
kaphe tu saindhavapippalīyuktaṃ sarpir bālaṃ pāyayet |
saindhavamadhukasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ vā madanapuṣpakalkena ca sakṣaudreṇa stanaṃ bālasya coṣṭham ālimpet |
yadā punar dhātrī sannipātaprakopanāny āseveta tad asyās trayo malā yugapad vakṣo 'bhiprapannāḥ kṣīravahā rasāyanīḥ samanusṛtya saṅgīrṇaliṅgaṃ stanyam āvahanti |
tac ced avijñānāt satatam apratyavekṣaṇāt pramādād vā mātuḥ kumāraḥ pibati tataḥ sa tena salilopamam acchaṃ vicchinnam āmaṃ durgandhi nānāvarṇavedanaṃ phenilam atisāryate |
tatra dhātrīṃ bālaṃ ca pūrvam evāśu vāmayet |
vihitasaṃsargayoś ca mustāpāṭhātiviṣākuṣṭhakaṭukānāṃ kvāthaṃ pānāya dadyāt |
sa dīrghāyuṣo 'ṣṭamān māsāt parato vā pravartate |
te hy atibālye dantotpādavedanayātipīḍitā na samyak sampūrṇadhātubalā bhavanti ||
tadā ca tayor asampūrṇavīryatvāt punaḥ kālāntareṇa dantānāṃ patanam āpūryamāṇadhātutvāc ca punar utthānam ata eva ca vṛddhānāṃ na punar dantotpattiḥ ||
balān nipatitānāṃ tu sahasā tadadhiṣṭhānagatadhātubījabhraṃśāt santativyucchedāc choṇitātipravṛtyābhighātāc ca nissāritatvāt |
sirāṇāṃ punar anutpādaḥ etena rogacyutā api prāyaśo vyākhyātāḥ ||
tau tu dhātū kālakrameṇa pacyamānau yadā dantāśayam anuprapadyete tadāsya kiñcid utsedhenordhvādhodantamāṃsasaṅghaṭṭanād aṅgaharṣo jāyate |
tadgatena ca śleṣmaṇā kaṇḍūs tayā cūcukaṃ daśyate |
yad yad ālabhate tat tad āsyam ānayati |
tataḥ sa kaphānuviddho 'sthimajjasthitaḥ sarvato visaran saha pittena dhātūn malāṃś ca dūṣayan vividhān yathoditān upadravān abhinirvartayati ||
yadā punar dantamāṃsāśrayī kevalo vikṛtaḥ prabalo 'nilaḥ sapitto vāsthimajjānau śoṣayati tadā dvijānām asambhava eveti |

lg.l: dantodbhede ca bālānāṃ na hi kiñcin na dūyate ||
ta eva doṣā dūṣyāś ca jvarādyā vyādhayaśca yat |
atas tad eva bhaiṣajyaṃ mātrā tv asya kanīyasī |
sadyas tān vamanaṃ tasmāt pāyayen matimān mṛdu ||
yuñjyād virecanādīṃs tu dhātryā eva yathocitān ||
madhuraiś ca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ siddhaṃ daśanajanmani ||
pīto jvaram atīsāraṃ tṛṣṇāṃ chardiṃ ca nāśayet ||
gavādanīṃ dāḍimaṃ ca tṛḍvān koṣṇāmbhasā pibet ||
kuryāt kukūṇapothakyor yathoktaṃ svaṃ svam auṣadham |
nīlotpalasya patraiś ca śreṣṭhā vartiḥ śatonmitaiḥ ||
līḍhaṃ jvaram atīsāraṃ kāsaṃ pāṇḍvāmayaṃ vamim |
hanyāc ca mātṛkādoṣān rogān anyāṃś ca tadvidhān ||
kṣīriṇāṃ ca pravālāni pāṭhā ca vipacet ghṛtam |
tat pītaṃ samadhu śleṣmajvaraghnaṃ dīpanaṃ param ||
śleṣmajvaraharo lepas tailam abhyañjanaṃ ca taiḥ |
hanti līḍham atīsāraṃ śiśoḥ kṣaudradrutaṃ drutam ||
tiktayā ca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ samakṣīraṃ vyapohati |
svayam āpy upaśāmyanti jātadantasya yat gadāḥ ||
yāvan māsasya yo jātas tāvad varṣasya sa dvijaḥ |
arocakaḥ pratiśyāyo jvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate |
siddhaṃ prasthārdham ājyasya srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ param |
pītaṃ pītaṃ vamati yaḥ stanyaṃ taṃ madhusarpiṣā |
tadval lihyāt tathā vyoṣaṃ maṣīṃ vā romacarmaṇām |
śākhābhyāṃ hṛdayaṃ yāti hṛdayād vā gudaṃ vrajet |
sadanto jāyate yas tu dantāḥ prāg yasya cottarāḥ ||
kurvīta tasminn utpāte śāntiṃ taṃ ca dvijataye |
dadyāt sadakṣiṇaṃ bālaṃ naigameṣaṃ ca pūjayet ||
cumbet kumāras trīn vārān prāyaścittam idaṃ param ||
nāvam ārohayet bālaṃ snātaṃ skandhaṃ gajasya vā |
mātuḥ kumāro garbhiṇyāḥ stanyaṃ prāyo 'pibann api |
yujyate koṣṭhavṛdhyā ca tam āhuḥ pārigarbhikam |
hanti prayuktaṃ tat kāle rogān pāribhavāśrayān ||
imān eva gadān kuryāt kuryāt teṣv etad eva ca ||
pītaṃ pītaṃ ca yaḥ stanyaṃ savātam atisaryate |
tasyāpy etat paraṃ pathyaṃ dīpanaṃ balavarṇakṛt ||
pāyayed anu ca kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ samadhuśarkaram |
śrapayet kṣīram ājyaṃ vā bījair ikṣurakasya ca |
tat prayojyaṃ guru snigdhaṃ yac cātyagnau pureritam ||
snāpayet taṃ na ced evaṃ kṣut tasya praśamaṃ varajet ||
vṛkṣaṃ cānu tataḥ kuryāt bhūṣaṇavyatyayaṃ tayoḥ |
siddhaṃ pītaṃ havir hanti taṃ vikāram aśeṣataḥ ||
śiraḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ tato muṣkau tataḥ pādau ca yo rujet |
badhvā gośakṛtā liptaṃ kukūle svedayet tataḥ ||
rasena limpet tālvāsyaṃ netre ca pariṣecayet |
tāmro vraṇo 'ntaḥ kaṇḍūmān jāyate bhūry upadravaḥ ||
kecit taṃ mātṛkādoṣaṃ vadanty anye tu pautanam |
pṛṣṭhārur gudakuṭṭaṃ ca kecic ca tam anāmakam ||
gṛhṇāti sūtikāgāre na stanaṃ cet spṛśet tataḥ |
rudate trasyate vāpi lehaṃ dadyāt sukhāvaham ||
pañcame 'hny apātan nālaṃ lepayed vā guḍāmbhasā ||
nābhiṃ pāke tu tailena taccūrṇeś cāvacūrṇayet ||
samparkād dhṛdaye duṣṭo mārgān āvṛṇute rasaḥ ||
ulbakaṃ sahajaṃ vyādhim ambupūrṇaṃ ca taṃ vadet ||
vidadhyāc chāgalaṃ mūtraṃ snānābhyaṅgau ca varjayet ||
pāṇḍurogaṃ ca vātotthaṃ svasthavṛtte ca puṣṭidam ||
vyādher yad yasya bhaiṣajyaṃ stas tena pralepitaḥ |
sthito muhūrtaṃ dhauto 'nu pītas taṃ taṃ jayet gadam ||
grahair api hi jāyante pracchannair vyādhayaḥ śiśoḥ |
karma śastam atas teṣu daivayuktyāśrayaṃ sadā ||
skande 'tha yauvanaṃ prāpte senāpatyaṃ ca tān grahān |
na tithiṣv apy atithayo devatāḥ pitaro 'pi vā |
haradhvaṃ teṣu bālānām ārogyaṃ dhāri śarma ca ||
śuddhena dehaṃ bālānāṃ gandharvā iva yoṣitām ||
teṣāṃ grahiṣyatāṃ rūpaṃ pratataṃ rodanaṃ jvaraḥ ||
vakravaktro vaman lālāṃ bhṛśam ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣate ||
skandārtas tena vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ vā bhaved dhruvam ||
ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣya hasanaṃ madhye vinamanaṃ jvaraḥ |
dhāvanaṃ viṭsagandhatvaṃ krośanaṃ ca śvavac chuni ||
romaharṣo muhus trāsaḥ sahasā rodanaṃ jvaraḥ |
muṣṭibandhaḥ srutiś cākṣṇor bālasya syuḥ pitṛgrahe ||
sphoṭāḥ sadāharukpākāḥ sandhiṣu syuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
niśy ahni pravilīyante pāko vaktre gude 'pi vā |
pūtanāyāṃ vamiḥ kampas tandrā rātrau prajāgaraḥ |
bastagandho jvaraḥ śoṣaḥ purīṣaṃ haritaṃ dravam |
udare granthayo vṛttā yasya nānāvidhaṃ śakṛt |
jihvāyā nimnatā madhye śyāvaṃ tālu ca taṃ tyajet ||
tatra hiṃsātmake bālo mahān vā srutanāsikaḥ |
kṣāmo mūtrapurīṣaṃ svaṃ mṛdnāti na jugupsate ||
hastau codyamya saṃrabdho hanty ātmānaṃ tathāparam |
tadvac ca śastrakāṣṭhādyair agniṃ vā dīptam āviśet ||
apsu majjet patet kūpe kuryād anyac ca tadvidham |
rakaṃ ca sarvamārgebhyo 'riṣṭotpattiṃ ca taṃ tyajet ||
hṛṣṭaḥ śāntaś ca duḥsādho ratikāmena pīḍitaḥ ||
śaṅkitaṃ vīkṣate rauti dhyāyaty āyāti bhītatām ||
graheṣu sādhyeṣu śiśuṃ vivikte śaraṇe sthitam |
śṛgālavinnā mustā ca kalkitais tair ghṛtaṃ pacet |
sagranthikaiḥ sendrayavaiḥ śiśos tat satataṃ hitam |
tan nāśayed grahān sarvān pānenābhyañjanena ca |
yojayed bhūtavidyāyāṃ yāny uktāni ghṛtāni ca ||
nirdhūmaś cānalas toyaṃ gugguluḥ sarpir āhutiḥ |
śuklaṃ puṣpaṃ balir dhūpo dūrvā śvetāś ca sarṣapāḥ ||
prāṅmukho 'tha śucir vaidyas trivarṇām athavā sitām |
vidhinā sādhitāṃ bhūtaiḥ sarvair apy aparājitām ||
udaṅmukhasya bālasya badhnīyāt tāṃ tato gale |
tad abhāve dṛḍhaṃ kṣaumasūtraṃ mantram idaṃ japan ||
yamo vaivasvato rājā ye ca tasyānucāriṇaḥ ||
nānākārāś ca ye bhūtās tasyaivānucarāḥ sadā ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaś cāśvināv api |
dīrgham āyur arogaṃ ca tava dāsyanti svasti te |
svasti te bhagavān brāhmā svasti nāradaparvatau ||
svasti vedāś ca yajñāś ca agnīṣomau ca svasti te |
svasti te śrīr dhṛtiḥ kīrtir lakṣmīr medhā kṣamā dyutiḥ ||
svasti tuṣṭiś ca puṣṭiś ca vapur drīr buddhir eva ca |
svasti rudro viśākhaś ca skandaḥ śaktidharaś ca te ||
svasti dhātā vidhātā ca suparṇaś ca mahābalaḥ |
svasti devāś ca yakṣāś ca mā ca te pāpam āgamat ||
nirvṛtas tvaṃ nirudvego jīva varṣaśataṃ sukhī ||
kṛsaro yāvakaḥ kṣaudraṃ palalaṃ lavaṇaṃ haviḥ |
gandhaṃ mālyaṃ phalaṃ hema dhūpaḥ sapurakunduruḥ ||
baliḥ suśastair deyaḥ syād bhavanasya caturdiśam ||
vṛtte vā caturasre vā maṇḍale kusumojvale ||
taṃ prati prāṅmukho vidyāṃ paṭhann upaharet balim ||
prajāpatau ca yat satyaṃ yat satyam amareśvare |
dharmarāje ca yat satyaṃ yac ca satyaṃ tapasviṣu ||
dhanādhite ca yat satyaṃ yac ca satyaṃ jalādhite |
yat satyam agnihotreṣu satyaṃ yac chrotriyeṣu ca ||
pativratāsu yat satyam īśvare ca mahātmani |
baliṃ copahṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sarve kaumārakā grahāḥ |
tataś cānu paṭhed enāṃ kulavidyāṃ samāhitaḥ |
aulā nīlā khalā kālā nakulā grahakārikā ||
senā susenā mātā ca mahāsenā yaśasvinī |
kumāravacanāc chīghraṃ pramuñcantu śiśun tv imam |
śarastambhaś ca te mudrā mucyatāṃ mātaraḥ śiśuḥ |
gandhaṃ dhūpaṃ ca mālyaṃ ca kumāras te prayacchati ||
na sthātavyaṃ tad āghrāya svāṃ gatiṃ gaccha mā ciram |
ṣammukho dvādaśākṣo vai tasmin kāle vṛto varam |
graho yaḥ kopayed ājñāṃ kumārasya yaśasvinaḥ |
sthānāt cyutaḥ sa vai kṣipraṃ bāhyaḥ pariṣado bhavet ||
puṣpair bhakṣyaiś ca vividhaiś caruṇā lohitais tathā ||
gandhair gugguludhūpaiś ca samidhaḥ khadirād atha |
tvaṃ hi yajñaś ca yūpaś ca tvaṃ hi dharmavatāṃ gatiḥ |
hiraṇyaretā devas tvaṃ tvaṃ hi vedavidāṃ gatiḥ ||

div2.p: tvaṃ hi śāntikaro vahnis tvaṃ mārutaharodanaḥ |
haripradhānagatir āsīd imaṃ nigṛhya guhyakam utsādaya tejasā tvaṃ mama vaśyaṃ ca taṃ kuru duṣṭagrahanivāraṇaṃ sarvopadraveṣu ca ||

lg.l: tvayā kṛtena homena śīghraṃ śāntiḥ prajāyate |
āyāhi vahne devānāṃ tvaṃ hi vaktraṃ purātanam |
tena satyena deveśa imaṃ sādhaya me graham ||

div2.p: namo 'stu te havyavāhana daṇḍaṃ pradarśaya daha daha darśa darśa teja teja moṭaya moṭaya apasmāram udghāṭaya kumāra piśācarevatīrodanatrāsana vitrāsana kampana utkampana vijṛmbhaṇa devayakṣagandharvabhūtanāgarākṣasasantajana daṇḍanāvidhūsāraya bhagavann agnidaṇḍa agnivīrya namas tejasā svena tyaktam utsādaya svāhā |

lg.l: puṣye mūle ca bālasya snānaṃ parvadineṣu ca ||
dhanadaṃ ca gadāpāṇiṃ yamasthānam atītya ca |
śaṅkhaṃ ca dakṣiṇāvartaṃ śrīvatsaṃ mālyadāma ca |
ṣaṭkīlān āyasān kuryāt sapta trailohikān bhiṣak |
aṣṭau ghaṭāḥ ṣoḍaśa vā dvātriṃśadviguṇā api |
pūrveṣu prakṣiped dhema tataś ca maṇimauktikam |
guptidvārāt samudrāc ca samiddhaṃ cāgnim āharet ||
bālam audumbare pīṭhe pālāśe vāpy udaṅmukham |
āstṛte haritair darbhair na tu prācyādidiṅmukham ||
juhuyāt tena tatrāgnim udīcyāṃ sthāpitaṃ diśi ||
amṛtāt pūrvam utpannam imaṃ te kalaśaṃ śubham |
dadātu bhagavān indro vijayaṃ nāma nāmataḥ ||
ebhiḥ sārdhaṃ mahān indraḥ snapanaṃ tenumanyatām |
pūrvadvāre sthitaṃ divyaṃ vajram indrājñayā śubham ||
yamo dadātu bhagavān vaijayantaṃ tu nāmataḥ ||
duḥsvapnaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sarvam adya haniṣyati ||
dadātu madhurājas te bhagavān varuṇaḥ svayam ||
prabalaiḥ kāpilair muṇḍair vikaṭair vāmanais tathā ||
sa te vaiśravaṇaḥ śrīmān snapanan tv anumanyatām ||
gadā te nāśayatv adya sarvapāpaṃ diśo daśa ||
āpaḥ pavitraṃ lokesminn āpo vai paramaṃ śuciḥ |
āpo vai devatāḥ sarvā āpas tvām abhiṣicyatām |
brahmā brahmarṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ bhagavāṃs tvābhiṣiñca tu ||
sāṅgopāṅgās tathā vedāḥ kīrtir lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī |
bālā dākṣāyaṇī sītā sāvitrī saramā dyutiḥ |
nadīnāṃ saṅgamās tīrthā nirjharāḥ sāgarās tathā |
merur mahendro himavān jagac ca sthāvaratrayam ||
adya tvām abhiṣiñcantu nīrujo bhava dāraka ||

div2.p: oṃ maṃ oṃ maṃ lmi lmi libhuk libhuk lipibhavanebhyaḥ svāhā ||

lg.l: rākṣasā ca palāyantu bhūtāś ca trastamānasāḥ |
puṣkaraṃ puṣkarāraṇyaṃ naimiṣaṃ ca tathā gayā |
tīrthāny etāni sarvāṇi abhiṣiñcantu svasti te ||
api tā nihatāḥ sarvā yāś cānyāḥ pāpacintakāḥ ||
satīnāṃ kapilānāṃ ca siddhānāṃ caiva tejasā |
prabhur mṛtyur alakṣmīś ca kālarātriś ca sārathiḥ |
lambā ca lohaśaṅkuś ca pūtanā kūṭapūtanā |
aśubhaṃ yac ca te kiñcit sarvaṃ pratihataṃ mayā ||
viśvāvasuś ca hāhā ca nāradas tumburus tathā |
dhanvantarir agastyaś ca susnātaṃ pradiśantu te ||
snapanaṃ pāpmajit puṇyaṃ nīrujām api puṣṭikṛt |
vidhinā vidhihīnan tu savaidyaṃ hanti bālakam |
sthālyām utkvāthya tat toyaṃ bālānāṃ snapanaṃ śivam |

div2.p: skandagrahe guggulvelavālukamanaśśilāharitālamañjiṣṭhośīrarāsnāgarudevadāruśrīveṣṭakahareṇūgirikadambakacandanaiḥ ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ pradeho vātaharavṛkṣapatrakvāthena kavoṣṇena pariṣekas teṣām eva ca mūlakvāthe sarvagandhasurāmaṇḍakaiḍaryāvāpavat tailaṃ vipakvam abhyaṅgaḥ ||
kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa kṣīreṇa ca siddham ardhapalikaiś ca piṣṭaiḥ sārivādvikākolīdvibalāṃśumatīdvayahastikarṇaparṇair ghṛtaprasthaṃ pānam ||
somavallīndravallīśamībilvavṛndākamṛgādinīmūlāni sūtreṇa grathitāni kaṇṭhena śirasā vā dhārayet ||

raktamālyānulepanavastrapatākāmaṇibījair vividhaiś ca bhakṣyaiḥ sadadhighṛtamadhulājakulmāṣamāṃsamatsyasurāsavaṃ samayūrakukkuṭaṃ saghaṇṭākaṃ saśūrpavyajanaṃ ca kumāragrahe raktaudanena balim upoṣito nivedayet ||
tatra ca rātrāv agniṃ jvālayitvā mantram imaṃ paṭhan madhusarpiṣā juhuyāt ||

lg.l: agnaye kṛttikābhyaś ca svāhā svāheti cāntataḥ |
nīrujo nirvikāraś ca śiśur bhavatu sarvadā ||

div2.p: sarveṣv eva graheṣu trikālam agniṃ pūjayet tarpayec ca |
viśeṣataḥ skandagrahe trirātraṃ ca rātrau rātrau gāyatryabhimantritodakena catvare dhātrīkumārayoḥ snapanam ācaret ||
trikālaṃ ca mantreṇānena bālam apamārjayet pratisarāṃ ca badhnīyāt ||

lg.l: tapasāṃ tejasāṃ caiva yaśasāṃ vapuṣāṃ tathā |
vidhātā yo 'vyayo devaḥ sa te skandaḥ prasīdatu ||
devadevasya mahataḥ pāvakasya ca yaḥ sutaḥ |
gaṅgomākṛttikānāṃ ca sa te śarma prayacchutu ||
raktādityavapur devaḥ pātu tvā krauñcasūdana iti ||

div2.p: viśākhe skandagrahokto vacākuṣṭhānvitaḥ pradeho golomībilvaśirīṣamustasurasādikvāthena pariṣekaḥ |
kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa jīvanīyagarbhaṃ sapayaskaṃ sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pānam |
naigameṣe viśākhoktaḥ pradehognimanthavaruṇanalarohiṣapūtīkapāribhadrakaiḥ pariṣeko dhānyāmlena sabījena guggulvaśvagandhāsarṣapośīraśvetākuṣṭhaśatāhvāvipakvaṃ tailamabhyaṅgaḥ ||

lg.l: yosau śvavigrahaḥ sṛṣṭaḥ sa devas tvābhirakṣatu ||

div2.p: bilvakapitthakarañjatarkārīsurasapāṭalīvaraṇapāribhadrakapārijātamātuluṅgapatrakvāthena rātrau pariṣeko bilvādibhir eva ca tailaṃ surābastamūtrayuktaṃ sādhitam abhyaṅgaḥ ||
triphalāṃśumatīdvayapayasyāmadhukakalkena daśamūlaniryūhe sakṣīraṃ sarpiḥ pakvaṃ pānam |
gṛddhrolūkavānararomāṇi saghṛtāni tatpurīṣaṃ vā suptajane dhūpo vacādibhir vā pradehoktaiḥ pūrvokto vā |
surāsavaguḍāpūpapiṣṭatilakṛtabhakṣo vṛkṣamūle savṛṣabhaḥ kāñcanākṣiyugayuktaḥ svayaṃ pitrā kumārasya nirvāpaṇīyo baliḥ |

lg.l: yaḥ pitā sarvabālānāṃ grahāṇāṃ pūjito varaḥ |
vṛkṣamūle kṛtāvāsaḥ sa tvāṃ pātu pitā sadā ||

div2.p: kṣīritarubhiḥ pariṣeko mārkavamūlakāmalakītvakpatrapriyaṅgumanaśśilālailādvayayaṣṭīkramukalodhradhātakīsārivāñjanotpalapataṅgasamaṅgādviharidrāmāṃsīmañjiṣṭhācandanapadmakasuvarṇagaurikais tailaṃ sapayaskaṃ pakvam abhyaṅgo grahahā vraṇaropaṇaś ca ||
kāśmaryapṛśniparṇīlodhramadhukair madhuravargeṇa ca samakṣīraṃ sarpiḥ śṛtaṃ prāśyamānaṃ śītapūtanāṃ chardihidhmākāsaśvāsāṃś ca śamayati ||
mudgaudanaprāyo jalāśayasamīpe balis tatraiva ca snānam |
syandanasyonākakāśmaryakhadirakuṣṭhairmadhuravargeṇa ca kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāye sakṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhuyuktaṃ cakṣuḥkāmopasṛṣṭānāṃ prāśaḥ |

lg.l: devī bālam imaṃ prītā pālayatv andhapūtanā ||

div2.p: bilvairaṇḍakapitthāgnimanthavaṃśīkuberākṣīpatrakvāthena pariṣekas teṣām eva ca svarasena madhukavājigandhāgarbham aikadhyaṃ tailaṃ vasā ca pakvam abhyaṅgaḥ ||
ebhir eva ca vipakvam ājaṃ ghṛtaṃ payo vā pibet ||
mātuś cāsya śleṣmaharam auṣadhaṃ pāne stanodvartane ca yuñjyāt ||
dhavāśvakarṇadhātakīkakubhatindukair jīvanīyaiś ca piṣṭair ghṛtaṃ śṛtaṃ prāśaḥ |
kulmāṣair madyena śuṣkamāṃsena ca śuṣkavṛkṣe baliḥ |

lg.l: revatī śuṣkanāmā ca sā te devī prasīdatu iti ||

div2.p: teṣām api cāparisaṅkhyeyaḥ parivāra ity ananto bhūtalokaḥ ||
sarvo 'pi ca prāyeṇāhārakāmā niśārdhavicāriṇo bhayānakā māṃsāsṛgvasāśinaḥ ||
teṣāṃ punar anupraveśe kāraṇaṃ sadyaḥ pūrvakṛto vā viśeṣeṇa prajñāparādhaḥ ||
tena hi kāmakrodhalobhamohādijanitena praluptadhamabhinnavratācāraśauco malīmasaḥ pūjyān atikrāmann ātmānam upahanti ||
tatas tam ātmahanam avatāragaveṣiṇo devādigrahā apy anughnanti |
evaṃvidhāṃs tu puruṣān eṣv āghātakāleṣv abhigacchanti ||
sandhyāvelāyām aprayatabhāve vā pakṣasandhiṣu vā mithunībhāve |
tatra śīlavantaṃ cokṣācāraṃ śuklāmbaradharaṃ tapaḥsvādhyāyaparaṃ prāyaḥ śuklapratipaditrayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā devā gṛhṇanti |
krodhanaṃ kadaryam ātmasambhāvinaṃ kularūpagarvitaṃ kṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ sandhyayoś cāsurāḥ |
priyanṛttagītavāditragandhamālyāmbaraṃ paradārarataṃ cokṣācāraṃ prāyaś caturthyām aṣṭabhyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca gandharvāḥ |
svapnaśīlaṃ capalam animitrakrodhanam arthasiddhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prāyaḥ pañcabhyāṃ sandhyayor madhyāhne ca nāgāḥ |
satvabalarūpagandharvadhanaśauryayuktaṃ mālyānulepanahāsyapriyam ativyākaraṇaṃ prāyaḥ śuklasaptamyām ekādaśyāṃ ca yakṣāḥ ||

svādhyāyatapovratacaryādevayatigurupūjārataṃ bhraṣṭaśaucaṃ vā brāhmaṇam abrāhmaṇaṃ vā brahmavādinaṃ śūraṃ māninaṃ devāgārasalilakrīḍanapriyaṃ ca skhalitabrahmacaryaṃ prāyaḥ śuklapañcamyām aṣṭamyāṃ pūrṇacandradarśane sandhyāsu ca |
hīnasatvaṃ piśunaṃ stenaṃ lubdhaṃ śaṭhaṃ prāyo dvitīyātṛtīyāṣṭamīṣu rākṣasapiśācādayaḥ |
kalipānapriyam asūyāvantaṃ paruṣabhāṣiṇaṃ bahvāśinaṃ ca kṛṣṇanavamīdvādaśyor niśi ca rākṣasāḥ ||
ātmaślāghinaṃ kūṭasākṣyapradaṃ paropatāpinaṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ piśācādayaḥ ||
mātāpitṛguruvṛddhasiddhācāryopasevinaṃ prāyo daśamyām amāvāsyāṃ ca pitaraḥ |
tadvidham eva ca prāyaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ navamyāṃ ca guruvṛddhasiddhāḥ |
devagobrāhmaṇatapasvināṃ hiṃsārucitvaṃ nṛśasābhiprāyatā kopanatvam aratir ojovarṇacchāyābalavapuṣāṃ copataptiḥ svapne devādibhir bhatsanaṃ pravartanaṃ ca ||

tatra saumyadṛṣṭiṃ gambhīram apradhṛṣyam akopanaṃ śucim anidraṃ bhojanānabhilāṣiṇam alpasvedamūtrapurīṣavācaṃ saṃskṛtavādinaṃ devadvijagurubhaktaṃ śuklamālyāmbarasaritpulinaśailoccabhavanadadhikṣīrasurabhipriyaṃ cirād akṣiṇī nimīlayantaṃ varapradātāraṃ śubhagandhaṃ varcasvinaṃ phullapadmopamamukhaṃ devagraheṇa gṛhītaṃ vidyāt ||
tatrāpi govṛṣam iva nadantaṃ dīptamukhanayanam ādīptena svareṇa sarvam ābhāṣamāṇam īśvareṇa |
dhanāni vācā prayacchantam ācchindantaṃ ca dhanadena |
surāsavasamagandhaṃ kāṣṭhatṛṇarajjvādi sarvaṃ pāśam abhimanyamānaṃ varuṇena ||

jihmadṛṣṭiṃ duṣṭātmānaṃ krodhanam atṛptaṃ sasvedagātraṃ devabrāhmaṇagurudveṣiṇaṃ nirbhayam abhimāninaṃ śūraṃ vyavasāyinaṃ rudro 'ham indroham upendro 'haṃ skando 'haṃ viśākho 'ham ityādi bhāṣamāṇaṃ vikṛtavācam asakṛd dhasantaṃ surāmiṣaruciṃ dantair nakhaiś ca parān hiṃsantam asureṇa ||
svācāraṃ hṛṣṭātmānaṃ śubhagandham alpavyavahāraṃ nṛtyantaṃ gāyantaṃ mukhavādyāni kurvantaṃ priyodyānapulinaraktavastrasnānamālyānulepanadhūpānnapānahāsalīlāśṛṅgārakathāgāndharvaṃ gandharveṇa |
tatrāpi śiro dhunānaṃ kalahaṃ kurvantaṃ saṃrambheṇa jāgarūkaṃ paṭhantaṃ hasantaṃ hasanena ||

krodhanam aniśaṃ viśvasantaṃ bhramantam ātapatrāt trasyantaṃ raktākṣaṃ stabdhadṛṣṭiṃ jihvāṃ lolayantaṃ sṛkviṇyau lihānam adhomukhaśāyinaṃ calaṃ vakragāminaṃ bilam avalokya sarpavad ūrdhvaṃ prasarantaṃ jalaughaghanadundubhisvanair hṛṣyantaṃ kṣīraghṛtaguḍamadhusnānamālyapriyaṃ gātrāṇi kampayantaṃ dantaiḥ khādantaṃ jale 'vatīrṇam uttaraṇam anicchantam urageṇa ||

asakṛt svapnarodanahāsanṛtyagītapāṭhakathānnapānasnānamālyadhūpagandharaktavastraratiṃ raktatrastaviplutākṣaṃ drutaṃ sagarvaṃ mattam iva gacchantaṃ vastrāntam utkarṣayantaṃ calitāgrahastaṃ bahubhāṣiṇaṃ strīlolupaṃ madyāmiṣapriyaṃ sannahya śastraṃ mṛgayamāṇam atibalam avyathaṃ hṛṣṭaṃ tuṣṭam alparoṣaṃ kiṃ kasmai dadāmīti vādinaṃ śubhagandhaṃ varcasvinaṃ dvijātivaidyaparibhāvinaṃ rahasyabhāṣiṇaṃ yakṣeṇa ||
tatrāpi hṛṣitaromāṇam ūrdhvekṣaṇaṃ prahṛṣṭanayanaṃ caṇḍaṃ paruṣaṃ mahāninādaṃ maṇivareṇa |
rahohasitanṛtyagītāny ācarantam ākīrṇe maunam āsevamānaṃ vikaṭena ||

hāsanṛttapriyam ākrośinaṃ pradhāvinaṃ devadvijabhiṣagdveṣiṇaṃ mantravedaśāstrābhidhāyinaṃ kāṣṭhaśastrādibhiś cātmānam āghnantaṃ chidraprahāriṇaṃ vaidyarandhrānveṣiṇaṃ bhoḥśabdavādinaṃ paruṣaṃ raudraceṣṭaṃ śīghragāminaṃ brahmarākṣasena |
tatrāpi vikṛtasvaraṃ bhāṣayantam utrāsayantaṃ brahmavādinaṃ saṃskṛtabhāṣiṇaṃ bahuśas toyaṃ yācantaṃ yajñasenena ||

sakrodhadṛṣṭiṃ bhrukuṭim udvahantaṃ bhairavāsyaṃ tvaritam abhidhāvantaṃ ruvantaṃ sasaṃbhramaṃ praharantaṃ naṣṭanidraṃ niśāvicāriṇam annadveṣiṇam anāhāram apy atibalinam annakāle hasantaṃ nirlajjaṃ śūraṃ roṣaṇam apriyavādinam aśuciṃ srīmadyamāṃsaraktamālyapriyaṃ raktam āmiṣaṃ vā dṛṣṭvoṣṭhau parilihantaṃ dīnaṃ śaṅkitaṃ dhāvantam akasmād rudantaṃ hasantaṃ gāyantaṃ nṛtyantaṃ nirarthakaṃ paribhāṣamāṇaṃ rākṣasena |
tatrāpi paruṣacchaviṃ bhūmiṃ tāḍayantam akasmād rudantaṃ viśākhena |
bhinnagadgadakaṇṭham aṅgāni bhañjayantaṃ jihvāṃ parilihānam akṣamālayā japamānaṃ śaucam abhīkṣṇaṃ kurvāṇaṃ saṅgamena |
meghavidyududayāyāsate krudhyantaṃ jalavṛṣṭiṃ samantān manyamānaṃ śakaṭaniṣpīḍinaṃ vidyunmālinā |

asvasthacittaṃ naikatra tiṣṭhantaṃ paridhāvinaṃ dayitanṛtyagītahāsocchiṣṭamadyamāṃsaśūnyanivāsaratiṃ purastād abhighnantaṃ nirbhatsanād dīnaśaṅkitavadanaṃ nakhair ātmavapuṣi likhantaṃ naṣṭasmṛtiṃ baddhābaddhabhāṣiṇam akasmād rudantaṃ duḥkhāny āvedayamānam udhvastarūkṣadehasvaraṃ durgandham aśuciṃ nagnaṃ malinaṃ rathyācailatṛṇābharaṇaṃ saṅkarakūṭakāṣṭhāśvārohiṇaṃ lolaṃ bahvāśinaṃ piśācena |
tatrāpi bhojanaṃ dṛṣṭvā hasantaṃ visvaraṃ krośantaṃ nityabhītaṃ kaśmalena |
sarvagātrāṇi spandayantaṃ muhur muhur dhāvantaṃ bhīṣayamāṇaṃ kuśena |
vaidyaṃ dṛṣṭvā kupyantaṃ bhramadbhojinaṃ bahvāśinaṃ bhasmaguṇṭhanaśayanaṃ striyo mārge rundhānaṃ mūtrapurīṣavimardinaṃ nistejasā |
bahupralāpam ugravākyaṃ vilambitagatiṃ kṛṣṇavadanaṃ śūnapralambavṛṣaṇaṃ kūṣmāṇḍena ||
nagnaṃ dhāvantam akasmād aśmakāṣṭhādi gṛhītvā bhramantaṃ tṛṇacīramālyanivasanam utrastadṛṣṭiṃ paruṣābhidhāyinaṃ śmaśānaśūnyaikavṛkṣarathyāniṣeviṇaṃ tilānnamadyāmiṣasaktadṛṣṭiṃ kākhordena ||
ugravādinaṃ raktatrastanetram annābhilāṣiṇam udakaṃ prārthayamānaṃ maukiraṇena ||
aprasannadṛṣṭiṃ calannetrapakṣmāṇaṃ śaṅkitekṣaṇaṃ dīnavadanaṃ saṃśuṣkatāluṃ nidrāluṃ pratihatavācam apasavyavastram alpāgnim arocakinaṃ tilaguḍapāyasamāṃsaruciṃ ca pitṛgraheṇa ||
ṛṣiguruvṛddhasiddhānām ābhiśāpānudhyānānurūpavihāravyāhārāhāraṃ tadgraheṇa gṛhītaṃ vidyād iti |

lg.l: vajraproktā vayasthā ca śṛṅgī mohanavaly api ||
purāṇam athavā tailaṃ navaṃ tat pānanasyayoḥ |
abhyaṅge ca prayoktavyam eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ ca dhūpane ||
ebhiś ca gulikāṃ yuñjyād añjane sāvapīḍane |
pralepe kalkam eteṣāṃ kvāthaṃ ca pariṣecane |
mañjiṣṭhāṃ dve niśe kṛṣṇāṃ bastamūtreṇa peṣayet |
haridre ca kṛtā vartiḥ pūrvavan nayanāñjanam |
vayasthā hiṅgu kaṭukā ṣaḍgranthā saindhavaṃ tathā ||
surāhvaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ sarpir gomūtre taiś caturguṇe ||
siddhaṃ siddhārthakaṃ nāma pāne nasye ca yojitam |
grahān sarvān nihanty āśu viśeṣād āsurān grahān ||
guṇaiḥ pūrvavad uddiṣṭo rājadvāre ca siddhikṛt ||
bījaṃ karañjāt kusumaṃ śirīṣāt phalaṃ ca valkaṃ ca kapitthavṛkṣāt ||
samāṇimanthaṃ sanataṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ syonākamūlaṃ kiṇihī sitā ca |
bastasya mūtreṇa subhāvitaṃ tat pittena gavyena guḍān vidadhyāt ||

div2.p: ghṛtam anavam aśeṣamūtrāṃśāsiddhaṃ mataṃ bhūtarāvāhvayaṃ pānatas tadgrahaghnaṃ param ||
bilvaiḥ sabhaiḥ kalkitair mūtravargeṇa siddhaṃ ghṛtam ||
vidhivinirhitam āśu sarvaiḥ kramair yojitaṃ hanti sarvagrahonmādakuṣṭhajvarāṃs tan mahābhūtarāvaṃ smṛtam ||

lg.l: grahā gṛhṇanti ye yeṣu teṣāṃ teṣu viśeṣataḥ |
rocate yad yadā yebhyas tat teṣām āharet tadā ||
bhakṣyāś ca sarve sarveṣāṃ sāmānyo vidhir ity ayam ||
dadhi cchatraṃ ca dhavalaṃ devānāṃ balir iṣyate ||
śvetapatraṃ ca lodhraṃ ca tagaraṃ nāgasarṣapāḥ |
hiraṇyaṃ ca balir yojyo mūtrājyakṣīram ekataḥ |
harītakī haridre dve laśuno maricaṃ vacā |
toyasya kumbhaḥ palalaṃ chatraṃ vastraṃ vilepanam ||
ebhir eva ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ gavāṃ mūtre caturguṇe |
piśācānāṃ baliḥ sīdhuḥ piṇyākaḥ palalaṃ dadhi |
ṛte piśācāt sarveṣu pratikūlaṃ ca nācaret |
savaidyamāturaṃ ghnanti kruddhās te hi mahaujasaḥ ||
mahāvidyāṃ ca māyūrīṃ śucis taṃ śrāvayet sadā ||
bhūteśaṃ pūjayet sthāṇuṃ pramathākhyāṃś ca tadgaṇān |
japan siddhāṃś ca tanmantrān grahān sarvān apohati ||
yac coktam iha tat sarvaṃ prayuñjīta parasparam ||

div2.p: tatronmādo nāma ya unmārgagaiḥ śārīramānasair doṣair manaso madaḥ ||

teṣāṃ punar unmārgagatve hetuḥ śamalaṃ vikṛtopahitam ahitam anucitam annapānavidhinirapekṣam āhārajātam atyupakṣīṇadehānāṃ vyavāyavyādhivegasamudgame viṣamaśarīraceṣṭopasevā devadvijagurūllaṅghanaṃ vā rāgadveṣajanitābhir ādhibhir manovighāto viṣopaviṣagaropayogo vā ||
ebhir hīnasatvasya manasy upahate buddhau pracalitāyām atyudīrṇatvād doṣāḥ prakupitā hṛdayam upasṛtya manovahāni srotāṃsy āvṛtya janayanty unmādam ||

tatra śirasaḥ śūnyatā cakṣuṣor asvasthatvaṃ svanaḥ karṇayor ucchvāsādhikyam āsyasaṃsravaṇam annānabhilāṣo 'rocako 'vipāko hṛdayagraho 'sthāne dhyānāyāsasammohodvegāḥ satataṃ romaharṣo jvaro 'bhīkṣṇam unmattacittatvam udarditvam arditākṛtikaraṇaṃ vyādheḥ svapne ca darśanam abhīkṣṇaṃ bhrāntacittacalitānavasthitānām apraśastānāṃ rūpāṇāṃ tilapīḍakavac cakrādhirohaṇaṃ vātakuṇḍalikābhir unmathanaṃ nimajjanaṃ kaluṣāṇām ambhasām āvarteṣu cakṣuṣoś cāpasarpaṇām iti doṣanimittānām unmādānāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi |
tataś ca deho hatasārathir iva ratho 'karṇadhāra iva cāpsu plavaḥ sukhaduḥkhācāradharmādharmapralupto 'kasmād bhramati ||

tatra vātād asthānasmitahasitanṛttagītavāditravāgaṅgavikṣepavāgbhedabhrū vikṣeparodanakrośanāsphoṭanāni paryaṭanam ajasram āsyāt phenāgamo yānam ayānair alaṅkaraṇam analaṅkārikair dravyair lobho 'bhyavahāryeṣu labdheṣu cāvamānas tīvraṃ mātsaryaṃ kārśyaṃ pāruṣyam utpiṇḍitāruṇākṣatā jīrṇe 'nne cātibalavatvam ||

pittāt krodhaḥ santarjanam akasmān muṣṭiloṣṭakāṣṭhaśastrair abhidravaṇaṃ nagnatā pracchāyaśiśirābhirātir udakābhilāṣaḥ santāpaḥ pītāvasraṃsanam animittam analajvalanopaśaṅkāhni tārakādarśanaṃ tāmraharitahāridrasaṃrabdhākṣatvaṃ ca ||

kaphād alpavākceṣṭāhāratvam arocako vamathur uṣṇasevā lālāsiṅghaṇakasravaṇaṃ rahaḥ kāmatā strīpriyatvaṃ nidrābībhatsatvaṃ śaucadveṣaḥ śvayathur āsye śuklastimitamalāvilākṣatā bhukte rātrau ca balavatvam iti |

lg.l: unmādaṃ dāruṇaṃ vidyāt taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet ||
pāṇḍur dīno muhur muhyan hāheti paridevate ||
snigdhāsvinnasya bastīṃś ca śirasaś ca virecanam |
snehakāle ca vātotthe tailaṃ śarīṣam iṣyate |
itham apy anuvṛttau tu tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanam añjanam |
yuñjyāt tāṃni hi śuddhasya nayanti prakṛtiṃ manaḥ ||
dvau prasthau svarasāt brahmyā ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca sādhitam |
pāṇḍukaṇḍūviṣe śoṣe mehe mohe jvare gare |
kalyāṇakām idaṃ sarpiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ puṃsavanaṣe ca ||
jaṭilā pūtanā keśī cāraṭī markaṭī vacā |
kaṭambharā vṛścikālī śāliparṇī ca tair ghṛtam |
kevalaṃ siddham ebhir vā ghṛtam uttamamātrayā |
śirīṣo madhukaṃ hiṅgu laśunas tagaraṃ vacā |
kuṣṭhaṃ ca bastamūtreṇa piṣṭaṃ syān nāvanāñjanam ||
brāhmīm aindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgujaṭāṃ muram |
rāsnāṃ viṣaghnāṃ laśunaṃ viśalyāṃ surasaṃ vacām ||
kaṭutailena cābhyaṅgo dhmāpayec cāsya tad rajaḥ ||
tiktakaṃ jīvanīyaṃ ca sarpiḥ snehaś ca miśrakaḥ ||
vidhyet sirāṃ yathoktāṃ vā tṛptaṃ medyāmiṣasya vā |
āśvāsayet suhṛt taṃ vā vākyair dharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ ||
brūyād iṣṭavināśaṃ vā darśayed adbhutāni vā |
kaśābhis tāḍayitvā vā badhvā śvabhre vinikṣipet ||
sarpeṇodghṛtadaṃṣṭreṇa dāntaiḥ siṃhair gajaiś ca tam |
tena yāti śamaṃ tasya sarvato viplutaṃ manaḥ |
yady unmāde tataḥ kuryāt bhūtanirdiṣṭam auṣadham ||
baliṃ ca dadyāt palalaṃ yāvakaṃ saktupiṇḍikām |
catuṣpathe gavāṃ tīrthe nadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca ||
nijāgantubhir unmādaiḥ satvavān na sa yujyate ||
hate sattve hṛdi vyāpte saṃjñāvāhiṣu kheṣu ca ||
tamo viśan mūḍhamatir bībhatsāḥ kurute kriyāḥ |
dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ hastau pādau ca vikṣipan ||
paśyann asanti rūpāṇi praskhalan patati kṣitau |
kālāntareṇa sa punaś caivam eva viceṣṭate |
pānaṃ tailasya madyasya tayor eva ca mehanam ||
tatra vātāt sphuratsakthiḥ pratataṃ ca muhur muhuḥ |
apasmarati saṃjñāṃ ca labhate visvaraṃ rudan ||
apasmarati pittena muhuḥ saṃjñāṃ ca vindati |
ebhir anyaiś ca vātaghnaiḥ kaṭutailaṃ prasādhitam |
prasthaṃ tadvad dravaiḥ pūrvaiḥ pañcagavyam idaṃ mahat ||
dviśataṃ piśitāt gavyāt chāgād vā tat paced apām ||
kapilānāṃ gavāṃ pittaṃ nāvanaṃ paramaṃ hitam |
pitteṣu sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasye 'bhyaṅge ca śasyate ||
bastamūtre hitaṃ nasyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vādhmāpayet bhiṣak ||
kāyasthāṃ śāradāṃ mudgam uśīraṃ jaladaṃ yavān ||
vyoṣaṃ ca bastamūtreṇa piṣṭvā vartīṃ prakalpayet |
tad eva sarpiṣā yuktaṃ dhūpanaṃ paramaṃ hitam ||
tailam abhyañjanaṃ kāryaṃ taiś ca dhūpanalepanam ||
tuṇḍaiḥ pakṣaiḥ purīṣaiś ca dhūpam asya prayojayet ||
bastamūtreṇa puṣyarkṣe tair dihyād dhūpayec ca taiḥ ||
udvartanaṃ sadā kuryāc chṛtaiś ca pariṣecanam ||
srotāṃsi cāsya śudhyanti smṛtiṃ saṃjñāṃ ca vindati ||
muktaṃ manovikāreṇa tvam itthaṃ kṛtavān iti |
na brūyād viṣayair iṣṭaiḥ kliṣṭaṃ ceto 'sya bṛṃhayet ||
vartmasandhiṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vā sarvam akṣi vā ||
rogān kuryuḥ calas tatra prāpya vartmāśrayāḥ sirāḥ |
vimardanāt syāc ca śamaḥ kṛcchronmīlaṃ vadanti tamū ||
karoty aruṅ nimeṣo 'sau vartma yat tu nimīlyate ||
vimuktasandhi niśceṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ vātahataṃ hi tat ||
pittena jāyate vartma pittotkliṣṭam uśanti tat ||
karoti kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca pittaṃ pakṣmāntam āśritam |
pakṣmaṇāṃ śatanaṃ cānu pakṣmaśātaṃ vadanti tam ||
pothakyaḥ piṭakāḥ śvetāḥ sarṣapābhā ghanāḥ kkaphāt |
granthiḥ pāṇḍur arukpākaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhinaḥ kaphāt |
kolamātraḥ sa lagaṇaḥ kiñcid alpas tato 'thavā ||
raktaṃ raktena tat srāvi cchinnaṃ cchinnaṃ ca vardhate ||
madhye vā vartmano 'nte vā kaṇḍūṣārugvatī sthirā |
doṣair vartma bahiḥ śūnaṃ yad antaḥ sūkṣmakhācitam |
yad vartmotkliṣṭam utkliṣṭam akasmān mlānatām iyāt |
bahalaṃ bahalair māṃsaiḥ savarṇaiś cīyate samaiḥ ||
kharatāntarmukhatvaṃ ca romṇām anyāni vā punaḥ ||
kaṇṭakair iva tīkṣṇāgrair ghṛṣṭaṃ tair akṣi śūyate |
kanīnake bahir vartma kaṭhino granthir unnataḥ |
sāsraiḥ syād arbudo doṣair viṣamo bāhyataś calaḥ ||
ādyo 'tra bheṣajaiḥ sādhyo dvau tatorśaś ca varjayet |
pakṣmoparodho yāpyaḥ syāc cheṣāñ chastrauṣadhair jayet ||
kuṭṭayet pakṣmāśatanaṃ chindyāt teṣv api cārbudam |

div2.p: kṛchrabodhe purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ drākṣākalkakvāthasiddhaṃ śarkarāvacūrṇitaṃ rātrau pāyayet |
vātaharadravyakalpitāṃś ca bastīn kṣīrasvinnair eraṇḍapallavaiḥ svedaṃ ca vartmanām ||
evam aśāntau mudgamātrāntaraiḥ padair agninā tvagdāhaṃ bindubhir ācaret ||
1AS.Utt.12.4 kumbhīkāpiṭakāsu vartma likhitvā saindhavenānupratisārya paṭolāmalakamadhukakvāthena secayet ghṛtena ca ||
pittaraktokliṣṭayor madhurauṣadhasiddhena sarpiṣā snigdhasya sirāṃ vidhyet |
likhite ca vartmani srutarakte yaṣṭyāhvaniryūheṇa prakṣālanam |
pakṣmaśāte romakūpān sūcyagreṇa kuṭṭAyej jalaukobhir vā grāhayet |
kākajaṅghā rohita matsyamāṃsaṃ ca kākaśoṇitabhāvitam antardhūmaṃ dagdhaṃ cūrṇāñjanaṃ kuryāt ||
pothakīr vilikhya śuṇṭhīsaindhavamāgadhikācūrṇaiḥ pratisārya prakṣālya coṣṇāmbhasā khadirasārāḍhakīśigrupatrakaṣāyeṇa secayet |
aśāmyaty agninā dāho vamanaṃ virecanaṃ ca |
utsaṅgapiṭakām añjananāmikāṃ ca bhitvā niṣpīḍya collikhitāṃ tagarailāsaindhavanepālīcūrṇena sakṣaudreṇa pratisārayet |
vedanāyāṃ tu kuṣṭhaguḍūcīkalkodakena saguḍakṣaudreṇa pariṣeko mūrdhānaṃ cāsya kaṭutailenābhyajya pāṭhākalkena pralipyārjunabilvanirguṇḍīmārkavatarkārīsairyakakārpāsīmālatīpatraniryūheṇa secayet ||
lohaśivāṭikāmṛdaḥ kapāle 'nekaśaḥ prataptāḥ stanyena nirvāpitāḥ ślakṣṇacūrṇam añjanam |
punaḥ punaś ca dhātrīṃ vamanavirecanair upapādayet ||
pakṣmoparodhe samupacitaṃ vartma lekhanenotkliṣṭaṃ raktaṃ visrāvaṇena saśophaṃ śirovirekakavalavamanair yāpayet ||
pravṛddheṣu tu romasu viśuddhadehasya sahiṣṇor bhruvodhastād dvau bhāgau pakṣmāntāt bhāgam ekaṃ samutsṛjya yavamātraṃ tadākṛti tiryak chedayed ārdravāsasā ca raktaṃ gṛhṇīyāt ||
tats tanubhūte rakte kṣaumasūtreṇa bālena vā dhanurvakrayā sūcyā mudgamātrāntaraiḥ padaiḥ sīvyet |
tato 'sya lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ badhvā tat sīvanasūtraṃ tatra sūcīpadair nātigāḍhaślatham āsajjet |
vraṇavedanāyāṃ vastrabaddhena yaṣṭīmadhukacūrṇena saṃskṛtaṃ sarpiḥ pariṣeko vaṭādikvaṣāyāś ca sakṣīrāḥ |
pañcame ṣaṣṭhe vāhani sthirībhūteṣu śastrapadeṣu sīvanasūtram avalambakāc chitvāpanayet |
tatra mṛduḥ svedaḥ snaihikaṃ ca nasyam ||
nirbhujya vā vartmadoṣopahatāṃ valīṃ vilikhya tumburuvakrakuśābhayābījānyatamakalkena pratisārayet kṣāreṇa vā dahet taprayā vā śalākayā ||
upapakṣmāṇi tu lākṣārasena lakṣayitvā sandaṃśenoddhṛtya tanusūcyagreṇāgnivarṇena romakūpān dahet |
tataś ca pūrvavat pariṣeko nāvanaṃ ca ||
bāhyālajer bhinnālikhitasya kṣāreṇāgninā vā dāho vraṇavac copacāraḥ |

lg.l: na sraṃsate calati vā vartmaivaṃ sarvatas tataḥ ||
phenena toyarāśer vā picunā pramṛjann asṛk ||
yathāsvam uktair anu ca prakṣālyoṣṇena vāriṇā ||
kuryāc caturthe nasyādīn muñced evāhni pañcame ||
vidyāt sulikhitaṃ vartma likhed bhūyo viparyaye ||
striyāḥ kṣīre chagalyā vā mṛditaṃ netrasecanam ||
niṣpīḍayed anu vidhiḥ śeṣaḥ syātatra pūrvavat ||
vāyuḥ kruddhaḥ sirāḥ prāpya jalābhaṃ jalavāhinīḥ |
tena netram arugrāgaśophaṃ syāt sa jalāsravaḥ ||
kaphāt kaphāsrave śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ sravet ||
mahān apākaḥ kaṇḍūmān upanāhaḥ sa nīrujaḥ ||
raktād raktāsrave tāmraṃ bahūṣṇaṃ cāśru saṃsravet ||
tāmrā mudgopamā bhinnā raktaṃ sravati parvaṇī ||
śastreṇa sādhayet pañca sālajīn āsravāṃs tyajet ||
śuklārmaśophas tv arujaḥ savarṇo bahalo mṛduḥ |
upekṣitaḥ sirotpāto rājīs tā eva vardhayan |
prastāry arma malaiḥ sāsraiḥ snāvarma snāvasannibham ||
śuṣkāsṛkpiṇḍavac chyāvaṃ yan māṃsaṃ bahalaṃ pṛthu ||
sādhayed auṣadhaiḥ ṣaṭkaṃ śeṣaṃ śastreṇa saptakam ||
navotthaṃ tad api dravyair armoktaṃ yat tu pañcadhā |
chitvā tvacaṃ janayati tena syāt kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam ||
doṣaiḥ sāsraiḥ sadṛk kṛṣṇaṃ nīyate śuklarūpatām |
yasya vā liṅganāśo 'ntaḥśyāvaṃ yad vā salohitam |
purāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ madhye vicchinnaṃ yac ca śukrakam |

div2.p: upanāhaṃ bhiṣak svinnaṃ vrīhimukhena bhitvā maṇḍalāgreṇa samantāl lekhayet |
pūyālase sirāṃ vidhyet tatas tam upanāhayed akṣipākoktaṃ cakṣeta |
kṛmigranthiṃ karīṣeṇa svinnaṃ bhitvā vilikhya ca kāsīsasaindhavatriphalāmākṣikaiḥ pratisārayet ||
viśeṣatas tilanālān yavanālān vā haritaśalākān ardhamāsam ajākṣīreṇa bhāvayitvā śoṣayitvā ca dāhayet |
ayam eva ca kalpaḥ phaṇijjāarjakāsphotabilvakapitthanirguṇḍyeraṇḍakumudotpalajātīkusumeṣu pṛthak kāryaḥ ||
stanyānvitaṃ vā kāsīsaṃ kṣaudradrutaṃ vā kāsīsasaindhavam arjune mātuluṅgarasena saśarkareṇāścyotanaṃ mastunā vā ||
śaṅkhanābhir mākṣikeṇa yuktā sitayā vā samudraphenakoñjanam |
sphaṭikakuṅkumaśaṅkhanābhimadhuyaṣṭikā vā kṣaudrārdrās tadvad vā rasāñjanaṃ kāsīsaṃ vā ||
arma tu pañcavidham api yat tanuraktaṃ dhūmāvilaṃ dadhinibhaṃ vā tac chukravat kāyaśirovirekalekhanāñjanair upācaret ||

athetarasmin snigdhasyāturasya peyāvilepijāṅgalarasānyatamāśitasya kṛtasvastyayanasya sukhaśayanagatasyottānadehasya kiñcid avākśirasaḥ sukhoṣṇāmbuplutatāntavasvinnanayanasya saindhavena sabījapūrakarasenāñjayitvāṅguṣṭhakena nimīlitam akṣi vimṛdgīyād ābalāsagrathitarūpotpatteḥ |
itthaṃ ca saṃroṣitākṣasya pracalite 'rmādhimāṃsake niścalaṃ paricārakaḥ śiro dhārayet ||
anyaś ca vāmadakṣiṇānyatarapārśve 'nukūlaṃ sthito dṛḍhavastragarbhābhyām aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ vartmanī nikṣipet |

atha vaidyaḥ kanīnakāt pravṛddhe 'rmaṇy apāṅgam akṣimāṇasya yatra yatra valī jāyate tatra tatrārma baḍiśena mucuṭyā vā nātyāyataṃ gṛhītvā kiñcid unnamya kṛṣṇaśuklamaṇḍalābhyāṃ sarvataḥ sūcyagreṇa mokṣayitvā kiñcid āñchet |
atha tīkṣṇena maṇḍalāgreṇa vṛddhipatreṇa vā vilikhya kanīnakaṃ copānīya kanīnakasamam eva caturbhāgaśeṣaṃ chindyāt |
yat tu jālavad arma vyāpi tad eṣiṇyā yāvatkanīnakam anusarann unmocyonnamayya pūrvavat chindyāt |
tadvad apāṅgāt pravṛddhe kanīnakam īkṣamāṇasya yāvadapāṅgaṃ copanīyāpāṅgasamam eva tathā yāvad varjayed apāṅgaṃ sirāś cetyādi |
tataḥ plotena raktaṃ viśodhya samyak chinnam avekṣya saindhavacūrṇena punaḥ punaḥ pratisārayed yavanālabhasmanā vā plotaśuddhaṃ ca punar madhunā |
tataḥ śītāmbu pariṣiktaṃ sarpiṣā sukhoṣṇena pariṣicya madhughṛtāktaṃ pūrvavat badhnīyāt |
mūrdhni pādayoś cāsmai śatadhautaghṛtaṃ śītāṃś ca pradehān dadyāt ||
dvitīye cāhni sāyaṃ prātar madhukasarpiṣā koṣṇena śiras tathāvabaddham eva cākṣi siñcet |
pañcāhaṃ coṣṇodakānupānaṃ sarpiḥ pītvā jīrṇe pathyam aśnīyāt ||
tṛtīye divase vimucya karañjabījasiddhena kṣīreṇākṣi svedayet |
lodhramadhukakiṃśukapaṭoladviharidrākoraṇḍamukulakvāthena madhumiśreṇāścyotayet saptame 'hani sarvathā muñcet ātapākāśadarśanaṃ ca pariharet ||
saśophe tu netre dhūmaḥ śirovirecanaṃ ca |
tilān sulikhitān madhukakākolīsuniṣaṇṇakapañcamūlaśarkarāśrutaśīte payasi saptāhaṃ bhāvitāṃs tenaiva payasā pīḍayet |
tat tailam ebhir evauṣadhaiḥ payasā cāṣṭaguṇena siddhaṃ nāvanād aśrurāgaghnaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ ca kṛṣṇagate tu vraṇe vraṇaśukravat kriyā |
nāgaramanaśśilālailāsaindhavaśarkarābhir ardhakarṣāṃśābhir yuktaṃ rasāñjanārdhapalaṃ kṣaudradrutam añjanād armaśeṣaśleṣmatimirapillāmayaghram ||
sirājāle sirā yās tu sthūlāḥ kaṭhināś ca tā baḍiśena gṛhītvā maṇḍalāgreṇollikhet ||
tatra vraṇaśukre trivṛnniryūheṇa trir vipakvaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayet |
duṣṭaśeṣaṃ ca piṇḍitam akṣigam asṛk jalaukobhir apaharet |
madhukakākolīmṛdvīkotpalavidārīkvāthena mañjiṣṭhākṣīrakākolīmadhukakvathitājakṣīreṇa vā saśarkareṇāścyotayet śītaiś cāsya śirovaktraṃ dihyāt siñcec ca |

vaiḍūryasphaṭikaśaṅkhamuktāvidrumarūpyāyastraputtāmrasīsālamanaśśilākukkuṭāṇḍatvaksamudraphenarasāñjanasaindhavair ajāpayaḥpiṣṭair vartayaś chyāyāśuṣkāḥ kṣaudraghṛṣṭāḥ prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca prayuktā vraṇaśukranudaḥ |
karivarāhagogardabhāśvājoṣṭradaśanāḥ śaṅkhamuktāsamudraphenāś ca marica caturthāṃśayutā jalapiṣṭā vartayaḥ kṣataśukraharāḥ |
nimnaṃ ca śukraṃ sarujam unnamayet snehapānanasyajāṅgalarasaiḥ |

tatra tarpaṇaṃ mṛgaviṣkirapiśitaṃ kāśmaryasuniṣaṇṇotpalamṛṇālaśṛṅgāṭakaśerudrākṣākṣīravidārījīvanīyāṃś ca kṣīreṇa pācayet tasmān navanītam uddhṛtya candanamadhuśarkarānantānīlotpalakalkair aṣṭaguṇena ca payasā vipakvaṃ pūrvavad yojayet ||
puṭapākaṃ ca kukkuṭam uddhṛtāntraṃ veśavārīkṛtya candanasārivāmadhukaśarkarānantānīlotpalaprapauṇḍarīka jīvanīyakalkaiḥ samadhughṛtaiḥ saṃsṛjya prāgiva kalpayet |
śirovirecanadravyavipakvaṃ vā tailaṃ marśaḥ pratimarśo vā ||
tac ca saghṛtair yavair āmalakapatraiś ca bahuśo dhūpayet |
vartir eṣā mahānīlā madhutoyaghṛṣṭā śuddhaśukraṃ nāśayati |
aśāmyati tu śukre sarvatra punaḥ punar yathoktam eva paryāyeṇa yojayet |
śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanyena ghṛṣṭaṃ saghṛtair yavaiḥ śamīpatraiś ca dhūpayet anena sandhāvāñjanenāñjayet |
tadvat suvarṇaṃ rūpyamayo va ghṛṣṭaṃ saghṛtair badarīpatrair dhūpitam añjanam |
śaṅkho nistuṣāś ca haritamudgāḥ piṣṭā vartiśrūrṇo vā madhuyukto 'ñjanaṃ śukragharṣaṇam |
masūrā nistuṣāḥ stanyapiṣṭās taruṇadarbhāṅkurā ghṛtam ājaṃ gokṣīraṃ śaraś cāyase tāmreṇa ghṛṣṭaṃ pratyañjanaṃ vedanāghnam |
yavagodhūmajīvanīyamāṃsīcūrṇena saghṛtaśarkarotkārikā svedopanāhe praṇītā vedanām apanayati śukraṃ cotsādayati |
gokharāśvoṣṭradantāḥ samudraphenaḥ śaṅkhaś cārjunakaṣāyapiṣṭā vartir lekhanī |
utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śukraṃ bālādibhir likhet puṭapākena vā |
sirāśukre tv adṛṣṭighne taruṇe vraṇaśukravat kuryāt ||
añjanaṃ cāsya prapauṇḍarīkamadhukaharidrāloharajoñjanabṛhatīkṣīrakākolīrajāpayaḥpiṣṭā yavair ghṛtayuktair āmalakīpatraiś ca paryāyeṇa dhūpitā vartiḥ ||
saptame divase kukkuṭāṇḍakapālasphaṭikacandanamanaśśilālair aśvavarāhadaśanaiś ca vartiṃ kṛtvāñjayet |
udadhikaphaśaṅkhacandanair ajāpayaḥpiṣṭair vartir madhughṛṣṭā pratyaṃjanaṃ sirāśukrajit |
anupaśame paśyati cāture kiñcid idam evāsakṛt kurvīta ||
ajakām adṛṣṭyupaghātinīṃ kṛṣṇāntajām asravisrāvaṇair madhuravirecanaiḥ kṣīrabastibhiñ ca sādhayet |

lg.l: sādhyeṣu sādhanāyālam idam eva ca śīlitam ||
ajakāṃ pārśvato vidhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam |
vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya ca |
saptarātrād vraṇe rūḍhe kṛṣṇabhāṃge same sthite ||
snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nasyaṃ ca kṣīrasarpiṣā |
yuktyā kuryād yathā nāticchedena syān nimajjanam ||
nityaṃ ca śukreṣu śṛtaṃ yathāsvaṃ pāne ca marśe ca ghṛtaṃ vidadhyāt |
na hīyate labdhabalā tathāntas tīkṣṇāñjanair dṛk pratataṃ prayuktaiḥ ||
avyaktam īkṣate rūpaṃ vyaktam apy animittataḥ ||
prāpte dvitīyaṃ paṭalam abhūtam api paśyati |
bhūtaṃ tu yatnād āsannaṃ dūre sūkṣmañ ca nekṣate ||
pārśve paśyen na pārśvasthe timirākhyoyam āmayaḥ ||
yathāvarṇañ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭir hīyeta ca kramāt ||
tatra vātena timire vyāviddham iva paśyati |
jālāni keśān maśakān naśmīṃś copokṣitetra ca |
kācībhūte dṛg aruṇā paśyaty āsyam anāsikam ||
vṛddhaḥ kāco dṛśaṃ kuryād rajo dhūmāvṛtām iva ||
dṛṅmaṇḍalaṃ viśaty antar gambhīrā dṛg asau smṛtā ||
kāce dṛk kāṃsyanīlābhā tādṛg eva ca paśyati |
dṛṣṭiḥ pittena drasvākhyā sā drasvā drasvadarśinī |
kaphena timire prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śvetañ ca paśyati |
sitābhāsā ca dṛṣṭis syāl liṅganāśe tu dṛśyate ||
raktena timire raktaṃ tamobhūtañ ca paśyati |
kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭis tādṛk ca paśyati |
timirādīn akasmāc ca taiḥ syād vyaktākulekṣaṇaḥ |
timire śeṣayor dṛṣṭau citro rāgaḥ prajāyate ||
dyotate nakulasyeva yasya dṛṅ nicitā malaiḥ |
nakulāndhaḥ sa tatrāhni citraṃ paśyati no niśi ||
sthagayanti dṛśaṃ doṣā doṣāndhaḥ sa gadoparaḥ ||
rātrāvāndhyaṃ ca jāyeta vidagdhoṣṇena sā smṛtā ||
bhṛśam amlāśanād doṣais sāsrair yā dṛṣṭir ācitā |
dhūmāvilāṃ dhūmadṛśaṃ dṛśaṃ kuryuḥ sa dhūmaraḥ ||
aupasargika ity eṣa liṅganāśaḥ atra varjayet ||
vinā kaphāl liṅganāśān gambhīrāṃ drasvajām api ||
ṣaṭkācā nakulāndhaś ca yāpyāś śeṣāṃs tu sādhayet |
timiraṃ kācatāṃ yāti kāco 'py āndhyam upekṣayā |
netrarogeṣv ato ghoraṃ timiraṃ sādhayet drutam ||
kārṣikair niśi tat pītaṃ timirāpaharaṃ param ||
tad āḍhakerdhapalikaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ prasthaṃ ghṛtāt pacet ||
ardhaprastho ghṛtāt siddhaḥ sitayā mākṣikeṇa vā |
yuktaṃ pibet tat timirī tad yuktaṃ vā varārasam ||
sauparṇaṃ labhate cakṣur ity āha bhagavān nimiḥ ||
gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ loharajo bhājane bādare sthitam |
niṣiktam agnivarṇair vā jīrṇaṃ sarpir ayoguḍaiḥ ||
hemarūpyāyasaiś cūrṇair yuktāṃ vā triphalāṃ pṛthak |
lohapātre sthitaṃ māsaṃ māṣarāśau ca bhakṣayet ||
prātar bhaktasya vā pūrvam adyāt pathyāṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
lohapātre tad ekatra sādhitaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam ||
dhmāpayitvā samāvṛttaṃ tatas tac ca niṣecayet |
kramād ajāpayaḥ sarpiḥ kṣaudrais tasmāt paladvayam ||
cūrṇo viśeṣāt timiraṃ bhāskaro bhāskaro yathā ||
nīlotpalaṃ viḍaṅgāni phenaṃ ca saritāṃ pateḥ ||
saptarātre gate bhūyaḥ piṣṭaṃ kṣīreṇa vartayet |
eṣā dṛṣṭipradā vartir api syād bhinnacakṣuṣaḥ ||
tatas tataḥ samudvṛtya māsāt sañcūrṇayet saha ||
payasā trayam etac ca cūrṇayitvā subhāvitam ||
sāmānyaṃ sādhanaṃ tv etat pratidoṣam ataḥ śṛṇu ||
vasāñjane ca vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā praśasyate |
na ced evaṃ śamaṃ yāti tatas tarpaṇam ācaret ||
sośīraiḥ sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ sakṣīraṃ tarpaṇaṃ hitam ||
ebhir evauṣadhaiś chāge pakve yakṛti tadrase |
vidhyet sirāṃ pītavato dadyāc cānu virecanam |
sadārvīkaiḥ payo yuktaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca nāvanam ||
dṛgvaimalyāya vimalā vartiḥ syāt kokilā punaḥ ||
vartiḥ pragāḍham apy āśu śukrapillāmayārma ca ||
piṣṭaiḥ kṣīridrumakvāthe ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ ca tarpaṇam ||
śigrupatrair jalasvinnaiḥ kāryaḥ svedaś ca mātrayā ||
tat srutaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ pacet kṣaudraṃ kṣiped dhane |
śīte cāsmin hitam idaṃ sarvaje timire 'ñjanam ||
vaṭapatrair anu tathā darbhaiḥ kṛṣṇamṛdānu ca |
vasābhir vidhinānena yogā yojyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||
vayombupiṣṭaiḥ saghṛtaiḥ śiro vaktraṃ ca lepayet ||
kuryāc chiraḥ parīṣekam ebhir eva payaḥśṛtaiḥ ||
sannipāte yad uditaṃ doṣodrekaṃ vibhajya tat |
na tu tatra sirāṃ vidhyet dṛksthitā yantrapīḍanāt |
kuryur āndhyaṃ malā dadyāt sravye tv asre jalaukasaḥ ||
snigdhaṃ virecayec chītaiś śītair dihyā ca sarvataḥ ||
bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ kumbhayoneḥ patraiḥ pāne ca pūjitam ||
kaṇā vā kāpile pitte māsārdhaṃ paribhāvitā |
ghṛte siddhāni jīvantyāḥ pallavāni ca bhakṣayet |
triphalām aśnato rātrau saṃskṛtaṃ pibato ghṛtam |
bhuktvā cāpibatas toyaṃ timiraṃ laghu śāmyati ||
suṣabhavyaṃ sukanyāṃ ca skandaṃ cyavanam aśvinau |
paḍ etān yaḥ smaren nityaṃ tasya cakṣur na hīyate ||
santarpaṇaṃ snigdhahimādi yojyaṃ tathāñjanaṃ hema ghṛtena ghṛṣṭam ||
cakṣūrakṣāyāṃ sarvakālaṃ manuṣyair yatnaḥ kartavyo jīvite yāvad icchā |
vyārtho loko 'yaṃ tulyarātrindivānāṃ puṃsām andhānāṃ vidyāmāne 'pi vitte ||
triphalā rudhirasrutir viśuddhir manaso nirvṛtir añjanaṃ sanasyam |
śakunāśanatā sapādapūjā ghṛtapānaṃ ca sadaiva netrarakṣā ||
ahitād aśanāt sadā nivṛttir bhṛśabhāsvaccalasūkṣmavīkṣaṇāc ca |
muninā niminopadiṣṭam etat paramaṃ rakṣaṇam īkṣaṇasya puṃsām ||
tamālatṛṭikuṅkumāny asitam utpalaṃ pippalī sitāñjanam ayorajo maricakākamācītvacaḥ |
sayaṣṭimadhukāñjanāny udadhiphenam akṣyāmayeṣv anuttamam ato 'ñjanaṃ vimalam āśu taimiryahṛt ||

div2.p: liṅganāśe nīlikā paṭalam āndhyam iti paryāyāḥ |

lg.l: asañjātā hi viṣamā dadhimastutanuś ca sā |
karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca sthagayet punaḥ ||
sā ca sampūryate śīghraṃ śleṣmalar vātapittalaiḥ |
cirāt sopadravā ca syān niṣprekṣyā tv arhati vyadham ||

div2.p: atha snigdhasya viriktasya ghṛtaiḥ sambhojitasya niśi rasena prīṇitottamāṅgasyābhuktavataḥ sajjopakaraṇasya vimale 'hani sādhake ca kṛtasvastyayanasya vihitādityavidehādhipatipraṇāmasya pūrvāhṇe nivātaprakāśadeśasthasya pratyādityam āstaraṇena labdhamārdavāyāṃ bhāmau prasāritacaraṇayugmam upaviṣṭasya kṣititalagatasamatalobhayapāṇeḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ sukhopaviṣṭena paricārakeṇa hastābhyāṃ niścalam avalambitaśirasaḥ kiścid uttānāsyasya svāṃ nāsām itarac cekṣaṇam īkṣamāṇasyāturasya jaṅghayor upariṣṭān nātyucchritāsananiviṣṭo bhiṣag dakṣiṇahastānulomam akṣi mukhabāṣpasvinnaṃ nimīlitam īṣadaṅguṣṭhodaravimṛditatārakatayā pariplutadoṣaṃ savyāṅguṣṭhapradeśinībhyām unmīlya dakṣiṇamadhyamāpradeśinyaṅguṣṭhair niṣkampaṃ gṛhītayā śalākayā kṛṣṇabhāgād bhāgadvayasyāpāṅgād ekabhāgasya ca saṅgame dṛṣṭer ārjavaṃ nātyūrdhvam adho vā netrasahajanmani sandhau vidhyet ||
evam eva dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhapradeśiny unmīlitam itareṇa kareṇaiva cāturasya dakṣiṇapārśve sthitvā ||
atha śabdavad avedanaṃ sāmbubindusruti ca samyag viddhaṃ vidyāt |
tataḥ punar āturam āśvāsya bhramayan śalākām ā dṛṣṭimadhyāt praveśayet ||
adhaś cāsyāvalikayato liṅganāśam adrutam avilambitam anusukham adhomukham apanayed ucchiṅkhayec cainam |
viśuddhadṛṣṭeś cāṅguliṃ tantūn jñātīn santatīṃś ca darśayet |
prekṣamāṇasya cānimīlitān netrāc channaiḥ śanaiḥ bhramayann eva śalākām apakarṣet |
atha vyapagatadoṣasya yathāvat paśyataḥ sukhoṣṇaghṛtāplutaṃ picum īkṣaṇasyopari datvā badhnīyāt |
tato nivātam āgāram anupraveśya saṃveśya ca sopadhāne mṛduśayane śayānaṃ dakṣiṇe 'kṣiṇi viddhe vāmena pārśvena vāme dakṣiṇenobhayasminn uttānam anukūlābhiḥ kathābhir upācaret |
tṛtīye cāhni muktvākṣi pariṣecayed eraṇḍapallavaśṛtena dugdhoṣṇena dugdhena |
jīvanīyair vā siddhena payasā haviṣā vā |
tataḥ prabhṛty evam eva pratyaham āsaptāham |
bhojayec cainaṃ vyoṣāmalakayuktaṃ dravam īṣatsnehalavaṇaṃ vāṭyam uṣṇodakadvitīyaṃ vilepīṃ vā |
tadanuvṛttau tu yaṣṭīmadhukalodhramṛdvīkāsaindhavaiḥ siddhena sasitenājapayasā nayanam āścyotayet |
ajākṣīradrutair vā payasyāsārivāpatramañjiṣṭhāyaṣṭyāhvair himaḥ sukhoṣṇo vā lepaḥ |
vyadhadoṣāḥ punar adha ūrdhvaṃ kṛṣṇāsannam apāṅgāsannaṃ sirāvyadhaś ca ||
tatrādhovyadhād atyarthaśūlāsrasrutirāgāḥ śalākāyāṃś copalepo bahalapicchilaḥ kṛṣṇāṃ valibhir upacīyate nayanaṃ sravati tad varjayet ||
dṛṣṭir api ca raktāvacchāditā kṛṣṇamaṇḍalābhā bhavati |
tatra ghṛtasekopavāsau bhruvor antare ca dāhaḥ ||
tatra stanyamadhukavipakvena sarpiṣā pariṣeko 'pāṅge vā dāhaḥ ||
sirājālavati tu netre prāk sirājālam apanayet |
tasmin yaṣṭīmadhukapoṭṭalyā ghṛtamṛditayā seko jalaukasaś ca |
atītya dṛṣṭiṃ śalākāyāḥ preraṇād raktasravaṇaṃ raktābharūpadarśanaṃ ca |
liṅganāśadoṣās tu sphuṭanam avagalanaṃ vistaraṇam utplavanaṃ līnatā ca |
tatra śalākayā spṛṣṭo liṅganāśo yaḥ sphuṭati tam eraṇḍapatrasvinnaṃ khaṇḍaśaḥ śodhayet |
avagalati tu śalākām apanīya stanyasekaṃ dadyād avapīḍanaṃ ca śuṇṭhīguḍaṃ jalaukasaś ca |
vistīryamāṇe sukhoṣṇāmbuplutena vāsasā svedo ghṛtamaṇḍaś ca pratimarśaḥ |
tadvad utplavamāne vitrāsanaṃ śītāmbhasā pratataṃ cocchiṅkhanaṃ ca ||
tathāpy anapagacchati śalākāpagamane vā punar utplavane snehapānanasyādibhir upapādya punar vidhyet |
evam api punar utplavane bhruvor antare dāhaḥ ||
yas tv apakṛṣyamāṇo dṛṣṭimaṇḍale līyate tatra kṣīreṇa nāḍīsvedaṃ dadyāt |

lg.l: kaṇṭhā ca viṣamāśrūṇi drasvā dīrghā ca durgrahā ||
ājena tāmram amunā pratanupradigdhaṃ saptāhataḥ punar idaṃ payasaiva piṣṭam ||
piṇḍāñjanaṃ hitam anātapaśuṣkam akṣṇi viddhe prasādajananaṃ balakṛc ca dṛṣṭeḥ |
śuṣkālpā dūṣikā śītam alpaṃ cāśru calā rujaḥ |
akṣy ādhmātam ivābhāti sūkṣmaiś śalyair ivācitam |
adhimantho bhavet tatra karṇayor nadanaṃ bhramaḥ |
hatādhimanthaḥ sopi syāt pramādāt tena vedanāḥ |
anekarūpā jāyante vraṇo dṛṣṭau ca dṛṣṭihā ||
tadvaj jihmaṃ bhaven netram ūnaṃ vā vātaparyaye ||
dāho dhūmāyanaṃ śophaḥ śyāvatā vartmanor bahiḥ |
adhimanthe bhaven netram syande tu kaphasambhave ||
adhimanthe bhaven netram syande tu kaphasambhave |
uktaḥ śuṣkākṣipāko 'yam saśophaḥ syāt tribhir malaiḥ ||
amloṣito 'yam ity uktā gadāḥ ṣoḍaśa sarvagāḥ ||
raktotpanno hanti tadvat trirātrān mithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva ||

div2.p: atha khalu sarvagākṣirogāṇāṃ pūrvarūpa eva śirovirekakavaladhūmopavāsān āsevetānyatra mārutodrekāt ||
śigruphalamanohvāśābaralodhraiḥ kramāc caturguṇapravṛddhaiḥ ślakṣṇarajobhiḥ sūkṣmatāntavasthair nayanam avacūrṇayet ||
śvetalodhratvacaṃ bahirvilikhitāṃ nimbapatrakalkena pradigdhāṃ puṭapāke vipakvām ardhapalonmitāṃ maricacatuṣṭayayuktāṃ ślakṣṇarajīkṛtāṃ vastrabaddhām akṣṇy avakiret |
pūrvavad vā lodhravalkalakalkam upaskṛtaṃ tanmātram eva maricadvayena manaśśilāpādenāṣṭāṃśakaiś ca yaṣṭīmadhukaśatapuṣpāñjanair yuktaṃ prakalpayet |

lg.l: āraṇyāś chagaṇarase paṭāvabaddhāḥ susvinnā nakhavituṣīkṛtāḥ kulatthāḥ |
tac cūrṇaṃ sakṛcūdavarṇanān niśīthe netrāṇāṃ vidhamati sadya eva kopam ||

div2.p: atha dāruharidrāpalam udakārdhaprasthenāṣṭāṃśaśeṣaṃ kvathitaṃ mākṣikayuktam āścyotanaṃ kurvīta ||
evaṃ cānupaśame vātābhiṣyandinam ādāv eva jāṅgalarasair bhejayitvā daśamūlarāsnātriphalākvāthena jīvanīyakalkena ca payoyutaṃ siddham itarad vā purāṇasarpiḥ pāyayet ||
aṃśumatīdvayabṛhatīkaṇṭakārikābhir vā tāntavāvabaddhābhiḥ surāmadyadhānyāmlānyatamāplutābhir ānūpamāṃsāmlakvāthena vā ||
tair eva ca māṃsair veśavārīkṛtasvinnair mahāsnehavadbhir yavacūrṇalavaṇapragāḍhām utkārikāṃ kṛtvā lalāṭagaṇḍādīn svedayet ||
rāsnādibhir eva siddhaṃ tailaṃ sarpir vā nāvanam |
saralasurabhighanadevadāruhiṃsrākarañjaphalabilvasarṣapaiś ca sabhṛṣṭatilaiḥ payasā piṣṭaiḥ sukhoṣṇair mukhālepo 'kṣivedanāstambhapraśamanaḥ ||
snehasvedaviṣyandaṃ hi vātaduṣṭam asṛṅ nirdriyamāṇaṃ nānilaprakopāya |
punaś ca snigdhāya tilvakena saṃyuktaṃ vā tilvakakaṣāyānupānaṃ sarpir virecanaṃ dadyāt |
śuddhaṃ ca vātapratiśyāyavad āsthāpayed anuvāsayec ca ||
atha tilān nistuṣān bilvaphalakvāthena bhāvayen niśi divā śoṣayed evaṃ pañcāham |
tebhyas tailaṃ gṛhītvā varāhamedoyuktaṃ bilvamūlamadhuyaṣṭikākalkena payasā ca pacet |
kāśmaryamadhukaḥ kumudotpalorupūgakuṣṭhabṛhatītamālamāṃsīsārivāprapauṇḍarīkadarbhamūlakaśerukābhiḥ payaḥ sādhayet tat tarpaṇanasyābhyaṅgeṣu vidadhyāt ||
tataḥ sneham uddhṛtya candanośīraśarkarotpalakalkena kṣīravatā pakvaṃ tarpaṇam |
puṭapākaṃ ca chāgorabhravarāhāṇām anyatamasya yakṛt pippalīsaindhavamadhughṛtopetaṃ kuryāt |
kṛṣṇatilān nistuṣān kṛtvā stanyena saptāhaṃ bhāvayec choṣayec ca |
tac cūrṇaṃ sitopalāsamaṃ kṛtvā madhukārdhabhāgena saindhavāṃśena kṛṣṇasarpaśirasaś cāntardhūmadagdhasya bhāgena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ divyodakapiṣṭāṃ guṭikāṃ kārayet ||
godhāsarpavasāyām ājamedasi ca saindhavapippalīcūrṇaṃ rasāñjanaṃ cāvapet |
eṣā māsaṃ sthitā rasakriyā dṛṣṭiprasādanī rujāharā ca ||
uddhṛtasareṇa gavyena dadhnāmlena rājataṃ bhājanam ālimpet |
nīlībhūtaṃ ca tad viśuṣkaṃ mastunā vartayaḥ kṛtāḥ chāyāviśoṣitā vātākṣirogaṃ jayanti |
saptāhāt saptāhād apanīya punas tathaiva piṣṭvā lepayet |
ayam eva ca sarvo vidhir adhimandhādiṣv api prayojyaḥ ||
viśeṣatas tv adhimanthe sahacarasphūrjātakakatakabījabilvavṛkṣādanīniryūheṇa sapayaskaṃ sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pibet ||
sarpiṣānupaśame tailaṃ vasāṃ majjānaṃ pūrvoktavidhivad vyatyāsena kuryāt |
tenaiva ca saśarkarastrīstanye cchāgadugdhe vā dāharāgaghnaḥ ||
śvetalodhraṃ madhukaṃ ca samaṃ ghṛtena bharjayitvā cūrṇayet |
tataḥ poṭṭalikāvabaddhaṃ stanyena toyena vā mṛditam āśu śūladāharāgaśophān apohati |
evam asiddhau sirāvyadhaḥ punaḥ snigdhasya ca triphalākāśmaryakvāthaśarkarātrivṛccūrṇaur virekaḥ ||
punaḥ saptāhād evaṃ saptabhiḥ saptarātrair guṭikāḥ kuryāt |
tāḥ stanyaghṛṣṭāḥ pittāmayeṣv añjanād rujam apaharanti ||
suvarṇagairikaṃ niśāṃ devyembhāsi sthitam ahaḥ śoṣayet saptāha mevam eva ca suśītena madhuravargakaṣāyeṇa bhāvayed etac cūrṇāñjanaṃ dāharāgaghnam ||
pañcāśad dārvīpalāni palikāni ca sārivāmadhukakākolīdviniśāmṛdvīkākāśmaryasuniṣaṇṇakamañjiṣṭhālodhrośīracandāni jaladroṇeṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ pacet |
parisrutaṃ ca punar ādarvīlepād avatārya ca sitopalāsamāṃśaṃ madhughṛtadvipalaṃ prakṣipet |
kāśmaryasvarasapiṣṭaḥ sārivāśarkarākalko nasyam ikṣurasapiṣṭaṃ vā yaṣṭyāhvam |
śleṣmābhiṣyandedhimanthe ca tryaham upavāsas tīkṣṇāni dhūmakavalanāvanāni |
nimbapatrakalkadigdhaṃ vā lodhram aṅgārasveditaṃ cūrṇitaṃ tāntavāvabaddham uṣṇāmbumṛditam |
nimbapaṭolajātipatralodhradvayamahauṣadhaiḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ kalpitair vastrabaddhaiḥ sakṣaudrair gauḍe sīdhau vā pariplutaiḥ sekaḥ paraṃ śleṣmaśūladhraḥ ||
tathāpi śophagharṣānubandhe yavamadanabhūrjaśamīpatraiḥ saghṛtair ghṛtenaiva vā nāḍyākṣi dhūpayet |
laghvaśitaṃ ca dvitīyehni prātar vyoṣavipakvaṃ yavakṣārāvacūrṇitaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayet |
saptasaptāhe ca gate vartayaḥ kāryāḥ maricaharidrābhayāñjanair vā jalapiṣṭā vartiḥ |
harītakī tutthaṃ ca samabhāgaṃ tutthād aṣṭāṃśena maricam eṣā vartiḥ kumārī sarvaśleṣmākṣirogaghnī ||
viḍaṅgacūrṇo vā vāruṇyā bhāvitaḥ śaṅkho bījapūrarasena madhukaṃ triphalārasena pṛthag aikadhyaṃ vā cūrṇāñjanaṃ vā piṇḍo vā pothakībahalakaphotkleśābhiṣyandān apaharati ||
saindhavavyoṣavarāviḍaṅgalodhraprapauṇḍarīkamadhukatutthakatārkṣyaśailatāmracūrṇaiḥ chāgapayaḥpiṣṭair mārkavasvarasaparipītair varttiḥ kāṇḍacitrākhyā sarvākṣirogān jayati ||
yakṛd ājam agarupriyaṅgunaladadevadāruyutaṃ payasi kvāthayet tasmin śīte khajamathite yan navanītaṃ tad ebhir evauṣadhair vipakvam |
puṭapākaś ca kuṣṭhatagaradārvīsarvagandhair ājena yakṛtā saha piṣṭair madhughṛtayutaiḥ ||
raktajaṃ punar abhiṣyandam adhimanthaṃ ca pittavad upatramet |
punaḥ punaś cāsya rudhiram avasecayet sirāvyadhena jalaukobhiś ca |
keśair jalārdraiḥ kāṃsyam udgharṣayet tān kāṃsyamaladigdhān antardhūmaṃ dagdhvā tat bhasma triphalākvāthe surasāsvarase kṣīre ca chāge pañcāhaṃ bhāvayet |
kṛṣṇasarpaṃ payasi kvāthayet tataḥ pūtaśītamathitāt sneham upoṣitāya kṛkavākave dadyāt |
kṛṣṇasarpamukham añjanasarpiṣoḥ pūrṇaṃ darbhaveṣṭitaṃ mṛdavaliptam adhomukhaṃ gomayenāgninā dagdhvā tatoñjanam ādāya patranaladanīlotpalatulyaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ paraṃ dṛkprasādajananam añjanam ||
ghṛtamaṇḍaś ca śarkarāmadhukanīlotpalair mānuṣīdugdhayuktaiḥ siddho nasyam iti |

lg.l: yataś ca raktaṃ sandūṣya tān atas tvarayā jayet ||
stanye vā chāgadugdhe vā sadyaḥkope tad añjanam ||
etayā satatam añjayitavyaṃ yaḥ suparṇasamam icchati cakṣuḥ ||

div2.p: sārivāvidārībalāmadhukotpaladrākṣāṭarūṣakajīvakacandanair jāṅgalarasakṣīropetaṃ tailaṃ sādhitaṃ nāvanāt sarvordhvajatrujān gadān vātapittottarān nihanti ||
ādarśamaṇḍale ghṛtāktakeśān ghṛṣṭvāntardhūmaṃ dahet sā maṣī ghṛtapiṣṭāyasabhājanasthitākṣipākam añjanā dapaharati ||
evam apy aśāntau madhukasiddhaḥ śatāhvācūrṇayukto ghṛtamaṇḍas tathā payo vā bastiḥ ||
tataḥ piṇḍasvinnaśirasaḥ sarṣapatailena saindhavayutena vā sarpiṣā phaṇijjakayuktena vā aṇutailena śiṃrovirekaḥ |
śaśaśiraḥkapālaṃ saindhavaṃ kāṃsye stanyaghṛṣṭaṃ sandhāvo vedanāghnaḥ |
tadvat tāmraṃ ca lohe gomūtraghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtadhūpitam ||
śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanyena ghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtābhyaktayavaśamīpatradhūpitaṃ gharṣavedanāghnam ||
madhukabṛhatītvaktāmrarajāṃsy ajākṣīrapiṣṭāni śamyāmalakapatrair ghṛtāplutair anekaśo dhūpitāni piṇḍāñjanaṃ śophavedanāghnam ||

tālīsapatrapippalīloharrajoñjanakāsīsatagarajātīmukulasaindhavair gomūtrapiṣṭais tāmram āliptaṃ saptarātraṃ sthāpayitvā punas tadvad eva piṣṭair guṭikāḥ kāryās tāḥ stanyaghṛṣṭāḥ stambhaśvayathuharṣagharṣāśrukaṇḍūghnyaḥ ||
abaddhāsthisahakāramāṃsaṃ vigatatvacaṃ samatāmracūrṇam īṣat saindhavopetaṃ gavyena dadhnā piṣṭvā tāmram ālepayet |
śuṣkaṃ śuṣkaṃ tathaiva ca piṣṭvā punar lepayet |
ittham api śophānuvṛttau punar asrāvasekaḥ śirovirekaś ca ||
pittakapharaktanicayotkliṣṭavartmapothakībisākhyakukūṇakapakṣmoparodhapūyālasaśuṣkākṣipākālpaśophāmloṣitā vātavarjyāś ca syandādhimanthā ity aṣṭādaśa dīrghakālānubandhino rogāḥ pillasaṃjñāḥ ||
sakṛl lekhanād aśuddhau punar lekhayet jalaukobhiś ca grāhayet ||
tuvarikāphalatrikarocanākvāthena madhumatā sāyaṃ prātaḥ sadā prakṣālanam añjanānte ca kaṣāyavṛkṣapallavakaṣāyeṇa ||
tair eva ca patrair uṣṇāpriyatāyām antarāntarā svedaḥ ||
tutthakapalaṃ viṃśatiś ca śvetamaricāni dhānyāmla piṣṭāni tatpalais triṃśatā tāmrapātre samāloḍitāni bahuvarṇām api pillānāṃ paramam āścyotanam ||
añjanaṃ cāsyāmradhātakīpuṣpatilaparṇīkalkena ca varttiḥ harītakyāḍhakīś cāṣṭaguṇembhāsy aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ kvāthayet punaś ca parisrāvyādarvīpralepād rasakriyeyaṃ pillākṣiropaṇī |
palāśaśākhāsvarase kvāthyamāne bṛhatyuśīrarajo dadyāt tat ghanībhūtaṃ śītam añjanam |
paripelavakāsīsaharidrādvayasarṣapapriyaṅgutagarapippalīkalkena tāmrabhājanam antarlepayitvā sauvīrakakumbhedhomukhaṃ saptāhaṃ vāsayet tato guṭikāś cūrṇaṃ vā kuryāt ||
sa eva vā tadāpluto netrāścyotanam iti |

lg.l: punaḥ punar virekaṃ ca pillarogāturo bhajet ||
śākaṃ caivaṃvidhaṃ māṃsaṃ jāṅgalaṃ dāḍimaṃ sitām ||
saindhavaṃ triphalāṃ drākṣāṃ vāri pāne ca nābhasam |
dve pādamadhye pṛthusanniveśe sire gate te bahudhā ca netre |
prāpya śrotrasirāḥ kuryāc chūlaṃ srotasi vegavat |
cirāc ca pākaḥ pakvaṃ tu lasīkām alpaśaḥ sravet |
śrotraṃ śūnyam akasmāc ca syāt sañcāravicāravat ||
sā lasīkā spṛśod yad yat tat pākam upaiti ca ||
nādān akasmād vividhān karṇanādaṃ vadanti tam ||
uccaiḥ kṛcchrāc chrutiṃ kuryāt badhiratvaṃ krameṇa ca ||
votana śoṣitaḥ śleṣmā sroto limpet tato bhavet |
rug gauravaṃ pidhānaṃ ca sa pratīnāhasaṃjñitaḥ ||
kaṇḍūśophau kaphāc chrutre sthirau tatsaṃjñayā smṛtau ||
kapho vidagdhaḥ pittena sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tathā |
khādanto jantavaḥ kuryus tīvrāṃ sa kṛmikarṇakaḥ ||
eko nīrug aneko vā garbhe māṃsāṅkuraḥ sthiraḥ |
sarvaṇaḥ sarujaḥ stabdhaḥ śvayaghuḥ sa upekṣitaḥ ||
saṅkocayati rūḍhā ca sā dhruvaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīm ||
kṛśā dṛḍhā ca tantrīvat pālī vātena tantrikā ||
karṇe śophaḥ saruk pālyām aruṇaḥ paripoṭavān ||
stabdhaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān unmantho galliraś ca saḥ ||
lihyākhyāḥ piṭakās tā hi lihyuḥ pālīm upekṣitāḥ ||
eṣām asādhyā yāpyaikā tantrikānyāṃs tu sādhayet ||

div2.p: vātaje karṇaśūle rātrau rātrau rasabhojanottaraṃ vātaharadravyasiddhaṃ sarpiḥ pibon niranno vā payonupānam ||
tato daśamūlasiddhe chāge payasi gośṛṅganihite 'gnivarṇān pāṣāṇān sandaṃśena gṛhītvāvapet |
ghṛtatailavasābhyaktāni taruṇāny aśvatthapatrāṇi puṭapāksvinnāni prapīḍya tadrasena karṇaṃ pūrayet ||
mahāpañcamūlasaralāgarudevadārvyanyatamakāṣṭham aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ tribhāge kṣaumeṇāveṣṭya tailena siktvāgre pradīpayet |
tato dahyamānād yaḥ snehaḥ patati sa sadyaḥ karṇarujam apaharati ||
madhūcchiṣṭakaiḍaryamadhuśigruphalavacāyavanaladailāguggulubhiḥ ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ kṣaumavastraṃ dhūmavarttipramāṇapariṇāhaṃ lepayet tataḥ sūtreṇāveṣṭya ḍuṇḍukanālena dhūmaṃ pātuṃ dadyāt ||
ḍuṇḍukanālam eva vānena kalkenābhyajya viśoṣayitvā dhūmaṃ vidadhyāt ||
śreyasīdevadārukākolīkuṣṭhaniculabījaiḥ kṣīrapiṣṭais tilayutaiḥ karṇaṃ bahir lepayet |
sarvadhānyasnehagokṣīrasiddhām utkārikām eraṇḍapatrāvacchādite karṇe svedārthaṃ praṇayet |
punaḥ punaś ca nāḍīsvedān piṇḍasvedāṃś ca |
parihāryāṇi ca parihared viśeṣataḥ pravātaṃ śītāmbupānaṃ śiraḥsnānaṃ ca ||
pittaje tu śūle prātaḥ śarkarāyutaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayet |
sitāmadhukakharjūramṛdvīkābhir vā sakṣīrekṣurasaṃ priyālakatailaṃ pācitam abhyaṅganasyakarṇapūraṇaiḥ śūladāhaghnam ||
madhukakuḍavaṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇenāmbhasāṣṭāvaśeṣaṃ sādhayitvā tena tailārddhakuḍavam aṣṭaguṇakṣīraṃ yaṣṭīsadhukośīrasārivākākolījīvakānantāmṛṇālamañjiṣṭhālodhracandanabisagarbhaṃ pacet |
eṣām eva ca kalkena saghṛtena karṇa parito lepayet |
evam apy anupaśame tu punar virekaḥ ||
kaphaje pippalīvipakvaṃ ghṛtam athavā sakṣaudraṃ pāyayitvā taṃ vāmayet |
rasāñjanamārkavavaijayantīśigrulaśunārdrakamūlakadalīnāṃ vā pṛthak samastānāṃ vā rasena madhunā vā rakṣoghnatailena vā |
pakveṣu karṇaśūleṣu pūyapravāhiṣu yathāsvaṃ dhūmanasyagaṇḍūṣavamanāny ācaret ||
upadigdhaṃ ca srotaḥ sāyaṃprātaḥ picuvartibhiḥ pramṛjya yavāgarumadanaiḥ saghṛtair guggulunā vā dhūpayitvā madhunā pūrayet ||
palāśadhavatiniśakakubhasarjatvakkvātha rasakriyayā svabhyaktāṃ picuvartiṃ srotasi dadyāt |
ebhir evauṣadhaiḥ sūkṣmacūrṇīkṛtaiḥ srotaso 'vakiraṇam evaṃ kledaśūlagauravāṇi śāmyanti |
eṣām eva ca kaṣāyeṇa sakṣaudreṇa kapitthasvarasena vā prakṣālanam |
śleṣmānubandhe tu prāk śleṣmāṇam apahared vamananāvanābhyāṃ tīkṣṇadhūmaiś ca ||
bādhiryaṃ ca bālavṛddhakṣīṇakāsaśoṣiṇāṃ cirotthitaṃ ca varjayet ||
tatra prāg eva purāṇasarpiṣā vā vātaharatailena vā snigdhaṃ snehenaiva virecayet |
karṇāsannaṃ jalaukobhis tato bastikarmamūrdhatailanasyadhūmān karṇapūraṇaṃ ca śīlayet ||
taruṇabilvaphalāni gomūtreṇa kvāthayet tena kvāthena sitāmadhukabījakabījakalkena ca payoyuktaṃ tailaṃ pācayet |
tat tailam uṣṇaṃ śīte bilvakvāthe prakṣipya manthayet yāvat piṇḍībhūtam uddhṛtya caitat punar anyatra bilvodake manthayet |
tataś coddhṛtyāṣṭaguṇe payasi madhukagandhacandanagarbhaṃ sādhitam āśu karṇapūraṇāt bādhiryaṃ nāśayati ||
tilān navapralūnān vastrabaddhān vahantīṣv apsu rātrim uṣitān divā śoṣayet pañcarātram |
evaṃ gate pañcarātre madhuyaṣṭikākṣīrakākolīmahāpañcamūladevadāruśatāhvājīvakakvathite payasi pañcāham evaṃ vāsayec choṣayec ca |
tatonenaiva kṣīreṇaiṣām eva ca dravyāṇāṃ cūrṇamātrayā yuktān prapīḍayet |
etan nasye karṇapūraṇe śirasi cābhyañjane praṇītam āśu śūlanādabādhiryāṇi sarvavātavikārāṃś ca pittānubandhān apohati bhagnāsthisandhānajananaṃ ca ||
atha karṇau suptāv iva bhavatas tatsamīpe yathoktāṃ sirāṃ mokṣayet |
pratīnāhe snehasvedaklinnaṃ karṇaṃ karṇaśodhanena viśodhya tailasya pūrayen mātuluṅgarasasya vā saśuktakṣaudrasaindhavasya ||
śodhyamāne vedanā raktāgamo vā yadi bhavet tato ghṛtamaṇḍena pūrayen nasyaṃ ca śīlayet |
karṇavidradhiṃ vamanapūrvaṃ vidradhivad āmaṃ pakvaṃ ca cikitset |
kṣatavidradhiṃ pittakarṇaśūlavad arśāṃsi nāsārśovad arbudāni ca ||
vidārikām āmāṃ karṇavidradhivad yathādoṣodayaṃ ca sādhayet ||
pālīśoṣe vātaśūlavan nasyam ālepaṃ svedaṃ ca kuryāt |

godhāpratudaviṣkirānūpaudakamāṃsavasāmajjānaṃ sarpis sarṣapatailaṃ ca yathālābhaṃ saṅgṛhyārkālarkabalātibalānantāvidārigandhājalaśūkamadhuravargapratīvāpaṃ vipaced ayam abhyaṅgaḥ pālyāḥ paraṃ māṃsajananaḥ ||
evam api tu yā kṣīyate pālī tasyā yad duṣṭaṃ tac chitvā vidhivat sandhāya yathoktena krameṇopacaret ||
tantrikām api caivam eva nasyābhyaṅgādibhir yāpayet ||

tilasarṣapalodhraharidrādvayair udvartitāyāḥ karṇapālyāstālīsatamālailākaṭphalarasāñjanair lepaḥ tālapatryaśvagandhārkasaindhavāvalgujabījasurasalāṅgalikābhirgodhākulīravasāyuktaṃ tailaṃ vipakvam abhyañjanam |
lehikāpiṭakāsu karṇapālīṃ bahuśo gāmayāpaṇḍasvinnām urabhrīmūtrapiṣṭaiḥ kṛmighnair ālimpet |
ebhir eva ca sarvais samaricanimbapatramadhūcchiṣṭais sarṣapatailaṃ siddhaṃ lehikāvraṇaghno 'bhyaṅgaḥ paridahane jalajābhir asṛk srāvayet |
grathitāyāṃ granthiṃ pāṭayitvā vilikhya ca kṛṣṇāsaindhavamadhubhiḥ pratisārayet |
ebhir eva ca yathāsvaṃ snehān abhyaṅgārthaṃ prakalpayet ||
atha rogato balād vā vicchinnaṃ karṇam anusandadhyāt ||
samāsatas tu pañcadaśa karṇasandhayaḥ prāyo nāmānugatasaṃsthānasthānaviśeṣatayā sambhavanti ||
tatra bāhyāyāṃ pālyāṃ dīrghāyām ābhyantaraḥ sandhiḥ |
yā tv ekaiva pālī sthūlā pṛthvī sthirā ca syāt tāṃ dvidhā pāṭayitvopari chitvā sandadhyāt ||
gaṇḍotkṛttena vā saśoṇitena sānubandhena māṃsena pālīṃ kalpayet |
yasya pālīdvayam api nāsti tasyāpy eṣa eva vidhiḥ |
athavā samānavayodoṣādeḥ sañcārya karṇapīṭhaṃ samaṃ madhya niveśya varddhayet ||
sandhānavidhiḥ punar āture grathitakeśānte bandhanam upaghārite chedyabhedyalekhyair upapannair upapādya karṇaṃ śoṇitam avekṣeta duṣṭam aduṣṭaṃ veti ||

tato vātaduṣṭe dhānyāmloṣṇodakābhyāṃ pittaduṣṭe kṣīraśītodakābhyāṃ śleṣmaduṣṭe vāruṇīsalilābhyāṃ prakṣālya punaś cāvalikhyānunnatam ahīnaviṣamaṃ sandhiṃ niveśya tato madhughṛtābhyām abhyajya picuplotayor anyatareṇāvaguṇṭhya sūtreṇa nātigāḍham aśithilaṃ ca badhvā sirāvyathoktena kapālasya vā cūrṇenāvakīryācārikam upadiśet ||
tryahāc caturahād vā salilena pariṣicya picuṃ sūtraṃ cāpanayet |
na cāśuddharaktam atipravṛttaraktaṃ kṣīṇaraktaṃ vā karṇaṃ sandadhyāt ||
tasya hi svayam api sandhir viśliṣyate ādhmāyate śyāvatām upaiti pacyate śuṣyati cirād rohati rūḍhopy ābharaṇaṃ na kṣamate |
sarvatra caivam api sopadravasandhau sandhiṃ vimucya pūrvāpacāropasthāpitasmṛtiḥ samyak sandadhīteti |

lg.l: suvarṣmāṇam arogaṃ ca śanaiḥ karṇaṃ vivarddhayet ||
thāpayet tat paraṃ karṇam ālepāt poṣayet kṛśam ||
atha kuryād vayasthasya cchinnāṃ śuddhasya nāsikām |
chindyān nāsāsamaṃ patraṃ tattulyaṃ ca kapolataḥ ||
sīvyet gaṇḍaṃ tataḥ sūcyā sīvanyā picuyuktayā ||
kapolavadhraṃ sandadhyāt sīvyen nāsāṃ ca yatnataḥ ||
chindyād rūḍhedhikaṃ māṃsaṃ nāsopāntāc ca carma tat |
sīvyet tataś ca suślakṣṇaṃ hīnaṃ saṃvardhayet punaḥ ||
kruddhā vātolbaṇā doṣā nāsāyāṃ styānatāṃ gatāḥ |
tatra vātāt pratiśyāye mukhaśoṣo bhṛśaṃ kṣavaḥ |
kīṭakā iva sarpanti manyate parito bhruvau |
duṣṭaṃ nāsāsirāḥ prāpya pratiśyāyaṃ karoty asṛk |
sarva eva pratiśyāyā duṣṭatā yānty upekṣitāḥ |
śleṣmā sucikkaṇaḥ pīto jñānaṃ ca rasagandhayoḥ ||
sa ghrāṇapākaḥ srāvas tu tatsaṃjñaḥ śleṣmasambhavaḥ ||
kaphaḥ pravṛddho nāsāyāṃ rudhvā srotāṃsy avīnasam |
aver iva sravaty asya praklinnā tena nāsikā |
ajasraṃ picchilaṃ śītaṃ pakvaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ ghanam ||
bhaved dhūmopamocchvāsā sā dīrpti dahatīva ca ||
śleṣmā ca pūtir nirgacchet pūtināsaṃ vadanti ||
nicayād abhighātād vā pūyāsṛṅ nāsikā sravet |
kaphaṃ sa śuṣkaḥ puṭatāṃ prāpnoti puṭakaṃ tu tat ||

div2.p: ghṛtāktasaktūn mallakasampuṭe kṛtvā dhūmaṃ ca pibet ||
pakve tu śirovirecanam avapīḍaṃ ca yuñjyāt ||
atha vātapratiśyāye pūrvam eva vātaharadravyavipakvaṃ sasaindhavaṃ prātaḥ sarpiḥ piben mahāṣaṭpalaṃ vā ||
daśamūlakulatthakolayavaśuṣkamūlakavyoṣalavaṇapañcakaiḥ sadadhi dhānyāmlaṃ sarpiḥ siddham āhāre pāne ca praṇītaṃ pratiśyāyayakṣmākāsaśvāsagrahaṇīgulmavibandhaghnam ||
jīrṇasnehaṃ jāṅgalarasena vyoṣadāḍimasaindhavavatā bālamūlakarasena sarvadhānyayūṣeṇa vā bhojayet |
evam aparipacyamāne punaḥ punar nāḍīsvedaṃ vātaharaṃ cāsthāpanam anuvāsanaṃ śirobastiṃ ca ||
pakve tu tailaṃ kṣavakacūrṇayuktaṃ sasaindhavaṃ sarpir vā śirovirecanam ||

pittapratiśyāye padmakośīrapaṭolasārivāvidārīśatāvarīkṣīridrumaśuṅgaśaṭhīkarkaṭākhyādurālabhānām arddhaḍhakam aṣṭaguṇembhāsi vipācya pādāvaśeṣe madhukamṛdvīkācandanaśṛṅgāṭakakaśerukaśvetapākāny akṣamātrāṇi datvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ payasā saha sādhayet |
tatra ca pakve doṣe śirovirekaṃ purāṇaghṛtena sasaindhavena ghṛtamaṇḍena vā kaṭphalānvitena kuryāt |
viśuddhasrotasaś ca jāṅgalarasena kṣīreṇa vā śītena bhojanam ||
kaphaje tu yavakṣārāvacūrṇitam uṣṇodakānupānaṃ ghṛtaṃ pāyayet |
tato vāmanīyauṣadhakvāthasiddhayā sasarpiṣkayā saindhavamāṣacūrṇapragāḍhayā peyayoṣṇāmbhasā ca vāmayet ||
tailāpluto nāgaracūrṇānuviddho mudga āhāro yathāsātmyaṃ ca rūkṣatīkṣṇoṣṇam ||
viriktaṃ ca kāle mustaharidrānāgarayavakṣārapūtīkarañjareṇukābhir ajāvigotradadhibhiś ca siddhaṃ sarpir upayojayet |
evam apy aśāntau hiṅgukṣārāmaradāruvipakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ māṃsarasānupānaṃ pibet ||

kośāmrapallavamūrvā tarkārīṅgudīphalaphaṇijjakamahāpañcamūlakaṇṭakārikāsārivorupūgahiṃsrānimbaśigruphalarakṣoghnakṛmighnadantī pūtikarañjapippalīvārtākabījāhimārakamūlatvakpatrapuṣpaphalair ajāmūtrapiṣṭair ajāśvaśakṛdrasayuktair dhūmavartiṃ kṛtvā ghṛtābhyaktāṃ pātuṃ prayacchet ||
bhṛśakṣavathau puṭake ca nimbakaṭphalakuṣṭhamaricacūrṇaiḥ kledanāya pradhamanam |
avīnase pūtināse ca guḍamaricahiṅguśivāṭikāviḍaṅgair ajāmūtrapiṣṭair nasyam |
vamitavato nirguṇḍīśigrutarkārīphaṇijjakakṣavakasurasārjakapatrasvarasena sārṣapaṃ pīlujaṃ vā tailaṃ vipācya nasyaṃ vidadhyāt ||
sthūlāni tu śastreṇa spṛṣṭvā dāhānantaraṃ śītāṃ kriyāṃ yojayet ||
arbudaṃ baḍiśena gṛhītvā maṇḍalāgreṇa mūle samaṃ chindyāt |
calapramṛṣṭaṃ ca vraṇaṃ śalākayā dahet tailena vā |
uparūḍhavraṇasya lodhrāvāpaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇadravyagomūtrayuktaṃ sārṣapaṃ kārañjaṃ vā tailaṃ nāvanam |
pittaje raktaje vārbude godantasaindhavālakāsīsakāṃsyanīlair ambupiṣṭair ālepaḥ |
śītair eva ca sādhitāni ghṛtāny abhyaṅganasyapānāni ||

lg.l: gandhājñānaṃ ca vīsarpo mūrcchā chindyād ataḥ samam ||
kruddhāḥ śleṣmolbaṇā doṣāḥ kurvanty antarmukhaṃ gadān ||
tatra khaṇḍauṣṭha ity ukto vātenauṣṭho dvidhākṛtaḥ ||
oṣṭhakope tu pavanāt stabdhāv oṣṭhau mahārujau |
grathitau ca punaḥ syātāṃ kaṇḍūlau daśanacchadau ||
dālyanta iva śūlena śītākhyo dālanaś ca saḥ ||
adhāvanān malo dante kapho vā vātaśoṣitaḥ |
pūtitvāt kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmā jāyante jāyate tataḥ |
calā mandarujo dantāḥ pūtivaktraṃ ca jāyate ||
dantayos triṣu vā śopho badarasthinibho ghanaḥ |
dantamāṃse malaiḥ sāsrair bāhyāntaḥ śvayathur guruḥ |
yasmiṃś calanti dantāś ca sa vidarbhobhighātajaḥ ||
dantamāṃsāśritān rogān yaḥ sādhyān apy upekṣate |
antas tasyāsravan doṣaḥ sūkṣmāṃ sañjanayed gatim |
tāḥ punaḥ pañca vijñeyā lakṣaṇaiḥ svair yathoditaiḥ ||
jihvā pittāt sadāhoṣā raktair māṃsāṅkuraiś citā |
tādṛg evopajihvas tu jihvāyā upari sthitaḥ ||
janayanti sthiraṃ raktaṃ nīrujaṃ tad galārbudam ||
varddhamānaḥ sa kālena muṣkaval lambate niruk ||
kṛṣṇāruṇo vā todāḍhyaḥ sa vātāt kṛṣṇarājimān |
vṛddhas tālugale śoṣaṃ kuryāc ca virasāsyatām ||
sthiraḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān śītasparśo guruḥ kaphāt |
vṛddhas tālugale lepaṃ kuryāc ca madhurāsyatām ||
dehaṃ vṛddhasya kurute gale śabdaṃ svare 'lpatā ||
tāmyan prasaktaṃ śvasiti yena sa svarahānilāt ||
vivṛṇoti ca kṛcchreṇa mukhaṃ pāko mukhasya saḥ ||
yāty ūrdhvaṃ vaktradaurgandhyaṃ kurvann ūrdhvagudas tu saḥ ||
kuryāt tat ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca vivardhate ||
mukhapāko bhavet sāsraiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvākṛtir malaiḥ ||
auṣṭhe gaṇḍe dvije mūle jihvāyāṃ tāluke gale |
vaktre sarvatra cety uktā pañcasaptatir āmayāḥ ||
ekādaśaiko daśa ca trayodaśa tathā ca ṣaṭ |
aṣṭāv aṣṭādaśāṣṭau ca kramāt teṣv anupakramāḥ ||
nāḍyoṣṭhakopau nicayād raktāt sarvaiś ca rohiṇī ||
yāpyas tu harṣo bhedaś ca śeṣān śastrauṣadhair jayet ||

div2.p: snigdhasvinnasya khaṇḍauṣṭhasyauṣṭhāntau vilikhya suśliṣṭau kṣaumasūtreṇa sīvyet |
eraṇḍapallavaiḥ kṣīrakvathitair nāḍīsvedaḥ khaṇḍauṣṭhoktaṃ nāvanaṃ śiro 'bhyaṅgaś ca ||
kaphaje jalaukobhiḥ śākādipatrair vā raktaṃ visrāvya vyoṣapāṭhāyavakṣārasvarjikākṣāraiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet |
medoje dantacchadaṃ svedayitvā vṛddhipatreṇa vipāṭya śuddhamedasam agninānupacaret |
avagāḍham ativṛddhaṃ vā kṣāreṇāgninā vā dahet haridrālodhramadhukamālatīhareṇutagarair vipakvaṃ tailaṃ ropaṇam ||
gaṇḍālajīm apakvāṃ śophavad vidagdhām upanāhya pakvāṃ vidārya vraṇavat sādhayet ||
śītadantasyoṣṇāmubusvinnasya vrīhimukhena pālīṃ likhitvā picutailena dahet |
dantaharṣe bhede ca vātaharasiddhaṃ tailam elākuṣṭhapāṭalīsvagvipakvo majjā vā gaṇḍūṣaḥ |
niyataṃ ca snaihikadhūmapāyī snigdhamadhurāhāro visrāvaṇaparaḥ syāt |
candanapadmakamadhukavidārīkaśerukanīlotpalamṛdvīkājīvakarṣabhakaśarkarāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ palena kṣīreṇa ca māṃsarasadviguṇena tailaprasthaṃ vipācayet |
adhidantakaṃ kṣāreṇālipya jarjaraṃ vijñāya kṛmidantakavidhinotpāḍya tadvad evopacaret |
dantaśarkarāṃ dantamūlāny apīḍayan dantalekhanena vilikhya kṣāratailenāvasecayet |
kṛmidantake suṣiraṃ guḍena madhūcchiṣṭena sarpiṣa vāpūrayitvā taptayā kubjaśalākayā dahet |
ebhir eva ca siddhaṃ tailaṃ gaṇḍūṣaḥ |
evam anupaśame sandaṃśayantreṇa dantam āyataṃ gṛhītvā vicālya śasreṇa pārśvebhyo mokṣayitvoddharet |
tasyoddharaṇāc choṇitātyayas tataś cendriyabhraṃśo vāta vyādhir vā ||
prakṣālitamukhaś ca samadhukacūrṇaṃ tailaṃ madhu vā gaṇḍūṣaṃ dhārayet ||
vidārīmadhukaśṛṅgāṭakakaśerukābhis tailaṃ daśaguṇe payasi siddhaṃ nasyam ||
upakuśe sukhoṣṇāmbusvinnāny utsannāni dantamāṃsāny avalikhen maṇḍalāgreṇa śākādipatrair vā |
madhuravargasiddham eva vā sarpiḥ punaḥ punaś ca rudhirāvasekaḥ ||
dantavidradhau tiktakaṭukaṣāyoṣṇaiḥ samūtraiḥ kabalo lepaś ca |
taṃ ca pākato rūkṣaśītair antarbahiḥ prayuktair vārayet |
vivṛddhan tu baḍiśena macuṭyā vā gṛhītvā maṇḍalāgreṇa chitvā tīkṣṇaiḥ pratisārayet |
vidarbhe dantamūlāni śastreṇa viśodhya kṣāraṃ prayujya ghṛtamaṇḍaṃ gaṇḍūṣe dadyāt |
dantanāḍīm eṣayitvā saṃvṛtāṃ śastreṇa vivṛtayitvā tadāśritaṃ dantam aśeṣam uddhṛtya śalākayā dahet |
pittajeṣu vighṛṣṭasrutarudhireṣu svādubhir dravyair avagharṣaṇagaṇḍūṣanāvanāni kuryāt |
adhijihvām unnamya baḍiśena gṛhītvā maṇḍalāgreṇa chidyāt |
upajihvāṃ śākapatreṇāṅguliśastreṇa vā visrāvya yavakṣāreṇa pratisārayet ||
vṛddhāyāṃ tūrvārubījanibham asirātatam agram upari jivhāyā niviṣṭaṃ baḍiśena mucuṭyā vā vastraveṣṭitābhyāṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhapradeśinībhyāṃ gṛhītvā maṇḍalāgreṇa nātyagre nātimūle chindyāt |
tālusaṅghāte puppuṭe kacchape ca nave vidhir ayam |
tālupāke tv apakvasya śvaythoḥ kāsīsarasāñjanakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam |
tāluśoṣe madhukapippalīnāgarasiddhaṃ sarpir uttaraṃ bhaktikaṃ satṛṣṇaḥ pibet |
kaṇṭharogeṣu tu jvarādyanupadruteṣu kaṭunīkṣṇair nasyāvagharṣaṇagaṇḍūṣādayaḥ sirāvyadho rasāñjanendrayavadārvīnimbakvāthaḥ pānam |
atha vātarohiṇīkām antarbahiḥ svinnām aṅguliśastrakeṇa madhulavaṇagarbheṇa vā nakhena visrāvya tīkṣṇaiḥ pratisārayet |
pittajām apy evaṃ visrāvya pataṅgaśarkarālodhrapriyaṅgubhiḥ pratisārayet |
galagaṇḍam anilajaṃ svedayitvā visrāvayet rūḍhavraṇa ca tilapriyālalaṭvāmūlakaśaṇātasībījair upanāhayet |
ślaiṣmikepy ayam eva vidhiḥ tīkṣṇatarāś ca svedapralepādayaḥ |
tathānupaśame pācayitvā vraṇavad ubhāv apy upācaret |
pūrvoktāḥ pralepāḥ prātaḥ prātaś cāsanādisārarajo gomūtreṇa pibet |
evam apy aśāntau śastreṇa vidārya medo viśodhya sīvyet |
mukhapākeṣu sāmānyatas triphalākvātho madhumān anye ca tiktakaṭukakaṣāyā mukhadhāvanāḥ |
dāruharidrārdhatulāṃ viṃśatiguṇe 'mbhasi śrapayitvā taṃ kvāthaṃ sagairikam ādarvīpralepāt sādhitaṃ kṣaudrayuktaṃ ghṛtabhājane nidadhyāt |
yavakṣārabhāgāḥ sapta suvarṇagairikāt bhāgadvayaṃ mūrvākaṭukātiviṣāmalakānām eko bhāgas tat sarvaṃ kutalakṣārodakapiṣṭaṃ guṭikāḥ kṛtvā khāden niṣṭhīvec ca ||
khadirasāratulām arimedatulādvayaṃ ca toyavahe 'ṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ kvāthayed avatāritaṃ parisrutaṃ ca punar āghanībhāvāt |

ghanībhūte śīte ca kārṣikāṇi ślakṣṇīkṛtāni prakṣipec candanapadmakośīravālakamañjiṣṭhādhātakīmustaprapauṇḍarīkamadhukatriphalācāturjātakalākṣānaladatārkṣyaśailalodhradvirajanīsamaṅgāpāṭhākaṭphalaileyapataṅgāgarugairikāñjanāni |
tā guṭikā vadanasthāḥ sarvān mukharogān jayanti |
eṣām eva ca kalkakaṣāyais tailaṃ sādhitaṃ kavale niyuñjyāt ||
tatra vātaje mukhapāke daśamūlakākolīrāsnāmadhukasārivākvāthena kuṣṭhakalkena ca siddhaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣaś ca |
madhuradravyasiddhaṃ payaḥ pānaṃ kavalo nasyaṃ ca |
sthirāsu tu piṭakāsu prāk śākādipatreṇa lekhanam |
devadārupāṭhātiviṣādantīndrayavakaṭukāgomūtreṇa kalkatāḥ kvathitā vā pītāḥ sarvakaphāmayān nighnanti ||
rocanākāsīsasaurāṣṭrikārasāñjanāni mocaraso madhu caikato vipakvaṃ lohabhājanasthaṃ kalkaṃ viśuṣkaṃ curṇīkṛtaṃ madhunā vraṇalepaṃ kuryāt ||
atha sarvasaram arbudam acirotthitam avṛddhaṃ maṇḍalāgreṇa chitvā muṣkakabhasmanā madhumiśreṇa pratisārayet svarjikāśuṇṭhīcūrṇena vā |
tataḥ svarjikāhiṅgugṛhadhūmamanaśśilailāśuṇṭhīviḍaṅgatejovatībhir guṭikāḥ kṛtvā madhudrutā mukhapariśodhanārthaṃ dadyāt |
śītādopakuśoktaṃ ca kuryāt nasyadhūmakavalāṃś ca śīlayet |

lg.l: tasmāt teṣām asakṛd rudhiraṃ visrāvayed duṣṭam ||
prāyaḥ śastaṃ teṣāṃ kapharaktaharaṃ tathā karma ||
yūṣā bhakṣyāś ca hitā yac cānyac chleṣmanāśāya ||
kaṇṭhāmayāś cikitsitam ato drutaṃ teṣu kurvīta ||
nistudyete bhṛśaṃ śaṅkhau ghāṭā sambhidyate tathā |
ghūrṇatīva śiraḥ sarvaṃ sandhibhya iva mucyate ||
pakṣāt kupyati māsād vā svayam evopaśāmyati |
ativṛddhas tu nayanaṃ śravaṇaṃ vā vināśayet ||
svedo 'kṣidahanaṃ mūrcchā niśi śītaiś ca mārdavam ||
kopite sannipāte ca jāyante mūrdhni jantavaḥ ||
śirasas te pibanto 'sraṃ ghorāḥ kurvanti vedanāḥ |
trirātrāj jīvitaṃ hanti sidhyaty apy āśu sādhitaḥ ||
śirasy eva ca vakṣyante kapāle vyādhayo nava ||
savarṇo nīrujaḥ śophas taṃ vidyād upaśīrṣakam ||
susūkṣmaṃ kaphavātābhyāṃ vidyād dāraṇakaṃ tu tat ||
tad indraluptaṃ rujjā ca prāhuś cāceti cāpare ||
khalater api janmaivaṃ śātanaṃ tatra tu kramāt ||
kaphāt ghanatvagvarṇāṃś ca yathāsvaṃ nirdiśet tvaci ||
doṣaiḥ sarvākṛtiḥ sarvair asādhyā sā nakhaprabhā |
dagdhāgnineva nirlomā sadāhā yā ca jāyate ||
keśān sadoṣaḥ pacati pālitaṃ sambhavaty ataḥ ||
tad vātāt sphuṭitaṃ śyāvaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣaṃ jvalatprabham |
pittāt sadāhaṃ pītābhaṃ kaphāt snigdhaṃ vivṛddhimat ||
sthūlaṃ suśuklaṃ sarves tu vidyād vyāmiśralakṣaṇam |

div2.p: nivātasthaṃ ca naktam abhyaktaśirasaṃ sarpiḥ payonupānaṃ tailaṃ vā pāyayet |
ānūpapiśitaveśavāreṇa yavatilamudgamāṣakulatthakuṣṭhadāruharidrātasīsaindhavar vā mahāsnehavatīm utkārikāṃ datvā śiro veṣṭayet |
tataḥ pratyūṣe daśamūlasiddhena payasā kavoṣṇena pariṣekaṃ kuryāt |
tatsiddhaiś ca pāyasaiḥ piṇḍasvedaṃ lepaṃ vā ||
kūrmamahiṣavarāhakukkuṭaśallakīnāṃ vasā sasaindhavā nasyaṃ śiraḥkarṇapūraṇaṃ ca |
tathaiva ca pañcamūlabalāsārivādvayakvāthe madhukajīvakarṣabhakapunarnavagarbhaṃ sapayaḥ sarpistailaṃ caikato vipakvam ||
evam asiddhau vātaje śleṣmaje ca yathokto dāhaḥ ||
sūryāvarte tv ayam eva vidhiḥ viśeṣatas tu sirāmokṣaḥ ||
pittaje raktaje ca śirobhitāpe snigdhasya sirāṃ vidhyet |
suśītaiḥ śatadhautaghṛtānvitaiḥ śiro vaktraṃ siñcet pradihyāc ca ||
candanasārivāmadhukadūrvotpalaprapauṇḍarīkamañjiṣṭhāvidārībhiḥ sakṣīraṃ sarpir vipācitaṃ nāvanaṃ śirobastiś ca |
jīvanīyavipakvāt payaso navanītam uddhṛtya jīvanīyakvāthakalkābhyāṃ pācitaṃ pānabhojananasyābhyaṅgabastiṣu praṇītaṃ pittaraktajān sarvān vikārān sādhayati |
jīvanīyagarbhaṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇe payasi siddham ājyaṃ vā ||
viḍaṅgatailaṃ nasyaṃ sārṣapaṃ vā tad eva vā vyoṣasiddham madhūkasārakalko vā madhuyutas tvag vā meṣaśṛṅgyā iṅgudasya vā |
tair eva ca pakvaṃ tailaṃ marśaḥ pratimarśo vā ||
upasnigdhasvinnasya devadārupūtīkakaṭabhīsarṣapaviḍaṅgatilakaṇṭakavipakvena tailena śiraḥ karṇau cābhyajya svedayet ||
tato rudhiragandhamadena prāvisṛtāḥ saptacchadasya tvagrasena puṣparasena vānantaraniṣiktena kṛmayaḥ patanti ||
saraladevadārukaṭphalasarṣapāpāmārgakṣavakakaṭukālābusurasabījapippalītaṇḍulacūrṇaṃs tatpakvaṃ vā tailaṃ sadyaḥ kṛmīn nirasyati |
gomāṃsena chāgamāṃsena vā vasāpiṣṭena yavāgūṃ kṛtvā śiro vilepayet |

evaṃ kṛmiṣv apagateṣu tejovatīpūtīkabimbīsurasanaktamālaviḍaṅgaharītakīsarṣapārkakaravīramūlamālatīdevadārukṣavakamustaphaṇijjakapippalīśatapuṣpāmadhūkaśaṇanimbasārakalkair ajāmūtrayutaiḥ sārṣapaṃ tailam aiṅgudaṃ pailukaṃ vā vipakvaṃ yuktyā nāvanam ||
jantubhiḥ pītaśoṇite hi śirasi punar asrāvasekād akāṇḍe mṛtyuḥ syāt |
upaśīrṣake janmottarakālajāte navotthite vātavyādhivihitān snehān pānanāvanābhyañjaneṣu yojayet |
abhyaktaṃ ca svedayitvopanāhayed yathā vidāho na bhavati |
vraṇībhūtāsu piṭakāsu nimbaniśāmadhukadhātrīphalair vipakvaṃ tailaṃ śodhanaropaṇam ||
ebhir eva ca siddhaṃ sarpir nasyam |
rūḍhaṃ tu vidradhau yadi tvak supteva bhavati tato vāmayet |
arūṃṣikāsu jalaukopahṛtaśoṇitaṃ śiraḥ kṣurāmṛṣṭaṃ vā nimbodakena pariṣicyāśvaśakṛdrasena lavaṇapragāḍhena lepayet |
abhyaṅgasnānanāvanāni ca śīlayet priyālabījamadhukakuṣṭhamāṣasarṣapaiḥ sakṣaudrair lepaḥ |
indralupte yathāsannaṃ sirāṃ vidhvā tutthakāsīsamanaśśilāmaricair lepayet |
avagāḍhapadaṃ vā sūcīkūrcakena pracchāya bhūyo bhūyaḥ pradihyāt kapotapaṅkāmūlena lāṅgīlakāmūlena vā mahiṣīkṣīrapiṣṭena ||
ghṛṣṭaliptam eraṇḍapatrāvacchāditaṃ rātrim uṣitaṃ māhiṣanavanītena limpet |
khalatāv indraluptoktaḥ kramo yathādoṣaṃ ca saṃśuddhiḥ ||

triphalārjunasairyakatvakpuṣpakṛṣṇapiṇḍītakaphalamūlanīlotpalalohacūrṇakāsīsajamvūmārkavamañjiṣṭhāmeṣaśṛṅgīkhadirarajaḥ sakardamam arditoktāṇutailayuktam asana sārasamudgake nyastaṃ kardame māsaṃ nikhātaṃ sthitam uddhṛtaṃ sūcīkūrcapracchitāyāḥ khalater lepaḥ paraṃ romasañjananaḥ ||

jambūdvayatvakpatramadhukabhṛṅgarajāstriphalāśleṣmātakamañjiṣṭhāphaṇijjakabalādrākṣājaśṛṅgīcapalātiviṣākaṭphalakalkena kṣīrivṛkṣakkāthena ca tilatailam akṣatailaṃ caikadhyaṃ sādhayet tan nasye 'bhyaṅge ca niyuñjyāt |
akālapaliteṣu vātādīn avekṣya snehasvedasaṃśo dhanāsravisrāvaṇāni kuryāt |
asanapuṣpapatramaye pātre bahir āmalakīkalkapradigdhe nihitam akṣatailaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ vrīhipalle sthitam abhyaṅgān nāvanāc ca palitaṃ jayati |
kapikacchūphalamūlagarbham akṣatailaṃ siddham ayaḥpātre pūrvavat sthitaṃ samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||

rāmataraṇīmūlapaladvayaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukapalaṃ sārivārdhapalam ekatra jarjarīkṛtam akṣatailapalair daśabhir āplutaṃ lohabhājane daśāhaṃ divasakarakaraprataptaṃ nāvanāt palitaghnaṃ sarvendriyadārḍhyāvahaṃ ca ||
tataḥ pūrvoktarasadrutena padminīkardamapraliptaptadhautān keśān kapālaṃ ca lepayet |

lg.l: khalatau palite valyāṃ harillomni ca śodhitam |
siddhaṃ taile bṛhatyādyair jīvanīyaiś ca nāvanam ||
siddhaś śailāsane bhāṇḍe śṛṅge meṣasya vā sthitaḥ |
kuryād ādityapākaṃ vā yāvac chuṣko bhaved rasaḥ |
ebhir eva ca bhaiṣajyaiḥ śiro vaktraṃ ca lepayet ||
bṛṃhayed rañjayec caitat keśān mūrdhnaḥ pralepanāt ||
tenāliptaṃ śiraḥ śuddham asnigdham uṣitaṃ niśām |
pātre sthāpitam āyase kṣititale māsaṃ nidhāyoddhṛtaṃ |
pālityaṃ khalatiṃ ca darpaṇanibhāṃ hanty etad abhyañjanāt ||
bījaiḥ śleṣmātakasya vyapagamitatuṣaiḥ kāñjikaślakṣṇapiṣṭair yal liptāl lohadaṇḍād dinakarakiraṇais tāpitāt pracyaveta |
tat tailaṃ keśakārṣṇyaṃ janayati paramaṃ nāvanābhyañjanābhyāṃ mūrddhaghrāṇākṣidantaśravaṇagalarujaṃ hanti niśśeṣataś ca ||
jale paktvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ tasmin kṣīrasamaṃ pacet |
caturguṇena payasā kalkair ebhiś ca kārṣikaiḥ ||
mahāmādhūram ity etan māyūrād adhikaṃ guṇaiḥ ||
ākhubhiḥ kukkuṭair haṃsaiḥ śaśaiś ceti prakalpayet ||
sarvendriyāṇi yenāsmin prāṇā yena ca saṃśritāḥ |

div2.p: yāvad āyur vṛṇīte vivṛṇoti vā śarīram iti vraṇaḥ ||
sa ca dvividho nija āgantuś ca |
so 'pi punar vātādibhir adhiṣṭhito nijatāṃ labhate ||
punaś ca dvedhā vraṇo duṣṭaḥ śuddhaś ca |
