tasya sāmānyaliṅgam atisaṃvṛtavivṛtatvam atimṛdukaṭhinatātyutsādāvasādāv atiśītoṣṇabhāvotiraktakṛṣṇapāṇḍutā pūtīmāṃsasirāsnāyupraticchannatvaṃ putīpūyāsrāvaḥ sotsaṅgitā dāhapākakaṇḍūśvayathuvedanāsaṃrambhapiṭakopadravopadrutatvaṃ dīrghakālānubandhaś ca ||

tatra śyāvo 'ruṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bhasmāsthikapotagalānyatamavarṇo vā dadhimastukṣārāmbumāṃsadhāvanapulākodakanibhālpasrāvo rūkṣaś caṭacaṭāyamānaśīlo 'kasmād vividhaśūlasphuraṇāyāmatodabhedasvāpabahulo nirmāṃsaś ca vātāt ||
kṣiprajaḥ pītanīlaharitakṛṣṇakapilapiṅgalo gomūtrabhasmaśaṅkhakiṃśukodakamārdvīkatailābhoṣṇabhūrikledo dāhoṣājvararāgapākāvadaraṇadhūmāyanānvitaḥ kṣārokṣitakṣatopamavedanaḥ piṭakājuṣṭaś ca pittāt ||

snigdhaḥ sthūlauṣṭhāḥ pāṇḍuś caṇḍakaṇḍūr navanītavasāmajjapiṣṭatilanārikelāmbusadṛśaśvetaśītabahalapicchilakledaḥ svāpastambhastaimityagauravopadehayuktaḥ sirāsnāyujālāvatato mandavedanaḥ kaṭhinaś ca kaphāt ||
yathāsvaliṅgasaṅkare dvābhyāṃ tribhiḥ sarvaiś ca duṣṭaṃ vidyāt |
ghṛtamaṇḍābho matsyadhāvanagandhir mudur viṃsarpī kṛṣṇapūyaś ca pittaraktābhyām ||
tatra yathoktaduṣṭaliṅgābhāvāt saṃrambharahitatvaṃ jihvāvarṇatā ślakṣṇatvaṃ nīrujatvaṃ nirāsrāvatā śyāvaparyantatvaṃ samauṣṭhamadhyatā kiñcidunnatamadhyatā vā ||
tatra ghṛṣṭāsu vā tvakṣu sphoṭeṣu vā bhinneṣu salilaprakāśo bhavaty āsrāvaḥ |
sirāgatas tu sadyaś chinnāsu sirāsu raktātipravṛttiḥ |
sa ca tanur vicchinnaḥ picchilo 'valambī śyāvaś ca ||
snāvagataḥ snighdo ghanaḥ siṅghāṇakapratimaḥ saraktaś ca ||
sandhigataḥ samantāt prapīḍyamāno na pravartate tathākuñcanaprasāraṇonnamananamanapravāhaṇeṣu sravati picchilo 'valambī sa phenarudhironmiśraś ca ||
asthi tv abhihataṃ sphuṭitaṃ bhinnaṃ doṣāvadāritaṃ vā doṣabhakṣitatvān nissāraṃ bhavati |
āsrāvaś cātra majjamiśraḥ sarudhiraḥ snigdhaś ca ||
tathāyataś caturasro vṛttas tripuṭakaś ca vraṇaḥ |
svayaṃ vidīrṇāś ca doṣajā na tu vaidyakṛtāḥ ||
vayasthānāṃ dṛḍhānāṃ prāṇavatāṃ satvavatām ātmavatāṃ dīptāgnīnāṃ ca vraṇāḥ sucikitsyāḥ ||
tatra vayasthānāṃ pratyagradhātutvād āśu vraṇasaṃroho bhavati |
dṛḍhānāṃ sthirabahumāṃsatvāc chastram avacāryamāṇaṃ sirāsnāyvādīn na prāpnoti |
satvavatāṃ dāruṇair api kriyāviśeṣair na vyathā bhavati |
ātmavatāṃ suniyamitāhāravihārādibhir upadeśair nānyathā bhavati dīptāgnīnām praklinnadehatvāt |
prakṛtitaś cāpraklediśarīrāṇāṃ tadvadhayoś ca deśakālayor āsrāvadairgandhyābhāvād āśu viśuddhena māṃsenānupadravam āpūraṇam ||
eta eva guṇā vṛddhakṛśālpaprāṇabhīrumandāgniprakledidehadeśakāleṣu viparītāḥ śiṣyopanayanīyaṃ cekṣeta ||

lg.l: vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyanti yeṣāṃ ca syur vraṇe vraṇāḥ ||

div2.p: asādhyāḥ punar māṃsapiṇḍavad udgatāḥ prasekinontaḥpūyā vedanāvantaś ca pāyuvad udvṛttauṣṭhāḥ kaṭhinā gośṛṅgavad unnatamāṃsaprarohā duṣṭaśoṇitāsrāviṇas tanupicchilāsrāvasrāviṇo vā madhyonnatāḥ samavasannasuṣiraparyantāḥ śaṇatūlavat snāyujālavanto durdarśanā medomajjavasāmastuluṅgasrāviṇaś ca doṣasamutthāḥ pītāsitāmūtrapurīṣavātavāhinaś ca koṣṭhasthāḥ raktaśayajāś ca kṣārodakasamāsrāvāḥ pakvāśayajāś ca pulākodakam iva sravantaḥ kṣīṇamāṃsānāṃ ca sarvatogatayas tv aṇumukhamāṃsabudbudavantaḥ saśabdavātavāhinaś ca śiraḥkaṭhasthā visarpajvarapipāsārocakāvipākakāsaśvāsātīsāracchardiyuktāḥ bhinno ca śiraḥkapāle yatra mastuluṅgadarśanaṃ tridoṣaliṅgaprādubhāvo vā syād iti |

lg.l: vraṇo mithyopacārāc ca naiva sādhyopi sidhyati ||
sthirāś ca piṭakāvanto rohatīti tam ādiśet ||

div2.p: vraṇasya śophāvasthāyāṃ śastrakarmavidhau śvayathucikitsite ca sādhanam uddiṣṭam |

lg.l: sadyaḥ śāmyanti śuddhānāṃ vraṇāḥ śophāś ca dehinām ||

div2.p: na tu śuṣyad upekṣitavyam anyatra pīḍayitavyāt |
yas tu śītas tanur muhur muhuś ca prayujyate sa pradeho raktapittatvacāṃ prasādakṛt |
pralepas tūṣṇaḥ śīto vā bahalaś ca tathā vātaśleṣmapraśamanas tasyopayogaḥ kṣatākṣateṣu |
yas tu kṣateṣūpayujyate sa bhūyaḥ kalka iti saṃjñāṃ labhate ||
snaihiko nirvāpaṇaḥ prasādanaḥ stambhano vilāyanaḥ pācanaḥ pīḍanaḥ śodhano ropaṇaḥ savarṇīkaraṇaś ca ||
tatra vāte snigdhadravyaiḥ snehāḍhyaiḥ snehenaiva vā snaihikaḥ |
pitte pittaprāye ca śophe viṣāgnikṣāradagdhe ca śītair nirvāpaṇaḥ |
sa eva ca punar asrātipravṛttau stambhanasaṃjñaḥ |
śleṣmamedobhūyiṣṭhe śītaiś cāvidagdhe piṣṭalabdhe grathite vā rūkṣair vilāyanaḥ |
sūkṣmāsye vraṇe rūkṣaiḥ picchilaiś ca pīḍanaḥ |
mā bhūc chaityapihitasyoṣmaṇo bahir anissaraṇād vikāraparivṛddhiḥ ||

lg.l: tamasā pihito hy ūṣmā romakūpair anāvṛtaiḥ |
lepāṃd vinaiva niryāti rātrau nālepayed ataḥ ||
na ca paryuṣitaṃ lepaṃ dadyāt bhūyas tam eva vā |
vyamlaḥ paryuṣito hi syāt bhraṣṭavīryas tathetaraḥ ||
śophe vraṇe ca kaṭhine vivarṇe vedanānvite |
saviṣe ca viśeṣeṇa jalajādyair hared asṛk |
pradehaḥ sasitas tadvat saktavo madhukaṃ ghṛtam ||
srutāsṛjāṃ ca śophānāṃ vraṇānām api cedṛśām ||

div2.p: sadāhaśūlāṃs tu tilān atasīś ca bhṛṣṭvā payasi nirvāpya tenaiva kṣīreṇa piṣṭvā pralepayet ||
daśamūlasiddhena sukhoṣṇenāmbhasā payasā vā ghṛtatailābhyāṃ vā pariṣekaḥ śophe vraṇe vā dāhaśūlaghnaḥ ||

lg.l: abhyajya svedayitvā ca veṇunāḍyā tataḥ śanaiḥ |
vilīyate sa cen naivaṃ tatas tam upanāhayet |

div2.p: śigruśaṇaphalacitrakakiṇvaniṣpāvasarṣapatilātasīsaktukolagṛhadhūmair amlapiṣṭaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ snigdhaiḥ salavaṇair utkārikāṃ kṛtvā tathā pralipyairaṇḍapatreṇāvacchādya badhnīyāt ||
pākābhimukhe ca śophe yatheṣṭam āturaṃ bhojayet pācanārthaṃ pākavedanāśastrakarmasahanārthaṃ ca ||
pakve tu yathoktena vidhinā śastram avacārayet |

lg.l: na mukhe cainam ālimpet tathā doṣaḥ prasicyate ||
vraṇān aśuddhān vijñāya śodhanair obhir ācaret ||

div2.p: tatra gambhīreṣu pittātmakeṣu dāhapākavatsu vraṇeṣv atīkṣṇoṣṇair ebhiḥ kārpāsīphalamiśraṃ kalkaṃ ghṛtaṃ ca sādhayitvā yojayet ||
utsannamāṃseṣv alpasrāveṣu rūkṣeṣu tilāpāmārgabṛhatīdvayayuktaiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ pūtīkādibhiḥ sarṣapaṃ tailaṃ ca ||
pracalapradeśajeṣu kledabahuleṣūtsannasthiramāṃseṣu tailena cāsidhyatsu rasakriyāṃ kuryāt |
yathoktānāṃ saṃśodhanauṣadhānāṃ kaṣāye punaḥ parisrāvyādhiśṛte manaśśilātuvarīkāsīsacūrṇapratīvāpasiddhāṃ ca mātuluṅgarasopetāṃ sakṣaudrāṃ yuñjīta ||
aśvagandhāpāmārgatālapatrīsuvarcalābalātibalānantādhātakīkusumasamaṅgābhiḥ padmakādivargeṇa nyagrodhādinā ca kalkastathā sarpīṃṣy abhyañjanārthe ||

lg.l: saruje kaṭhine stabdhe rūkṣe śuṣyati ca vraṇe ||

div2.p: tadvidhair eva ca siddhaṃ tailam abhyaṅgaḥ |
tathā sarpirmajjavasābhir dhūpāḥ susnigdhasaktusaindhavakiṇvatilapiṣṭakṛsarapāyasānūpaveśavārāḥ kiñcid uṣṇā bahuśaḥ pralepāḥ ||

lg.l: chinnāś ca sandhayo yeṣāṃ yathoktair ye ca sādhanaiḥ |
sādhyamānā na sidhyanti śodhyāḥ syus te 'gnikarmaṇā ||

div2.p: asanādinyagrodhādivargadhavasallakīkuṭajatvaco mañjiṣṭhāsamaṅgāmṛtāśvagandhāragvadhadhātakīpuṣpāṇi padmakādiś ca prakṣālanādiṣu saptasu prayojyā iti |

lg.l: dvāv ādyau pañcamūlākhyau gaṇo yaś cānilāpahaḥ |
te vraṇe vātike yojyāḥ kaṣāyādiṣu sapptasu ||
nyagrodhapadmakādyau tu paitte vargaś ca pittajit |
āragvadhādiḥ śleṣmaghraḥ kaphe miśrās tu miśraje ||
ghanaḥ koṣṇaś ca paitte tu payaḥpiṣṭo ghṛtānvitaḥ ||
rūkṣastailena vā snigdho bahalaḥ kaphaje hitaḥ ||
pūrvābhyāṃ sarpiṣā cāsau yuktaḥ syād āśu ropaṇaḥ |
tilavad yavakalkaṃ tu kecid icchanti tadvidaḥ ||
sādhitaṃ tailamājyaṃ vā tadvat kampillakena vā |
dūrvārasena vā dārvyās tvacā vā vraṇaropaṇam ||
kalkair ebhir ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ vā ropaṇaṃ param ||
tvacam āśu nigṛhṇanti tvakcūrṇaiś cūrṇitā vraṇāḥ ||
pralepaḥ kurute kārṣṇyaṃ sadya eva navatvaci ||
taineva piṣṭvā suślakṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇam ālepayed vraṇam ||
kāsīsaṃ madhukaṃ lepo vraṇe kṛṣṇe madhudrutaḥ ||
kāsīsaṃ prapunāṭañ ca māsaṃ nyastaṃ tato bhuvi |
bhuñjāno jāṅgalair māṃsaiḥ śīghraṃ vraṇam apohati ||

div2.p: vividhābhighātajanitais tu subahvākṛtibhir api sadyovraṇair adhiṣṭhitam aṅgaṃ samāsāt trividhaṃ bhavati chinnaṃ viddhaṃ piccitaṃ ca |
trividham api caitat tvagādikṣaṇanāt kṣatam ity ucyate ||
tasyaivāvagāḍhasya viśeṣeṇa viśālam āyataṃ ca vicchinnam |
etad eva caturvidhaṃ koṣṭhe pṛthumukhair vā praharaṇaiḥ kuntādibhir viddham anubhinnaṃ bhinnottuṇḍitam atibhinnaṃ nirbhinnam iti ca saṃjñāṃ labhate ||
yat punaḥ prahāreṇa pīḍanena vā gātram asthiyuktam asṛṅmajjaplutaṃ pṛthutām āpadyate tat piccitam |

lg.l: madhusarpiḥ prayuñjīta pittaghnīś ca himāḥ kriyāḥ ||
sasaṃrambheṣu kartavyam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca śodhanam |
tayor hy alpaṃ sravaty asraṃ pākas tenāśu jāyate ||
saptāhāt gatavege tu pūrvoktaṃ vidhim ācret ||
prāyaḥ sāmānyakarmedaṃ vakṣyate tu pṛthak pṛthak ||
ghṛṣṭe rujaṃ nigṛhyāśu varṇe cūrṇāni nikṣipet |
asādhyaṃ sphuṭitaṃ netram udīrṇaṃ lambate tu yat |
tato 'sya secane nasye tarpaṇe ca hitaṃ haviḥ ||
samaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt syūtva śīghraṃ nirantaram ||
ghātaṃ śākhāsu tiryaksthaṃ gātre samyaṅ niveśite |
pādau vilambimuṣkasya prokṣya netre ca vāriṇā |
kāryaś ca goṣphaṇābandhaḥ kaṭyām āveśya paṭṭakam |
snehasekaṃ na kurvīta tena klidyati hi vraṇaḥ ||
chinnāṃ niśśeṣataḥ śākhāṃ dagdhvā teilena yuktitaḥ |
kāryaḥ śalyāhṛte viddhe kramo bhaṅgāt tu piccite ||
vraṇe rohati caikeikaṃ śanair apanayet kacam ||
lohagandhitvam āsye 'sya syāt gātre ca vigandhitā ||
nābher adhastāc chītatvaṃ khebhyo raktasya cāgamaḥ ||
kliṣṭāntraḥ saṃśaye dehī chinnāntro naiva jīvati ||
abhinnam āntraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ praveśyaṃ na tv atonyathā |
uluṅgilaśirograstaṃ tad apy eke vadanti tu ||
prakṣālya payasā digdhaṃ tṛṇa śoṇita pāṃsubhiḥ |
aṅgulyā pramṛśet kaṇṭhaṃ jalenodvejayec ca tam |
tathāntrāṇi viśanty antas tatkālaṃ pīḍayeta ca ||
vraṇasaukṣmyāt bahutvād vā koṣṭham āntram anāviśat |
yathāsthānasthite samyag āntre sīvyed anu vraṇam |
sthānād apetam ādatte jīvitaṃ gupitaṃ ca tat ||
avakīrya kaṣāyair vā ślakṣṇair mūle tataḥ samam ||
dṛḍhaṃ ca badhvā sūtreṇa varddhayet kuśalo bhiṣak |
syād atyathā rugāṭopo mṛtyur vā chidyamānayā ||
sakṣaudre ca vraṇe baddhe sujīrṇenne ghṛtaṃ pibet |
haridre padmabījāni sośīraṃ madhukaṃ ca taiḥ |
tathāpi na tritvam atikramante cayādibhedair iva mārutādyāḥ ||

div2.p: tat tu bhaṅgajātaṃ dvyadhiṣṭhānaṃ sandhāvasandhau ca |
tatra sandhimuktaṃ ṣaḍvidham utpiṣṭaṃ viśliṣṭam avakṣiptam atikṣiptaṃ tiryakkṣiptaṃ vivartitam iti ||
tasya sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ prasāraṇākuñcana vivartanākṣepaṇāśaktir ugrarujatā sparśāsahiṣṇutvaṃ ca ||
athotpiṣṭe svasthāna eva sandhāv ubhayataḥ śopho vedanā viśeṣataś ca rātrau bhavati |
atikṣipte dvayor api sandhyasthnor atikrāntatā vedanā ca |
tiryak kṣipte tv ekasyāsthnaḥ pārśvato gamanam atyarthaṃ vedanā ca |
karkaṭakaṃ vakraṃ sthuṭitaṃ vellitam asthicchallikāśvakarṇaṃ piccitaṃ dāritaṃ cūrṇitam atipātitaṃ śeṣitaṃ majjānugatam iti ||
śvayathubāhulyaṃ spandanaṃ vivartanaṃ sparśāsahiṣṇutā ca pīḍyamāne śabdaḥ srastāṅgatā vedanātipravṛttiḥ sarvāsu cāvasthāsu śarma na labhata iti sādhāraṇam asandhibhagnarūpam ||
vaiśeṣikaṃ tu saṃvyūḍham ubhayatosthimadhyabhagnaṃ granthir ivonnataṃ karkaṭakānukāri karkaṭakam ||
kṣataṃ bhagnam unnamyamānaṃ majñi majjati majjānugatam ||
eṣām antyāni pañca kṛcchrasādhyāni kṛśātibālavṛddhāsahānām atyāśināṃ vātātmakānāṃ kuṣṭhinām upadravavatāṃ ca ||
asādhyaṃ tu bhinnaṃ kaṭīkapālaṃ sandhimuktaṃ vā jaghanam utpiṣṭaṃ kūrparo vivartitas tathā lalāṭaṃ cūrṇitam asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca śiraḥ śaṃkhapṛṣṭhastanāntarabhaṅgaṃ ceti |

lg.l: sandhīn śarīragān sarvāṃś calān apy acalān api |
ity etaiḥ sthāpanopāyaiḥ samyak saṃsthāpya niścalam |
śithilena hi hi bandhena sandhisthairyaṃ na jāyate |
tryahāt tryahād ṛtau gharme saptāhan mokṣayed dhime |
prātaḥ prātaḥ pibet bhagnaḥ śītalaṃ lākṣayāyutam ||
dhātakīlodhracūrṇair vā rohanty āśu tathā vraṇāḥ ||
iti bhaṅga upakrāntaḥ sthiradhātor ṛtau hime |
māsaiḥ sthairyaṃ bhavet sandher yathoktaṃ bhajatāṃ vidhim ||
sāmānyaṃ sādhanam idaṃ viśeṣo vakṣyate tv ataḥ ||
bhagnān sandhivimuktāṃś ca kṛtvā pūrvavad aṅgulīn |
āñcched ūrdhvam adhastāc ca kaṭībhagnaṃ cikitsakaḥ ||
anumṛjya tataḥ sandhiṃ pīḍayet kūrparāc cyutam |
maṇibandhe ca jānau ca gulphe caiṣaḥ kriyākramaḥ ||
ubhe tale same kṛtvā talabhagnasya dohinaḥ |
prāg gomayamayaṃ piṇḍaṃ dhārayen mṛnmayaṃ tataḥ |
sannam unnāmayet svinnam akṣakaṃ musalena tu |
grīvāyāṃ tu vivṛttāyāṃ praviṣṭāyām adhopi vā |
samaṃ kuśābhir badhnīyād uttānaṃ śāyayec ca tam ||
ghṛtaṃ vātaghnamadhuraiḥ siddhaṃ nasyaṃ ca pūjitam ||
trīn māsān mṛdu bhuñjīta rasānnaṃ kaṭhināṃs tyajet ||
nāsāṃ vivṛttāṃ sannaṃ vā ṛjūkṛtya śalākayā |
bhagnaṃ karṇaṃ ghṛtābhyaktaṃ nyasya bandhena yojayet |
yantraṇārthaṃ tataḥ kīlāḥ pañca kāryā nibandhanāḥ |
jaṅgo rupārśvayor dvau dvau tala ekaś ca kīlakaḥ ||
śroṇyāṃ vā pṛṣṭvaṃśe vā vakṣasy akṣakayos tathā |
ūktair vidhānair budhyā ca yathāsvaṃ sthānamānayet ||
āpothya bhagnaṃ yamayet tatto bhagnavad ācaret ||
bhaṅgo naiti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak |
catuṣprayogān balyāṃś ca bastikarma ca śīlayet ||
glānir na śasyate tasya sandhiviśleṣakṛd dhi sā ||
lavaṇaṃ kaṭukaṃ kṣāram amlaṃ maithunam ātapam |
vyāyāmaṃ ca na seveta bhagno rūkṣaṃ ca bheṣajam ||
samyag yamitam apy asthi durnyāsād durnibandhanāt |
saṅkṣobhād api yat gacched vikriyāṃ tad vivarjayet |
ādito yac ca durjātam asthi sandhir athāpi vā ||
avedanaṃ ca ceṣṭāyāṃ bhagnaṃ vidyāt susādhitam ||
kṛṣṇās tilān virajaso dṛḍhavastrabaddhān saptakṣapā bahati vāriṇi vāsayet |
saṃśoṣayed anudinaṃ pratisārya cainān kṣīre tathaiva madhukakvathite ca toye ||
punar api pītapayaskāṃs tān pūrvavad eva śoṣitān bāḍham |
sakṣīraśuklaiḥ sapayaḥ sadūrvaistailaṃ pacet tan naladādibiś ca ||
gandhatailam idam uttamam asthisthairyakṛj jayati cāśu vikārān |
pāyor vraṇo 'ntar bāhyo vā duṣṭāsṛṅmāṃsago bhavet |
vātaṃ mūtraṃ śakṛc chukraṃ khaiḥ sūkṣmair vahati kramāt ||
doṣaiḥ pṛthagyutaiḥ sarvair āgantuḥ so 'ṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
bhagandarakarīṃ vidyāt piṭakāṃ na tv atonyathā ||
sthirā snigdhā mahāmūlā pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍūmatī kaphāt ||
vraṇatāṃ yānti tāḥ pakvāḥ pramādāt tatra vātajā |
jāyate paritas tatra prākāraṃ parikheva ca ||
sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinnosya kledayan mūlam arśasaḥ |
gatayo dārayanty asmin rugvegair dāruṇair gudam ||
kṣiṇoti tiryaṅ nirgacchann unmārgaṃ ca tato gatiḥ ||
syāt tadā pūyadīrṇāyāṃ māṃsakothena tatra ca |
jāyante kṛmayas te 'sya khādantaḥ parito gudam |
vidārayanti na cirād unmārgī kṣatajaś ca saḥ ||
pravāhiṇīṃ balīṃ prāptaṃ sevanīṃ vā samāśritam ||

div2.p: atha bhagandāriṇam apakvapiṭakaṃ pākaparihārātham apatarpaṇena vraṇapratiṣedhavihitena śīghram upācaret ||

pakvapiṭakaṃ punar upasnigdham arkādikvāthaśuddhaṃ svabhyaktam avagāhasvinnaṃ bhuktavantaṃ śayanastham arśasam iva yantrayitvā parācīnam arvācīnaṃ bahirmukham antarmukhaṃ vā bhagandaraṃ samyag īkṣeta ||
tato 'ntarmukhe yantraṃ prāṇidhāya pravāhaṇapraviṣṭaṃ bhagandaram abhisamīkṣya samyag eṣitvā śastreṇa pāṭayet |
bahirmukhe tv eṣāṇīṃ praṇidhāya sāśayam uddharec chastreṇānantaraṃ co 'bhayam apy agninā kṣāreṇa copatrameta uṣṭhagrīvaṃ tu kṣāreṇaiva ||
tato nirvāpaṇaśodhanaropaṇair yathākālaṃ sādhayod iti sāmānyo vidhiḥ ||
atha śataponake nāḍīr ekāntaritāḥ pāṭayitvā ropayet |
anyathā tu vivṛttaṃ vraṇaṃ gudasrotovidāraṇād vātaviṇmūtrāṇy anuprapadyante |
tatra snehābhyaktagudasya snigdhān piṇḍanāḍīkumbhīsvedān prayuñjītāvagāhaṃ vā |
svinnaṃ ca vaca hiṃgukuṣṭhavyoṣalavaṇapañcakājamodān sarpirmadyākāñjikakulatthayūṣānyatamena pāyayet |
evam eva ca parikṣepiṇyām api kramāt gatiṃ nāḍīvihitena kṣārasūtreṇa dviśas triśo vāvadārayet |
sakṛd eva hy avadaraṇād asādhyatā yāpyatā vā syāt ||
arśobhagandare pūrvam arśāṃsi cchindyāt tato gatyanusāreṇa bhagandaram ||
sālvalapradigdhaṃ vā vraṇaṃ kadalīmṛgalopākājinakauśeyāvikair upanāhayed iti |

lg.l: ārdrakasya rase siddhaṃ kalke vā pāyayet ghṛtam |
guggulupañcapalaṃ palikāṃśā māgadhikā triphalā ca pṛthak syāt |
bhagandareṣv eṣa viśeṣa uktaḥ śeṣāṇi tu vyañjanasādhanāni |
vraṇādhikārāt pariśīlanāc ca samyag viditvaupayikaṃ vidadhyāt ||
sāhasāni vividhāni ca ruḍhe vatsaraṃ parihared adhikaṃ vā ||
vṛttonnataṃ yaṃ śvayathuṃ sa granthir grathanāt smṛtaḥ ||
mṛdur bastir ivānaddho vibhinnocchaṃ sravaty asṛk ||
pittāt sadāhapītābho rakto vā pacyate drutam |
bhinno 'sram uṣṇaṃ sravati śleṣmaṇā nīrujo ghanaḥ |
śītaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān pakvaḥ pūyaṃ sravet ghanam ||
doṣair duṣṭesṛji granthir bhaven mūrcchatsu jantuṣu |
māṃsalair dūṣitaṃ māṃsam āhārair granthim āvahet |
pravṛddhaṃ sedurair medo nītaṃ māṃse 'tha vā tvaci |
vāyunā kurute granthiṃ bhṛśaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛduṃ calam ||
sa vibhinno ghanaṃ medas tāmrāsitasitaṃ sravet ||
vāyuḥ sampīḍya saṅkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca |
nisphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāhvayaḥ ||
kuryāt sadāhaḥ kaṇḍūmān vraṇagranthir ayaṃ smṛtaḥ ||
sādhyā doṣāsramedojā na tu sthūlakharāś calāḥ |
tallakṣaṇaṃ ca medontaiḥ ṣoḍhā doṣādibhis tu tat |
prāyo medaḥkaphāḍhyatvāt sthiratvāc ca na pacyate ||
māṃsāṅkkuraiś citaṃ yāti vṛddhiṃ cāśu sravet tataḥ |
teṣv asṛṅmāṃsaje varjye catvāry anyāni sādhayet ||
śanaiḥ śanair ghanaṃ śophaṃ ślīpadaṃ taṃ pracakṣate ||
rūkṣaṃ ca vātāt pittāt tu pītaṃ dāhajvarānvitam ||
kaphāt gurusnigdham aruk citaṃ māṃsāṅkurair bṛhat ||
ślīpadaṃ jāyate tac ca deśe 'nūpe bhṛśaṃ bhramāt ||
avagāḍhān bahūn gaṇḍāṃś cirapākāṃś ca kurvate |
gatiḥ sā dūragamanān nāḍī nāḍīva saṃsruteḥ |
sā doṣaiḥ pṛthag ekasthaiḥ śalyahetuś ca pañcamī ||
antaḥsthitaṃ śalyam anāhṛtaṃ tu karoti nāḍīṃ vahate ca sāsya |
phenānuviddhaṃ tanum alpam uṣṇaṃ sāsra ca pūyaṃ sarujaṃ ca nityam ||

div2.p: sarveṣv eva pūrvaṃ granthiṣu bṛhatīdvayapippalīcitrakasādhitena purāṇasapiṃṣā snigdhaṃ vāmayet |
kṛtasaṃsarjanasya cottamāṅgagateṣu granthiṣu lākṣādvirajanīviḍaṅgaśuṇṭhīpūtīdārubhiḥ śiro virecayet dhūmakavalagaṇḍūṣāṃś ca sa seveta ||
bahuśaḥ svinnam aṅguṣṭhena veṇuparvaṇā vā śanaiś śanaiḥ punaḥ punar vimardayet |
atha vātaje granthau daśamūlasiddhaṃ mahāsnehaṃ pibet |
pakvaṃ tu vidārya nirastapūyaṃ kṛtvārkādivargāmbhasā prakṣālya tilakalkena sacitrakasaindhavenālepayet |
pittaje raktaje ca jalaukaso nyagrodhādiḥ pradehapariṣekayoḥ padmakādiḥ pāne ca drākṣekṣurasayuktā harītakī virekaḥ |
kaphajam antaś śuddhasya bhṛśaṃ svedayed vimlāpayec ca kākādanīvikaṅkatakākanandikāragvadheṅgudamūlamadanaphalabhārṅgīkarañjair lepayet |
evam apy apacyamānam amarmasthaṃ vidārya sthitaraktaṃ niśśeṣam agninā dahet |
tato nirvāpitaṃ kṣārakṣaudraguḍottarair ālepais saṃśuddhaṃ ropayet ||
medojepy ayam eva vidhiḥ api ca medogranthiṃ tilakalkadigdhaṃ dviguṇapaṭāntaritaṃ taptena phālena darvyā vā jatuliptayā bahuśaḥ pramṛjyāt |
supakvaṃ vā vipāṭya mūtraprakṣālitaṃ kṣaudrasaindhavasuvarcikākāñcanakṣīrīharitālamiśraiḥ kṣīrabakapragāḍhais tilair ālepayet ||
sirāgranthau tv abhinave tailaṃ sāhacaraṃ pibet upanāhañ ca vātaharair bastikarma ca kuryāt |
nāḍīsvedañ ca kuryāt bahuśaś cātra śṛṅgeṇa rudhiram avasecayet |
pittotthe mṛdūn svedopanāhān kāyavirecanañ ca prayojayet |
śleṣmaje tūrdhvam adhaś ca hṛtadoṣasya srutaraktasya ca vamanavirecanadravyaiḥ pralepaḥ |
lepāsvādalobhena ca nilīyamānā makṣikāḥ sa mupekṣeta |
tadvimuktaiḥ kṛmibhir itarair vā bhakṣyamāṇañ ca |
punaḥ punaś ca kṣārān kālāpekṣayā yojayet |
medorbudaṃ svinnabhinnaṃ suśodhitamedaskam upaśāntaraktasrāvaṃ sadyaḥ ssīvyet |
sarvārbudāni ca yadṛcchayā paryāgatāni supariśodhitāni ropayet |

lg.l: saśeṣadoṣāṇi tu yorbudāni karoti tasyāśu punar bhavanti |
tasmād aśeṣoddharaṇaṃ praśastaṃ kṣāreṇa śastreṇa tathāgninā vā ||

div2.p: ślīpade tu vātātmake snehasvedopanāhān prayujya gulphasyopariṣṭād vyaṅgule sirāṃ vidhyet |
paittike mṛdur upanāho gulphasyādhaḥ sirāmokṣaḥ pittārbudoktāḥ snehavirekāḥ pittaghnāś ca lepāḥ ||
sakṣaudrāṃś ca kaphaghnān kaṣāyān abhīkṣṇaṃ pāyayet |
sakṣaudrāṃś ca kaphaghnān kaṣāyān abhīkṣṇaṃ pāyayet |
ādārīkākajaṃghākākādanīśukanāsākadambapuṣpabṛhatīdvayam antardhūmaṃ dagdhvā gomūtreṇa bahuśaḥ parisrāvayet tatas tat kṣārodakaṃ kṣārakalpena vipacet |
dadyāc cātra paratīvāpaṃ phalguśukākhyā madanaphalarasaṃ eṣa kṣāro madhurāhāreṇābhyastaḥ ślīpadāpacīgrahaṇīdoṣārocakān sarvaviṣāṇi ca niyacchati ||
ālepayec ca nāgarāmṛtāviḍaṅgakaṭukābhadradārubhir mūtrapiṣṭair ūrustambhoktaiś ca bheṣajair yavānnaṃ ca śīlayet ||
madhūkasāraṃ vā śigruphalāni vā nimbakarañjakaravīrasiddhaṃ vā tailaṃ vairecanikañ ca dhūmaṃ pibet ||
guñjākaravīrārkaśyāmāsiddhārthakair ajāmūtrayuktair daśakṛtvā vipakvaṃ tailaṃ lavaṇapañcakapippalīmaricacūrṇo petam abhyaṅgāt sarvāvasthān apacyarśorbudanāḍīduṣṭavraṇavalmīkān apohati ||
taṇḍūlīyakasvarasena vā sanirguṇḍīrasaṃ vā tailaṃ sādhitam abhyaṅgapānanāvanair gaṇḍamālānāḍīvraṇakuṣṭhānilārtiharam ||

kākādanīnalikāgnijihvāvandhyākarkoṭakīviśālāpāṭhottuṇḍakījīmūtakośātakībījair arddhapalāṃśaur viṣakarṣayuktair nirguṇḍīsvarasopetaṃ karañjatailaprasthaṃ vipacet tat pūrvavad eva prayuktaṃ param apacīghnam ||
amarmajāṃś ca gaṇḍān apakvān evodbhṛtyāgninā kṣāreṇa vā prasādhayet |
māṃsīsarjarasakārpāsīphalasaindhavaiḥ stanyapiṣṭais tailaṃ vipakvam abhyaṅgo vraṇakāṭhinyaghnaḥ sarpājagaravase tailaṃ ca samaṃ trayam etad apacīghnam |
evam anupaśame vāmapārśvajāyāṃ dakṣiṇajaṅghāpṛṣṭhamadhyād indrabaster adhaḥ ūrdhvaṃ vā śastreṇākṣimātraṃ vraṇaṃ kṛtvā matsyāṇḍajālanibhaṃ medopanīyāgninā dahet |
nāḍīm anilajām upanāhya pūyagatim asyā niśśeṣam oṣitvāvadārayec chastreṇa |
vidāritāṃ ca tilanāgadantīmañjiṣṭhākalkena pūrayet śyāmātribhaṇḍītriphalātilvakaharidrādvayakalkakṣīrasaṃskṛtaṃ sarpir abhyaṅgaḥ |
śleṣmajāṃ saktukulatthakiṇvasarṣapair upanāhya vidārya ca nimbatilasaindhavasaurāṣṭrīnikumbhair lepayet |
śalyahetukīṃ pāṭayitvā sarvaśaḥ śalyaṃ viśodhya madhughṛtatilakalkapraticchannāṃ badhnīyāt |
bilvakapitthakumbhīkharjūravanaspatiśalāṭukvāthe priyaṅgumustorupūgaśakunasugandhikālodhramocarasadhātakīpuṣpagarbhaṃ tailaṃ prasādhitaṃ sādhayaty āśu śalyajāṃ gatim ||
aśastrakṛtyāṃ nāḍyāṃ bhedinyaiṣiṇyānte samudbhidya kṣārāktaṃ sūtraṃ praveśayet |
tadasannidhāne tv itarayaiṣiṇyā ca tenānavadīrṇāyāṃ tadanusyūtam anyad anyat kṣārasūtraṃ sañcārayed ā gatibhedād ayam anapāyo 'bhyupāyaḥ |
sūkṣmānekagatiṣu bhagandareṣu mūleṣu ca chidriteṣu granthyarbudeṣv iti |

lg.l: yā vartyo yāni tailāni tan nāḍīṣv api kalpayet ||
varāhaviṣṭhā ca maṣī sudagdhā tailaplutā sarvagatīr nihanti ||
dhattūrakaṃ madanakodravajañ ca bījaṃ kośātakī śukanasā mṛgabhojanī ca |
aṅkolajañ ca kusumaṃ parikalpya cūrṇaṃ lākṣodakāpahṛtadoṣagatau prayojyam ||
miśritaṃ tena tailañ ca paramaṃ gatiropaṇam |
sauvaheṣu ca kandeṣu kṛtaṃ vajrāhvayeṣu ca ||
tailaṃ samārkavarasair vinihanti kṛcchrāṃ nāḍīṃ kaphānilakṛtām apacīvraṇāṃś ca ||
avaktrā tv alajī vṛttāḥ stokapūyā ghanonnatāḥ |
granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍ vā kacchapī kacchaponnatāḥ ||
śālūkābhā panasikā śophas tv alparujaḥ sthiraḥ |
medogarbhā mukhe śūnāṃ tābhyāṃ ca mukhadūṣikā ||
te padmakaṇṭakā jñeyā yaiḥ padmam iva kaṇṭakaiḥ |
sā viddhā vātapittābhyāṃ tābhyām eva ca gardabhī ||
pittāt bhavanti piṭakāḥ sūkṣmā lājopamā ghanāḥ |
tādṛśī mahatī tv ekā gandhanāmeti kīrtitā ||
pañcāhāt saptarātrād vā pakṣād vā hanti jīvitam ||
durgandhiṃ rudhiraṃ klinnaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tato malāḥ |
tāṃ srāvayanti nicitāṃ vidyāt tac charkarārbudam ||
valmīkavac chanair granthis tadvat bahvaṇubhir mukhaiḥ |
granthiḥ kīlavad utsanno jāyate kadaraṃ tu tat ||
kṛcchrān nirgacchati vyādhir ayaṃ ruddhagudo mataḥ ||
cippam akṣatarogaṃ ca vidyād upanakhaṃ ca tam ||
kṛṣṇobhighātād rūkṣaś ca kharaś ca kunakho nakhaḥ |
kṛṣṇān avedanāṃs tvaksthān maṣāṃs tān eva connatān |
tathāvidho jatumaṇiḥ sarujo lohitas tu saḥ ||
kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ vā sahajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ lāñchanaṃ samam ||
śyāmalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vyaṅgaṃ vaktrād anyatra nīlikā ||
paruṣaṃ paruṣasparśaṃ vyaṅgaṃ śyāvaṃ ca mārutāt |
pittāt tāmrāntam ānīlaṃ śvetāntaṃ kaṇḍumat kaphāt |
tatas tvag jāyate pāṇḍuḥ krameṇa ca vicetanā |
utkoṭhaḥ sonubandhas tu koṭha ity abhidhīyate ||
proktāḥ ṣaḍtriṃśad ity ete kṣudrarogā vibhāgaśaḥ |
yān vijñāya na sammuhyec cikitsāyāṃ cikitsakaḥ ||

div2.p: padmakaṇṭakeṣu nimbāmbuvāntaṃ nimbodakasiddhaṃ sarpiḥ sakṣaudraṃ pāyayet |
vivṛtādīn jālagardabhāntan irivellikāṃ ca pittavisarpavac cikitset ||
agnirohiṇīm api pratyākhyāya pittavisarpad upācaret pakvāṃ tu madhuravargasiddhena sarpiṣāṃ ropayet ||
pakvāṃ śastreṇa vidārya nimbatilapaṭolakalkena pracchādya badhnīyāt |
balmīkaṃ hastasya pādasya copariṣṭān marmaṇi vā jātaṃ pravṛddham atibahucchidrāvṛtaṃ saśophaṃ ca varjayet ||
atonyathā tu prāk kṛtaśuddheḥ śoṇitam apaharet |
pakve tu sarvāṃ gatiṃ duṣṭamāṃsāni ca śastreṇa samyak śodhayitvāgninā kṣāreṇa vā dahet ||
suśuddhe tu vraṇe bhallātakamanaśśilālailākālānusāryagarucandanair nimbatailaṃ ropaṇārthaṃ śrapayet ||
vyapagatoṣmāṇañ cainam uṣṇāmbunā pariṣicya yathāyogaṃ śastreṇa parikartyāpanayet ||
tato rasāñjanarocanānepālītejohvākalkair amlapiṣṭaiḥ śodhayitvā kāleyakāgaruharidrārasāñjanasiddhena tailena ropayet |
tilakālakān maṣāṃś ca sūryakāntenāgninā vā dahet kṣāreṇa vā |
tenaiva vā bālāmalakaṃ gomūtreṇa saptāhaṃ sthitam |

tatrāpi vātajeṣu devadārudurālabhābṛhatīmañjiṣṭhāmūrvāpāmārgatrāyantītrāyamāṇāśukanasābalāvidārīyavabadarakulatthabilvotpalaśatāvarīdarbhamūlakvāthe śṛṅgīviḍaṅgagarbhaṃ ghṛtaṃ vipakvam adhobhaktaṃ pānam abhyaṅgaṃ nāvanaṃ ca sāyaṃ yojayet ||
paitteṣu balāmadhukamāgadhikākṣīrakākolīsvaguptāphalakākamācītugāhvābhiḥ sapayaḥ sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pūrvavat prayojayet ||
kṛtarudhirāvasecanān etāṃś ca vyaṅgān madhukasārivābalācandanalodhrotpalair ghṛtayuktair ālepayet |
śītamadhuram annapānaṃ pravātam ahaḥsvapnaṃ saumanasyaṃ ca seveta ||
kaphajeṣu daśamūladevadāruharītakīśvadaṃṣṭrāmalakīkvāthe mustakuṣṭhaharidrāmaratarukalkais tadvat sādhitaṃ sarpis tadvad evopayuñjīta ||
utkoṭhe pittaśleṣmaharo vidhiḥ sakṣāralavaṇaṃ ca tailam abhyaṅgaḥ |

lg.l: tṛṣitaṃ spṛśatas toyaṃ ratānteṣv api naiva vā ||
doṣā duṣṭā gatā guhyaṃ trayoviṃśatim āmayān ||
pṛthagdoṣaiḥ sarudhiraiḥ samastaiś ca atra mārutāt |
śleṣmaṇā kaṭhinaḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmāñ chītalo guruḥ ||
piṭakā bahavo dīrghā dīryante madhyataś ca yāḥ |
nivartate sarugdāhaṃ kvacit pākaṃ ca gacchati ||
piṇḍitaṃ kuthitaṃ carma tat pralambam adhomaṇeḥ |
vātena dūṣitaṃ carma maṇau saktaṃ ruṇaddhi cet |
maṇer vikāsarodhaś ca sa niruddhamaṇir gadaḥ ||
chidrair aṇumukhair yat tu mehanaṃ sarvataś citam |
sarāgair asitaiḥ sphoṭair vedanābhiś ca pīḍitam |
mehanaṃ vedanā cogrā taṃ vidyād asṛgarbudam ||
māṃsārbudaṃ prāg uditaṃ vidradhiś ca tridoṣajaḥ ||
caturo varjayed oṣāṃ śeṣān śīghram upācaret ||
bhraṃśaṃ vaṅkṣaṇapārśvādau vyathāṃ gulmaṃ krameṇa ca |
tāṃs tāṃś ca svān gadān vyāpad vātikī nāma sā smṛtā ||
rujan sandūṣayed yoniṃ vāyuḥ prākcaraṇeti saḥ ||
sā phenilaṃ rajaḥ kṛcchrād udāvṛttaṃ vimuñcati ||
iyaṃ vyāpad udāvṛttā jātaghnī tu yadānilaḥ |
jātaṃ jātaṃ sutaṃ hanti raukṣyād duṣṭārtavodbhavam ||
striyā yonim aṇudvārāṃ kuryāt sūcimukhīti sā ||
ṣaḍahāt saptarātrād vā śukraṃ garbhāśayān marut |
vamet saruṅ nīrujo vā yasyāṃ sā vāminī matā ||
duṣṭo viṣṭabhya yonyāsyaṃ garbhakoṣṭhaṃ ca mārutaḥ |
kurute vivṛtāṃ srastāṃ vātikīm iva duḥkhitām |
upaplutā smṛtā yoniḥ viplatākhyā tv adhāvanāt |
iti yonigadā nārī yaiḥ śukraṃ na pratīcchati |
tato garbhaṃ na nṛhṇaṇāti rogāṃś cāpnoti dāruṇān |

div2.p: ubhayataś cāsya vidhivad doṣān apahared viśeṣato virecanena |

lg.l: tvacaḥ kṣīridrumāṇāṃ ca triphalāṃ ca pacej jale |
sa kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ tena pakvaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam |
sāmānyaṃ sādhanam idaṃ vātikaṃ tu pralepayet |
na ca yāti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhṛśam |
pakvaiḥ snāyusirāmāṃsaiḥ prāyo naśyati hi dhvajaḥ ||

div2.p: tair eva ca tailaṃ vraṇaropaṇaṃ kuryāt ||
lodhratindukatriphalākṛtas tu lepas tailaṃ ca ropaṇam ||
teṣv eva ca tailaṃ vraṇaropaṇārthaṃ kurvīta ||
uttamāṃ piṭakāṃ śastreṇa cchitvā kaṣāyacūrṇapradehair madhumādbhir upācaret ||
svinnam upanāhayet trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā sālvalena |
tato bhūyaḥ svedayitvā ghṛtenābhyajya śanaiḥ śanaiś carma samānayan maṇim avapīḍayet |
niruddhamaṇau suvarṇādikṛtāṃ dārujāṃ vā jatusṛtāṃ nāḍīm ubhayatodvārāṃ snehābhyaktāṃ srotasi praṇidhāya sūkaraśiṃśumārayor vasayā majjñā vā pariṣecayet |
tṛtīye tṛtīye cāhani nāḍīṃ pīnatarāṃ vidadhyāt |
evam asya srotodvāraṃ vivardhayet snigdhaṃ cāhāraṃ bhojayet |
evam anupaśāntau śastreṇa sevanīṃ parihṛtya dārayitvā sadyaḥkṣatavad upācaret ||
vidāryādisiddhena ca tailena ropayet śarkarārbude raktavidradhivat sādhanam ||
yonivyāpadi tu vātikyāṃ lavaṇatailāktāṃ yoniṃ piṇḍanāḍīkumbhīprabhṛprabhṛtibhiḥ svedayet |
balādroṇadvayaniryūhe payasyāsālaparṇīmāgadhikāśatāvarīkākanāsāśrāvaṇīśarkarājīvanīyagarbhaṃ kṣīracaturguṇaṃ ghṛtatailāḍhakaṃ sādhayet tatpānāt sarvān vātapittavikārān apohati garbhajananaṃ ca ||
śatāvarītriphalāguḍūcīkāśmaryamṛdvīkākāsamardakaparūṣakaharidrādvayasahacaraśukanāsāpunarnavaiḥ kārṣikair ghṛtaprasthaḥ siddhaḥ pīto vātajān yonirogān apohati garbhajananaś ca ||
tenaiva cārjakamūlaṃ bilvayuktaṃ vā pippalī yuktaṃ vā |
rāsnāmālatīcchinnaruhāmadhukabalāvyāghrīdevadārucitrakayūthikāmūlaiḥ karṣāṃśais tailaprasthaḥ samūtro dviguṇapayasā vipakvaḥ picunā praṇīto 'nilārtiharaḥ ||
bastikarma cābhīṣṇaṃ svedaṃ ca prayojayed viśeṣato vātaharaiḥ sukumārabalātailaśirīṣatailaiḥ śatapākasahasra pākaiś cānuvāsanam uttarabastiṃ ca |
aticaraṇādiṣu sarvāsv anilajāsv ayam eva kramaḥ ||
dhārayec ca viplutāyāṃ gomatsyānyatarapittenaikaviṃśatikṛtvo bhāvitān kṣaumanaktakān kiṇvaṃ vā mākṣikayuktam evam asyāḥ srotāṃsi viśudhyanti kaṇḍūkledaśophāś ca nivartante ||
karṇinyāṃ tu kuṣṭhārkapallavapippalīsaindhavair bastamūtrapiṣṭair vartiṃ kṛtvā dhārayet |
udāvṛttāyām ānūpamāṃsarasāḥ kṣīraṃ svedo daśamūlatrivṛtākvāthakalkāsiddhaś ca snehaḥ pānānuvāsanottarabastiṣu |
yonisraṃse ca mahāyoniprabhṛtiṣv eṣa eva vidhiḥ ||

lg.l: śleṣmalāsu ca rūkṣoṣṇaṃ karma kuryād yathāyatham |
sannipāte vimiśraṃ tu saṃsṛṣṭāsu ca kārayet ||
snigdhasvinnāṃ tathā yoniṃ duḥsthitāṃ sthāpayet samām |
pāṇinā namayet jihmāṃ saṃvṛtāṃ prathayet punaḥ ||
sthānāpavṛttā yonir hi śalyabhūtā striyā matā ||
yac ca vātavikārāṇāṃ karmoktaṃ tac ca kārayet |
na hi vātād ṛte yonir vanitānāṃ praduṣyati |
ato jitvā tam anyasya kuryād doṣasya bheṣajam ||
śītāḥ pittajitaḥ kāryāḥ snehanārthaṃ ghṛtāni ca ||
siddhaśīte tu madhunaḥ pippalyāś ca palāṣṭakam |
śarkarāyā daśapalaṃ kṣipel lihyāt picuṃ tataḥ ||
kṣataṃ kṣayam asṛkpittaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ halīmakam ||
garbhadaṃ pittajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ paramaṃ hitam ||
tilacūrṇaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ phāṇitaṃ saukarī vasā |
varāhasya raso medhyaḥ sakaulatthaś ca tadguṇaḥ |
satārkṣyaśailaṃ lākṣāṃ vā chāgena payasā pibet |
madhukaṃ triphalāṃ lodhraṃ mustaṃ saurāṣṭrikāṃ madhu |
pibed arśasv atīsāre raktaṃ yac copaveśyate |
doṣā jantukṛtā ye ca bālānāṃ tāṃś ca nāśayet ||
piṣṭair yuktaṃ tataḥ snehapicuṃ yonau nidhāpayet |
saśakraraiḥ kaṣāyaiś ca śītaiḥ kurvīta secanam ||
picchilā vivṛtā yoniś ciraduṣṭā tu dāruṇā |
saptāhāc chudhyati kṣipram apatyaṃ ca samaśnute ||
tailaṃ kvāthena tasyaiva kāryaṃ dhāryaṃ ca pūrvavat ||
akṣamātrair ajāmūtre kṣīre ca dviguṇe pacet ||
yavānnam abhayāriṣṭaṃ sīdhu tailaṃ ca śīlayet |
āsrāve kṣaumapaṭṭān vā bhāvitāṃs tena dhārayet |
dhāryā madhukṛtā vartiḥ kaṣāyāṇāṃ ca bhūriśaḥ ||
durgandhe picchile klede stambhanaś cūrṇa iṣyate |
durgandhānāṃ kaṣāyaḥ syāt tailaṃ vā kalka eva vā |
evaṃ yoniṣu śuddhāsu garbhaṃ vindanti yoṣitaḥ |
dve niśe madhukaṃ medā dīpyakaḥ kaṭurohiṇī ||
āyuṣyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ medhyaṃ dhanyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ param ||
phalasarpir iti khyātaṃ puṣpe pītaṃ phalāya yat |
etat paraṃ ca bālānāṃ grahaghnaṃ dehavarddhanam ||

div2.p: iti śalyatantraṃ nāma pañcamam aṅgaṃ samāptam ||
purā khalv amṛtārthaṃ surāsuraiḥ salilanidher vimathyamānāt krodha iva rūpavān satvaṃ samudvabhūva kṛṣṇam analanayanam ūrdhvapradīptakeśaṃ daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ bhairavārāvarūpam |
taddarśanād eva yato devadānavāś ca viṣaṇṇās tasmāt tad viṣasaṃjñām avāpa ||
tat sahasaiva sarvabhūtāni nirdagdhukāmam upayogaviśeṣair viṣam amṛtatāṃ vinayamāno brahmānunīyauṣadhiṣu nyastavān ||
tatas tat sthāvarāsu mūrtiṣv adhivasanāt sthāvaram ity ucyate ||
jaṅgamaṃ punaḥ pṛthivyā bhārāvatārārtham uragādirūpeṇa viṣṇur nirmame ||
sarvam eva ca sthāvaraṃ jvarahidhmādantaharṣahanustambhagalagrahaphenavamanāruciśvāsamūrcchāḥ karoti viśeṣeṇa kandajam |
sarvam api caitan maulam ity ucyate mūlāśrayatvāt patrādīnām ||
tatkṛtān yathāsvam āmayān sādhanaṃ cottaratra vakṣyati ||
dvividham api caitad viṣaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣaviśadasūkṣmavyavāyyāśukārivikāśilaghvavyaktarasatvairdaśabhirguṇair yuktam apāki ca ||
tatra taikṣṇyauṣṇyāt pittaṃ raktaṃ ca prakopayati |
saukṣmyād vyavāyitvāc ca doṣadhātumalādīn samastān śarīrāvayavān anupraviśati |
lāghavād durnirharam avyaktarasatvāc chleṣmaprakopaṇam annarasāṃś ca sarvān anuvartate |
ata eva ca prayatnenānnāni viṣato rakṣed ity uktam |
mantrauṣadhabalena copaśamitam api pratyayam āsādya punaḥ prakṛpyatīti |

lg.l: sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ceti viṣaṃ proktam akṛtrimam ||
hanti yogavaśenāśu cirāc ciratarāc ca tat |
api caitad viṣaṃ sarvaṃ tīkṣṇādyair anvitaṃ guṇaiḥ |
viṣaṃ hi dehaṃ samprāpya prāg dūṣayati śoṇitam |
koṭhaḥ samaṇḍalaḥ svedo romaharṣaś ca jāyate ||
vātādayo vaśaṃ yānti balinopy abalā iva ||
viṣaṃ yad doṣabhūyiṣṭhaṃ taṃ doṣaṃ prāk prapadyate |
āśaye yasya yasyaiva tatas tad avatiṣṭhate |
taj jān vikārān kurute yān sarveṣūpadekṣyati ||
ity anyāpi ca viṣaṃ sthitam aṅge 'bhilakṣayet ||
vyāpyaivaṃ sakalaṃ deham uparudhya ca vāhinīḥ |
viṣaṃ viṣam iva kṣipraṃ prāṇān asya nirasyati ||
daṃśe tiṣṭhati bhūyiṣṭhaṃ sarvataḥ piṇḍitaṃ viṣam |
nādyād ato viśeṣeṇa teṣāṃ māṃsaṃ tadāśrayam ||
yathāsvaṃ bhakṣite pīḍā yathāsvaṃ ca kriyākramaḥ ||
sapta vegān viṣasyāhur aṣṭāv iti punarvasuḥ ||
doṣāś cāś caturthe teṣu syur yathāyatham upadravāḥ ||
pañcame pāṇḍujihvāsya śoṣaḥ ṣaṣṭhe hṛdi vyathā |
saptame maraṇaṃ vega iti gagnajito matam ||
mūrcchā hṛdi paraṃ pīḍā śirorug apatantrakaḥ |
snāvavarjaṃ tu tatsthāne doṣān icchati koṣṭhagān ||
dhātvantareṣu yāḥ sapta kalāḥ pūrvaṃ prakīrttitāḥ |
atītya tāsām ekaikāṃ vegaṃ prakurute viṣam ||
muninā yena yat tūktaṃ tat sarvam iha darśitam ||
jīrṇaṃ viṣaghnauṣadhibhir hataṃ vā davāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ vā |
svabhāvato vā na guṇaiḥ suyuktaṃ dūṣīviṣākhyāṃ viṣam abhyupaiti ||
mūrcchan vaman gadgadavāg vimuhyan bhavec ca dūṣyodaraliṅgajuṣṭaḥ ||
bhaven naro dhvasthīśaroruhāṅgo vilūnapakṣaḥ sa yathā vihaṅgaḥ |
duṣṭaṃ dūṣayate dhātūn ato dūṣīviṣaṃ smṛtam ||
jihvāyāḥ śyāvatā stambho mūrcchā trāsaḥ klamo vamiḥ ||
dvitīye vepathuḥ svedo kaṇṭhe ca vedanāḥ |
viṣaṃ cāmāśayaṃ prāptaṃ kurute hṛdi vedanām ||
tāluśoṣas tṛtīye tu śūlaṃ cāmāśaye bhṛśam |
durbale harite śūne jāyete cāsya locane ||
dvitīye pūrvavad vāntaṃ viriktaṃ cānu pāyayet |
mūrdhni kākapadaṃ kṛtvā sāsṛg vā piśitaṃ kṣipet ||
sarveṣu sarvāvastheṣu ye viṣeṣu paraṃ hitāḥ ||
candanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kāṅkṣī lākṣā priyaṅgavaḥ |
puṣye samāhṛtaiḥ piṣṭair yojyas tair agadottamaḥ ||
candanaṃ vālakaṃ mustaṃ dhyāmakaṃ kaṭukā natam |
dāḍimaṃ kuṅkumaṃ śuṇṭhī kapitthaṃ vatsakāt phalam ||
karkaṭī pūtanā keśī śvetā ca girikarṇikā |
pippalīṃ pāṭalīṃ padmāṃ śvetāṃ ca girikarṇikām |
phalīnīṃ kiṇihīṃ ceti gavāṃ pittena bhāvayet |
sūryodayo hanti viṣaṃ tamaḥ sūryodayo yathā ||
priyaṅgu tagaraṃ lākṣā mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ madhu |
raktā nataṃ vacā dantī śivaḥ śivakṛto 'gadaḥ ||
surālā pāvakī somā bhogavaty amṛtā natam |
śvetā vacā hiṅgv amṛtā sugandhā kuṣṭhasaindhavam |
eṣa māheśvaro yogo na kvacit pratihanyate ||
viṣadigdhena viddhas tu pratāmyati muhur muhuḥ |
śūyate pacyate sadyo gatvā māṃsaṃ ca kṛṣṇatām |
śalyam ākṛṣya taptena lohenānu dahed vraṇam ||
viṣāṇāṃ cālpavīryāṇāṃ yogo gara iti smṛtaḥ ||
manyate kṛṣṇam ātmānaṃ gauro gauraṃ ca kālakaḥ |
etair anyaiś ca bahubhiḥ kliṣṭo ghorair udravaiḥ |
lehaḥ praśamayaty ugraṃ sarvaṃ yogakṛtaṃ viṣam ||
haridrāṃ nākulīṃ jātīṃ pṛthak piṣṭvā vipācayet |
nāgadantī trivṛd dantī dravantī snukpayaḥ palaiḥ |
viḍaṅgaṃ candanaṃ patraṃ priyaṅgur dhyāmakaṃ balā |
eṣāṃ kalkair ghṛtaṃ siddham ajeyaṃ nāma viśrutam |
viṣāṇi hanti sarvāṇi śīghram eva prayojitam ||
gomūtrapiṣṭais taiḥ sarpiḥ siddhaṃ biṣaharaṃ param |
amṛtaṃ nāma vikhyātam api sañjīvayen mṛtam ||
sāraṃ madhūkā triphalāṃ karañjasya phalaṃ vacām ||
rajanyau lodhram akṣāṃśaṃ piṣṭvā sādhyaṃ ghṛtāḍhakam |
tathā maṇḍalisarpoktā vikārās tac ca bheṣajam ||
vibhajya yojayet ūrdhvam adhaḥ saṃśodhitaṃ ca tam |
taṃ vāmayeta madhuraiḥ pāyayed vā sitāpayaḥ ||
kūṣmāṇḍakaṃ ca saguḍaṃ bahuśas tatra bhakṣayet ||
dūṃṣīviṣārtaṃ susvinnam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca śodhitam |
yuñjyād vā viṣarogeṣu reke vyoṣādikaṃ bhiṣak ||
kolamātram ataḥ khādan jayet sarvaviṣāṇi ca ||
yathā nivāryate śīghraṃ prayuktair na tathauṣadhaiḥ ||
prakupyati viṣaṃ bhūyaḥ kevalaiś cauṣadhair jitam |
te 'pi ca vratahīnasya hīnā vā svaravarṇataḥ |
yasmān na siddhim āyānti tasmād yojyo 'gadakramaḥ ||
visarpati ghanāpāye tad agastyo hināsti ca |
nāghṛtaṃ sraṃsanaṃ śastaṃ pralepo bhojyam auṣadham |
raktage srāvayed raktaṃ pittavac ca kriyākramaḥ |
yaḥ syād asādhyaliṅgaiś ca rahitas tasya yojayet ||
āśaye yasya doṣasya viṣaṃ tiṣṭhati taṃ punaḥ |
svedo vātāśaye dadhnā pānaṃ ca natakuṣṭhayoḥ ||
bhojane ca praṇihitaṃ hanti vātāśayād viṣam ||
divyā garjanti varṣanti dyotante dyotayanti te ||
dhārayanti jagat kṛtsnaṃ kuryuḥ kruddhāś ca bhasmasāt |
dṛṅniśvāsair namas tebhyo na teṣv asti cikitsitam ||
tridhā samāsato bhaumā bhidyante te tv anekadhā |
snigdhā vicitravarṇābhis tiryag ūrdhvaṃ ca citritāḥ ||
godhāsutas tu gaudhero viṣe darvīkaraiḥ samaḥ ||
dve śate viṃśatī dve ca sā sūte tatra jāyate |
catasraḥ sambhavanty ahni viṣaṃ tāsu caturdaśe ||
vāmādharāsitā pītā tadūrdhvā dakṣiṇā tv adhaḥ |
tāḥ kramān mudgamātrotra binduḥ eṣa hi bhoginām |
viṣe vikalpo nānyeṣāṃ vidyāṃd daṣṭrās tathāparāḥ |
vyaktabhogaḥ punān dhīraḥ strī syāt tasmād viparyaye ||
astaṃgate ravau śūdrāḥ daśanti brāhmaṇāḥ puraḥ |
saṃsthitā dakṣiṇe pārśve kṣatriyā vāmato viśaḥ ||
śūdrās tu pṛṣṭhato viprās trīn apy anilapūrvakān |
kopayanti kramād doṣāṃs trīṃs trayaḥ kṣatriyādayaḥ ||
na tu daṃṣṭrākṛtaṃ daṃśaṃ tat tuṇḍāhatam ādiśet ||
ekaṃ daṃṣṭrāpadaṃ dve vā vyālīḍhākhyam aśoṇitam |
daṃṣṭrāpade sarakte dve vyāluptaṃ trīṇi tāni tu ||
nirviṣaṃ dvayam atrādyam asādhyaṃ paścimaṃ vadet ||
viṣaṃ nāheyam aprāpya raktaṃ dūṣayate vapuḥ |
raktam aṇv api tu prāptaṃ vardhate tailabinduvat ||
kadācit kurute śophaṃ sarpāṅgābhihataṃ tu tat ||
viṣodvego jvaraś charddir mūrcchā dāhopi vā bhavet |
daṃās tu saviṣaḥ sarvaḥ saśopho vedanānvitaḥ |
tudyate grathitaḥ kiñcit kaṇḍūmān dahyate bhṛśam |
śuṣkodgāro muhus te te vātajāś cāpare gadāḥ ||
āśusarvāṅgavisṛtir gadās te te ca pittajāḥ ||
kaṇṭhe ghurughuraḥ pāko kaṇḍūr akṣṇor himo jvaraḥ ||
bahuvādī ca vṛddhena cirān mandāś ca vedanāḥ ||
bālena śīghraṃ tīkṣṇāś ca kumāreṇākṣṇi dakṣiṇe |
rogī kumāryā vāme tu garbhiṇyā kṛṣṇajihvadṛk ||
śyāvatā tena vaktrādau sarpantīva ca kīṭakāḥ ||
dāho hidhmā ca ṣaṣṭhe tu hṛtpīḍā gātragauravam ||
tṛtīye daṃśavikledaḥ svedas tṛṣṇā ca jāyete |
dajṭasya rājilair duṣṭaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ yāti śoṇitam |
pāṇḍutā tena gātrāṇāṃ dvitīye gurutāti ca ||
caturthe garimā mūrdhno manyāstambhaś ca pañcame |
vākyasaṅgo jvaraḥ śītaḥ śeṣayoḥ pūrvavad vadet ||
kuryāt pañcasu vegeṣu cikitsāṃ na tataḥ param ||
deśaṃ ca vidyādhyuṣitaṃ sarpās telpaviṣā matāḥ ||
raktāsyanayanā ye ca te syur āśīviṣopamāḥ |
na teṣāṃ kālaniyamo na ca vegeṣv anukramaḥ ||
kaścij jīvati tair daṣṭo virūpo vikalo 'pi vā ||
nairṛtākhye muhūrte ca daṣṭaṃ marmasu ca tyajet ||
stabdhajihvo muhur mūrcchan śītocchvāso na jīvati ||
hidhmā śvāso vamiḥ kāso daṣṭamātrasya dehinaḥ |
jāyate yugapad yasya sa hṛcchūlī na jīvati ||
raktaṃ khebhyaḥ samastebhyo vartate na tu daṃśataḥ ||
romṇāṃ na śītalair harṣaḥ śvayathur lohitāsitaḥ |
na nasyaiś cetanā tīkṣṇair na kṣatāt kṣatajāgamaḥ |
rakṣan kaṇṭhagatān prāṇān viṣam āśu śamaṃ nayet ||
mātrāśataṃ viṣaṃ sthitvā daṃśe daṣṭasya dehinaḥ |
kuryāc chīghraṃ yathā dehe viṣavallī na rohati ||
daṣṭamātro daśed āśu tam eva pavanāśinam |
loṣṭaṃ mahīṃ vā daśanaiś chitvā vānu sasambhramam ||
kṣaumādibhir veṇikayā siddhair mantraiś ca mantravit ||
aśaktaḥ śithilo rodhduṃ viṣaṃ deśāntaraṃ vrajat ||
na vahanti sirāś cāsya viṣaṃ bandhābhipīḍitāḥ ||
karoti bhasmasāt sadyo vahniḥ ki nāma na kṣaṇāt ||
aṅgaṃ sahaiva daṃśena lepayed agadair muhuḥ |
viṣe pravisṛte vidhyet sirāṃ sā paramā kriyā ||
rakte nirddriyamāṇe hi kṛtsnaṃ nirddriyate viṣam |
duṣṭe hi vyāpnuyād aṅgaṃ dhruvaṃ mṛtyur bhavaty ataḥ ||
stambhayed ativṛttaṃ ca tair eva prāṇarakṣayā ||
yathādoṣaṃ viśuddhaṃ ca pūrvaval lakṣayed asṛk ||
bhavanti tān jayec chītair vījec cāromaharṣataḥ ||
viṣaṃ karṣati tīkṣṇatvād dhṛdayaṃ tasya guptaye |
pibed ghṛtaṃ ghṛtakṣaudram agadaṃ vā ghṛtāplutam ||
aikadhyaṃ pañcagavyaṃ vā dadhi gairikavāri vā ||
tathā mūrcchādayo na syur viṣaṃ cāśv eti nānilam ||
vamanair viṣahṛdbhiś ca naivaṃ vyāpnoti tad vapuḥ ||
susūkṣmaṃ samyag ālocya viśiṣṭāṃ cācaret kriyām ||
pānaṃ darvīkarair daṣṭe nasyaṃ madhu sapākalam ||
agadaḥ phaṇināṃ ghore viṣe rājīmatām api ||
sakṣaudro himavān nāma hanti maṇḍalināṃ viṣam |
mañjiṣṭhāṃ madhukaṃ ceti daṣṭo maṇḍalinā pibet ||
raktaṃ māṃsaṃ ca godhāyāḥ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ hitam |
kaṭabhyāś ca pibed raktagate māṃsagate punaḥ ||
sarveṣv api balāyugmaṃ madhukaṃ madanaṃ natam ||
saindhavaṃ cāñjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gavāṃ pittena kalkitam ||
puṣpaṃ ca saurāsaṃ piṣṭam añjanaṃ bastavāriṇā |
pippalīṃ ca samaṃ piṣṭvā gavyapittena pāyayet ||
jayet saṅkrāmaṇair āśu viṣaṃ śirasi saṃśritam |
dadyād adhastād daṣṭasya mūrdhni kākapade kṛte ||
viṣaṃ saṅkramate tatra nihanyāc chīghram anyathā ||
viṣaṃ hi netraṃ rūkṣasya tīkṣṇair hanti samīritam ||
śleṣmalaṃ śleṣmalair daṣṭaṃ nābher ūrdhvaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
paittikaṃ paittikair daṣṭam adho nābher viśeṣataḥ |
muhur uttiṣṭhato hy asya viṣaṃ dūṣayatenilam |
pibed vānto virikto vā yavāgūṃ viṣanāśinīm ||
atha darvīkṛtāṃ vege pūrve visrāvya śoṇitam |
dvitīye vamanaṃ kṛtvā tadvad evāgadaṃ pibet |
pibec caturthe pūrvoktāṃ yavāgūṃ vamane kṛte |
māṃsaṃ sarudhiraṃ tasya carma vā tatra nikṣipet ||
tṛtīye vāmitaḥ peyāṃ vege maṇḍalināṃ pibet |
atīkṣṇam agadaṃ ṣaṣṭhe gaṇaṃ vā padmakādikam ||
alābunā hared raktaṃ pūrvavac cāagadaṃ pibet ||
ṣaṣṭhe vegeñjanaṃ tīkṣṇam avapīḍaṃ ca yojayet |
garbhiṇībālavṛddheṣu mṛdu vidhyet sirāñ ca na ||
tvaṅmanohvā niśe vakraṃ rasaḥ śārdūlajo nakhaḥ |
hanti sarvaviṣāṇy etad vajraṃ vajram ivāsurān ||
jyotiṣmatī nataṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śvetā ca girikarṇikā ||
bilvasya mūlaṃ surasasya puṣpaṃ phalaṃ karañjasya nataṃ surāhvam |
phalatrayaṃ vyoṣaniśādvayaṃ ca bastasya mūtreṇa susūkṣmapiṣṭam ||
ārttān narān bhūtavidharṣitāṃś ca svasthīkaroty añjanapānanasyaiḥ ||
maṃjiṣṭhā tryūṣaṇaṃ tadvat kalkayet sa mahāgadaḥ ||
puṣpam āruṣkaraṃ patraṃ saurasaṃ kramukaṃ puram |
pṛṣatāc citrapatrāc ca gośṛṅge pūrvavat sthitaḥ |
pralepādyaiś ca niśśeṣaṃ daṃśād apy uddhared viṣam |
bhūyo vegāya jāyeta śeṣaṃ dūṣīviṣāya vā ||
sitā vaigandhiko drākṣā payasyā madhukaṃ madhu |
śastraṃ dūrvāṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ kuryād daṣṭasya mūrddhataḥ |
evaṃ śāmyati saptāhād viṣam ātmavataḥ sataḥ ||
tathā droṇaṃ mahādroṇaṃ mānasīṃ sarpajaṃ maṇim |
chatrī jharjharapāṇiś ca cared rātrau viśeṣataḥ |
doṣair vyastaiḥ samastaiś ca yuktāḥ kīṭāś caturvidhāḥ ||
klītaḥ kṛmiśarārī ca yaś cāpy utkleśakaḥ smṛtaḥ |
sthairyakaḥ pracalākaś ca vaṭabhaḥ kiṭibho jaṭī ||
srāvāḍhyaḥ sarvaliṅgas tu daṃśaḥ syāt sānnipātikaiḥ ||
vegāś ca sarpavac chopho varddhiṣṇur visraraktatā |
sarveṣāṃ karṇikā śopho jvaraḥ kaṇḍūr arocakaḥ ||
daṣṭasya kaṇabhaiḥ śopho visarpo vamathur jvaraḥ |
trikaṇṭakais tu daṣṭasya nānāvarṇotha vā sitaḥ |
daṃśo bhavec chvayathumān moho bhedaś ca varcasaḥ ||
daṃśo raktaiś citaḥ sphoṭaiḥ saśūlair dambhavodbhavaḥ ||
daṃśo daṣṭaḥ satṛṇnidro mūrcchāvān haritaṃ vamet ||
mātsyo daṃśaḥ sarugdāhaḥ prāg evokto jalaukasām |
kledī ca daṃśo daṣṭasya hṛspīḍā granthisambhavaḥ ||
taddaṃśo dāhakaṇḍūmāṃs tāsāṃ tu sthālikāṃ tyajet |
yat gātram ācitaṃ soṣma tad vidyād avamūtritam ||
vṛścikasya viṣaṃ tīkṣṇam ādau dahati vahnivat |
ūrdhvam ārohati kṣipraṃ daṃśe paścāt tu tiṣṭhati |
mandāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śyāvā rukṣāḥ karburamecakāḥ |
karoti sekam aṅgānāṃ daṃśaḥ śītāmbuneva ca ||
uṣṭravarṇatayā proktaḥ sa eva hy uṣṭradhūmakaḥ |
rātriko rātricārāc ca pṛthak tu kaṇabhādiṣu |
svedo nāḍīpulākādyair bṛṃhaṇaś ca vidhir hitaḥ ||
nṛkeśāḥ sarṣapāḥ pītā guḍo jīrṇaś ca dhūpanam |
viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca ||
yāti kīṭaviṣaiḥ kampaṃ na kailāsa ivānilaiḥ ||
dhūpo hanti kṛtaḥ śīghraṃ kīṭavṛścikajaṃ viṣam ||
dve bale nākulīṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śirīṣaṃ rajanīdvayam ||
rohītakaṃ ca pittena kalkayet sa varo 'gadaḥ |
sitāsite ca lavaṇe maricaṃ ca sanāgaram |
lepaḥ sukhoṣṇaś ca hitaḥ piṇyāko gomayopi vā ||
pāne sarpir madhuyutaṃ kṣīraṃ vā bhūriśarkaram |
ādaṃśe yasya kaṇḍūḥ syāt kothaḥ koṭhaṃ ca dāruṇam |
dantauṣṭhadaṃśo romṇāṃ ca harṣas tasya nivartate |
vego viṣasya pañcāhān naiva vā kriyayā vinā ||
indriyārthaṃ na jānāti prasvidyati ca yo muhuḥ |
saindhavaṃ ca vinihanty agado 'yaṃ lepato 'likulajaṃ viṣam āśu ||
kuṭajasya phalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ mālatī phalinī natam |
arkasya dugdhena śirīṣabījaṃ trir bhāvitaṃ pippalicūrṇamiśram |
svedaleśāḥ smṛtā lūtā lūne ye patitās tṛṇe ||
ye sphuliṅgā viniścerus te lūtā iti kecana ||
yathāsvaṃ dhārayantas te lūtāḥ kīṭāś ca saṃjñitāḥ ||
tatra ghoratamā lūtā bhidyante tā api tridhā |
saptāhena daśāhena pakṣeṇa ca paraṃ kramāt ||
kākāṇḍy eṇapadī lājā vaidehī jālinī tathā |
tā daśanti site pakṣe 'site sandhau sadaiva ca ||
sito 'sito 'ruṇaḥ pītaḥ śyāvo vā mṛdur unnataḥ ||
kledena yat spṛśaty aṅgaṃ tatrāpi kurute vraṇam ||
aṣṭābhir udvamanty etā viṣaṃ vaktrād viśeṣataḥ ||
pacyate cāśu pakvaś ca pāṇḍuḥ pīluphalopamaḥ |
lūtā nābher daśanty ūrdhvam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca kīṭakāḥ |
taddūṣitaṃ ca vastrādi dehe pṛktaṃ vikārakṛt ||
vikārān kurute tāṃs tān pañcame viṣakopajān |
ṣaṣṭhe vyāpnoti marmāṇi saptame hanti jīvita ||
viṣam ity atitīkṣṇānām itare vibhajed ataḥ ||
veputhur vamathur dāhas tṛḍ āndhyaṃ vakranāsatā |
dahet jāṃbavoṣṭhādyair na tu pittottaraṃ dahet ||
prasṛtaṃ sarvato daṃśaṃ na chindīta dahet vā ||
śastaḥ paryuṣito lepaḥ saghṛtaḥ paittike varṇe ||
āsphoṭagundrā ca hitā pralepaḥ ślaiṣmike viṣe ||
yathāsvaṃ kalkitair yuktaṃ pṛthag dadyād virecanam ||
śigrupāṭhā kuśavṛṣaṃ vidulaṃ ca jale pacet |
kanīyaḥ paścamūlaṃ ca tasmin maṇḍaṃ pacet ghṛtāt ||
jīvantī laśunaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ katakaṃ mārkavaṃ natam ||
pāne pralepe seke ca lūtāsu paramaṃ hitaḥ ||
surālā kaṭabhī jātiḥ śvetā ca girikarṇikā ||
lepe pāne ca lūtāsu nānena sadṛśogadaḥ ||
dehe patanti tāvatyo jāyante karṇikāḥ samam ||
viṣasya vṛddhaye tailam agner iva tṛṇolapam ||
ādaṃśe piṭakā tāmrā bhavet kapilayā sthirā |
padmābhaḥ padmayā sphoṭo bhinno 'bhinnaḥ punar bhavet |
klidyaty āśu sravaty uṣṇaṃ kledaṃ sparśe 'tirukkaraḥ ||
utthāpyate kṛṣṇam asṛg duṣṭaṃ tatra ca bheṣajam |
śūnaḥ pāṇḍūrayā daṃśaḥ śopho vaktrasya gauravam |
jvaro vighūrṇanaṃ jṛmbhā śiroruk tatra bheṣajam |
koṭhaiś ca cīyate gātraṃ tatra śastaṃ bhiṣagjitam |
trimaṇḍalāyā bahalo daṃśaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ sravaty asṛk |
chardir dāhaḥ śiraḥkampas tatra sevyaḥ samākṣikaḥ |
ādaṃśe citrayā raktā piṭakā visṛtā sthirā |
dīryate pārśvatas tais taiḥ saṃrabdhair maṇḍalair yutaḥ ||
śirokṣirugjvaraḥ kāsas tṛṇā śopho vamir bhramaḥ ||
kapilā tatra nāsāyām agnir daśati jatruṇi |
pītā tu gaṇḍayoḥ padmā dakṣiṇāṃsetha kakṣayoḥ ||
vāmapārśve daśet bhṛṅgā vāmāṃse piṅgalā daśet |
trimaṇḍalodare pūtiḥ pṛṣṭhe vīrā tu dakṣiṇe ||
kaṇṭhe raktā lalāṭe tu citrā santānikauṣṭhayoḥ ||
kākāṇḍy eṇī tu hṛdaye lājavarṇā stanāntare ||
yasminn aṅge pataty eṣāṃ śukram aṅgaiḥ spṛśanti vā |
yac chukradigdhais tatrāsre dūṣite pāṇḍutāṃ gate ||
vyavāyyākhuviṣaṃ kṛcchraṃ bhūyo bhūyaś ca kupyati ||
daṃśas tena vidaṣṭasya suptaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kṣaraty asṛk |
sarvatra saviṣe liṅgaṃ viparītaṃ tu nirviṣe ||
daṣṭo yena tu tac ceṣṭārutaṃ kurvan vinaśyati |
dagdhaṃ visrāvayed daṃśaṃ pracchitaṃ ca pralepayet |
lepo jayaty ākhuviṣaṃ karṇikāyāś ca pātanaḥ ||
tatomlaiḥ kṣālayitvā tu toyair anu ca lepayet |
anyaiś ca viṣaśophaghnaiḥ sirāṃ vā mokṣayet drutam ||
madanasya ca sañcūrṇya dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet ||
vāntasya śuddhe hṛdaye śūlaṃ hidhmārucir vamiḥ |
uṣṇodgārānubandho vā syāc cet tatraitad auṣadham ||
adhobhāge viśuddhasya śūlaṃ nābhyāṃ bhaved yadi |
purīṣaṃ vā vibadhyeta gude syād vā vikartikā ||
phaṇitaṃ tailam ājyaṃ ca viṣaghnaṃ pītam ekataḥ ||
vacā śvadaṃṣṭrā jīmūtam eṣāṃ kvāthaṃ samākṣikam |
takreṇa śarapuṅkhāyā bījaṃ sañcūrṇya vā pibet |
payaḥ payasyayā yuktaṃ sitayā madhukena ca ||
kapitthaṃ rājavṛkṣaṃ vā pibed anyatamaṃ jvarī ||
sthirāṃ mandarujāṃ pracchet karṇikāṃ pātayeta vā |
ropaṇyaḥ kalkitāstailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā sādhitaṃ tathā |
lālanena vamir mūrcchā lālāsrāvaś ca jāyate |
capalena vamir mūrcchā tṛḍ vā tatrāvalehayet |
śirīṣabījaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca madhunā tatra lehayet ||
cikireṇa śiroduḥkhaṃ śopho hidhmā vamir bhramaḥ |
sa sinduvārakau tatra sahau lihyān madhuplutau ||
granthayaḥ kokilenogrā jvaro dāhaś ca dāruṇaḥ |
kapilena vraṇe kotho jvaro granthir bhramaḥ satṛṭ |
lehayen madhunā śvetāṃ śvetāṃ cātra punarnavām ||
raktaṃ kṛṣṇena vamati viśeṣād durdine pibet |
janayanti kramād rogān sarve ca granthikarṇikāḥ ||
kvāthe dadhipayaḥ sarpiḥ pṛthak prasthonmitaṃ pacet ||
tatra sarve yathāvasthaṃ prayojyāḥ syur upakramāḥ |
yathāsvaṃ ye ca nirdiṣṭās tathā dūṣīviṣāpahāḥ ||
daṃśa tv alarkadaṣṭasya dagdham uṣṇena sarpiṣā |
pradihyād agadais tais taiḥ purāṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ pibet |
kalko muhur muhur lepaḥ śvadaṃśaviṣajit param ||
śīdhunā śvaviṣaṃ hanti pītaṃ vā taṇḍulāmbunā ||
aikadhyaṃ palalaṃ tailaṃ rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ |
sa kvāthaḥ śītalaḥ pītaḥ paraṃ śvaviṣabheṣajam ||
jalatrāse samaste ca viṣe tat garuḍopamam ||
aśuddhasya nirūḍhepi vraṇe kupyati tad viṣam ||
sthaṇḍile saritas tīre snānaṃ vāsya catuṣpathe ||
alarkajuṣṭam etaṃ me nirviṣaṃ kuru mā cirāt |
gacchanty upokṣitā nāśaṃ yair juṣṭā viṣarogiṇaḥ ||
sakṣaudraṃ vālakarajaḥ kvāthaṃ vā saguḍaṃ pibet ||
dvau bhāgau citrakād aṣṭau kuṭajād vāriṇā pibet |
śvayathau śuddhakoṣṭhasya payaḥ pāne hitaṃ śṛtam |
prāyo na sahate tīkṣṇam uṣṇaṃ vā bheṣajaṃ viṣam ||
rakte sravaty atibhṛśaṃ ghṛtaṃ samaricaṃ pibet |
śamīkalkaṃ pibec chlakṣṇam aṅgaṃ limpod viśālayā |
nāvane hemaṃ śuklā ca tataḥ śāmyati śoṇitam ||
pratikuryād yathāsvaṃ ca rogeṣv evaṃ pareṣu ca |
alpam apy avaśiṣṭaṃ hi vyādhaye maraṇāya vā ||
varddhamānam ayo bilvaṃ kṣāravat pākam āgatam |
tat lohakumbhe nihitaṃ kāryaṃ sannihitaṃ sadā ||
mātā me vijayā nāma jayo nāma pitā mama |
ajayyasya ca putrosau vijaye ca jayāmi vaḥ ||

div2.p: nidhāpayet gavāṃ śṛṅge manuṣyaṃ punar āharet | (manuṣyaṃ tena jīvayet)

lg.l: śītam eva ca kurvīta vidhānaṃ viṣarogiṇām |
jāṅgalaṃ dāḍimaṃ dhātrī kapitthaṃ saindhavaṃ sitā ||
tat tad dadyād viṣārtebhyaḥ kāryā vyañjanasaṃskṛtiḥ |

div2.p: athāto viṣopayogīyaṃ nāmādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ |

lg.l: na hi mantrasahāyasya viṣaṃ yāty avidheyatām ||
prāyaḥ pittaguṇair yuktam adhogāmi ca jaṅgamam ||
guṇair iti viparyastair nihatas te parasparam |
daṣṭasya dvau yavau kīṭais tilamātraṃ tu vṛścikaiḥ |
naiva svasṛksthe pāne tu lūtādaṣṭasya neṣyate ||
saviṣe yuktam amṛtaṃ viṣam evāviṣe viṣam |
vatssnābhaṃ ca karmaṇyaṃ viṣaṃ snigdhaṃ ghanaṃ guru |
na jātv anyat prayoktavyaṃ kālakūṭaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
kṣīrakṣaudraghṛtair yuktaṃ pītaṃ hanti viṣaṃ viṣam |
yas tu saṃroṣito bhogī dhūmaṃ vaktrād vimuñjcati |
daṇḍāgre piśitaṃ badhvā bahuśas tena daṃśayet ||
grīṣmepy ātyayike vyādhau na ca varṣāsu durdine ||
na krodhane na pittārte na klībe rājani dvije |
rūkṣam annaṃ viśeṣeṇa bhayaṃ vājīrṇataḥ sadā ||
viṣaṃ rūkṣāśinaḥ kuryān mṛtyum eva tv ajīrṇataḥ ||
viṣaṃ bṛṃhaṇam etad dhi viṣasyādau praśasyate ||
tat piben mastunā vātajvare kṣīreṇa paittike |
kṣīreṇa ca viṣaṃ yuktaṃ jīrṇajvaraharaṃ param ||
savedane sapāke ca vraṇe duṣṭe pralepanam ||
saviṣārddhapalaiḥ prasthaṃ ghṛtāt taj jīrṇabhuk pibet ||
vajravad dārayaty etad ekataḥ pītam aśmarīm ||
samūlā pippalī mūtraṃ viṣaṃ śūlaharaṃ tathā |
śvitrī viṣeṇa saṃsṛṣṭaṃ tataḥ sphoṭān kilāsajān |
dantī viṣaṃ sātiviṣaṃ pippalī maricāni ca |
tais tailṃ kaṭutailaṃ vā śvitrasyābhyañjanaṃ pacet |
viṣaṃ sarpiḥ sitā kṣaudraṃ timirāpaham añjanam |
viṣam indrāyudhaṃ stanye ghṛṣṭaṃ kācajid añjanam |
viṣaṃ māgadhikā dve ca niśe kācaghram añjanam ||
ato yathottaraṃ dadyād ayasā ca samaṃ viṣam |
pūrayet sarpiṣā cānu sarpir eva ca pāyayet |
śuṇṭhī pathyā viṣaṃ pāṭhā dravantī pūtināsajit ||
vācaḥskhalanatāṃ hanti pītam ity āha kāśyapaḥ ||

div2.p: iti viṣatantraṃ nāma ṣaṣṭham aṅgaṃ sampūrṇam ||

lg.l: dīrgham āyuḥ smṛtiṃ medhām ārogyṃa taruṇaṃ vayaḥ |
pūrve vayasi madhye vā tat prayojyaṃ jitātmanaḥ |
aviśuddhe śarīre hi yukto rāsāyano vidhiḥ |
na bhāti malasaṃsṛṣṭe vastre rāga ivārpitaḥ ||
yathaiva pauruṣaṃ tadvan na sidhyati rasāyanam ||

div2.p: sarve ca doṣā bhavanti grāmyād āhārād amlalavaṇakaṭukakṣāravirudvāsātmyarūkṣābhiṣyandiklinnagurupūtipuryuṣitanavadhānyaśuṣkaśākāmamāṃsatilakulatthadadhiśuktakāñjikapiṣṭānnavirūḍhakaniṣeviṇāṃ divāsvapnastrīmadyanityānāṃ viṣamātimātravyāyāmāyāmasaṅkṣobhitavapuṣāṃ krodhalobhabhayaśokāyāsabahulānā pāpakarmaṇām asamañjasāhāravihāranirhāraniratānām ||

ato nimittaṃ hy aviśuddhaḥ sañjāyate raso vidahyate raktaṃ śithilībhavanti māṃsāni viṣyandate medo dūṣyante doṣā vimucyante sandhayo na sandhīyantesthiṣu majjāno nāpyāyate śukraṃ naujo na balaṃ na vīryam ||

tataḥ sa evaṃbhūto glāyati sīdati nidrātandrālasyasamanvitaḥ khidyate nirvidyate nirutsāho 'samarthaḥ śārīramānasānāṃ viśiṣṭānāṃ ceṣṭānāṃ bhraṣṭacchāyo naṣṭasmṛtir alpabuddhir asampādyamānābhilaṣitārtho 'harniśam aniśam aniśaṃ niśvasann adhiṣṭhānabhūto rogāṇāṃ nopāttam api sarvam āyur avāpnoti ||
tasmāt buddhimān apāsya yathoktān āhārādidoṣān nirvāhya ca pūrvopacitān rasāyanaṃ vidhivihitam upaseveta ||
tat tu dvividhaṃ kuṭīprāveśikaṃ vātātapikaṃ ca |

tasya vidhiḥ kṣemasubhikṣadhārmikaśaddadhānajananṛpavaidyavipre sulabhamahauṣadhighṛtakṣīrapathyabhojanopakaraṇe grame nagare vā pūrvottarasyāṃ diśi prāgudakpravaṇe suvibhaktavihāroddeśe deśe dṛḍhaghanasumṛṣṭabhittim utsedhavistārasampannāṃ sūkṣmalocanāṃ trigarbhām ṛtusukhāṃ nirvātāṃ pravātaikadeśāṃ prāgdvārām udagdvārāṃ vā śamīvilvakṣīrivṛkṣaparigṛhītām aniṣṭendriyārthavātātaparajodhūmasvedakledadaṃśamaśakasarīsṛpavyālabālastrīdāsāntāvasāyinām agamyāṃ sannihitasadvaidyaparicārakopakaraṇāṃ kuṭīṃ kārayet ||

tasyāṃ rasāyanārthī śaradi vasante vā śuklapakṣe praśaste ahani pūjayitvā yathārhaṃ devaguruviprān praṇamya brahmadakṣāśviprabhṛtīn parimṛśya suvarṇaghṛtamadhusiddhārthakapriyaṅgurocanāḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gobrāhmaṇān anu praviśet ||

lg.l: tatra saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhaḥ sukhī jātabalaḥ punaḥ |
haridrāṃ pippalīṃ vellaṃ guḍaṃ coṣṇāmbunā pibet |
snigdhasvinno naraḥ pūrvaṃ tena sādhu viricyate ||
trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā saptāhaṃ vā ghṛtānvitam |
yasya yad yaugikaṃ paśyet sarvam ālocya sātmyavit ||
yasmād vijayate vyādhīn samagrān vijayā tataḥ |
abhayaṃ sarvarogebhyo bhavaty āyuś ca śāśvatam |
yataḥ śīlayatām enāṃ teneyam abhayā smṛtā ||
navā vṛttā ghanā snigdhā gurvī majjati cāpsu yā |

div2.p: atha harītakīnāṃ himavacchailasambhavānāṃ kālajātānām āpūrṇarasavīryāṇām anāmayānāṃ dviśastriśo vā śakalitānām anasthnām āḍhakaṃ caturguṇena payasā saṃsvedya mṛdubhūtam avatārya śītaṃ sarpirmadhvāḍhakābhyāṃ saṃsṛjya suguptaṃ sthāpayet |
tatas trirātrād ūrdhvam āhārānuparodhinīṃ mātrāṃ pratyaham upayojayet jīeṇe śāliṣaṣṭikaṃ payasā bhuñjīta |
asya prayogād varṣaśatam ajaro nirvalīkhalatipalitāmayaḥ śrutismṛtisampannaḥ samiddhānalaś ca puruṣo bhavati ||

lg.l: bhavaty apatyaṃ vipulaṃ sthiraṃ ca samaśnato yogam imaṃ prayatnāt ||
dve ca tailāt pacet sarvaṃ tad agnau lehatāṃ gatam ||
avatīrṇaṃ himaṃ yuñjyād viṃśaiḥ kṣaudraśatais tribhiḥ |
etad rasāyanaṃ brāhmaṃ samaṃ pūrveṇa sarvathā |
vaikhānasā bālakhilyāḥ prāśya prāptā navaṃ vayaḥ |
ghṛtasya kumbhaṃ madhukaṃ madhūkaṃ kākoliyugmaṃ ca balāṃ svaguptām |
sakṣīraśuklām ṛṣabhaṃ sajīvaṃ sukhāmbupas tac ca pibet guṇāḍhyam ||

div2.p: āmalakasahastraṃ piṣṭasvedanavidhānena kṣīroṣmaṇā susvinnam anātapaśuṣkam anasthi cūrṇayet |

tad āmalakasahasrasvarasaparipītaṃ sthirājīvantīpunarnavānāgabalāmaṇḍūkaparṇībrahmasuvarcalābhīruśaṅkhapuṣpīvacāpippalīviḍaṅgasvaguptāmṛtāgarucandanamadhukamadhūkapuṣpapadmotpalanavamālikāyuvatiyūthikācūrṇāṣṭabhāgasampṛktaṃ punar nāgabalāpalasahasrasvarasaparipītaṃ chāyopaśoṣitaṃ dviguṇitasarpiṣā kṣaudreṇa kṣudraguḍākṛti kṛtvā ghṛtabhājanasthaṃ bhasmarāśer adhaḥ sthāpayed antarbhūmeḥ pakṣam atharvavedavitkṛtarakṣaṃ pakṣātyaye coddhṛtya kanakarajatatāmrapravālakālāyaścūrṇāṣṭabhāgasaṃyuktam arddhakarṣābhivṛddhyā yathāgni prātaḥ prayojayed iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||
āmalakasahasram ārdrapalāśadroṇyāṃ sāpidhānāyāṃ bāṣpam anudvamantyām āraṇyagomayāgnibhir upasvedayet |

tāni susvinnaśītāny uddhṛtya niṣkulīkṛtāny āpothya pippalī viḍaṅgataṇḍulānāṃ pṛthag āḍhakenādhyarddhena śarkarāyāḥ ṣaḍbhir madhughṛtatailānāṃ saṃyojya ghṛtakumbhe sthāpayed viṃśatirātraṃ paraṃ copayojayed iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||
abhayāmalakasahasraṃ pippalīsahasrayuktaṃ taruṇapalāśakṣārodakenāplāvya śucau bhāṇḍe sthāpayet |

tatonugatakṣāram anātapaśuṣkam āsthirahitaṃ cūrṇayitvā sitopalāpādena caturguṇābhyāṃ ca madhughṛtābhyāṃ saṃyojya ghṛtabhājane ṣaṇmāsān antarbhūmeḥ sthāpayitvā parato yathāgnibalam upayuñjīteti samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||
āmalakacūrṇāḍhakam ekaviṃśatirātram āmalakasvarasabhāvitaṃ madhughṛtāḍhakābhyāṃ pippalīcūrṇāṣṭabhāgena śarkarācaturbhāgena ca saṃsṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtabhājanasthaṃ prāvṛṣi bhasmarāśau nidadhyāt |
tac charadi copayojayed iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||
viḍaṅgataṇḍulānām āḍhakam āḍhakaṃ pippalītaṇḍulānām adhyarddhaṃ sitopalānāṃ madhughṛtatailāḍhakaiḥ ṣaḍbhir ekīkṛtaṃ ghṛtabhājanasthaṃ prāvṛṣi bhasmarāśāv iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||

abhayāmalakabibhītakānāṃ dviśastriśo vā saṃyojitānāṃ palāśatvagavanaddhānāṃ mṛdāvaliptānāṃ kukūlasvinnānāṃ nirasthīkṛtānāṃ palasahastram ulūkhale saṅkṣudya dadhibhadhughṛtatailapalalaśarkarāsampṛktaṃ bhakṣayed anannabhug yathoktena vidhinā prayogānte tato dviguṇaṃ kālaṃ yavāgūyūṣakṣīraghṛtaṣaṣṭikānnam āhārobhyañjanaṃ sarpir udvartanaṃ yavacūrṇam iti samānaṃ pūrveṇābhyadhikaphalaṃ vā ||

lg.l: parṇinyau pippalī śṛṅgī medā tāmalakī truṭiḥ ||
jīvantī joṅgakaṃ drākṣā pauṣkaraṃ candanaṃ śaṭhī |
vidārī vṛṣamūlaṃ ca tad aikadhyaṃ palenmitam |
pādaśeṣaṃ rasaṃ tasmād vyasthīny āmalakāni ca |
ity eṣa cyavanaprāśo yaṃ prāśya cayvano muniḥ |
kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ śoṣaṃ hṛdrogaṃ vātaśoṇitam |
medhāṃ smṛtiṃ kāntim anāmayatvam āyuḥprakarṣaṃ pavanānulomyam |
strīṣu praharpaṃ balam indriyāṇām agneś ca kuryād vidhinopayuktaḥ ||
jīvaty arugjaras tasya samābhyāsāt samāḥ śatam ||
varṣaṃ khādet prāṇadāṃ prātar ekām aśnann annāt pūrvam akṣadvayaṃ ca |
sājyakṣaudraṃ bhojanānte catuṣkaṃ dhātrīkānāṃ tad vayaḥsthāpane 'lam ||

div2.p: teṣāṃ tādṛśānāṃ palaśatam āyasyāṃ sthālyāṃ prakṣipyāmalakasvarasottaraṃ kṛtvā supihitaṃ bhasmahitaṃ bhasmarāśau nikhanet |

tataś cottarakālaṃ kṛtvā vamanavirecanaṃ snigdhatanur eva kevalaṃ samantatoṅguṣṭhaparvamātramukhenāyasena sruveṇāyasa eva bhājane tasmāt kalkīkṛtāt sruvam ekaṃ gṛhītvā madhudhṛtābhyāṃ pṛthak sruveṇa saṃyojya prāśnīyāt |
jīrṇe kṣīrarasayūṣāṇām anyatamena sarpirmiśraṃ navaṃ ṣaṣṭikaudanam aśnīyāt |
anena vidhinā varṣam upayujya varṣam eva cānyad apy uddiṣṭāhāro yantritātmā kuṭīṃ samadhivaset |
tataḥ sarvopatāpān jitvā vyādhijarāmaraṇaśastrāgnitoyaviṣāṇām agamyaḥ sarvabhāveṣv atīndiryo varṣasahasradvayaṃ jīvati ||

lg.l: dīrghāyuṣo mandajaropatāpāḥ sarīsṛpāṇāṃ ca bhavanty agamyāḥ ||
madhumāgadhikāviḍaṅgasāratriphalā hema ghṛtaṃ sitāṃ ca khādan |
jarasānavalīḍhadehakāntiḥ samadhātuś ca samāḥ śataṃ ca jīvet ||
āyuṣkāmaḥ śaṅkhapuṣpyā sametaṃ medhākāmaḥ kāñcanaṃ sogragandham |
lakṣmīkāmaḥ padmakiñjalkayuktaṃ yuktaṃ khādet kāmakāmo vidāryā ||
maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ svarasaṃ yathāgni kṣīreṇa yaṣṭīmadhukasya cūrṇam |
rasaṃ guḍūcyāḥ sahamūlapuṣpyāḥ kalkaṃ prayuñjīta ca śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ ||
medhyāni caitāni rasāyanāni medhyā viśeṣeṇa tu śaṅkhapuṣpī ||
triphalā kaṭukatrayaṃ haridre sapaṭolaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca taiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ ||
triguṇena rasena śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ sapayaskaṃ ghṛtanalvaṇaṃ vipakvam |
upayujya bhavej jaḍopi vāgmī śrutadhārī pratibhānavān arogaḥ ||
peṣyair mṛṇālavisakesarapatrabījaiḥ siddhaṃ sahemaśakalaṃ payasā ca sarpiḥ |
pañcāravindam iti tat prathitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ prabhraṣṭapauruṣabalapratibhair niṣevyam ||
yan nālakandadalakesaravad vipakaṃ nīlotpalasya tad api prathitaṃ pṛthivyām |
sarpiś catuṣkuvalayaṃ sahiraṇyapatraṃ medhyaṃ gavām api bhavet kimu mānuṣāṇām ||
vaidehikā ca triyavāḥ pṛthak syur yavau suvarṇasya tilo viṣasya ||
sarpiṣaś ca palam ekata eta dyojayet pariṇate ca ghṛtāḍhyām |
bhojanaṃ samadhu vatsaram evaṃ śīlayann adhikadhīsmṛtimedhāḥ ||
atharvamantrādikṛtāś ca kṛtyāḥ śāmyanty anenātibalāś ca vātāḥ ||

div2.p: yathoktaguṇāyāṃ bhūmau jātām abālām ajīrṇāṃ śīrṇapurāṇaparṇām asañjātānyaparṇāṃ tape tapasye vā māse yathoktena vidhinā puṣyayukte candramasi sumuhurte nāgabalāṃ samūlām uddharet |
tasyā mūlānāṃ tvakpiṇḍam āmramātram akṣamātraṃ vā ślakṣṇapiṣṭam avacūrṇitaṃ vā payasā piben madhughṛtābhyāṃ vā lihyāt |
evaṃ saṃvatsaraprayogād varṣaśatam ajara ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||
tatra sāravṛkṣāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ svarasārthī kuṣṭhacikitsite khadirakalpam īkṣeta |
ārdravṛkṣāsambhave tu sāraśakalāni dvyaṅgulatryaṅgulāni tanūni caturguṇembhsyā plāvyātape trirātraṃ sthāpayet |
trirātrāc ca punar anyāny evaṃ navarātreṇa triḥprakṣepaṇoddhāreṇa ca svarasaḥ parikalpito bhavati ||
phalānāṃ punar vīrudauṣadhīnāṃ ca yantreṇolūkhalena vā saṅkṣudya niṣpīḍya svarasaṃ gṛhṇīyāt ||
pariśuṣkāṇāṃ tu cūrṇikṛtānām āḍhakam āḍhakam udakasyāhorātrasthitaṃ vimṛditapūtaṃ svarasavat prayojyam |

lg.l: tat tailaṃ sambhṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ paced āsalilakṣayāt ||
tenāsyordhvam adhastāc ca doṣā yānty asakṛt tataḥ |
pañcāhāni pibet tailam itthaṃ varjyāni varjayet |
tad eva khadirakvāthe triguṇe sādhu sādhitam |
nihitaṃ pūrvavat pakṣaṃ piben māsaṃ suyantritaḥ ||
sarpirmadhuyutaṃ pītaṃ tad eva khadirād vinā |
tad eva nasye pañcāśad divasān upayojitam |
antrdhūmaṃ tasya majjā sudagdhaḥ kṣiptas taile saindhavaṃ cāgnivarṇam |
tulyaṃ hanyād armanaktāndhyakācān nīlīrogaṃ taimiraṃ cāñjanena ||
ekāntaraṃ tauvarakañ ca tailaṃ pibed dhitāśī niyamena māsam |
prabhinnakoṣṭho galitāṅgadeśas tvacaṃ tyajet sarpaivāśu jīrṇam ||
kuryād ekatamaṃ ca sārddham athavā govāriṇāloḍitaṃ |
kuṣṭhī taddivasāsthito niraśanaḥ sūrye gate 'staṃ pibet ||
tāvad eva ca tathaiva ca bhūyaḥ pāyayet tam aruṇodayakāle |
apy ajīrṇam avicintya vamiṃ vā bheṣajaṃ puruṣadoṣabalajñaḥ ||
snāyāt sukhāmbhobhir amadyamāṃsa strīsaṅgatiḥ syāt triguṇaṃ ca yogāt ||
upayujya yogam akhilaṃ pratidinam eva dvikālam abhiyuktaḥ |

div2.p: atha bhallātakāny anupahatāny anāmayāny āpūrṇarasaprpamāṇavīryāṇi pakrajāmbavaprakāśāni śucau śukre vā māse saṅgṛhya yavapalle māṣapalle vā nidhāpayet |
tāni caturmāsasthitāni sahe sahasye vā māse prayoktum ārabheta |
śītasnigdhamadhuropaskṛtaśarīraḥ pūrvaṃ daśabhallātakāny āpothyāṣṭaguṇenāmbhasā sādhu sādhayet |
teṣāṃ rasam aṣṭabhāgāvaśiṣṭam anuṣṇaṃ sapayaskaṃ sarpirgaṇḍūṣābhyaktoṣṭhatālujihvaḥ prātaḥ pibet |
vidhinānena sahasraprayogas triguṇaś ca kālo ghṛtakṣīrābhyāṃ śāliṣaṣṭikam aśanam evaṃ viśeṣād vigatakuṣṭhadurnāmakṛmipramehamedodoṣo varṣaśatam ajara ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||
pūrvam ekaikabhallātakakvāthaṃ sapayaskaṃ pibed ekaikaṃ ca bhallātakam abhivarddhayed yāvat pañca |
tataḥ pañca pañca vardhayed yāvat saptatiḥ |
prāpya ca saptatim apakarṣayet bhūyaḥ pañca pañca yāvat pañca |
vidhinānena sahasraṃ prayoga ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||
bhallātakānāṃ jarjarīkṛtānāṃ piṣṭasvedanaṃ pūrayitvā bhūmāv ākāṇṭhanikhātasya snehabhāvitasya dṛḍhasyopari kumbhasyāropyoḍupenāpidhāya kṛṣṇabhṛdāvaliptaṃ gomayāgninopasvedayet |
teṣāṃ yaḥ svarasaḥ kumbhaṃ prapadyate tam aṣṭabhāgamadhusaṃyuktaṃ dviguṇitaghṛtam adyāt |
triguṇaś ca kālo ghṛtakṣīrābhyām ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||
anenaiva vidhinā bhallātakasya rasaṃ gṛhītvā kevalam eva māsam ekaṃ prayuñjīta |
triguṇaś ca kāla ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa |
evaṃ daśamāsān upayujya varṣasahasram āyur bhavati ||
triguṇaś ca kāla ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||

bhallātakatailaṃ kṛṣṇatilatailaṃ sarpir āmalakaraso 'sanādisārakaṣāya ity eṣāṃ droṇaṃ droṇaṃ triphalātrikaṭukaviḍaṅgasāracitrakaharidrādvayatrivṛddantīndrayavayaṣṭīmadhukaviṣātiviṣārasāñjanapriyaṅgūnāṃ pālikābhāgās tad aikadhyaṃ snehapākavidhinā vipācyāvatārya paripūya cānuguptaṃ nidadhyāt |
tata upaskṛtaśarīraḥ prātaḥ prātaḥ pāṇiśuktimātraṃ kṣaudreṇa pratisaṃsṛjyopayuñjīta |
jīrṇe mudvāmalakayūṣeṇālavaṇena sarpiṣmatā khadirodakasiddhaṃ mṛdum odanam aśnīyāt |
khadirodakenodakakāryāṇīty evam ato droṇam upayujya vigatakuṣṭhadurnāmetyādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||

lg.l: ghṛṣṭveṣṭikācūrṇakaṇair jalena prakṣālya saṃśoṣya ca mārutena ||
tad rasaṃ punar api śrapayeta kṣīrakumbhasahitaṃ caraṇasthe ||
sarpiḥ pakvaṃ tena tulyapramāṇaṃ yuñjyāt svecchaṃ śarkarāyā rajobhiḥ |
ekībhūtaṃ tat khajakṣobhaṇena sthāpyaṃ dhānye saptarātraṃ suguptam ||
tam amṛtarasapākaṃ yaḥ prage prāśam aśnann anu pibati yatheṣṭaṃ vāri dugdhaṃ rasaṃ vā |
smṛtimatibalamedhāsatvasārair upetaḥ kanakanikaṣagauraḥ sośnute dīrgham āyuḥ ||
droṇe 'mbhaso vraṇakṛtāṃ triśatād vipakvāt kvāthāḍhake palasamais tilatailapātram |
guḍena payasā ghṛtena yavasaktubhir vā saha |
tilena saha mākṣikeṇa palalena sūpena vā |
kaphajo na sa rogāsti na vibandhosti kaścana |
yaṃ na bhallātakaṃ hanyāc chīghram agnibalapradam ||
pañcāṣṭau sapta daśa vā pippalīr madhusarpiṣā |
tisras tisras tu pūrvāhne bhuktvāgre bhojanasya ca |
piṣṭās tā balibhiḥ peyāḥ śṛtā madhyabalair naraiḥ |
ghnanti śophaṃ vamiṃ hidhmāṃ plīhānaṃ vātaśoṇitam ||

div2.p: tena viśeṣād vigatakṛmidurnāmakuṣṭhapramehamedodoṣo varṣaśatam ajara ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa |
viḍaṅgacūrṇaṃ kṣaudrabhallātakakvāthābhyāṃ madhvāmalakarasābhyāṃ guḍūcīkvāthena ca etāṃś caturo yogān māsam upayuñjīteti samānaṃ pūrveṇa |
sarveṣu ca māsi māsi varṣaśatam āyuṣo 'bhivṛddhiḥ ||

lg.l: alambuṣāṃ svena rasena bhāvitāṃ pṛthag ghṛtakṣīramadhūṣṇavāribhiḥ |

div2.p: śvetāvalgujaphalāny ātapaśuṣkāṇī cūrṇayitvā tattulyaguḍena saṅkṣudya ghṛtakumbhe dhānyarāśau saptparātraṃ nidadhyāt |
tato 'nudite bhāsvati yathābalaṃ mātrāṃ sukhodakānupānām upayojayet |
tasya māsaprayogād viśeṣeṇa vigatakuṣṭho grahaṇadhāraṇavān varṣaśatam ajara ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa |
pītvā cātape nirvātoṣṇe vā garbhagṛhe tiṣṭhed aparāhṇe tadvad eva srānam aśanaṃ ca |
tasya trisaptarātraprayogād vigatakuṣṭha ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||

lg.l: tvagromakeśadaśanān nakhāṃś ca muktvā punarnavān labhate |
palāni daśa bākucyā daśaiva ca phalatrayāt |
sapta krimighnād ayasas trīṇi dve girisambhavāt ||
cūrṇayed atha tan mātrāṃ bhakṣayet pālikīṃ parām |

div2.p: tato nistuṣīkṛtya chāyāyāṃ viśoṣayitvā susūkṣmaṃ ca sañcūrṇya tryahaṃ tryahaṃ kramaśo bhāvayet triphalākvathena kāravallīvāsābrāhmīguḍūcībhṛṅgarājasvarasaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak khadirāsanarājavṛkṣapicumandakvāthaiḥ ||

lg.l: tīvreṇa kuṣṭhena parītamūrttir yaḥ somarājīṃ niyamena khādet |
ye somarājyā vituṣīkṛtāyāś cūrṇair upetāt payasaḥ sujātāt |
uddhṛtya sāraṃ madhunā lihanti takraṃ tad evānu pibanti cānte ||
khadirāmbhasā pibed vā ravisevī tāṃ tayā yavāgūṃ vā |
śvitrāṇi somarājī prasahya hanyāt pralepāc ca ||
kuryāc chāyāviśuṣkaṃ pṛthag iti ca phalaṃ prāpunāṭaṃ ca śuṣkam ||
aṃśas tābhyāṃ tathāṃśaḥ kṛmiripudahana sphoṭakṛdbhyaḥ sa cūrṇo gomūtreṇopayuktaḥ pramitahitabhujaḥ ścitram āśv eva hanti ||
upalam aghanaṃ ghanaṃ vā rasāśināṃ hanti bākucikā ||
uṣṇodakena piṣṭā pītā ca ghṛtānvitā jayet gulmam laghupañcamūlasiddhāṃ peyām upayojayej jīrṇe ||
mehān madyair nigadair niṣovitā bākucī prabalān ||
viṣkirarasena pītā daśamūlarasena vā guḍūcyā vā |
jaṭhareṣu piben mūtrair jalodare traivṛtena yūṣeṇa |
ikṣurakādikvāthair vardhmani mūtreṇa vā gavāṃ śastaḥ |
dhāroṣṇena tu payasā yuktaḥ śophajvarau hanti ||
lekhām indoḥ saghṛtāṃ sukhāmbunā putriṇī bhavati pītvā puṣṣodayeśvagandhāśṛtena payasā ca bhuñjānā ||
vandhyāpi saptāham imaṃ prayogaṃ karoti yā harṣayatī sugandhiḥ |
priyaṃvadā sadvrataśaucayuktā sūte sutān sā niyamāt guṇāḍhyān ||
snigdhair uṣṇair madhurair harati gadān vātajān yutā paittān |
gehe sthitāpi rekhā cāndramasī kimuta koṣṭhasthā ||
avalgujo mokṣayate mahābhayāc chriyaṃ ca medhāṃ ca dadāti pupkalām ||

div2.p: haimavatyā vacāyāḥ piṇḍam āmalakamātraṃ payasāloḍya pibej jīrṇe payassarpirodana ity āhāraḥ |
saptabhiḥ saptarātraiḥ śrutadharo varṣaśatam ajara ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||
itarasyā api vacāyā dvipalakvāthaṃ pibet jīrṇe payaḥ sarpir ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa |
tac cūrṇaṃ vā kṣaudrasarpibhyāṃ yathābalam avalihyāt |
jīrṇe payaḥ sarpir ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||
vacākalkaśatapākaṃ ghṛtadroṇam upayujya viśeṣāt grahonmādāpasmāragalagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāślīpadasvarabhedavimuktaḥ sarvārtheṣu siddhimān varṣaśatāyur bhavati ||

lg.l: bheṣajasya pavanopahatānāṃ vakṣyate vidhir ato laśunasya ||
amṛtasya kaṇā bhūmau te rasonatvam āgatāḥ ||
śīlayel laśunaṃ śīte vasante ca kapholbaṇaḥ |
māsaḥ parosya rasakalkaniṣevaṇāya svacchandam apy upadiśanti vimardakais tu |
ṣaṇmāsam anyavidhinā na tu śastamāhuḥ pakṣaprayogam api hīnataraṃ rasone ||
tatkāla eva vā yuktaṃ yuktam ālocya mātrayā ||
kvāthena vā yathāvyādhi rasaṃ kevalam eva vā ||
śeṣaṃ pibet klamāpāye sthiratāṃ gata ojasi ||
sahimasalilagarbhāścandraśubhrā mṛṇālīḥ kuvalayadalamālā hārayaṣṭīś ca lolāḥ |
stanataṭaviniviṣṭāś cārugātryo dadhānās tanusarasavilitā gāḍham enaṃ svajeran ||

div2.p: dayitākarapallavaiś ca śītair śunasvedakṛtaṃ klamaṃ hareyuḥ ||

lg.l: kuḍavosya parā mātrā tad arddhaṃ kevalasya tu |
palaṃ piṣṭasya tan majjñaḥ sabhaktaṃ prāk ca śīlayet ||
kuryād atas taṃ tvarito na yuñjyāt ||
bhuñjīta yūṣaiḥ payasā rasair vā dhanvacāriṇām ||
madyam ekaṃ pibet tat tu tṛṭprabandhe jalānvitam |
amadyapo yas tu phalāmbutukram avantisomaṃ ca sugandhi śītam |
sauvīrakaṃ jāṅgalajaṃ rasaṃ vā tuṣodakvaṃ vā parisikthikāṃ vā ||
sthitaṃ daśāhād aśnīyāt tadvad vā vasayā samam ||
sadyaḥ piṣṭaṃ sarpiṣā saṃyutaṃ vā niryāsena svena yuktaṃ ca kāmam |
yuñjītainaṃ pūrvakair eva pānaiḥ koṣṇāmbhobhir vaiṣa kalpotivīryaḥ ||
rasonakalkaḥ sadṛśājasarpiḥ ṣaṇmāsam urvyām uṣito nihanti |
dve tule laśunāc chruddhāt tryūṣaṇāt kuḍayatrayam ||
palaṃ tvacaś ca tac ślakṣṇaṃ nihitaṃ ghṛtabhājane |
dve same yavamadhyasthaṃ pūrvasmād adhikaṃ guṇaiḥ ||
gate ca saptarātre tu tulārddham asitāt tilāt ||
pṛthak palāṣṭakaṃ tailāt ghṛtāt kṣuṇṇāc ca sarṣapāt ||
paṭūni pañca kṣārau dvau dadyāt tatrākṣamānataḥ |
ekādaśāhaṃ tad dhānye sthitam aśnan prage prage |
guṇān rāsāyanān sarvān sa prāpnoti nirāmayaḥ ||
nimardakān vā ghṛtaśuktayuktān prakāmam adyāl laghutuccham aśnan ||
tailena gulmī khadireṇa kuṣṭhī khādet kṛmighnaiḥ kṛmimān rasonam ||
yathāyathaṃ prayogosya kāryas taṃ taṃ gadaṃ prati ||
dvāv apetamalāt kiṇvād aṣṭau piṣṭāc ca ṣaḍyavāt ||
meṣaśṛṅgībhavāt kvāthā droṇaṃ pūtāc ca śītalāt |
snehapātre tadaikadhyaṃ nidadhyāc ca śucau dṛḍhe ||
kramāt tatra punar dadyāt piṣṭaṃ prasthacatuṣṭayam |
pakṣāt param iyaṃ peyā surā vātavikāribhiḥ ||
trirātram uṣitāṃ dhenuṃ laśunaṃ khādayet tataḥ |
śuddhe vā vidyate vāyau na dravyaṃ laśunāt param ||
svapnaṃ divā jāgaraṇaṃ niśāsu piṣṭaṃ vyavāyaṃ dadhi cātra necchet ||
laśunaṃ snehasaṃyogāt garīyān jāyate hi saḥ ||
atitikṣor ajīrṇaṃ ca rasono vyāpade dhruvam ||
paitte vikārekṣigadetisāre kṣāme śarīre ca sa varjanīyaḥ ||
śīlita eṣa karoti durāpaṃ vahniśarīrabalaṃ samam eva |
amṛtakaṇasamutthaṃ yo rasonaṃ rasonaṃ vidhiyutam iti khādec chītakāle sadaiva |
sa nayati śatajīvī strīsahāyo jarāntaṃ kanakaruciravarṇo nīrujas tuṣṭijuṣṭaḥ ||
kapolakāntyā vijitaḥ śaśāṅko rasātalaṃ gacchati nirvid eva ||
snigdhāṅgatvaṃ gauratā kāntimattā vaner dīptir varṣmapuṣṭir vṛṣatvam |
samprāpyante yantraṇodvegamuktaiḥ ryasyābhyāsād dhāri dīrghaṃ sukhaṃ ca ||
apy āhāre śīlito dīrghārātraṃ balyaś cakṣuṣyas tarpaṇaḥ sthairyakārī |
tais tair yogair yojitoyaṃ palāṇḍus tāṃs tān ātaṅkān mehinām ucchinatti ||
rasaṃ rasonavat tasya pītvāśnīyāt tathaiva ca |
marakatamaṇinīlaṃ nālam asyātibālaṃ pariṇataśaśigauraṃ yac ca bījaṃ supiṣṭam |
sasurasasumukhābhyāṃ prājyamāṃsaṃ saśuktaṃ mṛdudhavalasuvṛttair maṇḍakair āttamūrtim ||
babūva tebhyaḥ kila kukkuṭī yayā vrajanti devatvam ivādya mānuṣāḥ ||
nisvilarogaharāpi viśeṣato jayati dāruṇam apy anilāmayam |
tanmātravṛttis tu bhaved daśāhaṃ viṃśatyahaṃ svādubhug apramādī |
bhuñjītālpataraṃ dinārditam ṛṣiḥ pakṣakṣaye bhakṣayan kṣīraṃ bījakavāri takram athavā pītvā sthitiṃ kalpayet |
māṃsaṃ prāśya tathā nakhadvijakacaḥ śīrṇotthitaiḥ kāntimān jīvaty abdaśatatrayaṃ dhṛtimatismṛtyādibhir bhūṣitaḥ ||
kṣīreṇa kandacūrṇaṃ piban yavāgūṃ ca pariṇate māsam |
timiraṃ kṣaudraghṛtābhyāṃ pathyabhujas tadrajo jayen māsāt |
kandatrayaṃ ca bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛteśnato bhakṣitaṃ vātān ||
trīn kandakāṃś ca niśi bhakṣayatājyabhṛṣṭān dhātrīphalāmbu sasitaṃ cahgalīpayo vā |
peyaṃ dṛgāmayajayāya niṣevitavyā kāmaṃ ca rogaśamamātraphalārthibhiḥ sā ||
vibhartti yā pallavam abdaśabdāt sā kañcukī śvetavapur vareṇyā ||
āṣāḍhe kārtike vāttaṃ tatkandaṃ śītalaṃ sthitam |
kuṭīpraveśastaṃ pītvā kṣīram eva pibed anu |
kṣīram eva ca jīrṇepi peyāṃ vā snehabharjitām ||
kiñcid uṣṇāmalavaṇāṃ spṛśed uṣṇāmbu no himam |
tyaktvā tvacaṃ tato jīrṇāṃ keśadantanakhān api |
khādan hitāśī saptāhaṃ tvagdoṣāṃs timiraṃ jayet ||
kṣīreṇa bhojanaṃ jīrṇe śāler lābarasena vā |
medhāvinaḥ praṇaśyanti gātraṃ suptaṃ ca budhyate |
snehaṃ dadhnas tato lihyāj jitātmā sasitāmadhu ||
śāler annaṃ payaḥ pānaṃ māsam evaṃ prayojayet |
śatāni pañca varṣāṇāṃ jīved deva ivorjitaḥ ||
aṣṭāṃśaśiṣṭe tu ghṛtāt prasthaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ pacet ||
pacet palāni kañcukyās trīṇi lohāt sucūrṇitāt |
palāśabījāc catvāri daśa dve ca phalatrayāt ||
vahe 'pāṃ pādaśeṣe ca pṛthag arddhāḍhakena ca |
etat somāmṛtaṃ pītvā yas somo 'dyāpi rājate ||

div2.p: idam upayujya sarpir ativīryam udāraguṇaṃ bhavati suvāk sudhīḥ sudṛḍhasubalaḥ subhagaḥ |

lg.l: vīkṣya viṣṇur amṛtaṃ kilāsṛjat gugguluṃ balavapurjayapradam ||
adyāpy ataḥ suragaṇāḥ kila dhūpamukhyān hitvā varāgaruturuṣkahimendudarpān |
nirdahyamānavapuṣṣo 'pi śikhāṃ pibanto gandhena yasya muditā dadhati prasādam ||
sa yogavāhī sa śivaḥ sa sārvaḥ sarvartusevyaḥ sukhaśīlanīyaḥ |

div2.p: yaḥ padmarāgarāgo yaḥ kanakacchedapāṭalo yo vā |

lg.l: upayoktus tathaivāsya bhava tvaṃ hi mahābala ||
laghīyasopi tadvac ca sukhoṣṇena jalena vā |
kvāthaiḥ pṛthak pathyaparasya hanti māsena ghorān kaphapittarogān ||
pibet palaśataṃ yosya vidhinā niyato yatiḥ |
nākālamṛtyor na vyādher na tasya jaraso bhayam ||
guṇanidhir api kuryāt so timātropayuktas timiravadanaśoṣaklabitākārśyamohān |
śamalaśithilabhāvaṃ deharaukṣyaṃ ca tasmād rajanicaraniṣevī syyān na rogeṣv amīṣu ||
grīṣme rkataptā girayo jatutulyaṃ vamanti yat |
śilābhyo yasya yaj jātaṃ dhātos tattadguṇaṃ vadet ||
sarvaṃ ca tiktakaṭukaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ kaṭu pākataḥ |
chedanaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa lauhaṃ tatra praśasyate ||
snigdhamanamlakaṣāyaṃ mdṛu guru ca śilājatu śreṣṭham ||
nicaye 'pi doṣabalato yogān etān vikalpya yujjīta |
vividhagaṇasaṅgrahoktais tais taiś ca gaṇair gires sāram ||
tat samarasatāṃ yātaṃ saṃśuṣkaṃ prakṣiped rase bhūyaḥ |
svai svair evaṃ kvāthair bhāvyaṃ vārān bhavet sapta ||
tryahaṃ yuñjīta girijam ekaikena tathā tryaham ||
guṇān samagrān kurute sahasā vyāpadaś ca na ||
hanyād rogān aśeṣāṃś ca jīrṇe hitamitāśinaḥ ||
upayogād api parato dviguṇaṃ parivarjayet kālam ||
kulatthān kākamācīṃ ca kapotāṃś ca sadā tyajet |
piben māhendram udakaṃ kaupaṃ prāsravaṇāmbu vā ||
śoṣī saraiḥ kravyabhugāmiṣotthair māyuramāṃsaiḥ payasā ca kārśye ||
viṣaṃ viṣaghnair agadair hanty evaṃ tad yathāmayam ||
kṣīraudanāśī yo jīrṇe yakṣmaṇā na sa bādhyate ||
śilāhvāt ṣoḍaśapalaṃ tris trir ekatra bhāvayet |
balāyā madhuyaṣṭyāś ca rase gavye ca vāriṇi |
bhāvitam itthaṃ girijaṃ dvipalaiś cūrṇīkṛtair yuñjyāt ||
tāsām ekāṃ khādet pratidinam anupānam atreṣṭam ||
saptāhamātram evaṃ sarvānnīnaḥ kramāt bhavet parataḥ |
bhaktasyānte prāgvā guṭikā na virudhyate saiṣā ||
prabalam api vātaśoṇitam ūrustambhaṃ jvaraṃ dīrgham ||
vidradhimudaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śvitraṃ jāḍyaṃ kṣayaṃ madaṃ mūrcchām |
atikārśyam atisthaulyaṃ svedam atha ślīpadaṃ gude kīlān |
pāpmālakṣmīṃ ceyaṃ guṭikā śamayec chivā nāmnā ||
kurute nṛpavallabhatāṃ jayaṃ vivāde ca vaktrasthā ||
na sosti rogo bhuvi sādhyarūpo jatvaśmajaṃ yaṃ na jayet prasahya |
tatkālayogair vidhivat prayuktaiḥ svasthasya corjāṃ vipulāṃ dadhāti ||
daśaguṇam upayuṅkte yaḥ śataṃ śailajātāl laghuhitamitabhojī varjayan varjanīyān |
satatasamanuṣaktān varjitān vaidyavṛndairvidhamati sagadaughān nekṣate cāyuṣo ntam ||
yo mandarasyātmabhuvā hitāya nyastaḥ sa śaileṣu śilājarūpī ||
kiṃcit kaṣāya ubhayaḥ śītaḥ pāke kaṭur laghuḥ |
na tanniṣevī jarasābhibhṛyate na pannagair nāpi garair na vṛścikaiḥ |
sodaśvitko mākṣikadhātuḥ saghṛto vā sakṣaudro vā kṣaudraghṛtābhyāṃ sahito vā |
sāmbhasko vā tailayuto vā vinihantā tvagdoṣāṇāṃ sarvaviṣāṇāṃ sagarāṇām ||
datvā tulyaṃ mākṣikadhātuṃ madhumiśraṃ lihyāt pāṇḍuvyādhyabhibhūtaḥ śivam icchan ||
aṃśaḥ śuṇṭhyā lohamalāṃśo badarāṃśaḥ pippalyaṃśo mākṣikadhātur dviguṇāṃśaḥ |
kṣaudraṃ kāmaṃ kṛṣṇatilānām api cāṃśaḥ śreṣṭhā piṇḍī pāṇḍuvikāraśvayathughnī ||
kṣīrāhāro yo 'valihānaḥ prayatātmā kṛtyudvāraṃ śoṣam apohaty acireṇa ||
lohaṃ sarpir mākṣikadhātur madhumātrā dhātrīcūrṇaṃ ke saramambuprabhavānām |
kṛtyaikasthaṃ mākṣikadhātuṃ triphalāṃ ca bhrāṣṭre paktvā ye sahaviṣkaṃ vilihanti |
pathyādās tān vārdhakadoṣā na bhajante māturdoṣāḥ stanyanivṛttān iva vālān ||
śanaiḥ śanair yāti jarā vināśaṃ pratyantavāsād iva lokayātrā ||
trikoṇakāṇḍā subahupratānā phaleṣu pītā kusumeṣu raktā |
bhuvi paramauṣadhir mahiṣavallarīti prathitā kvacid api vṛddhadāraka iyatvapi vellarikā ||
lihyād anu pivet kṣīraṃ jīrṇe kṣīraghṛtāśanaḥ ||
jīrṇo pūrvavad aśnīyād yo jīvet sa samāḥ śatam |
svarasena śatāvaryā saptāhaṃ bhāvitaṃ ca tat |
kṣīreṇa vā pibanmāsaṃ śataṃ jīved aruk sudhīḥ ||
tatkalkasiddhaṃ sarpir vā sa jīven nīrujaḥ śatam ||
gavyaṃ pibed anu payo māhiṣaṃ vā yatheṣṭabhuk ||
māsād uddhṛtya taṃ lehaṃ yo varṣam upayojayet |
atonyathā tu ye teṣāṃ sauryamārutiko vidhiḥ ||
sukhopacārā bhraṃśe 'pi ye na dehasya bādhakāḥ ||
śītodakaṃ payaḥ kṣaudraṃ ghṛtam ekaikaśo dviśaḥ |
triśaḥ samastam athavā prākpītaṃ sthāpayed vayaḥ ||
sarpirmadhubhyām adataḥ śarīraṃ kālāgradūtī na jarā dunoti ||
triphalām asanodakena piṣṭāṃ rajanīṃ paryuṣitām ayaḥ kapāle |
madhunā madhurāṃ lihan hinasti sthavimānaṃ jarasaṃ gadāṃś ca sarvān ||
niyamena narā niṣevitāro yadi jīvanty ajarāḥ kim atra citram ||
madhuloharajoghṛtāplutānāṃ na hi leḍhāram abhidravanti rogāḥ ||
śīlayatsu puruṣeṣu jarattāsv āgatāpi vinivarttata eva ||
harītakīṃ sarpiṣi sampratāpya samaśnatas tat pibato ghṛtaṃ ca |
bhavec cirasthāyi balaṃ śarīre sakdtkṛtaṃ sādhu yathā kṛtajñe ||
ārāccitānāṃ kalaśaṃ purāṇaṃ dhātrīphalānāṃ madhunaś ca pūrṇam |
saṃvatsarārddhaṃ nihitaṃ yaveṣu niṣevamāṇo jarasaṃ nihanti ||
niṣevamāṇasya bhaven narasya tāruṇyalāvaṇyam api praṇaṣṭam ||
navāmalakaśuktayo madhu ghṛtaṃ rajaś cāyasaṃ catuṣṭayam ayoghaṭastham iti cūrṇitaṃ vatsaram ||
krameṇa lihataḥ payo nupibataś ca pathyāśinaś ciraṃ bhavati jīvitaṃ kṣayam upaiti pṛthavījarā ||
vṛṣasthiraḥ śāntavikāraduḥkhaḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvati kṛṣṇakeśaḥ ||
arśāṃsi jantūṃś ca jayaty udīrṇān vahniṃ ca sandhukṣayati kṣaṇena ||
tailena cūrṇāni niṣevamāṇān śarīriṇo nopatapanti rogāḥ ||
jarānadīṃ rogataraṅgiṇīṃ te lāvaṇyayuktāḥ puruṣās taranti ||
viḍaṅgakalkaṃ svarasena dhātryāḥ kṣaudreṇa yuktaṃ ca piben naro yaḥ |
drākṣārasakṣaudrapariplutaṃ vā vijitya rogān sa bhavec chatāyuḥ ||
punarnavasyārddhapalaṃ palaṃ vā piṣṭaṃ pibed yaḥ payasārddhāmāsam |
māsadvayaṃ tat triguṇaṃ samāṃ vā jīrṇopi bhūyaḥ sapunarnavaḥ syāt ||
tān jīvitādhvānam abhiprapannān na vipralumpanti vikāracorāḥ ||
pītāśvagandhā payasārddhamāsaṃ ghṛtena tailena sukhāmbunā vā |
kṛśasya puṣṭiṃ vapuṣo vidhatte bālasya sasyasya yathā suvṛṣṭiḥ ||
poṣaḥ śarīrasya bhavaty analpo dṛḍhībhavanty āmaraṇāc ca dantāḥ ||
gāyatrīśikhiśiṃśapāsanaśivā vellākṣakāruṣkarān piṣṭvāṣṭau daśaṣaṭguṇembhasi dṛtān khaṇḍaiḥ sahāyomayaiḥ |
pātre lohakṛte tryahaṃ ravikarair āloḍayan pācayed agnau cānu mṛdau salohaśakalaṃ pādasthitaṃ tat pacet ||
pūtasyāṃśaḥ kṣīratoṃśas tathāṃśau bhārṅgān niryāsāt pibaryās trayo ṃśāḥ |
aṃśāś catvāras tatra hayyaṅgavīnād ekīkṛtyaitat sādhayet kṛṣṇalauhe ||
vimalayā sitayā madhunāthavā yutam ayuktam idaṃ yadi vā ghṛtam |
śrīmān nirdhūtapāpmā vanamahiṣabalo vājivegaḥ sthirāṅgo keśair bhṛṅgāṅganīlair madhusurabhimukho naikayoṣin niṣevī |
vāṅmedhādhīsamṛddhaḥ supaṭuhutavaho māsamātropayogād dhattesau nārasiṃhaṃ vapur analaśikhātaptacāmīkarābham ||
havir idam atiprabhāvaṃ svam iva vapur nirmitaṃ nṛsiṃhena |
bhṛṅgapravālān amunaiva bhṛṣṭān ghṛtena yaḥ khādati yantritātmā |
anenaiva ca kalpena yas tailam upayojayet |
tān evāpnoti sa guṇān kṛṣṇakeśaś ca jāyate ||
upayujya payo nnāśī ciraṃ jīvati kāntimān ||
mahānuśaṃsāny api cāparāṇi prāptyādikaṣṭāni na kīrttitāni ||
amānuṣāṇāmativismayānāṃ satkarmaṇāṃ yady api tāni hetuḥ |
samūlakāṣaṃ tu kaṣanti dehaṃ bhraṃśād vidhes tena vivarjitāni ||
yugasvabhāvād yadi cauṣadhīnāṃ kriyāsu śaktiḥ parikalpyate 'lpā |
āyurbalādiṣv api sā tatheti yatnān niṣevyāṇi rasāyanāni ||
na cauṣadhīnām api sarvathaiva prabhāvahāniḥ parikalpanīyā |
phalaṃ prayāty ūrdhvam adhas trivṛt tu pratyakṣataḥ kasya na siddham etat ||
nāśaṃ nayante sahasaiva dehaṃ samyak prayuktāni tathaiva vṛddhim ||
jitvā tasmād indriyādīn suduṣṭān kālopetaḥ śvaddadhāno yathāvat |
āyuḥprajñātejasāṃ yad vivṛdhyai vīryopetaṃ śīlayed auṣadhaṃ tat ||
sthiraṃ śarīraṃ kriyate śarīriṇāṃ kulaṃ yathā satpuruṣair adhiṣṭhitam ||
yathāsvam auṣadhaṃ teṣāṃ kāryaṃ muktvā rasāyanam ||
adhyākrāntā ye 'mlapaṭukṣārakaṭūṣṇair dravyais tīkṣṇaiḥ sannihitā teṣu jarattā |
sandhukṣyognis tair upajāte ca vivarjyā yogās tegnau dhātusamṛddheḥ sa hi mūlam ||
āyuryogāḥ sādhv api yuktā mṛduvahnau nairarthakyaṃ yānti kṛtaghne 'py upakārāḥ |
dīpte vahnau te tu guṇaughair api tucchā vistīryante pātranisṛṣṭā iva bhogāḥ ||
guṇair obhiḥ samuditaḥ sevate yo rasāyanam |
sa nirvṛtātmā dīrghāyuḥ paratreha ca modate ||
maṭhapraveśena vināpi siddhiṃ vrajanti goṣṭheṣu rasāyanāni ||
tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭir apatyaṃ ca guṇavat tatra saṃśritam |
tad vājīkaraṇaṃ tad dhi dehasyaujaskaraṃ param ||
striyaḥ sāddhvyaḥ prasuvate narān guṇamayān iva ||
gṛhaṃ hi jīnam etābhir na śrīmad api śobhate ||
na tu tā api śobhante jarasānugatā iva |
puṃyogena vinā strīṇāṃ sa hi saṃvananaṃ param ||
na śarīram avāpnoti na vā ratiratiḥ kṣayam ||
