yathaikaś caikaśākhaś ca nirapatyas tathā naraḥ ||
asambandho hy aputrasya nityam eva paraḥ paraḥ |
sīdaty asyāvasāne ca gṛhaṃ susthepy anāyakam |
sarveṣv ṛtuṣv ahar ahar vyavāyo na nivāryate ||
tṛptasyāpi striyo gantuṃ na śaktir upajāyate ||
na hi jātabalāḥ sarve narāś cāpatyabhāginaḥ |
narāś caṭakavat kecid vrajanti bahuśaḥ striyaḥ ||
gajavac ca prasiñcanti kecin na bahugāminaḥ |
kecit prayatnair vāhyante vṛṣāḥ kecit svabhāvataḥ ||
mede dve dve ca kākolyau sūpyaparṇyau śatāvarīm |
vīrāṃ payasyāṃ jīvantīm ṛddhiṃ rāsnāṃ trikaṇṭakam |
madhukaṃ śāliparṇīṃ ca bhāgāṃs tripalikān pṛthak ||
māṣāṇām āḍhakaṃ caitat dvidroṇe sādhayed apām |
vīrāṃ svaguptāṃ kākolyau yaṣṭīṃ phalgu dvipippalīm |
tat siddhapūtaṃ cūrṇasya pṛthak prasthena yojayet |
śarkarāyās tugāyāś ca pippalyāḥ kuḍavena ca ||
sarvaiḥ kṣīreṇa haviṣo navāt prasthaṃ śṛte 'tra ca |
palaṃ kaṇāt purobhaktaṃ lihaṃs tat palapūrvakam |
medādibhiś ca karṣāṃśaiḥ śṛtaṃ bāṣkayaṇaṃ payaḥ |
pādābhyām aspṛśan bhūmiṃ lihan kālyam ataḥ picum |
labhate valam utsāhaṃ strīś ca yāti kuliṅgavat ||
tac cūrṇaṃ prasṛtaṃ līḍhvā gacchati pramadāśatam ||
payonupānaṃ yo lihyān nityavegaḥ sa nā bhavet ||
kulīraśṛṅgyā yaḥ kalkam āloḍya payasā pibet |
uccaṭācūrṇam apy evaṃ śatāvaryāś ca yojayet ||
kṣīriṇī ca śvadaṃṣṭrā ca phāṇitaṃ śarkarā madhu |
gṛṣṭikṣīraṃ navaṃ sarpir etat puṃsavanaṃ param ||
pītvā saśarkaraṃ śītaṃ kuliṅga iva hṛṣyati ||
pādaśeṣe ca saṃcūrṇya kuḍavāṃśāḥ pṛthak kṣipet ||
vidāryā madhunaś cātra kuḍavaṃ kuḍavaṃ kṣipet |
pṛthak dvau mudgatilayor ghṛte śaṣkulikās tataḥ |
paced ekāṃ tataḥ prāśya śataṃ vrajati yoṣitām ||
payonupānās tāḥ śīghraṃ kurvanti vṛṣatāṃ param ||
cūrṇaṃ māṣāt tilāc chāler vidāryāś ca sasaindhavam |
paktvā śaṣkulikrāḥ khādann ārohet ṣaṣṭim aṅganāḥ ||
phalānām ātmaguptāyāḥ śāler māṣāt tilāt ghṛtāt ||
mudgāt godhūmataś cāpi kuḍavaṃ kuḍavaṃ pṛthak |
cūrṇitair nistuṣais tais tu kṣīreṇāloḍya marditaiḥ |
pakvāṃ pūpalikāṃ khādan strīṣu hṛṣyati vājivat ||
māyuraṃ taittiraṃ hāṃsam evam eva rasaṃ pibet |
kolavad guṭikāḥ kṛtvā tapte sarpiṣi varttayet ||
varttanastambhitās tāś ca prakṣepyāḥ kaukkuṭe rase |
yathā na bhindyād guṭikās tathā taṃ sādhayed rasam |
taṃ piban bhakṣayaṃs tāś ca balī bāleyavad vrajet |
pīto bhuktaś ca sa rasaḥ kurute śukram akṣayam ||
surānupānān yaḥ khādet sa tṛptas tarppayet striyaḥ ||
tapte sarpiṣi yaḥ khādet sa gacchet strīṣu na kṣayam ||
ghṛtaṃ māṣān sabastāṇḍān phalāmle māhiṣe rase |
svādau vā sādhayet pūtaṃ tad rasaṃ bharjayet ghṛte ||
pītaḥ sa vṛṣyo balyaś ca bṛṃhaṇaś ca paraṃ rasaḥ ||
caṭakāṃs taittire tadvat tittirīn kaukkuṭe rase |
kalpayec chikhino hāṃse haṃsān vā śikhije rase ||
tṛptiṃ caṭakamāṃsānāṃ gatvā yonu payaḥ pibet |
ghṛtāḍhyaṃ kukvuṭaṃ śūlyaṃ śītaṃ khādet samākṣikam |
pibec cānantaraṃ kṣīraṃ ya icchec chukram akṣayam ||
sādhitau bhakṣayed yas tu sa gacchet pramadāśatam ||
yaḥ khādet sasitān gacchet sa strāśatam apūvavat ||
payaḥ pibati jāgarti kṛtsnāṃ rātriṃ sa vegavān ||
śucinā vāsasā pūtaṃ yojayet prasṛtais tribhiḥ ||
śṛṅgāṭakāni capalā navaṃ sarpiḥ payo jalam |
tad vṛṣyaṃ balakṛd varṇyaṃ kaṇṭhyaṃ dehasya bṛṃhaṇam ||
vayasaḥ sthāpanaiś cetat payaḥ siddhaṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||
sitayā ca yutaṃ pītvā vṛddhopi taruṇāyate ||
maṇḍalair jātarūpasya sutaptais tat payaḥ śṛtam |
aśnaṃś ca ṣaṣṭikaṃ kṣīrasarpirbhyāṃ vājivad bhavet ||
pādalepaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā niśi vegair na hīyate ||
siddhaś caraṇalepoyaṃ bhuvaṃ padbhyāṃ tu na spṛśet ||
ikṣur ikṣurakaḥ kṣīraṃ kṣaudraṃ drākṣā sitopalā ||
ebhir bhakṣyāṇi peyāni lehyāni ca ghṛtāni ca |
yuñjīta bastīn putrārthī putrakāmoditaṃ ca yat ||
yat kiñcin madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ balavarddhanam |
manaso harṣaṇaṃ yac ca tat sava vṛṣyam ucyate ||
dravyair evaṃvidhais tasmāt bhāvitaḥ pramadāṃ vrajet |
iṣṭā hy ekaikaśopy arthā harṣaprītikarāḥ param |
kiṃ punaḥ strīśarīre ye saṅghaghātena pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
taṃ taṃ prāpya vivarddhante naraṃ rūpādayo guṇāḥ ||
tasmād yā yasya hṛdayaṃ viśatīva varāṅganā |
pāśabhūtair vahanty aṅgair lāvaṇyam iva mūrtimat |
pibantīva ca paśyantī spṛśantī limpatīva yā |
nayaty utsukatāṃ ceto nityaṃ sannihitāpi yā |
yayā viyukto niḥstrīkam aratir manyate jagat ||
pragalbhā rītasaṅgrāme svasthā lajjāmayī ca yā |
bahuśopi ca yāṃ gatvā tatpūrvam iva gacchati ||
caritair nirvikārā yā vikārair iva nirmitā |
sugandhipuṣpotkarareṇukīrṇā mṛdur manojñā vipulā ca śayyā ||
prājñāḥ kalājñā vaśagā vinītāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ prītikarā vayasyāḥ |
kāntā vanāntāḥ parapuṣṭaghuṣṭā ramyāḥ sravantyaḥ satataṃ sravantyaḥ |
madyaṃ madāmodakaraṃ viśeṣādh dṛdyā prasannā surabhiḥ prasannā ||
saudhaṃ sudhāśubhratarāḥ karāś ca candrasya kurvanti paraṃ vṛṣatvam ||
bandhena pūrvopahitena puṃsaḥ khinnasya vṛttiḥ karaṇāntareṇa |
saṃvāhanaṃ sparśasukhaiḥ karaiś ca karoty apūrvām iva manmathecchām ||
tasmān nityaṃ strīṣu vāñchan priyatvaṃ vṛṣyair yogair jātakāmo 'pi kāmī |
satvṃa sātmyaṃ deśakālau ca budhvā cātuṣṣaṣṭe ceṣṭite vyāpriyeta ||
calanūpuraśabdayuto 'pi muhuḥ śamam āvahate na ratātiśayaḥ ||
sītkāragarbhaṃ hasitaṃ sahāvaṃ chinnākṣaraṃ vibhramavac ca gītam ||
kāle yathāsvaṃ vapuṣaś ca śuddhiḥ saṅkalpayoner dhuram udvahanti ||
srotassu śudveṣv amale śarīre vṛṣyaṃ yad ādyaṃ mitam atti kāle |
vṛṣāyate tena paraṃ manuṣyas tad bṛṃhaṇaṃ dehabalapradaṃ ca ||
tasmāt purā śodhanam eva kāryaṃ balānurūpaṃ na ca vṛṣyayogāḥ |
sidhyanti dehe kaluṣe prayuktāḥ kliṣṭe yathā vāsasi rāgayogāḥ ||
etat svarūpaṃ śāstrasya yad vyāpitvena varṇyate |
munayaḥ sadayā brūyus tān yogeṣv anyathā katham ||
kathaṃ vā sarva evaite yogā rāgāgnidīpanāḥ |
pūrvācāryaiḥ kṛtaṃ vartma ko laṅghayitmum arhati ||
prakrānte sarvathā sarvam uktaṃ bhavati sūditam |
tathā ca gardabhīkṣīraṃ māṃsam aśvasya hastinām |
saṅgrahād yan na budhyeta taj jñānam atidurlabham ||
yathā pratijñātam iti krameṇa vedoyam aṣṭāṅganidher nibaddhaḥ |
yathā gṛhasya dīpābhās tathā tantrasya yuktayaḥ ||
pittāmahena lokasya smṛtvā tad idam avyayam |
idaṃ śāstram adṛṣṭīnām evam ālokakāry api |
kuryāt prayuktaṃ śastrādi saśeṣam api rogiṇam |
kuryāc cikitsitaṃ prājño na yogair eva kevalaiḥ ||
śāstratatvaṃ na vijñāya sa durātmā cikitsati ||
tebhyo rakṣet sadātmānam ātmā yasmāt sudurlabhaḥ ||
avaidyo nirghṛṇaḥ krūro yaḥ karoti bhiṣagjitam ||
naro narakapātī syāt tasya sambhāṣaṇād api ||
arājakā yathā deśā bhartṛhīnā yathā gṛhāḥ |
yajñasya hi śiraś chinnam aśvibhyāṃ sandhitaṃ punaḥ |
pātitā daśanāḥ pūṣṇo bhagasya ca vilocane ||
somān nipatito vajrī bhujastambhe ca dāruṇe ||
bhārgavaś cavanaḥ kāmī vṛddhaḥ san vikṛtiṃ gataḥ |
ebhiś cānyaiś ca bahubhiḥ karmābhīr bhiṣaguttamau |
aśvibhyāṃ sahitaḥ somaṃ prātaḥ pibati vāsavaḥ |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ ca bhagavān aśvibhyāṃ saha modate ||
aśvinoḥ kalpyate bhāgo yajñeṣu brāhmaṇair api |
aśvināv agnir indraś ca vedeṣu sutarāṃ stutāḥ ||
vaidyavity aśvinau tasmāt pūjyete vibudhair api |
ajarair amarair nityaṃ sukhitair evam ādṛtaiḥ ||
kiṃ punar bhiṣajo martyaiḥ pūjyāḥ syur nātiśaktitaḥ ||
prāṇibhiḥ pitṛvat pūjyaḥ prāṇācāryaḥ sa hi smṛtaḥ ||
na vaidyo vaidyaśabdaṃ hi labhate pūrvajanmanā ||
vidyāsamāptāv āṣa vā brahmaṃ vā bhiṣajaṃ dhruvam |
tasvam āviśati jñānāt tena vaidyo dvijaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
nāvadhyāyen na cākrośed ahitaṃ na samācaret |
prāṇācāryaṃ budhaḥ kacchid icchann āyur anaśvaram ||
bhiṣag apy āturān sarvān svasutān iva yatnavān |
te hitvā kāñcanaṃ rāśiṃ pāṃsurāśim upāsate ||
yaś chitvā yacchati prāṇān dātā nāsty eva tatsamaḥ ||
na jīvitapradānād dhi dānam anyad viśiṣyate |
kvacid dharmaḥ kvacin mitraṃ kvacid arthaḥ kvacid yaśaḥ |
karmābhyāsaḥ kvacic ceti cikitsā nāsti niṣphalā ||
nityam ādaravān vaidyas tasmād ārtān upācaret |
prāṇān sahātmanaḥ kīrtyā nihanty eṣām anādarāta ||
sarvatra maitrī karuṇātureṣu nirāmadeheṣu nṛṣu pramodaḥ |
manasy upekṣāpakṛtiṃ vrajatsu vaidyasya sadvṛttam alaṃ tanoti ||
yo nihanty āmayān vaidyaḥ sopi kenopamīyatām ||
kimuta nirāmiṣeṇa manasā karuṇāmṛdunā kṛpaṇaviśiṣṭayoḥ sadṛśam ādaram udvahatā |
atiguru bodhisatvacaritaṃ satataṃ vidadhac chamayati rogajālam api yotivirodhi mithaḥ ||
dāhaḥ śūlaṃ tṛḍ ādhmānaṃ kṣutkṣāmatvam arocakam |
kaḥ prākṛto jayed rogān nityam anyonyarodhinaḥ ||
prāṇācārthaṃ vedapāraṃ prayātaṃ budhyā yuktaṃ pūjayen nityam asmāt |
yasmin yasya prāṇayātrā nibaddhā tasmai yacchan ko dhanānāṃ dhanāyet ||
āyurvedaṃ ślokalakṣeṇa pūva brahmāmnāsīd agniveśādayas tu |
bhiṣagvaro vāgbhaṭa ity abhūn me pitāmaho nāmadharo 'smi yasya |
sutobhavat tasya ca siṃhaguptas tasyāpy ahaṃ sindhuṣu labdhajanmā ||
samadhigamya guror avalokitāt gurutarāc ca pituḥ pratibhā mayā |
pūrvoktam eva vadatā kim ivoditaṃ syāc chraddhālutuṣṭijananaṃ na bhavaty apūrvam |
saṅkṣiptasaṃśayitavistṛtaviprakīrṇaḥ kṛtsnortharāśir iti sādhu sa eva dṛṣṭaḥ ||
smṛtvedam uditaṃ pūrvaṃ śrutvedānīṃ dvayoḥ punaḥ |
smarttuḥ śrotuś ca sutarāṃ śraddhātuṃ kasya yujyate ||
athavā śrutam apy etat smartur eva kramāgatam |
ūrdhvam eti madanaṃ trivṛtādho vastumātraka iti pratipādye |
madvidho yadi vaded athavātriḥ kathyatāṃ ka iva karmaṇi bhedaḥ ||
bāliśo bhavati no khalu vidvān sūkta eva ramate matir asya ||
yad uditam iha puṇyaṃ kurvato menuvādaṃ bhavatu vigatarogo nirvṛtas tena lokaḥ ||
